requirements.title: Organisation hierarchy
requirements.statement: The platform shall represent the operator, countries, legal organisations, departments, sites, programmes and studies with stable identifiers and effective dates.
requirements.acceptance: A study can involve three organisations without merging their users, contracts or data permissions.
requirements.behaviour: Create distinct operator, legal organisation, country association, department, site, programme and study records. Link them through typed relationships with effective dates; show the hierarchy without copying permissions between nodes.
requirements.exception: Reject cycles, duplicate verified legal identities and attempts to reparent a historical study without a reviewed transfer.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study can involve three organisations without merging their users, contracts or data permissions.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Verified organisation onboarding
requirements.statement: The service shall verify an organisation's legal identity, authorised representative, institutional email domains and accountable administrator before granting institutional privileges.
requirements.acceptance: An unverified applicant can prepare an application but cannot authorise data access or approve studies.
requirements.behaviour: Submit freezes identity evidence. A different authorised verifier records verified, returned or rejected with reasons. Activation requires a verified representative, approved administrator and valid organisational terms.
requirements.exception: A returned application stays editable; an unverified institution may prepare drafts but cannot approve data or studies.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unverified applicant can prepare an application but cannot authorise data access or approve studies.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Tenant boundaries
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain separate security boundaries for organisations and explicitly authorised shared workspaces; membership in a network shall confer no implicit access.
requirements.acceptance: Cross organisation searches, direct links, exports and background jobs all reject ungranted access.
requirements.behaviour: Resolve the active organisation before register queries, shared study views and exports. A participation record exposes only explicitly shared objects; display which institution owns each asset.
requirements.exception: Use the safe unavailable response for an ungranted direct link and exclude hidden objects from counts and suggestions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Cross organisation searches, direct links, exports and background jobs all reject ungranted access.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Programme configuration
requirements.statement: Authorised managers shall configure programme objectives, eligibility, funding, countries, clinical areas, dates, owners and participant limits.
requirements.acceptance: Two programmes can apply different eligibility and funding rules to the same product.
requirements.behaviour: Save programme settings as versions. Validate dates, funding eligibility, supported country profiles and capacity; preview which open applications a change would affect before publishing the new rules.
requirements.exception: Existing submitted applications retain their original rule version until an approved transition decision is recorded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Two programmes can apply different eligibility and funding rules to the same product.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Cross organisation collaboration
requirements.statement: An organisation shall join a study through a documented invitation and agreement identifying its role, contributed assets and access expiry.
requirements.acceptance: Accepting a study invitation grants only the study permissions specified in the approved agreement.
requirements.behaviour: Invite an institutional representative with a study role, contribution, agreement and expiry. Acceptance creates pending participation; approved terms and scoped grants activate it.
requirements.exception: Decline or expiry creates no membership; acceptance cannot grant access beyond the approved participation package.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Accepting a study invitation grants only the study permissions specified in the approved agreement.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Accountability register
requirements.statement: Every active programme, study, dataset and deployment shall have an accountable institutional owner and a named operational contact with a backup.
requirements.acceptance: Removing the last accountable owner is blocked until an authorised successor accepts responsibility.
requirements.behaviour: Display the primary owner, operational contact and backup for each governed object. Reassignment requires an eligible successor to accept; dependent tasks transfer with an audit trail.
requirements.exception: Block departure or closure that would leave an active critical object without an accountable owner.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Removing the last accountable owner is blocked until an authorised successor accepts responsibility.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Lifecycle management
requirements.statement: Organisations and programmes shall support draft, active, suspended and closed states with controlled effects on invitations, jobs and existing records.
requirements.acceptance: Suspension blocks new activity while preserving authorised incident response and required evidence access.
requirements.behaviour: Activate, suspend or close through reasoned commands. Suspension stops invitations and new processing in scope, while authorised evidence preservation, incidents and remediation remain available.
requirements.exception: Resumption rechecks all prerequisites; closure fails with an itemised list of unassigned surviving obligations.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Suspension blocks new activity while preserving authorised incident response and required evidence access.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Delegated network administration
requirements.statement: Country and programme administrators shall manage only assigned institutions and configurations within centrally defined policy limits.
requirements.acceptance: A country administrator cannot change another country's rules or weaken mandatory operator controls.
requirements.behaviour: Delegation specifies managed countries, organisations, role ceilings and expiry. Preview effective powers and record a separate approver before delegated administration becomes active.
requirements.exception: Reject rules or assignments outside the delegation or below mandatory operator safeguards.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A country administrator cannot change another country's rules or weaken mandatory operator controls.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Institutional ownership changes
requirements.statement: The service shall handle mergers, renamed institutions and changes of sponsor through reviewed transfers preserving provenance and contractual restrictions.
requirements.acceptance: Historical reports retain the original legal entity and show the effective transfer date.
requirements.behaviour: Create a transfer proposal with effective date, successor acceptance and rights review. Update future responsibility only after approval; retain predecessor identity on old reports and contracts.
requirements.exception: Disputed assets or nontransferable agreements remain held and appear as unresolved transfer items.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Historical reports retain the original legal entity and show the effective transfer date.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Demonstration environment
requirements.statement: Demonstration tenants shall use approved synthetic or public demonstration data and visibly identify their nonproduction status.
requirements.acceptance: A demo administrator cannot connect a production dataset or issue a production evidence report.
requirements.behaviour: Create demonstration organisations with an immutable environment label and approved synthetic or public data catalogue. Show the label on pages and exports; issue only demonstration reports.
requirements.exception: Reject production connectors, restricted source uploads and production evidence signatures from the demonstration context.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A demo administrator cannot connect a production dataset or issue a production evidence report.
requirements.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: User invitations
requirements.statement: Invitations shall identify organisation, proposed roles, scope, inviter and expiry; acceptance shall verify the invitee and prevent reuse.
requirements.acceptance: An expired or already accepted invitation cannot create another membership.
requirements.behaviour: Invite a named person using the shared single use invitation contract. Show pending, accepted, expired and revoked states. Acceptance verifies the identity and creates only the specified membership.
requirements.exception: Resend invalidates the prior token; an already accepted or mismatched identity cannot reuse it.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An expired or already accepted invitation cannot create another membership.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Authentication
requirements.statement: Users shall authenticate through approved enterprise federation or secure local accounts; shared human accounts shall be prohibited.
requirements.acceptance: Each accepted write and approval is attributable to one uniquely identified human or service principal.
requirements.behaviour: Authenticate through a verified institutional issuer or approved local account. Resolve a unique human principal before writes and show active institution on entry.
requirements.exception: Reject shared account registration and untrusted issuer claims; failed login messages must not reveal whether an email exists.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Each accepted write and approval is attributable to one uniquely identified human or service principal.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Multifactor authentication
requirements.statement: Multifactor authentication shall be mandatory for privileged users and anyone accessing restricted data or approvals; phishing resistant methods shall be available.
requirements.acceptance: A restricted dataset remains inaccessible after password only authentication.
requirements.behaviour: Before entering restricted scope, inspect current assurance and require an approved additional factor if insufficient. Offer phishing resistant methods for privileged roles.
requirements.exception: A remembered browser or email link alone cannot satisfy a stronger factor requirement; failure preserves only safe drafts.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A restricted dataset remains inaccessible after password only authentication.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Enterprise federation
requirements.statement: The platform shall support institutional single sign on using approved SAML or OpenID Connect profiles with verified organisation mapping.
requirements.acceptance: A federated identity cannot claim an organisation or administrator role using an untrusted attribute.
requirements.behaviour: Configure federation in draft, verify domain and issuer control, map trusted claims and test a nonprivileged account before activation. Show the effect on existing members.
requirements.exception: Do not create administrator powers from arbitrary group names; preserve an approved recovery procedure for issuer outage.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A federated identity cannot claim an organisation or administrator role using an untrusted attribute.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Provisioning and deprovisioning
requirements.statement: The platform shall support managed directory provisioning, group mapping and deprovisioning, including SCIM where required by an institution.
requirements.acceptance: A directory removal revokes mapped memberships within the agreed revocation objective and creates an audit event.
requirements.behaviour: Preview directory mappings and reconcile desired against effective memberships. Apply create, update and disable events idempotently; record source identity and event version.
requirements.exception: Out of order or conflicting events enter reconciliation; deprovisioning revokes rather than deleting historical authorship.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A directory removal revokes mapped memberships within the agreed revocation objective and creates an audit event.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Account recovery
requirements.statement: Recovery shall verify identity, invalidate compromised credentials and notify the legitimate user; support staff shall not bypass multifactor controls without a reviewed recovery procedure.
requirements.acceptance: A recovery attempt cannot replace a privileged authentication factor through email access alone.
requirements.behaviour: Open a recovery case with claimed identity, risk level and independent evidence. Approved recovery replaces specified factors, revokes affected sessions and sends a notice to verified channels.
requirements.exception: A support agent cannot complete privileged recovery alone or rely solely on the potentially compromised mailbox.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A recovery attempt cannot replace a privileged authentication factor through email access alone.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Session management
requirements.statement: Users and security administrators shall view and revoke sessions; inactivity, absolute expiry and step up authentication shall follow the active risk policy.
requirements.acceptance: A revoked session fails its next protected action within the specified revocation limit.
requirements.behaviour: List sessions by device description, last activity and approximate location where lawful. Revoke one or all sessions and display pending versus effective revocation.
requirements.exception: The next protected action fails by the revocation deadline; do not claim immediate deletion of previously downloaded material.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A revoked session fails its next protected action within the specified revocation limit.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Membership changes
requirements.statement: Joiner, mover and leaver workflows shall remove obsolete privileges, reassign responsibilities and preserve authorship history.
requirements.acceptance: A departing reviewer loses active access without losing attribution on signed historical decisions.
requirements.behaviour: Run joiner, mover or leaver checklists covering privileges, tasks, ownership and service credentials. A move removes obsolete scopes before new duties begin.
requirements.exception: Departure can revoke access immediately while ownership handover remains an open operational task; attribution is retained.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A departing reviewer loses active access without losing attribution on signed historical decisions.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Temporary access
requirements.statement: Guest memberships and exceptional privileges shall have an owner, purpose, expiry and review; indefinite guest access shall be disallowed.
requirements.acceptance: Expired access is denied by both the user interface and the API without manual cleanup.
requirements.behaviour: Create temporary access with named sponsor, purpose, bounded scope and expiry. Show expiry in effective permissions and alert the owner before it lapses.
requirements.exception: No renewal is automatic; expiry denies access even if a cleanup task has not run.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Expired access is denied by both the user interface and the API without manual cleanup.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Service identities
requirements.statement: Automations and integrations shall use separately governed service identities with limited scopes, credential rotation and a named owner.
requirements.acceptance: A service credential cannot perform a human clinical signoff or inherit its owner's unrelated privileges.
requirements.behaviour: Create service principals with least privilege and a credential issue action that reveals the secret only through the approved secure channel. Track rotation and disablement separately from human departure.
requirements.exception: Reject human signoff commands and unrelated scopes; missing active owner blocks new credential issuance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A service credential cannot perform a human clinical signoff or inherit its owner's unrelated privileges.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: User preferences
requirements.statement: Users shall manage language, timezone, accessibility settings, notification channels and ordinary profile information without changing verified professional credentials.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a display name does not alter the verified signer identity on an issued report.
requirements.behaviour: Allow personal language, timezone, accessibility and ordinary notification preferences. Preview localisation and preserve exact dates and units.
requirements.exception: Verified names and credentials require a verification workflow; preference changes cannot suppress mandatory safety notifications.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Changing a display name does not alter the verified signer identity on an issued report.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Professional verification
requirements.statement: Clinical investigators, adjudicators and authorised signers shall have role specific credentials, verification evidence, validity periods and restrictions recorded.
requirements.acceptance: Expired credentials block new restricted decisions while preserving historical decisions for review.
requirements.behaviour: Submit credential evidence for an eligible verifier. Verification records permitted jurisdictions and decisions, expiry and restrictions; qualification is evaluated at assignment and signoff.
requirements.exception: Expired or suspended credentials block new decisions and trigger reassignment; old signed records retain the original verification context.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Expired credentials block new restricted decisions while preserving historical decisions for review.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Identity reconciliation
requirements.statement: Duplicate identities and changed institutional addresses shall be reconciled through verified procedures with an audit trail.
requirements.acceptance: Two accounts cannot be merged in a way that removes an existing conflict of interest declaration.
requirements.behaviour: Present suspected duplicate identities and their memberships, interests and historical signatures to an authorised reconciliation reviewer. Link verified aliases without rewriting historical actor identifiers.
requirements.exception: Merging cannot erase conflicts, sanctions or audit records; ambiguous identity remains separate and restricted pending resolution.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Two accounts cannot be merged in a way that removes an existing conflict of interest declaration.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Access recertification
requirements.statement: Institutional owners shall periodically review active users, service identities and permissions; overdue high risk access shall follow a defined suspension policy.
requirements.acceptance: The review lists actual effective privileges and records retain, reduce or revoke decisions.
requirements.behaviour: Generate periodic review campaigns showing effective grants, inherited scopes, last use and accountable owners. Reviewers record retain, reduce or revoke for each item.
requirements.exception: Overdue high risk entries follow the approved suspension policy; the campaign cannot close with unanswered required entries.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The review lists actual effective privileges and records retain, reduce or revoke decisions.
requirements.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Permission model
requirements.statement: The platform shall combine roles with organisation, country, study, dataset, purpose, sensitivity, lifecycle state and time constraints; default access shall be denied.
requirements.acceptance: A user with an evaluator role cannot read an unassigned study merely because both share a country.
requirements.behaviour: Evaluate the full context in Section 3 for each action. The inspector computes effective access for a chosen object and purpose using the same rules as runtime.
requirements.exception: Missing context, unresolved conflicts and unavailable policy verification deny the affected protected action.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A user with an evaluator role cannot read an unassigned study merely because both share a country.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Granular actions
requirements.statement: Permissions shall distinguish discover, view metadata, view records, edit, execute, approve, export, publish, administer and delete.
requirements.acceptance: Permission to view a result does not automatically permit downloading its underlying records.
requirements.behaviour: Display independent permission switches with a preview of resulting actions. Granting view does not preselect export, and granting edit does not preselect approve or publish.
requirements.exception: Reject permission combinations beyond the grantor's delegation, even if submitted outside the interface.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Permission to view a result does not automatically permit downloading its underlying records.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Independent approval
requirements.statement: The submitter or commercial beneficiary of an evaluation shall not be its sole final scientific approver; conflicting assignments shall be blocked or independently resolved.
requirements.acceptance: A developer attempting to approve its own product's final report receives a recorded denial.
requirements.behaviour: At reviewer assignment and final signature, compare verified identity and declared affiliations against the submitter, author and beneficiary. Require eligible independent signers.
requirements.exception: A conflicted sole approver is blocked; an independently accepted conflict mitigation must be scoped and visible to final reviewers.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer attempting to approve its own product's final report receives a recorded denial.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Privileged administration
requirements.statement: Platform administrators shall not receive routine access to patient data, proprietary models or sealed benchmarks by virtue of administrative status.
requirements.acceptance: An administrator can manage an account without opening that account's restricted study files.
requirements.behaviour: Separate infrastructure administration from content grants. Operators see identifiers, health and approved diagnostics; a content request opens the normal access workflow.
requirements.exception: Administrator flags cannot override restricted file, proprietary model or sealed benchmark policies.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An administrator can manage an account without opening that account's restricted study files.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Exceptional access
requirements.statement: Emergency administrative access shall require a recorded purpose, narrow scope, time limit and independent oversight; local clinical emergency procedures remain separate.
requirements.acceptance: The access session expires automatically and generates a reviewable record of every protected action.
requirements.behaviour: Create a narrow exceptional session after the approved emergency process. Display an active access banner, expiry and case reference; record each protected action for independent review.
requirements.exception: Expiry ends the elevated session; emergency administration cannot create new clinical authority or waive prohibited processing.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The access session expires automatically and generates a reviewable record of every protected action.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Permission inheritance
requirements.statement: Inherited grants, group membership and explicit restrictions shall resolve predictably; administrators shall preview effective access before changes.
requirements.acceptance: An explicit dataset restriction remains effective when a user receives a broader programme role.
requirements.behaviour: Preview direct, group and inherited grants together with explicit restrictions. Show which rule determines each action before a policy change is submitted.
requirements.exception: Broader programme access cannot override a dataset restriction; unresolved precedence is a blocking policy conflict.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An explicit dataset restriction remains effective when a user receives a broader programme role.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Uniform enforcement
requirements.statement: Authorisation shall apply to APIs, search, previews, thumbnails, aggregate reports, exports, notifications, caches and asynchronous tasks.
requirements.acceptance: A denied user's search counts and file previews do not disclose hidden objects.
requirements.behaviour: Apply authorisation to rows, snippets, counts, suggestions, thumbnails, exports, notifications, assistant retrieval and background processing. Recheck cached content before delivery.
requirements.exception: Hide existence where discovery is denied; do not return restricted fragments in diagnostics or search facets.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A denied user's search counts and file previews do not disclose hidden objects.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Access request workflow
requirements.statement: Users shall request additional access with purpose and duration; authorised data and institutional owners shall decide with reasons.
requirements.acceptance: Approval for one purpose cannot be reused for an unrelated study or training activity.
requirements.behaviour: Request access with study, purpose, dataset version, team, fields, environment and duration. Route to the owners whose rights are implicated; decisions may approve a subset.
requirements.exception: Changing purpose or adding users after approval creates a new request; denied requests retain authorised reasons and appeal path.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Approval for one purpose cannot be reused for an unrelated study or training activity.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Dual control
requirements.statement: Sensitive exports, grant of powerful roles, evidence publication and deletion under special circumstances shall require the configured independent approvals.
requirements.acceptance: One actor cannot satisfy two required approval roles on the same action.
requirements.behaviour: Create an approval package with separate slots and an exact payload digest. Each eligible signer approves that version; commitment occurs only when all mandatory slots are satisfied.
requirements.exception: One person cannot fill two independent slots; any payload change invalidates pending approvals.
requirements.fs_acceptance: One actor cannot satisfy two required approval roles on the same action.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Permission changes during work
requirements.statement: Active jobs, downloads and cached authorisations shall respond to revoked grants according to the safety and revocation policy.
requirements.acceptance: A queued export is cancelled when its grant expires before delivery.
requirements.behaviour: On revocation identify sessions, queued work, active jobs, controlled downloads and output releases. Cancel unstarted tasks and contain active processing under the approved safety procedure.
requirements.exception: A short lived link must still meet the 60 second online revocation limit; completed external downloads require recorded follow up.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A queued export is cancelled when its grant expires before delivery.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Permission explanations
requirements.statement: Authorised administrators shall inspect why access is granted or denied without disclosing restricted content to the requester.
requirements.acceptance: A support explanation identifies the missing grant and responsible approver rather than revealing protected data.
requirements.behaviour: Show authorised administrators the missing scope, assurance, expiry or condition and its owner. Provide the requester only an approved explanation and request route.
requirements.exception: Never reveal hidden asset titles, reviewer identities or policy details that would expose restricted information.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A support explanation identifies the missing grant and responsible approver rather than revealing protected data.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Conflict aware assignment
requirements.statement: Financial, employment, authorship and organisational conflicts shall affect reviewer selection and the visibility of competing submissions.
requirements.acceptance: A reviewer with a declared material conflict is excluded until an independent decision is recorded.
requirements.behaviour: Collect conflict declarations before assignment and periodically on material change. Match affiliations against the current study and competing submissions; exclude material conflicts pending independent review.
requirements.exception: A changed employer or new ownership interest triggers reassessment without erasing previous reviews or declarations.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reviewer with a declared material conflict is excluded until an independent decision is recorded.
requirements.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

requirements.title: Country profiles
requirements.statement: Each participating country shall have a versioned profile of responsible authorities, ethics routes, data restrictions, approved activities and institutional contacts.
requirements.acceptance: A study records the exact country profile version used at each gate.
requirements.behaviour: Create profiles in draft and version all authorities, permitted activities and local rules. Pin the exact profile version to each gate decision and retain prior versions.
requirements.exception: A draft profile cannot make a country operationally active or retrospectively change a signed study decision.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study records the exact country profile version used at each gate.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Applicability assessment
requirements.statement: A qualified owner shall assess each study's intended use, device status, research status and applicable legal obligations; automated suggestions shall remain advisory.
requirements.acceptance: No study becomes active with an unanswered mandatory applicability item.
requirements.behaviour: Generate study applicability questions from intended use and country scope. Qualified owners resolve required answers with evidence or a reasoned not applicable decision.
requirements.exception: An AI suggestion is visibly advisory; an unanswered mandatory item blocks only the dependent activity.
requirements.fs_acceptance: No study becomes active with an unanswered mandatory applicability item.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Rule provenance
requirements.statement: Every mandatory country rule shall record its source, effective date, interpretation owner, review date and evidence of approval.
requirements.acceptance: A source change creates a review task rather than silently changing a previously approved study.
requirements.behaviour: Require source, interpretation owner, effective date and review date for each mandatory rule. Link changes to a reviewed successor and an impact task.
requirements.exception: An unverified source or overdue mandatory interpretation cannot silently remain accepted for newly affected activity.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A source change creates a review task rather than silently changing a previously approved study.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Residency and transfer rules
requirements.statement: Profiles shall specify permitted storage, processing, support access, backup regions and cross border transfers for each data class.
requirements.acceptance: An otherwise valid workspace request is blocked when its region conflicts with the dataset policy.
requirements.behaviour: Match requested storage, compute, backups, support location and transfer path to every contributing asset policy. Display the permitted execution choices.
requirements.exception: No compatible location yields a blocking residency conflict; user preference cannot select a forbidden region.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An otherwise valid workspace request is blocked when its region conflicts with the dataset policy.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Restriction precedence
requirements.statement: The platform shall apply applicable legal restrictions, ethics conditions and contracts together; unresolved conflicts shall block the affected activity.
requirements.acceptance: A permissive programme template cannot override a stricter data use agreement.
requirements.behaviour: Resolve law, ethics, agreement and institutional restrictions as a combined policy set. Display conflicts with affected scope and qualified resolution owner.
requirements.exception: A commercial template cannot override stricter terms; incompatible rules block processing until formally resolved.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A permissive programme template cannot override a stricter data use agreement.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Local terminology and language
requirements.statement: Country profiles shall support languages, clinical guideline versions, terminology systems, currencies, units and timezone conventions.
requirements.acceptance: A measurement is not interpreted in a different unit because a user changes display language.
requirements.behaviour: Register terminology, guideline and locale versions. Show units and source language next to clinical values and require approved mappings for conversion.
requirements.exception: Changing language alters presentation only; an unknown code or unit is not interpreted by analogy.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A measurement is not interpreted in a different unit because a user changes display language.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Rule change impact
requirements.statement: Changes to country rules shall identify affected grants, studies, workspaces, reports and deployments and route decisions to accountable owners.
requirements.acceptance: Affected owners receive an actionable list with suspend, remediate or retain decisions and reasons.
requirements.behaviour: On approved rule change calculate affected grants, workspaces, studies, reports and deployments. Assign an impact decision with due date and permitted transitional treatment.
requirements.exception: Unreviewed affected activities remain restricted according to the effective rule; old findings are not silently rewritten.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Affected owners receive an actionable list with suspend, remediate or retain decisions and reasons.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Authority boundaries
requirements.statement: The platform shall distinguish internal eligibility, ethics approval, research permission, market authorisation and procurement decisions with separate issuers and scopes.
requirements.acceptance: An internal successful evaluation cannot populate a market authorisation field.
requirements.behaviour: Store internal eligibility, ethics, research, market access and procurement as separate typed records with different issuers and scopes. Present them in separate status fields.
requirements.exception: The scientific result action has no ability to populate market authorisation or procurement approval.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An internal successful evaluation cannot populate a market authorisation field.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Regulatory collaboration
requirements.statement: Participating authorities may review permitted materials through scoped workspaces and record requests without gaining unrelated institutional access.
requirements.acceptance: Two authorities reviewing the same solution see only the evidence explicitly shared with each.
requirements.behaviour: Invite an authority reviewer into a bounded review package with material scope, purpose and expiry. Record questions and their own decisions without inheriting other authority access.
requirements.exception: Requests for additional material follow a new sharing review; one authority cannot inspect another's private deliberations.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Two authorities reviewing the same solution see only the evidence explicitly shared with each.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Profile activation
requirements.statement: A country profile shall be activated only after local clinical, legal, privacy and operational owners approve the supported scope.
requirements.acceptance: Marketing cannot advertise an active clinical sandbox in a country whose profile is still draft.
requirements.behaviour: Activate a declared country scope only after local clinical, legal, privacy and operations signoff and capability checks. Publish only the activated scope to programme selection.
requirements.exception: Missing signoff keeps the profile draft or restricted; marketing configuration cannot alter operational activation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Marketing cannot advertise an active clinical sandbox in a country whose profile is still draft.
requirements.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Problem statements
requirements.statement: Institutions shall register priority problems with affected population, current workflow, baseline, comparator, intended outcome and decision owner.
requirements.acceptance: An opportunity cannot advance to funded evaluation without a defined decision and accountable institution.
requirements.behaviour: Save a need with the current process, affected population, measurable decision and named owner. Submit for feasibility only when required context is present.
requirements.exception: A vague AI topic without an institutional decision remains a draft and cannot become a commissioned evaluation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An opportunity cannot advance to funded evaluation without a defined decision and accountable institution.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Calls for solutions
requirements.statement: Managers shall publish versioned calls specifying eligibility, intended use, evidence needed, support offered, timelines and evaluation criteria.
requirements.acceptance: Applicants retain the call version under which they submitted.
requirements.behaviour: Preview and publish an approved call version. Record open and close instants and the applicant's submitted version; validate late submission against explicit programme policy.
requirements.exception: Editing an open call creates a successor and transition notice; existing applicants retain original terms unless formally changed.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Applicants retain the call version under which they submitted.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Applicant screening
requirements.statement: The service shall screen technical maturity, clinical relevance, affordability, licensing and deployment feasibility against declared criteria.
requirements.acceptance: Rejected applicants receive authorised reasons and an available reconsideration route.
requirements.behaviour: Apply a screening checklist to maturity, relevance, affordability, licence and deployment constraints. Each criterion has pass, gap or fail with evidence and reviewer.
requirements.exception: Reject or return with authorised reasons and reconsideration deadline; confidential reviewer material stays restricted.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Rejected applicants receive authorised reasons and an available reconsideration route.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Portfolio prioritisation
requirements.statement: Programme owners shall score opportunities using transparent weights for need, readiness, equity, evidence gaps, cost and adoption prospects.
requirements.acceptance: A ranking can be reproduced from its inputs and declared weights.
requirements.behaviour: Score eligible applications using the frozen rubric. Calculate weighted results only for complete valid inputs and retain individual reviewer scores and tie rules.
requirements.exception: Missing criteria cannot be treated as zero without rubric authority; discretionary overrides require reasons and approval.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A ranking can be reproduced from its inputs and declared weights.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Budget and buyer identification
requirements.statement: Each funded study shall identify its payer, budget owner, purchasing decision, available envelope and funding expiry.
requirements.acceptance: A study lacking an adoption buyer is explicitly labelled exploratory and excluded from adoption readiness claims.
requirements.behaviour: Bind a funding source, budget owner and purchasing decision to commissioned scope. Display exploratory status when adoption ownership is absent.
requirements.exception: Exploratory studies cannot enter adoption readiness metrics as if a buyer had committed.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study lacking an adoption buyer is explicitly labelled exploratory and excluded from adoption readiness claims.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Feasibility review
requirements.statement: Intake shall assess data availability, sample feasibility, reference standards, site capacity and integration constraints before commitment.
requirements.acceptance: A feasibility decision records unresolved gaps and their cost and schedule consequences.
requirements.behaviour: Complete data, sample, reference, staffing and integration feasibility before issuing a study commitment. Convert unresolved gaps into costed owner assigned tasks.
requirements.exception: A critical unresolved feasibility gap blocks commission or requires an explicitly narrower approved exploratory scope.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A feasibility decision records unresolved gaps and their cost and schedule consequences.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Demand aggregation
requirements.statement: Multiple health systems may define a shared evaluation need while retaining local thresholds and purchasing decisions.
requirements.acceptance: A shared call produces distinct country decision records rather than one universal approval.
requirements.behaviour: Link multiple institutional needs to a shared call while keeping local decision records. Reuse common descriptions but require each institution's own scope acceptance.
requirements.exception: A shared call cannot copy clinical thresholds, funding commitments or purchasing approval between countries.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A shared call produces distinct country decision records rather than one universal approval.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Pipeline management
requirements.statement: Managers shall track application status, owner, next action, age, blockers and reasons for withdrawal or rejection.
requirements.acceptance: A pipeline report separates incomplete applications from scientifically unsuccessful evaluations.
requirements.behaviour: Track first submission, current stage, accountable owner, next action and delay category. Preserve withdrawals and rejection reasons in funnel history.
requirements.exception: A returned application does not reset elapsed age; scientific failure remains distinct from administrative incompleteness.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A pipeline report separates incomplete applications from scientifically unsuccessful evaluations.
requirements.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Site registry
requirements.statement: The service shall maintain site identity, service level, location, clinical capabilities, equipment, connectivity, data assets and responsible personnel.
requirements.acceptance: A study can filter suitable sites using verified capabilities and current availability.
requirements.behaviour: Register capabilities as verified or self declared and record equipment versions and current connectivity. Searches can filter only on permitted metadata.
requirements.exception: Self declared capability cannot satisfy a formal study readiness gate until qualification verifies it.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study can filter suitable sites using verified capabilities and current availability.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Qualification and renewal
requirements.statement: Sites and specialist partners shall undergo documented due diligence, capability assessment and periodic requalification.
requirements.acceptance: An expired qualification blocks new study allocation until reviewed.
requirements.behaviour: Run qualification with scoped evidence and renewal date. Approval activates only the verified tasks and resource types; expiry removes the site from new allocations.
requirements.exception: An expired qualification triggers impact review for ongoing work rather than pretending prior evidence never existed.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An expired qualification blocks new study allocation until reviewed.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Capacity planning
requirements.statement: Sites shall publish capacity for data preparation, recruitment, evaluation and oversight with booking and overcommitment controls.
requirements.acceptance: Two programme managers cannot unknowingly allocate the same unavailable clinical capacity.
requirements.behaviour: Reserve a resource against a dated capacity window using a concurrency checked transaction. Tentative holds have explicit expiry; confirmed reservations reduce available units.
requirements.exception: Overlapping requests cannot both consume the last capacity unit; return a conflict with alternative permitted slots.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Two programme managers cannot unknowingly allocate the same unavailable clinical capacity.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Local accountability
requirements.statement: Every clinical site shall identify its principal investigator or equivalent, data custodian and escalation contacts.
requirements.acceptance: A live study cannot open a site without all required local accountable roles.
requirements.behaviour: Assign investigator, data custodian and escalation contacts to each site and study relationship. Verify active role and accepted responsibility.
requirements.exception: Opening a site fails if any required local owner or urgent backup is missing or expired.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A live study cannot open a site without all required local accountable roles.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Partner agreements
requirements.statement: Participation terms shall cover responsibilities, data access, compensation, incident reporting, publication and exit.
requirements.acceptance: An agreement expiry is visible before a new study or renewal is approved.
requirements.behaviour: Bind site participation to signed active terms covering the allocated work. Alert on expiry and surviving obligations in the capacity and study views.
requirements.exception: A new allocation cannot rely on an unsigned or expired agreement; renewal does not erase previous obligations.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An agreement expiry is visible before a new study or renewal is approved.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Expert matching
requirements.statement: Managers shall identify reviewers, statisticians and specialists by verified expertise, language, availability and conflict status.
requirements.acceptance: A match explains its eligibility and never reveals a private competing application.
requirements.behaviour: Rank eligible experts by required competence, language, availability and declared conflict status using transparent matching criteria.
requirements.exception: Do not reveal private assignments or competing applications; conflict disqualification is reviewed through ACC.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A match explains its eligibility and never reveals a private competing application.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Site performance
requirements.statement: Operational reports shall track timeliness, data quality, protocol adherence and workload without using recruitment volume as the sole quality measure.
requirements.acceptance: Performance comparisons disclose case mix and data completeness limitations.
requirements.behaviour: Report operational quality with approved definitions and denominators. Show incomplete data and case mix differences beside comparisons.
requirements.exception: Recruitment volume alone cannot determine qualification or scientific quality; metric changes are versioned.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Performance comparisons disclose case mix and data completeness limitations.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Partner suspension
requirements.statement: The service shall suspend compromised or unqualified partners, stop new access and coordinate study continuity.
requirements.acceptance: Affected studies receive a documented reassignment or safe closure plan.
requirements.behaviour: Suspend a partner with scope, reason and effective time. Block new allocations and grants and produce an affected study continuity queue.
requirements.exception: The queue remains open until qualified successors accept work or safe closure is recorded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Affected studies receive a documented reassignment or safe closure plan.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Community participation
requirements.statement: Programmes shall record community and patient representatives, consultation outcomes and responses to material concerns.
requirements.acceptance: Community feedback has an accountable response and can influence the approved protocol.
requirements.behaviour: Record community consultation topics, participants' capacity, concerns and responsible responses. Link accepted changes to protocol amendments.
requirements.exception: Confidential feedback is restricted; closing consultation requires a reasoned response to each material concern.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Community feedback has an accountable response and can influence the approved protocol.
requirements.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Product identity
requirements.statement: Each solution shall record developer, manufacturer where relevant, owner, intended use, users, population, deployment setting and prohibited uses.
requirements.acceptance: A solution cannot enter evaluation with an undefined intended population or user.
requirements.behaviour: Create a product profile with explicit intended user, population, task, setting and prohibited use. Validate responsible developer and manufacturer where applicable.
requirements.exception: Missing intended use prevents submission and cannot be filled by inferred marketing text.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A solution cannot enter evaluation with an undefined intended population or user.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Version identity
requirements.statement: Each evaluated configuration shall bind model, software, prompts, retrieval corpus, rules, preprocessing, thresholds and material dependencies to immutable version identifiers.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a decision threshold creates a new evaluated configuration rather than overwriting the old one.
requirements.behaviour: Assemble a configuration from immutable component references and parameters. Freezing records a digest and version; any material component or threshold change creates a successor.
requirements.exception: Remote models without stable provider versions carry an explicit identity limitation and cannot claim exact reproducibility.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Changing a decision threshold creates a new evaluated configuration rather than overwriting the old one.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Submission package
requirements.statement: Developers shall provide technical documentation, prior evidence, known limitations, security information, commercial terms and required runtime resources.
requirements.acceptance: Submission validation identifies missing mandatory materials before scientific review begins.
requirements.behaviour: Generate the submission checklist from study task, mode and risk. Upload documents through quarantine and show missing, pending scan, accepted or returned items.
requirements.exception: Scientific review cannot start while a mandatory item is absent or quarantined.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Submission validation identifies missing mandatory materials before scientific review begins.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Claims register
requirements.statement: Each performance or clinical claim shall identify supporting evidence, tested setting, date, limitations and whether it is independently verified.
requirements.acceptance: A developer supplied claim remains visibly distinct from a sandbox finding.
requirements.behaviour: Create claim records with exact scope and evidence links. Display developer supplied and independently verified claims with different labels and provenance.
requirements.exception: A positive result for an older configuration cannot automatically verify a new version's claim.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer supplied claim remains visibly distinct from a sandbox finding.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Regulatory status
requirements.statement: The registry shall record jurisdiction, authority, reference, scope, version and validity of reported authorisations with verification status.
requirements.acceptance: An authorisation for one use and jurisdiction is not displayed as unrestricted global clearance.
requirements.behaviour: Record external authorisation details and route verification to the qualified country owner. Show scope, validity and unverified status until evidence is checked.
requirements.exception: A document for another indication or country cannot populate the requested scope's verified status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An authorisation for one use and jurisdiction is not displayed as unrestricted global clearance.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Deployment modes
requirements.statement: Submissions shall identify hosted API, local software, container, edge device or other supported execution modes and the visibility each permits.
requirements.acceptance: A black box API submission identifies reproducibility and inspection limits before acceptance.
requirements.behaviour: Declare container, local, edge or hosted API mode and required inspection visibility. Admission binds the approved execution profile and disclosed limits.
requirements.exception: Unsupported mode remains in discovery; a black box API cannot be presented as inspected source or weights.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A black box API submission identifies reproducibility and inspection limits before acceptance.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Dependency disclosure
requirements.statement: Developers shall disclose relevant third party models, services, licences, update policies and patient data transmission.
requirements.acceptance: An undeclared external model provider prevents activation of a restricted data evaluation.
requirements.behaviour: List all external models, services and licences and the data they receive. Material dependency changes trigger rights, region and version review.
requirements.exception: An undeclared or unapproved provider blocks any run that would transmit restricted content.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An undeclared external model provider prevents activation of a restricted data evaluation.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Commercial readiness
requirements.statement: Solutions shall disclose pricing structure, licensing restrictions, implementation needs, support, maintenance and exit conditions.
requirements.acceptance: A procurement reviewer can distinguish evaluation access from production licensing rights.
requirements.behaviour: Separate evaluation licence from production licence and capture recurring fees, integration, support and exit. Present the approved terms to procurement users.
requirements.exception: Missing production rights or support is a readiness blocker, even when evaluation access is valid.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A procurement reviewer can distinguish evaluation access from production licensing rights.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Confidentiality controls
requirements.statement: Developers shall classify submission materials and propose sharing scopes subject to contractual and transparency obligations.
requirements.acceptance: Publishing a public solution profile does not expose its proprietary model files.
requirements.behaviour: Assign classification and proposed audience per artefact; preview public and partner profiles independently. Publication checks all contributing rights.
requirements.exception: Making a profile public does not release model binaries, confidential prices or patient evidence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Publishing a public solution profile does not expose its proprietary model files.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Withdrawal and recall
requirements.statement: Developers and authorised operators shall withdraw submissions or flag recalls without deleting existing findings, safety history or obligations.
requirements.acceptance: A withdrawn version is unavailable for new studies while its historical evidence remains traceable.
requirements.behaviour: Withdraw a submission or recall a configuration with reason and affected versions. Block new studies and identify active runs, reports and deployments for action.
requirements.exception: Preserve negative findings, safety history and contractual duties; withdrawal cannot delete them.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A withdrawn version is unavailable for new studies while its historical evidence remains traceable.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Comparable profiles
requirements.statement: The public and restricted catalogues shall use consistent metadata and filters for use case, evidence status, population and operating requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Search results do not rank unlike clinical tasks by a single undifferentiated accuracy score.
requirements.behaviour: Use a common profile schema and filters for intended use, population, setting and evidence status. Show comparisons only within declared compatible task and method scope.
requirements.exception: Do not sort unrelated products by a single accuracy field or imply endorsement from catalogue presence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Search results do not rank unlike clinical tasks by a single undifferentiated accuracy score.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Ownership disputes
requirements.statement: The service shall record ownership challenges, restrict disputed assets and preserve evidence while a responsible institution resolves the dispute.
requirements.acceptance: A disputed uploader cannot transfer or delete the challenged asset during a hold.
requirements.behaviour: Open an ownership dispute with claimant, evidence, affected assets and responsible institution. Apply a hold to transfer and deletion while preserving controlled review access.
requirements.exception: The challenged uploader cannot resolve its own dispute or erase evidence during the hold.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A disputed uploader cannot transfer or delete the challenged asset during a hold.
requirements.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

requirements.title: Agreement register
requirements.statement: The platform shall track participation, confidentiality, data use, processing, evaluation, licensing and site agreements with parties, versions and signatures.
requirements.acceptance: A study gate evaluates the active signed agreement rather than an unsigned draft.
requirements.behaviour: Register versions and parties, then collect verified signatures against the exact file digest. Only effective signed versions satisfy study gates.
requirements.exception: Replacing a file creates a successor and resets its signature status; unsigned drafts cannot satisfy effectiveness.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study gate evaluates the active signed agreement rather than an unsigned draft.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Rights by activity
requirements.statement: Agreements shall separately identify rights to inspect, execute, modify, fine tune, train, retain, publish and transfer assets.
requirements.acceptance: Permission to run inference does not authorise training or model weight redistribution.
requirements.behaviour: Capture separate rights for each activity and asset class. Preview whether a proposed run, adaptation, export or publication is permitted.
requirements.exception: Inference permission cannot satisfy training or redistribution checks; ambiguous rights block that activity.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Permission to run inference does not authorise training or model weight redistribution.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Evidence ownership
requirements.statement: Contracts shall specify ownership, use rights, publication rights and confidentiality for raw data, derived data, models, results and reports.
requirements.acceptance: A report export checks the rights of all contributing assets.
requirements.behaviour: Record ownership and licensed use of raw data, derived assets, models, results and reports. Resolve contributing rights when assembling an export.
requirements.exception: Restricted publication terms withhold affected content until redaction or an additional right is approved.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A report export checks the rights of all contributing assets.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Term and expiry
requirements.statement: Effective dates, renewal, termination, surviving obligations and legal holds shall drive alerts and activity restrictions.
requirements.acceptance: An expired data licence blocks new runs even if a study remains administratively open.
requirements.behaviour: Calculate effective, expiring, expired and terminated states from signed dates. Create renewal tasks and enforce the exact effective boundary.
requirements.exception: Renewal discussions do not extend rights; surviving confidentiality, retention and safety duties remain active.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An expired data licence blocks new runs even if a study remains administratively open.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Subprocessors and providers
requirements.statement: The service shall register approved processors, subprocessors, external model providers and their permitted regions and retention terms.
requirements.acceptance: A new provider cannot receive study data before its approval becomes effective.
requirements.behaviour: Approve providers for specific services, purposes, regions and data classes. Connectors and assistants reference the effective approval version.
requirements.exception: Changed provider or training terms suspend affected transmission until assessed; vendor registration alone is insufficient.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A new provider cannot receive study data before its approval becomes effective.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Funding restrictions
requirements.statement: Sponsors shall attach eligible costs, reporting rules, geographic limits, milestones and spending periods to awards.
requirements.acceptance: A charge outside the award period is flagged before invoicing or drawdown.
requirements.behaviour: Bind awards to eligible costs, geography, period and milestones. Validate commitments and charges before allocation.
requirements.exception: Out of scope costs enter a finance exception queue and cannot silently consume the award.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A charge outside the award period is flagged before invoicing or drawdown.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Independence terms
requirements.statement: Evaluation agreements shall define reviewer independence, treatment of negative results, developer response rights and final editorial authority.
requirements.acceptance: A payer cannot remove an unfavourable finding from the signed scientific record.
requirements.behaviour: Record editorial authority, negative result treatment, developer response period and appeal route as required evaluation terms.
requirements.exception: A payer cannot acquire unilateral power to replace or remove signed scientific findings.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A payer cannot remove an unfavourable finding from the signed scientific record.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Contract exceptions
requirements.statement: Proposed exceptions shall have an owner, rationale, approval, scope and expiry and shall not waive nonwaivable controls.
requirements.acceptance: A commercial discount does not modify clinical safety or data protection requirements.
requirements.behaviour: Request exceptions with affected clause, compensating measures, owner, expiry and independent decision; preview the affected activities.
requirements.exception: Reject nonwaivable law, clinical or data exceptions; a discount changes price only.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A commercial discount does not modify clinical safety or data protection requirements.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Signature integration
requirements.statement: The platform shall accept authenticated signatures or verified external signed documents with signer identity and document integrity.
requirements.acceptance: Replacing an agreement file invalidates its prior signature association.
requirements.behaviour: Accept an approved signature response or verify an external signed file. Bind signers, document bytes, time and verification evidence.
requirements.exception: Invalid integrity or unknown signer capacity leaves the agreement pending; retries cannot duplicate signatures.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Replacing an agreement file invalidates its prior signature association.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Liability allocation
requirements.statement: The service shall record responsibilities for care, product performance, study conduct, data handling, insurance where required and incident response.
requirements.acceptance: Activation is blocked where a required responsibility or coverage obligation is unresolved.
requirements.behaviour: Require accepted responsibility for care, study, product, data and incidents; verify required insurance scope and period.
requirements.exception: Unassigned responsibility or expired required coverage blocks the dependent activation gate.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Activation is blocked where a required responsibility or coverage obligation is unresolved.
requirements.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

requirements.title: Configurable gates
requirements.statement: Workflows shall define mandatory evidence, responsible roles, dependencies and permitted transitions by study type and country.
requirements.acceptance: Users cannot skip an applicable ethics or data gate by changing a display status.
requirements.behaviour: Instantiate gates from study type and effective country profiles. Show required evidence and use the Section 5 transition guards.
requirements.exception: Changing a display status or template cannot skip mandatory gates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Users cannot skip an applicable ethics or data gate by changing a display status.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Task orchestration
requirements.statement: The platform shall assign tasks, deadlines, dependencies, reminders and escalation paths with clear ownership.
requirements.acceptance: A blocked task shows the dependency and accountable party rather than an unexplained delay.
requirements.behaviour: Create dependent tasks with owners, due dates and escalation. Mark actionable only when prerequisites are satisfied.
requirements.exception: Departure routes the task to accountable owner and backup; it never completes the task automatically.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A blocked task shows the dependency and accountable party rather than an unexplained delay.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Decision records
requirements.statement: Each gate decision shall record decision, scope, evidence versions, conditions, reasons, signer and timestamp.
requirements.acceptance: A report can reconstruct precisely which documents supported the decision.
requirements.behaviour: Present the exact evidence snapshot and scope. Commit decision, conditions and audit together after eligible signature.
requirements.exception: Stale evidence or expired competence returns a blocker; no partial approval is recorded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A report can reconstruct precisely which documents supported the decision.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Parallel review
requirements.statement: Independent reviewers shall work concurrently where appropriate with controlled visibility and conflict checks.
requirements.acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see another review before its permitted unblinding point.
requirements.behaviour: Assign independent parallel review lanes with configured blinding. Lock each review before permitted comparison.
requirements.exception: Comments, exports and notifications preserve blinding; early disclosure becomes a deviation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see another review before its permitted unblinding point.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Conditional decisions
