requirements.statement: Approvals with conditions shall record measurable obligations, responsible owners and expiry or recheck triggers.
requirements.acceptance: An unmet prerequisite condition prevents the dependent activity from starting.
requirements.behaviour: Classify every condition as execution prerequisite or permitted follow up, with measurable completion and owner.
requirements.exception: Unmet prerequisites block dependent action; vague conditions require clarification before decision acceptance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unmet prerequisite condition prevents the dependent activity from starting.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Rework and resubmission
requirements.statement: Applicants shall answer queries and resubmit versioned materials without destroying earlier reviews.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewers can compare the changed material and distinguish new evidence from unchanged claims.
requirements.behaviour: Return itemised queries and accept a versioned resubmission with comparison. Preserve original review and first submission time.
requirements.exception: Reviewers acknowledge changed material; unchanged evidence is reused only within continuing validity.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Reviewers can compare the changed material and distinguish new evidence from unchanged claims.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Appeals
requirements.statement: Applicants shall have an auditable appeal route with grounds, deadlines and an independent reviewer or panel.
requirements.acceptance: The original decision maker cannot be the sole adjudicator of the appeal.
requirements.behaviour: Accept appeal grounds within the programme window and assign an independent panel. Retain the appealed decision and its evidence.
requirements.exception: Original sole decision maker cannot adjudicate; an appeal does not automatically lift a safety hold.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The original decision maker cannot be the sole adjudicator of the appeal.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Suspension and resumption
requirements.statement: Authorised safety or governance owners shall suspend affected work; resumption requires recorded remediation and approval.
requirements.acceptance: A commercial manager cannot resume a clinical suspension independently.
requirements.behaviour: Suspend affected activity, retain prior phase and permit authorised remediation. Resumption rechecks every active hold and gate.
requirements.exception: Commercial users cannot clear clinical or security holds; each hold requires its own authorised resolution.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A commercial manager cannot resume a clinical suspension independently.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Amendments
requirements.statement: Material changes to intended use, protocol, data, model, sites or oversight shall trigger impact assessment and appropriate reapproval.
requirements.acceptance: An added site cannot recruit under another site's approval unless explicitly covered.
requirements.behaviour: Submit material changes as amendments and calculate affected sites, permissions, runs and claims. Route impact decisions separately.
requirements.exception: New sites, uses or configurations remain inactive until relevant amendment and local prerequisites pass.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An added site cannot recruit under another site's approval unless explicitly covered.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Service clocks
requirements.statement: Review timers shall separate active work, applicant delay, external authority delay and agreed pauses.
requirements.acceptance: Turnaround reporting cannot improve by silently resetting an application's start date.
requirements.behaviour: Record stage events and reasoned pause intervals. Show wall clock elapsed and active time using normalised nonoverlapping intervals.
requirements.exception: Rework cannot reset age and overlapping pauses cannot be deducted twice.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Turnaround reporting cannot improve by silently resetting an application's start date.
requirements.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Ethics applicability
requirements.statement: Every study shall record whether ethics review is required and the qualified determination supporting approval, exemption or another lawful route.
requirements.acceptance: An evaluator cannot self declare exemption without the required institutional authority.
requirements.behaviour: Require a qualified applicability determination with evidence supporting approval, exemption or another lawful route.
requirements.exception: An evaluator cannot self select exemption without the required institutional authority.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An evaluator cannot self declare exemption without the required institutional authority.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Approval records
requirements.statement: Ethics permissions shall capture issuing body, protocol version, sites, population, conditions, dates and approved materials.
requirements.acceptance: A study cannot use an approval that covers a different protocol or excluded population.
requirements.behaviour: Match permission to protocol, sites, population, activities and materials. Show scope, conditions and expiry beside the study gate.
requirements.exception: A different protocol or excluded population creates a blocker, not assumed equivalence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study cannot use an approval that covers a different protocol or excluded population.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Consent and notices
requirements.statement: Prospective studies shall maintain approved participant information, consent or authorised waiver basis, language versions and collection evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A participant's record identifies the exact consent materials and basis that apply.
requirements.behaviour: Store approved materials by language and source version; bind exact consent or waiver evidence to each governed participant activity.
requirements.exception: Draft translations or missing collection evidence cannot satisfy enrolment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A participant's record identifies the exact consent materials and basis that apply.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Vulnerable populations
requirements.statement: Protocols involving children or other vulnerable groups shall specify applicable safeguards, assent or representative processes and exclusions.
requirements.acceptance: Recruitment blocks when the required authorised consent pathway is missing.
requirements.behaviour: Apply the approved vulnerable population pathway and validate representative authority, assent and exclusions.
requirements.exception: Missing required safeguards block recruitment and route to the qualified local owner.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Recruitment blocks when the required authorised consent pathway is missing.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Secondary use
requirements.statement: Retrospective use shall document permitted purposes, lawful basis and ethics conditions independently of assumptions about deidentification.
requirements.acceptance: A deidentified dataset is rejected for a purpose excluded by its data use agreement.
requirements.behaviour: Assess retrospective use against lawful basis, purposes, ethics and data terms; bind to dataset and protocol.
requirements.exception: Deidentification does not authorise an excluded secondary purpose.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A deidentified dataset is rejected for a purpose excluded by its data use agreement.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Participant withdrawal
requirements.statement: Withdrawal requests shall stop relevant future participation and trigger an assessment of permitted retention and analysis obligations.
requirements.acceptance: The participant and study owner receive an outcome showing what ceased and what must remain.
requirements.behaviour: Verify withdrawal, stop governed future participation and review retention, analyses and follow up. Record the participant response.
requirements.exception: Do not promise deletion of lawfully retained records; distinguish what ceased and what remains.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The participant and study owner receive an outcome showing what ceased and what must remain.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Clinical oversight
requirements.statement: Studies influencing care shall specify qualified supervision, escalation, standard care fallback and responsibilities at each site.
requirements.acceptance: The study cannot start until a local accountable clinician accepts the oversight plan.
requirements.behaviour: Require local clinical acceptance of supervision, escalation and standard care fallback. Display current urgent contacts at each site.
requirements.exception: No qualified owner or fallback means care affecting functionality cannot start.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The study cannot start until a local accountable clinician accepts the oversight plan.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Ethics renewal
requirements.statement: Expiry and amendment conditions shall trigger alerts and prevent unauthorised continued activity.
requirements.acceptance: New affected activity stops at expiry unless a valid extension is recorded.
requirements.behaviour: Generate renewal and amendment tasks and stop governed new activity at expiry unless a verified extension is effective.
requirements.exception: Submitted renewal is not approval; existing participants require a local continuity decision.
requirements.fs_acceptance: New affected activity stops at expiry unless a valid extension is recorded.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Participant communication
requirements.statement: The service shall support approved communication of study information, material changes and results through site appropriate channels.
requirements.acceptance: Messages are checked for language, confidentiality and approved content before release.
requirements.behaviour: Prepare approved language content, validate recipients and obtain release authority before dispatch. Track delivery and acknowledgement where needed.
requirements.exception: Failed delivery remains open; shared device previews contain no sensitive details.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Messages are checked for language, confidentiality and approved content before release.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Ethical complaints
requirements.statement: Participants and staff shall have accessible routes to raise concerns, including confidential handling and protection against retaliation.
requirements.acceptance: A complaint receives an independent owner and cannot be deleted by the subject of the complaint.
requirements.behaviour: Accept confidential concerns independently of developer permissions and assign a handler outside the implicated chain.
requirements.exception: The complaint subject cannot delete the case, reveal protected reporter details or close its independent review.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A complaint receives an independent owner and cannot be deleted by the subject of the complaint.
requirements.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Dataset catalogue
requirements.statement: Each dataset shall describe custodian, modality, provenance, population, time period, geography, quality, permitted uses, sensitivity and access conditions.
requirements.acceptance: A catalogue entry can be discoverable without exposing records or sensitive sample counts.
requirements.behaviour: Publish metadata separately from records. Custodians choose discoverable fields and restrict sensitive population counts or locations.
requirements.exception: Discovery never grants sample, thumbnail or underlying record access.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A catalogue entry can be discoverable without exposing records or sensitive sample counts.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Data access applications
requirements.statement: Applicants shall specify purpose, protocol, users, environment, duration, outputs and training intent for each access request.
requirements.acceptance: The custodian can approve a restricted subset or deny with reasons.
requirements.behaviour: Request purpose, protocol, team, version, region, period and outputs. Reviewers approve exact subsets and conditions.
requirements.exception: Added users, fields or training intent require revised approval; returned requests retain questions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The custodian can approve a restricted subset or deny with reasons.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Purpose bound grants
requirements.statement: Data permissions shall bind approved users, study, purpose, dataset version, region and duration and be enforced on execution and export.
requirements.acceptance: A valid grant for evaluation cannot be used by a training job.
requirements.behaviour: Issue a grant after all required decisions; enforce approved view and period on queries, runs, exports and provider calls.
requirements.exception: Evaluation rights fail training requests; successor datasets are not automatically included.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A valid grant for evaluation cannot be used by a training job.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Consent and legal basis metadata
requirements.statement: Datasets shall retain applicable consent categories, lawful basis, use restrictions and evidence references at suitable granularity.
requirements.acceptance: A mixed dataset can exclude records that are not authorised for the requested purpose.
requirements.behaviour: Apply consent and basis restrictions at record or cohort level where needed. Include only eligible records and retain safe exclusion counts.
requirements.exception: Mixed rights cannot collapse into one permissive dataset flag; uncertain records remain excluded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A mixed dataset can exclude records that are not authorised for the requested purpose.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Data minimisation
requirements.statement: Study owners shall justify required fields, granularity and retention; approved views shall expose only the necessary information.
requirements.acceptance: An evaluator using age bands cannot request dates of birth without a new approved need.
requirements.behaviour: Review necessary fields and precision against the protocol, then publish the approved view.
requirements.exception: Extra identifiers or granularity require documented need and reapproval.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An evaluator using age bands cannot request dates of birth without a new approved need.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Data residence
requirements.statement: The catalogue shall record where original, working, derived, cached and backup data may reside and whether remote access is allowed.
requirements.acceptance: A cross border support session is evaluated under the same applicable restrictions as processing.
requirements.behaviour: Validate every planned copy, backup and remote support location against the asset inventory and policy.
requirements.exception: Cross border support is a governed access event, not a routine administrative exemption.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A cross border support session is evaluated under the same applicable restrictions as processing.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Pseudonymisation
requirements.statement: Direct identifiers and linkage keys shall be separated and restricted; pseudonymised data shall remain governed as sensitive personal data where applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Evaluation users cannot recover identities using the linkage key store.
requirements.behaviour: Expose study pseudonyms to evaluators and restrict linkage and reidentification to separately authorised local roles.
requirements.exception: Pseudonymised data remain sensitive; operators cannot use linkage stores through administrative status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Evaluation users cannot recover identities using the linkage key store.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Revocation and downstream impact
requirements.statement: A revoked grant shall identify active workspaces, copies, jobs, exports and derived outputs requiring action.
requirements.acceptance: New access stops promptly and each affected asset receives an accountable remediation decision.
requirements.behaviour: Revoke with reason, identify active work, controlled copies and outputs, then assign containment and remediation.
requirements.exception: New online access stops within 60 seconds; external copies require tracked contractual follow up.
requirements.fs_acceptance: New access stops promptly and each affected asset receives an accountable remediation decision.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Controlled exports
requirements.statement: Outputs shall be assessed for personal information, small cells, memorisation and contractual restrictions before authorised release.
requirements.acceptance: A result containing disallowed patient rows is withheld even when its aggregate score is releasable.
requirements.behaviour: Check rights, personal information, small cells and inference risks on the exact export manifest, then collect required human approvals.
requirements.exception: Patient rows remain withheld even when aggregate scores are releasable; changes invalidate release approval.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A result containing disallowed patient rows is withheld even when its aggregate score is releasable.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Federated access
requirements.statement: A dataset may remain with its custodian while approved evaluation work and reviewed outputs move under local rules.
requirements.acceptance: A local custodian can refuse a run or an output release independently of central scheduling.
requirements.behaviour: Send an approved run to a custodian node; local acceptance and outgoing result review remain separate decisions.
requirements.exception: Central scheduling cannot override refusal; missing acknowledgement never implies execution.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A local custodian can refuse a run or an output release independently of central scheduling.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Benchmark secrecy
requirements.statement: Sealed evaluation sets shall have limited custodians, query budgets and rules preventing disclosure or repeated optimisation against hidden labels.
requirements.acceptance: A developer cannot download sealed labels or bypass its submission limit with a duplicate identity.
requirements.behaviour: Enforce hidden labels and attempt budgets across verified related identities. Record attempts and disclose only approved feedback.
requirements.exception: Duplicate accounts cannot reset quota; reset requires independent authority.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer cannot download sealed labels or bypass its submission limit with a duplicate identity.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Data rights requests
requirements.statement: The service shall route access, correction, objection and deletion requests to the responsible controller with deadlines and evidence of disposition.
requirements.acceptance: A request is not automatically fulfilled in a way that destroys a lawful clinical record or legal hold.
requirements.behaviour: Verify the rights requester, controller, scope and deadline; trace affected assets and issue a reasoned outcome.
requirements.exception: Assess holds and clinical duties before deletion; do not fulfil requests by arbitrary record removal.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A request is not automatically fulfilled in a way that destroys a lawful clinical record or legal hold.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Import methods
requirements.statement: Approved users shall import supported files or connect authorised source systems with declared source, schema, owner and expected volume.
requirements.acceptance: An import without an authorised source and active access grant cannot enter a study workspace.
requirements.behaviour: Register source, rights, manifest and mapping before transfer. Accept only admitted formats and approved source systems.
requirements.exception: Unknown source, unsupported type or absent purpose keeps the batch unaccepted.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An import without an authorised source and active access grant cannot enter a study workspace.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Quarantine and scanning
requirements.statement: Incoming files, archives, models and attachments shall be quarantined and checked for malware, unsupported content and unsafe structures.
requirements.acceptance: A failed scan prevents previews, execution and downstream indexing.
requirements.behaviour: Quarantine before preview, extraction, indexing or execution. Record detected type, malware and unsafe structure results.
requirements.exception: Failed or unavailable scan blocks downstream use; extensions cannot override content detection.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed scan prevents previews, execution and downstream indexing.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Schema and semantic validation
requirements.statement: Imports shall validate field types, required values, units, codes, time ordering and modality specific constraints.
requirements.acceptance: A plausible numeric value with an incompatible unit is flagged rather than silently accepted.
requirements.behaviour: Validate types, required values, units, codes and chronology against the approved schema. Expose field reasons to permitted reviewers.
requirements.exception: Do not coerce semantically incompatible clinical values into acceptance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A plausible numeric value with an incompatible unit is flagged rather than silently accepted.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Identity and deduplication
requirements.statement: Imports shall detect duplicates, repeated participants and linkage ambiguity without exposing unnecessary identifiers.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated encounters remain distinguishable from accidental duplicate records.
requirements.behaviour: Detect duplicates and overlap through approved linkage, then distinguish repeated encounters using reviewed disposition.
requirements.exception: Ambiguous identity remains unresolved; messages cannot expose hidden identifiers.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Repeated encounters remain distinguishable from accidental duplicate records.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Import reconciliation
requirements.statement: The platform shall reconcile source, accepted, rejected and quarantined counts with record level reasons visible to authorised users.
requirements.acceptance: An import cannot report complete while unaccounted records remain.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile source count as accepted plus rejected plus quarantined. Release a summary with every exclusion and reason.
requirements.exception: Unaccounted inputs block completion; partial acceptance needs explicit approval carried into analysis.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An import cannot report complete while unaccounted records remain.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Resumable transfer
requirements.statement: Large uploads shall support interrupted transfer recovery, integrity verification and duplicate safe retries.
requirements.acceptance: A resumed upload produces one verified asset with the expected checksum.
requirements.behaviour: Resume verified chunks under the same upload identity and check final size and digest.
requirements.exception: Conflicting payloads fail integrity; retries cannot produce duplicate released assets or charges.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A resumed upload produces one verified asset with the expected checksum.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Provenance lineage
requirements.statement: Transformations shall retain source version, applied rules, actor, timestamp and destination versions without overwriting source evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A reported metric can be traced back through every material transformation.
requirements.behaviour: Persist lineage for every material transform with versions, parameters, mapping and execution identity.
requirements.exception: Missing source or transform references block use in formal findings.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reported metric can be traced back through every material transformation.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Data correction
requirements.statement: Custodians shall correct data through controlled versions and issue impact notifications to affected analyses.
requirements.acceptance: Correcting a label creates a new dataset version and marks dependent reports for assessment.
requirements.behaviour: Correct through a successor with original, replacement, reason and evidence; notify affected analyses and reports.
requirements.exception: Never overwrite an issued dataset; scientific owners decide correction or withdrawal impact.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Correcting a label creates a new dataset version and marks dependent reports for assessment.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Deidentification review
requirements.statement: Relevant modalities shall undergo identifier detection and human review as required, including metadata, free text and burned in image identifiers.
requirements.acceptance: Removing structured identifiers alone does not mark an imaging dataset safe to release.
requirements.behaviour: Detect identifiers across structured metadata, text and pixels; require specified human residual risk review.
requirements.exception: Removing identifier columns alone does not clear imaging or narrative data for release.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Removing structured identifiers alone does not mark an imaging dataset safe to release.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Scheduled ingestion
requirements.statement: Approved connectors shall support incremental ingestion, freshness monitoring, schema change detection and safe replay.
requirements.acceptance: An incompatible source change pauses affected processing and identifies the responsible integration owner.
requirements.behaviour: Ingest incrementally with approved source cursor, freshness checks and schema fingerprint before checkpoint advancement.
requirements.exception: Incompatible changes pause processing; replay uses source keys and versions to prevent duplicates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An incompatible source change pauses affected processing and identifies the responsible integration owner.
requirements.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

requirements.title: Reference standard definition
requirements.statement: Each evaluation shall document its reference standard, rationale, timing, limitations and adjudication method.
requirements.acceptance: A protocol cannot label an unverified model prediction as clinical ground truth.
requirements.behaviour: Approve the clinical reference before annotation and evaluation; record timing and limitations for analysis.
requirements.exception: Available model predictions cannot be declared clinical ground truth by default.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A protocol cannot label an unverified model prediction as clinical ground truth.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Annotation work allocation
requirements.statement: Managers shall allocate annotation tasks by verified expertise, permitted data access and blinding rules.
requirements.acceptance: An annotator cannot open an unassigned task or access a disallowed patient identifier.
requirements.behaviour: Allocate to qualified users with valid grants and blinding. Reserve work while permitting planned independent labels.
requirements.exception: Assignment does not grant access; expired competence or purpose blocks opening cases.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An annotator cannot open an unassigned task or access a disallowed patient identifier.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Annotation guidelines
requirements.statement: Instructions, label definitions and examples shall be versioned and approved before use.
requirements.acceptance: Every label records the applicable guideline version and annotator identity.
requirements.behaviour: Bind each label to an approved guideline. Changes create successors and identify tasks needing review.
requirements.exception: In progress tasks cannot silently switch definitions; annotators acknowledge the new version.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Every label records the applicable guideline version and annotator identity.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Independent labelling
requirements.statement: Studies shall support multiple independent labels and adjudication by an eligible reviewer when their protocol requires it.
requirements.acceptance: Initial independent labels remain recoverable after adjudication.
requirements.behaviour: Collect independent labels without revealing peers, then route disagreement to an eligible adjudicator.
requirements.exception: Preserve originals and disagreement; conflicts or insufficient competence require reassignment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Initial independent labels remain recoverable after adjudication.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Agreement and quality checks
requirements.statement: The system shall calculate appropriate interrater agreement and sample quality checks, with methods and denominators disclosed.
requirements.acceptance: A quality report distinguishes consensus, disagreement and missing labels.
requirements.behaviour: Calculate approved agreement and sampled quality with denominators, missingness and method version.
requirements.exception: Post adjudication consensus cannot be reported as original interrater agreement.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A quality report distinguishes consensus, disagreement and missing labels.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Uncertain and unavailable labels
requirements.statement: Reference data shall represent uncertainty, indeterminate findings and unavailable follow up without forcing a binary label.
requirements.acceptance: An indeterminate outcome is handled according to the prespecified analysis plan.
requirements.behaviour: Offer explicit uncertain, indeterminate and unavailable outcomes with reasons; carry them into analysis.
requirements.exception: Do not force binary labels or convert missing follow up into clinical negatives.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An indeterminate outcome is handled according to the prespecified analysis plan.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Blinding controls
requirements.statement: Label assignment shall restrict access to model outputs or other information that could bias the reference standard.
requirements.acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see the evaluated model's prediction through exports or task history.
requirements.behaviour: Filter views, history, exports and links under blinding; record authorised unblinding.
requirements.exception: Accidental output exposure creates a deviation and affected label review.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see the evaluated model's prediction through exports or task history.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Dataset partitions
requirements.statement: Data owners shall control development, tuning, validation and final test partitions using patient, site and time boundaries as applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Patient overlap across partitions is detected before an evaluation is accepted.
requirements.behaviour: Assign partitions using patient, site and time rules; retain leakage checks before freezing.
requirements.exception: Known overlap blocks independent test claims unless explicitly justified by the approved design.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Patient overlap across partitions is detected before an evaluation is accepted.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Curation release
requirements.statement: A dataset release shall require quality review, rights verification and a frozen manifest of included records and labels.
requirements.acceptance: A released dataset cannot change its membership without a new version.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze records and labels after rights and quality approval and generate immutable manifest identity.
requirements.exception: Membership or label changes create a successor; drafts cannot be formal test inputs.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A released dataset cannot change its membership without a new version.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Specialist annotation integrations
requirements.statement: The platform shall integrate approved annotation tools while preserving task identity, access rules and provenance.
requirements.acceptance: Imported annotations reconcile to the original task and retain reviewer attribution.
requirements.behaviour: Export scoped tasks to approved tools and reconcile returned labels to task, guideline and reviewer.
requirements.exception: Unknown tasks, changed definitions or missing attribution enter reconciliation rather than automatic acceptance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Imported annotations reconcile to the original task and retain reviewer attribution.
requirements.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

requirements.title: Workspace request
requirements.statement: Workspace provisioning shall require approved study, configuration, data grants, execution region, access list and resource budget.
requirements.acceptance: Provisioning fails when any required grant or prerequisite is expired.
requirements.behaviour: Provision after checking study gates, configuration, grants, region, access and funded resources. Expiry is bounded by controlling permissions.
requirements.exception: Missing prerequisites return blockers; partially provisioned workspaces remain inaccessible.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Provisioning fails when any required grant or prerequisite is expired.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Execution isolation
requirements.statement: Submitted models, containers and scripts shall run in isolated environments with approved privileges, storage, network access and controlled cleanup before resource reuse.
requirements.acceptance: A workload cannot read another study's files, secrets or residual CPU or GPU memory.
requirements.behaviour: Use validated isolation profiles and verified cleanup of storage and residual CPU or GPU memory before reuse. Retain profile and cleanup evidence.
requirements.exception: Failed isolation or cleanup quarantines resources before another study can use them.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A workload cannot read another study's files, secrets or residual CPU or GPU memory.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Network controls
requirements.statement: Outbound access shall be denied unless explicitly required and authorised; allowed destinations and transmitted data shall be logged appropriately.
requirements.acceptance: A model attempting an undeclared external API call is blocked and flagged.
requirements.behaviour: Match each outbound destination to approved egress; record permitted categories and safe blocked connection diagnostics.
requirements.exception: Undeclared connections are denied and flagged without copying unrestricted payloads into logs.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A model attempting an undeclared external API call is blocked and flagged.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Resource quotas
requirements.statement: The platform shall enforce compute, storage, concurrency, runtime and spend limits at study and institutional levels.
requirements.acceptance: A runaway job stops at its approved limit and cannot exhaust another study's allocation.
requirements.behaviour: Reserve resources and budget before start, meter consumption and enforce limits while preserving other studies' allocations.
requirements.exception: Retries cannot bypass remaining budget; safety investigation reserves remain protected.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A runaway job stops at its approved limit and cannot exhaust another study's allocation.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Reproducible run manifest
requirements.statement: Every run shall bind input versions, model configuration, environment, dependencies, seeds where applicable, parameters and execution identity.
requirements.acceptance: An authorised reviewer can reconstruct the exact configuration used for a reported result.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze the run manifest before dispatch and record actual environment identities at start.
requirements.exception: Missing or unpinned components create explicit reproducibility limits and block execution where the protocol requires stable identity.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An authorised reviewer can reconstruct the exact configuration used for a reported result.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Execution lifecycle
requirements.statement: Users shall submit, queue, start, inspect, cancel and retry authorised runs with explicit states and failure reasons.
requirements.acceptance: A failed job cannot be represented as a completed successful evaluation.
requirements.behaviour: Use requested, validating, queued, running, cancelling, succeeded, failed, cancelled and blocked states with observed times.
requirements.exception: Execution success is distinct from scientific success; failure cannot be cleared by editing status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed job cannot be represented as a completed successful evaluation.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Idempotent retries
requirements.statement: Retries shall preserve lineage and avoid duplicate evidence, charges or downstream actions.
requirements.acceptance: A network retry creates no second charge or duplicate final result for the same logical request.
requirements.behaviour: Retry with a linked attempt after checking current permission and budget; duplicate network submissions return the existing request.
requirements.exception: Changed payload under the same key conflicts; evidence and charges follow the declared attempt policy.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A network retry creates no second charge or duplicate final result for the same logical request.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: External API evaluation
requirements.statement: Remote model endpoints shall be permitted only under approved data terms and recorded version guarantees or limitations.
requirements.acceptance: An unpinned provider change marks comparability uncertain and triggers review.
requirements.behaviour: Check endpoint terms, region, fields and version guarantees; record request identities and provider configuration.
requirements.exception: Provider change triggers comparability review; unapproved transmission is blocked.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unpinned provider change marks comparability uncertain and triggers review.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Output handling
requirements.statement: Run outputs shall remain restricted until validated and reviewed under the applicable output release policy.
requirements.acceptance: Logs containing patient data cannot be automatically attached to a public support ticket.
requirements.behaviour: Keep outputs and logs restricted until integrity, schema and disclosure checks pass on the exact manifest.
requirements.exception: Sensitive diagnostics cannot automatically enter ordinary support tickets or public reports.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Logs containing patient data cannot be automatically attached to a public support ticket.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Expiry and shutdown
requirements.statement: Workspace access and new processing shall stop on grant expiry, suspension or study closure; retained assets follow policy.
requirements.acceptance: A scheduled job cannot restart a closed workspace using an old credential.
requirements.behaviour: At expiry, suspension or closure block new processing, cancel queued work and safely contain active jobs.
requirements.exception: Saved schedules and old credentials cannot restart an expired workspace.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A scheduled job cannot restart a closed workspace using an old credential.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Remote execution nodes
requirements.statement: Approved local institutions may operate execution nodes with policy enforcement, attestation evidence and connectivity status.
requirements.acceptance: A disconnected node cannot be assumed to have received a stop instruction.
requirements.behaviour: Dispatch scoped instructions to qualified local nodes and track acceptance, execution and observed completion; display contact age and lease.
requirements.exception: Disconnected status stays unconfirmed; local policy stops new work after approved offline lease expiry.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A disconnected node cannot be assumed to have received a stop instruction.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Emergency termination
requirements.statement: Authorised operators shall terminate unsafe sandbox execution and preserve necessary diagnostic evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Termination prevents new affected execution and records the scope, requester and observed completion status.
requirements.behaviour: Allow immediate authorised termination, preserve bounded diagnostics and distinguish requested from observed stop.
requirements.exception: A central command does not prove local shutdown; missing acknowledgement escalates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Termination prevents new affected execution and records the scope, requester and observed completion status.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

requirements.title: Protocol templates
requirements.statement: Protocols shall specify intended use, setting, population, comparators, endpoints, data, risks, methods, oversight and decision rules.
requirements.acceptance: A protocol with an undefined primary endpoint cannot be frozen for formal evaluation.
requirements.behaviour: Populate protocol sections from an approved task template, then require explicit intended use, setting, population, endpoints, comparator and oversight.
requirements.exception: Missing primary endpoint or decision rule blocks freeze; copied text remains draft until reviewed for local relevance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A protocol with an undefined primary endpoint cannot be frozen for formal evaluation.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Study type
requirements.statement: The platform shall distinguish technical benchmarking, retrospective validation, simulation, silent prospective evaluation and interventional studies.
requirements.acceptance: Study type determines required gates and allowable exposure of outputs to clinical users.
requirements.behaviour: Select study type before gate generation. Changing type recalculates ethics, site, participant and output exposure requirements.
requirements.exception: Silent prospective type cannot enable clinician worklist outputs; change to intervention requires a reviewed amendment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Study type determines required gates and allowable exposure of outputs to clinical users.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Sample justification
requirements.statement: An accountable statistician or qualified reviewer shall approve sample size or precision rationale, prevalence assumptions and subgroup feasibility.
requirements.acceptance: An underpowered subgroup is labelled inconclusive rather than represented as proven safe.
requirements.behaviour: Capture the sample rationale, assumptions and qualified statistical approval. Preview subgroup counts against the required precision or adequacy criteria.
requirements.exception: Insufficient subgroups remain inconclusive and cannot inherit overall performance as proof of safety.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An underpowered subgroup is labelled inconclusive rather than represented as proven safe.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Prespecified thresholds
requirements.statement: Clinical and technical thresholds shall be defined by intended use, comparator and risk before final testing.
requirements.acceptance: Threshold changes after results are viewed create a protocol amendment and disclosed exploratory analysis.
requirements.behaviour: Approve thresholds before final results are unblinded. Store comparison operators, units, populations and confidence rules as machine interpretable values.
requirements.exception: Changing a threshold after viewing results creates an amendment and exploratory analysis label.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Threshold changes after results are viewed create a protocol amendment and disclosed exploratory analysis.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Analysis plan
requirements.statement: The plan shall define missing data, exclusions, repeated measures, multiplicity, uncertainty estimates and handling of failed predictions.
requirements.acceptance: An evaluator cannot silently remove model failures from the primary denominator.
requirements.behaviour: Specify denominator, exclusions, failures, repeated measures and missingness before running primary analysis. Register each planned analysis identity.
requirements.exception: Unplanned filtering cannot silently alter a primary denominator; deviations require explicit disclosure and review.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An evaluator cannot silently remove model failures from the primary denominator.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Comparator definition
requirements.statement: Each comparative claim shall identify the comparator version, standard care workflow and comparable dataset or study design.
requirements.acceptance: A comparison using different populations must disclose the limitation and cannot imply a controlled head to head result.
requirements.behaviour: Bind comparator version and standard care workflow to the study, including data and timing differences.
requirements.exception: Different populations require a qualified limitation; they cannot be presented as a controlled head to head comparison.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A comparison using different populations must disclose the limitation and cannot imply a controlled head to head result.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Subgroup plan
requirements.statement: Protocols shall prespecify relevant demographic, clinical, site, device, language and intersectional analyses with lawful data collection.
requirements.acceptance: A missing protected attribute is shown as unassessed rather than interpreted as absence of bias.
requirements.behaviour: Define subgroup attributes, lawful collection basis, intersections and adequacy rules. Show not collected separately from not assessed.
requirements.exception: Missing protected attributes do not imply no bias; sparse groups follow disclosure and uncertainty rules.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A missing protected attribute is shown as unassessed rather than interpreted as absence of bias.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Freeze and amendment
requirements.statement: Protocol and analysis versions shall be frozen before formal evaluation, with approved amendments and access to prior versions.
requirements.acceptance: Final results link to the frozen plan and identify all departures from it.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze a complete reviewed plan, generating immutable identity and signatures. Formal runs reference that version; amendments preserve the original and impact decision.
requirements.exception: New material cannot modify a frozen plan in place or conceal departures from prespecification.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Final results link to the frozen plan and identify all departures from it.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Stopping rules
requirements.statement: Clinical studies and high risk tests shall define pause, stop, escalation and resumption criteria with accountable decision makers.
requirements.acceptance: A trigger crossing creates the configured hold and requires the designated independent decision.
requirements.behaviour: Define stopping triggers and responsible authorities. A qualifying observation opens the specified hold and urgent task with supporting evidence.
requirements.exception: Only the relevant independent authority may resume; acknowledgement alone does not clear the trigger.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A trigger crossing creates the configured hold and requires the designated independent decision.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Protocol reuse
requirements.statement: Approved templates may be reused across sites or countries while identifying required local adaptation.
requirements.acceptance: Reusing a template does not copy another country's ethics approval or clinical thresholds automatically.
requirements.behaviour: Clone an approved template as a new draft and display required local adaptations. Preserve template provenance without copying approvals.
requirements.exception: Country permissions and clinical thresholds must be explicitly reviewed for the receiving scope.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Reusing a template does not copy another country's ethics approval or clinical thresholds automatically.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Risk proportional review
requirements.statement: Review depth shall reflect intended use, harm potential, autonomy, evidence maturity and deployment context.
requirements.acceptance: A high risk clinical use cannot enter through a low risk administrative template.
requirements.behaviour: Apply the approved risk rubric to intended use, autonomy, harm and maturity. Set review depth and required competence accordingly.
requirements.exception: A high risk clinical use cannot select an administrative low risk route to avoid safeguards.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A high risk clinical use cannot enter through a low risk administrative template.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Study registration
requirements.statement: The service shall record applicable external study registration, identifier and timing and reconcile material changes.
requirements.acceptance: A claimed registered study includes a verifiable registration reference and matching scope.
requirements.behaviour: Record registry identity, registration time, protocol match and public reference when applicable. Track amendments against the external record.
requirements.exception: Unverifiable or mismatched registration remains unverified and cannot support a registered study claim.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A claimed registered study includes a verifiable registration reference and matching scope.
requirements.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Task appropriate metrics
requirements.statement: The platform shall support registered metric definitions suited to classification, regression, segmentation, detection, forecasting or other admitted tasks.
requirements.acceptance: Every reported metric identifies its definition, implementation version and denominator.
requirements.behaviour: Select metrics only from the admitted task pack. Each result binds the formula, implementation version, denominator and validated fixture evidence.
requirements.exception: Unsupported metrics remain experimental and cannot become official endpoints through a user entered name.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Every reported metric identifies its definition, implementation version and denominator.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Diagnostic performance
requirements.statement: Diagnostic evaluations shall support sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, confusion matrices and threshold analysis where applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Predictive values state the observed or assumed prevalence and are not transferred without qualification.
requirements.behaviour: Calculate confusion matrices and diagnostic measures using approved reference labels and failure handling. Display observed or assumed prevalence with predictive values.
requirements.exception: Undefined denominators display not estimable; zero divisions cannot become zero performance or a pass.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Predictive values state the observed or assumed prevalence and are not transferred without qualification.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Uncertainty estimates
requirements.statement: Reports shall include appropriate confidence or uncertainty intervals and clustering adjustments when required by the study design.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated observations from one patient are not treated as independent without justification.
requirements.behaviour: Apply the protocol's interval and clustering method. Retain participant or site resampling unit and method parameters with results.
requirements.exception: Repeated observations cannot be treated as independent without approved justification; failed intervals remain explicit.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Repeated observations from one patient are not treated as independent without justification.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Calibration and utility
requirements.statement: Risk score evaluations shall assess calibration and decision consequences where relevant, alongside discrimination.
requirements.acceptance: A high discrimination score alone cannot satisfy a protocol requiring calibration or clinical utility.
requirements.behaviour: For risk scores show calibration measures and decision consequences alongside discrimination when required by protocol.
requirements.exception: High AUROC alone cannot satisfy a calibration or clinical utility criterion.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A high discrimination score alone cannot satisfy a protocol requiring calibration or clinical utility.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Missing and rejected inputs
requirements.statement: Tests shall measure missing fields, poor quality inputs, abstentions, unsupported cases and failed outputs under explicit scoring rules.
requirements.acceptance: All attempted cases reconcile across scored, abstained, rejected and failed categories.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile every attempted case into mutually exclusive execution categories and separately identify reference availability. Carry the prespecified scoring rule into denominators.
requirements.exception: Do not drop abstentions, rejected inputs or model failures to improve reported accuracy.
requirements.fs_acceptance: All attempted cases reconcile across scored, abstained, rejected and failed categories.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: External validation
requirements.statement: Evaluation records shall identify independence from development data and report site, temporal and population differences.
requirements.acceptance: A developer's tuning set cannot be labelled an independent external test set.
requirements.behaviour: Record development independence and site, time and population shifts using dataset provenance and overlap checks.
requirements.exception: Known tuning data cannot be labelled independent external validation; unresolved overlap blocks that claim.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer's tuning set cannot be labelled an independent external test set.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Robustness testing
requirements.statement: Relevant tests shall examine input variation, noise, device differences, distribution shift and operational constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Reports distinguish tested conditions from unsupported assumptions about robustness.
requirements.behaviour: Run the approved robustness scenarios against exact perturbation or condition definitions. Present baseline and changed-condition results with scope.
requirements.exception: Untested devices, languages or shifts remain unassessed; simulated robustness is not prospective clinical evidence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Reports distinguish tested conditions from unsupported assumptions about robustness.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Subgroup results
requirements.statement: The system shall report prespecified subgroup performance, uncertainty, sample sufficiency and clinically relevant gaps.
requirements.acceptance: A suppressed small cell remains marked as suppressed rather than displayed as zero.
requirements.behaviour: Calculate prespecified subgroup outputs and adequacy, then apply disclosure rules to display and export.
requirements.exception: Suppressed cells stay marked suppressed and cannot be recovered through complementary totals or repeated filters.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A suppressed small cell remains marked as suppressed rather than displayed as zero.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Baseline comparison
requirements.statement: Evaluations shall compare against the approved baseline using consistent inclusion and analysis rules.
requirements.acceptance: A benefit claim identifies both absolute and relative differences where relevant.
requirements.behaviour: Compare to the frozen baseline using identical inclusion rules where required. Show absolute and relative changes with uncertainty and comparator provenance.
requirements.exception: Incompatible populations or follow up display limitations and block unsupported comparative claims.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A benefit claim identifies both absolute and relative differences where relevant.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Independent reproduction
requirements.statement: An independent reviewer shall be able to verify reported outputs from retained manifests, data access and approved metric code.
requirements.acceptance: A reproduced result outside the declared tolerance triggers an investigation before report issue.
requirements.behaviour: Assign an independent reproducer to the retained manifest and approved metric code. Compare results against protocol tolerances and retain evidence.
requirements.exception: Out of tolerance results create an investigation and prevent a reproduced status until resolved.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reproduced result outside the declared tolerance triggers an investigation before report issue.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Custom metric governance
requirements.statement: Qualified teams may register task specific metrics with documentation, validation and version controls.
requirements.acceptance: A custom metric cannot replace a primary endpoint without an approved protocol change.
requirements.behaviour: Register a custom metric with formula, intended task, fixtures, limits and qualified validation before activation.
requirements.exception: Replacing a primary endpoint requires a protocol amendment; registration alone does not change the study plan.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A custom metric cannot replace a primary endpoint without an approved protocol change.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Evidence interpretation
requirements.statement: Automated score calculation shall remain separate from the authorised interpretation of clinical significance and suitability.
requirements.acceptance: A benchmark score cannot automatically issue a clinical suitability decision.
requirements.behaviour: Keep computed score status separate from clinical interpretation. Eligible reviewers record suitability only for the stated use and population.
requirements.exception: Automated threshold checks cannot issue an independent clinical suitability decision.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A benchmark score cannot automatically issue a clinical suitability decision.
requirements.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Generative configuration identity
requirements.statement: Evaluation shall bind base model version, prompts, tools, retrieval corpus, decoding settings, guardrails and context limits.
requirements.acceptance: A prompt or retrieval update invalidates claims of an unchanged evaluated configuration.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze the complete generative configuration and provider identity before tests. Retain prompts, tools, corpus and decoding parameters under appropriate rights.
requirements.exception: Any material change creates a new configuration and cannot inherit unchanged evaluation status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A prompt or retrieval update invalidates claims of an unchanged evaluated configuration.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Clinical answer assessment
requirements.statement: Tests shall assess factuality, harmful omissions, inappropriate reassurance, unsafe recommendations, uncertainty and escalation using qualified clinical review.
requirements.acceptance: A fluent but clinically unsafe answer is treated as a safety failure under the approved rubric.
requirements.behaviour: Assign qualified clinicians to rubric based response review. Score omissions, unsafe advice, reassurance, uncertainty and escalation separately from fluency.
requirements.exception: Severe safety failures remain individually visible and cannot be averaged away by stylistic quality.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A fluent but clinically unsafe answer is treated as a safety failure under the approved rubric.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Grounding and citations
requirements.statement: Tests shall assess whether retrieved sources support generated claims and whether guideline jurisdiction and currency are appropriate.
requirements.acceptance: A plausible fabricated citation is counted as an error rather than credited for formatting.
requirements.behaviour: Link each material claim to retrieved evidence and assess support, authenticity, jurisdiction and date. Review citations in their original context.
requirements.exception: A plausible but fabricated reference is an error; inaccessible support remains unverified.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A plausible fabricated citation is counted as an error rather than credited for formatting.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Interaction testing
requirements.statement: Evaluation shall cover multi turn conversations, contradictory inputs, changing context, long records and follow up questions.
requirements.acceptance: Performance reporting identifies failures that appear only across multiple turns.
requirements.behaviour: Execute ordered multi turn scenarios with contradictions, context changes and follow up. Preserve conversation-level outcomes and the failure turn.
requirements.exception: Do not report isolated turn success as full task success when later context exposes a failure.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Performance reporting identifies failures that appear only across multiple turns.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Language and population coverage
requirements.statement: Tests shall include approved languages, dialects, health literacy levels and locally relevant presentations with competent reviewers.
requirements.acceptance: English performance cannot substitute for evidence in another advertised clinical language.
requirements.behaviour: Build language and population strata with competent reviewers and scenario provenance. Report coverage and unsupported advertised languages.
requirements.exception: English results cannot substitute for local language evidence; unavailable qualified review blocks the claim.
requirements.fs_acceptance: English performance cannot substitute for evidence in another advertised clinical language.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Adversarial safety
requirements.statement: Authorised testing shall assess prompt injection, malicious documents, tool misuse, leakage and unsafe instruction following in isolated environments.
requirements.acceptance: Successful bypasses are recorded with impact and remediation evidence without releasing sensitive attack artefacts publicly.
requirements.behaviour: Run authorised adversarial tests in isolated accounts and data. Record attack identity, successful action, impact and remediation retest.
requirements.exception: Attack content cannot escape into production tools or public artefacts; real data exposure opens an incident.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Successful bypasses are recorded with impact and remediation evidence without releasing sensitive attack artefacts publicly.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Agent permissions
requirements.statement: Agents shall operate within explicit action scopes, simulation boundaries and approval requirements for consequential actions.
requirements.acceptance: A test agent cannot issue a real prescription, contact a patient or modify a live record without the separately authorised workflow.
requirements.behaviour: Declare agent tool permissions and use simulation endpoints for consequential actions. Capture requested, denied, approved and executed tool actions.
requirements.exception: No real prescribing, patient contact or clinical record write without the separately authorised clinical workflow.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A test agent cannot issue a real prescription, contact a patient or modify a live record without the separately authorised workflow.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Judge validation
requirements.statement: Automated evaluators shall have documented agreement with qualified human reviewers, known limitations and drift checks.
requirements.acceptance: An unvalidated model judge cannot be the sole basis for a final clinical safety decision.
requirements.behaviour: Compare model judge scores to qualified human review on a documented sample and assess disagreement by severity.
requirements.exception: An unvalidated judge cannot be sole safety adjudicator; material judge changes require revalidation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unvalidated model judge cannot be the sole basis for a final clinical safety decision.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Stochastic variation
requirements.statement: Tests shall use prespecified repeat runs and report variability, rare severe failures and uncertainty where outputs are stochastic.
requirements.acceptance: Reporting one favourable run while excluding unsuccessful repetitions is prevented or explicitly disclosed.
requirements.behaviour: Run the prespecified repetitions and include all attempts, failures and variability. Record seeds only where meaningful and explain provider nondeterminism.
requirements.exception: Selecting a favourable run cannot replace the full planned denominator; rare severe failures remain visible.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Reporting one favourable run while excluding unsuccessful repetitions is prevented or explicitly disclosed.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Privacy and memorisation
requirements.statement: Evaluations shall assess inappropriate disclosure, cross session leakage and relevant memorisation risk with controlled test data.
requirements.acceptance: A model that exposes another participant's information triggers the incident and hold workflow.
requirements.behaviour: Test cross session disclosure and memorisation with approved controlled fixtures. Restrict raw sensitive findings and record risk assessment.
requirements.exception: Disclosure of another participant's data initiates containment and incident handling immediately.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A model that exposes another participant's information triggers the incident and hold workflow.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Cost and latency tradeoffs
requirements.statement: Reports shall measure task completion, latency, resource consumption and human correction burden with the tested configuration.
requirements.acceptance: A low per token price cannot be reported as total workflow cost.
requirements.behaviour: Measure complete task cost, latency and human correction burden for the tested configuration. Include retries and failed attempts under declared accounting.
requirements.exception: Per token price alone cannot be labelled workflow cost or labour saving.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A low per token price cannot be reported as total workflow cost.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Synthetic evaluation limits
requirements.statement: Synthetic cases and simulated patients shall be labelled, reviewed and separated from evidence based on real clinical outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Passing synthetic scenarios cannot automatically satisfy a requirement for prospective clinical evidence.
requirements.behaviour: Label synthetic cases and simulated patients at scenario and report level. Require qualified review of realism and limitations.
requirements.exception: Passing synthetic tests cannot satisfy a protocol that requires real prospective outcome evidence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Passing synthetic scenarios cannot automatically satisfy a requirement for prospective clinical evidence.
requirements.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

requirements.title: Tabular prediction
requirements.statement: Admitted structured data tasks shall support feature dictionaries, units, timestamps, missingness and leakage checks.
requirements.acceptance: Post outcome variables are identified before a prediction evaluation is accepted.
