requirements.behaviour: Validate structured features against meaning, unit, availability time and missingness. Flag post outcome information before model execution.
requirements.exception: Unresolved temporal leakage blocks predictive evaluation acceptance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Post outcome variables are identified before a prediction evaluation is accepted.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Imaging evaluation
requirements.statement: Admitted imaging tasks shall support study series relationships, device metadata, relevant annotations and image quality assessment.
requirements.acceptance: Results retain linkage to the correct examination and evaluated image series.
requirements.behaviour: Preserve examination, study and series relationships and required device metadata. Validate annotation coordinates and image quality in the approved viewer.
requirements.exception: Wrong series or orientation mapping blocks scoring; deidentification must preserve necessary clinical meaning.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Results retain linkage to the correct examination and evaluated image series.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Clinical text
requirements.statement: Text evaluations shall preserve document context, redaction status, chronology and applicable language while restricting identifiers.
requirements.acceptance: A summary evaluation can identify clinically material omissions from the authorised source record.
requirements.behaviour: Retain document chronology, source context, language and redaction status for text evaluation. Link material omissions back to permitted source passages.
requirements.exception: An isolated excerpt cannot represent a complete record unless the task explicitly defines that scope.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A summary evaluation can identify clinically material omissions from the authorised source record.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Speech and audio
requirements.statement: Speech evaluations shall assess clinically relevant transcription and comprehension errors, speaker variation and recording conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Medical term errors and consequential negation errors remain distinguishable from ordinary word errors.
requirements.behaviour: Capture recording conditions and assess clinical transcription and comprehension errors separately from ordinary word errors.
requirements.exception: Negation, dosage and medical term errors retain their clinical severity instead of being hidden in aggregate word error rate.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Medical term errors and consequential negation errors remain distinguishable from ordinary word errors.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Signals and devices
requirements.statement: Time series and connected device tasks shall support sampling frequency, device versions, missing intervals and alignment requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Misaligned sensor timestamps cannot be silently compared to clinical event labels.
requirements.behaviour: Validate sampling frequency, device version, clock alignment and missing intervals before comparing signals to outcomes.
requirements.exception: Misalignment or unapproved resampling blocks dependent evaluation; transformation provenance is retained.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Misaligned sensor timestamps cannot be silently compared to clinical event labels.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Multimodal systems
requirements.statement: Combined input solutions shall be evaluated for modality contribution, missing modalities and inconsistent inputs.
requirements.acceptance: A solution's advertised fallback behaviour is tested when one required modality is absent.
requirements.behaviour: Test required, optional and missing modalities plus contradictory inputs according to the declared fallback contract.
requirements.exception: An advertised fallback cannot be accepted without testing the absent modality scenario.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A solution's advertised fallback behaviour is tested when one required modality is absent.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Administrative and public health AI
requirements.statement: Nonclinical workflow tools shall be assessed against their own operational and equity outcomes with documented clinical spillover risks.
requirements.acceptance: A scheduling model is not assigned diagnostic metrics solely because it operates in a hospital.
requirements.behaviour: Select operational and equity endpoints for administrative or public health tasks and document potential clinical spillovers.
requirements.exception: Hospital location alone does not make diagnostic metrics appropriate for scheduling or allocation tools.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A scheduling model is not assigned diagnostic metrics solely because it operates in a hospital.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Capability admission
requirements.statement: Each supported modality and study type shall have a validated evaluation pack, responsible experts and required controls before admission.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported tasks remain in discovery status and cannot receive a formal validated result.
requirements.behaviour: Activate a task pack only after fixtures, method validation, qualified owners and required controls pass within declared scope.
requirements.exception: Unsupported tasks stay in discovery and cannot issue formal validated findings.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Unsupported tasks remain in discovery status and cannot receive a formal validated result.
requirements.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

requirements.title: Workflow definition
requirements.statement: Evaluations shall describe user roles, work steps, handoffs, decision authority and standard care fallback.
requirements.acceptance: A model result cannot be interpreted without its intended position in the clinical workflow.
requirements.behaviour: Map intended work steps, handoffs and decision authority with the standard care comparator and fallback. Bind the model output to a specific step.
requirements.exception: A model score cannot be interpreted as workflow benefit without its intended use context.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A model result cannot be interpreted without its intended position in the clinical workflow.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Usability studies
requirements.statement: Teams shall assess task completion, errors, training needs and cognitive workload with representative users in relevant settings.
requirements.acceptance: A usability report identifies participant roles and includes observed failures as well as satisfaction.
requirements.behaviour: Run approved task scenarios with representative roles, recording completion, observed errors, training needs and workload.
requirements.exception: Reports include failures and sample limits; satisfaction alone cannot establish usable clinical performance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A usability report identifies participant roles and includes observed failures as well as satisfaction.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Human AI interaction
requirements.statement: Tests shall assess overreliance, underreliance, overrides, alert fatigue and the quality of human review.
requirements.acceptance: An apparent time saving is qualified when required verification work is omitted.
requirements.behaviour: Capture reliance, overrides, verification time and alert exposure using the approved observation method.
requirements.exception: Apparent time savings exclude no required review work; omitted verification is recorded as a safety or protocol issue.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An apparent time saving is qualified when required verification work is omitted.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Accessibility and inclusion
requirements.statement: Studies shall examine barriers related to disability, literacy, language, connectivity and shared devices for the intended users.
requirements.acceptance: A deployment plan includes mitigations for material exclusion risks identified during evaluation.
requirements.behaviour: Assess barriers across disability, literacy, language, connectivity and device sharing. Assign mitigations and verify them in the intended context.
requirements.exception: Unresolved material exclusion risk remains a deployment blocker or explicit scope restriction.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A deployment plan includes mitigations for material exclusion risks identified during evaluation.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Clinical workflow outcomes
requirements.statement: Prospective evaluations shall capture referral completion, follow up, treatment delays and other relevant workflow outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: A high detection rate alone cannot establish benefit when the protocol requires completed referral.
requirements.behaviour: Track downstream referrals, follow up and delays with correct eligible denominators and outcome windows.
requirements.exception: Detection alone cannot satisfy an endpoint that requires completed referral or treatment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A high detection rate alone cannot establish benefit when the protocol requires completed referral.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Training effectiveness
requirements.statement: Implementation teams shall record training participation, assessed competence, refresher needs and role specific permissions.
requirements.acceptance: An untrained user cannot be enabled for a function requiring verified competence.
requirements.behaviour: Record training, assessment, competence and renewal against the user role and procedure version.
requirements.exception: Expired or failed required competence removes access to the affected clinical function until renewed.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An untrained user cannot be enabled for a function requiring verified competence.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Equity interpretation
requirements.statement: Equity assessments shall consider access, error distribution and downstream burden as well as aggregate performance.
requirements.acceptance: The report identifies who may lose access or bear additional costs under the proposed workflow.
requirements.behaviour: Interpret equity across access, errors and downstream burden, with qualified consideration of missing groups and costs.
requirements.exception: Aggregate model performance cannot erase an identified exclusion or disproportionate burden.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The report identifies who may lose access or bear additional costs under the proposed workflow.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Patient and staff feedback
requirements.statement: Feedback shall be collected through approved confidential channels and linked to issues and corrective actions.
requirements.acceptance: Negative feedback remains visible to reviewers even when a site or developer disputes it.
requirements.behaviour: Accept staff and patient feedback through approved confidential routes and link concerns to issue ownership.
requirements.exception: Disputed negative feedback remains available to independent reviewers; implicated parties cannot delete it.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Negative feedback remains visible to reviewers even when a site or developer disputes it.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Economic measurement
requirements.statement: Studies shall capture staff time, integration, equipment, training, recurring fees and downstream resource costs.
requirements.acceptance: A cost effectiveness calculation states perspective, currency, price year, assumptions and uncertainty.
requirements.behaviour: Capture staff, integration, equipment, training, recurring and downstream costs under explicit perspective and price year.
requirements.exception: Missing assumptions or incompatible currencies block a definitive cost effectiveness claim; uncertainty remains visible.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A cost effectiveness calculation states perspective, currency, price year, assumptions and uncertainty.
requirements.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

requirements.title: Site activation
requirements.statement: Each site shall pass a readiness gate covering approvals, contracts, trained staff, systems, emergency procedures and resources.
requirements.acceptance: No recruitment or care affecting evaluation can begin at an inactive site.
requirements.behaviour: Activate each site only after verified permissions, terms, competent staff, integration and emergency readiness for exact protocol and configuration.
requirements.exception: Inactive sites cannot enrol or expose care affecting outputs; another site's approval cannot substitute.
requirements.fs_acceptance: No recruitment or care affecting evaluation can begin at an inactive site.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Eligibility and enrolment
requirements.statement: Authorised site staff shall apply approved inclusion and exclusion criteria, document eligibility and prevent duplicate enrolment where relevant.
requirements.acceptance: An ineligible enrolment creates a deviation and cannot be silently corrected out of the record.
requirements.behaviour: Apply approved eligibility rules, record source evidence and check authorised duplicate enrolment constraints before enrolment.
requirements.exception: An ineligible enrolment is retained as a deviation; it cannot be silently edited out of history.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An ineligible enrolment creates a deviation and cannot be silently corrected out of the record.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Participant identifiers
requirements.statement: Studies shall use site controlled identifiers and restrict reidentification and cross site linkage to approved roles.
requirements.acceptance: Central evaluators receive only the participant information authorised by their study role.
requirements.behaviour: Assign site controlled study keys and restrict linkage to authorised local roles. Central users see only approved participant fields.
requirements.exception: Cross site matching requires explicit authority and cannot expose identities through duplicate warnings.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Central evaluators receive only the participant information authorised by their study role.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Case report forms
requirements.statement: The platform or approved integration shall support versioned forms, validation, queries, source references and correction history.
requirements.acceptance: A corrected clinical observation retains its original value, reason, actor and timestamp.
requirements.behaviour: Use approved form versions with semantic validation and queries. Corrections retain original value, reason, actor and time.
requirements.exception: Source discrepancies remain queries until resolved; version upgrades cannot reinterpret historic answers silently.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A corrected clinical observation retains its original value, reason, actor and timestamp.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Allocation and blinding
requirements.statement: Studies requiring randomisation or allocation concealment shall use validated procedures and controlled unblinding.
requirements.acceptance: Only authorised staff can unblind, with reason and downstream impact recorded.
requirements.behaviour: Use the validated allocation procedure and restrict concealed assignments. Unblinding requires an eligible actor, reason and impact record.
requirements.exception: Emergency local care follows its approved route; unblinding is never an ordinary unrestricted reveal button.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Only authorised staff can unblind, with reason and downstream impact recorded.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Silent prospective mode
requirements.statement: Outputs from silent evaluation shall remain unavailable for treatment decisions and clearly separated from active care interfaces.
requirements.acceptance: A silent mode prediction cannot appear in a clinician's production worklist.
requirements.behaviour: Route silent predictions only to authorised evaluation storage and blinded review workflows; exclude them from clinical production worklists.
requirements.exception: Accidental exposure creates a deviation and safety assessment, with containment of the leaking channel.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A silent mode prediction cannot appear in a clinician's production worklist.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Interventional controls
requirements.statement: Studies influencing care shall enforce authorised users, approved version, operating limits and oversight specified in the protocol.
requirements.acceptance: A changed clinical configuration requires the defined amendment process before use.
requirements.behaviour: Permit care affecting outputs only for authorised users, approved version and operating limits with active oversight.
requirements.exception: Changed configuration or expired permission blocks further use under the affected protocol and activates fallback.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A changed clinical configuration requires the defined amendment process before use.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Deviations and queries
requirements.statement: Sites shall record protocol deviations, missing observations and data queries with resolution ownership and impact review.
requirements.acceptance: A deviation affecting participant safety triggers escalation independently of ordinary data cleaning.
requirements.behaviour: Open deviations and data queries with severity, owner and due date; preserve correction history and scientific impact.
requirements.exception: Safety relevant deviations escalate immediately and do not wait in ordinary data cleaning queues.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A deviation affecting participant safety triggers escalation independently of ordinary data cleaning.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Monitoring and verification
requirements.statement: Monitors shall review consent, eligibility, source evidence and study conduct within approved access boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Monitoring findings have accountable corrective actions and verifiable closure evidence.
requirements.behaviour: Give monitors bounded access to consent, eligibility and source evidence. Record findings, corrective actions and independent verification.
requirements.exception: Monitoring access does not permit changing original clinical observations or closing its own unresolved findings without authority.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Monitoring findings have accountable corrective actions and verifiable closure evidence.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Safety reporting
requirements.statement: Sites shall report adverse events, near misses and serious concerns with timely local escalation and applicable reporting routes.
requirements.acceptance: A report initiates safety review without waiting for causality to be proven.
requirements.behaviour: Accept adverse events, near misses and serious concerns with minimal initial information and local escalation.
requirements.exception: Causality need not be proven before reporting; incomplete fields cannot block an urgent safety case.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A report initiates safety review without waiting for causality to be proven.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Study closeout
requirements.statement: Closeout shall reconcile participants, unresolved queries, safety events, assets, financial obligations and retention requirements.
requirements.acceptance: A study cannot be marked fully closed while mandatory follow up obligations remain unassigned.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile participants, queries, safety, assets and duties before closeout. Assign any lawful continuing obligation to an accepting owner.
requirements.exception: Unassigned required follow up blocks fully closed status even after recruitment ends.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study cannot be marked fully closed while mandatory follow up obligations remain unassigned.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: External study systems
requirements.statement: Existing validated electronic data capture and trial systems may remain the source of record with controlled integration.
requirements.acceptance: An imported record retains source identity and does not create an inconsistent competing master record.
requirements.behaviour: Import from approved EDC or trial systems with source identifiers, versions and reconciliation. Mark external authoritative fields read only locally.
requirements.exception: Conflicting masters create a reconciliation case; imported data cannot silently replace the authoritative source.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An imported record retains source identity and does not create an inconsistent competing master record.
requirements.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

requirements.title: Safety case
requirements.statement: Each admitted use shall maintain hazards, foreseeable misuse, mitigations, residual risks, evidence and accountable acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: No clinical use proceeds with an unaccepted material residual risk.
requirements.behaviour: Maintain hazards and residual risks linked to each admitted intended use and mitigation evidence. Require the accountable qualified acceptance before activity.
requirements.exception: Unaccepted material risk blocks affected activation; lower estimated likelihood cannot hide severe unresolved consequences.
requirements.fs_acceptance: No clinical use proceeds with an unaccepted material residual risk.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Incident intake
requirements.statement: The service shall accept reports from authorised staff, institutions and appropriate external channels with confidentiality controls.
requirements.acceptance: A reporter can raise a concern without needing permission from the implicated developer.
requirements.behaviour: Accept concerns from approved staff and external channels without developer permission. Preserve confidential reporter details and minimal initial facts.
requirements.exception: Anonymous or incomplete reports enter triage where supported; attachments remain quarantined without delaying intake.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reporter can raise a concern without needing permission from the implicated developer.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Severity and triage
requirements.statement: Qualified owners shall triage impact, affected population, urgency and scope while allowing uncertain initial information.
requirements.acceptance: An incomplete but potentially serious report enters urgent review rather than being rejected by form validation.
requirements.behaviour: Assign qualified triage, record uncertainty and choose urgency based on potential harm. Route potentially serious reports immediately.
requirements.exception: Missing causality or participant details cannot postpone urgent review; reclassification retains original assessment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An incomplete but potentially serious report enters urgent review rather than being rejected by form validation.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Containment
requirements.statement: Authorised owners shall suspend affected datasets, versions, jobs or sites and communicate local containment responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance: A targeted suspension prevents affected new activity without concealing historical evidence.
requirements.behaviour: Apply targeted holds to versions, datasets, runs or sites and notify responsible local owners. Preserve evidence and permitted remediation.
requirements.exception: Containment does not delete historical findings or imply that remote sites already stopped.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A targeted suspension prevents affected new activity without concealing historical evidence.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Deployment stop coordination
requirements.statement: For deployed tools, the platform shall issue stop or rollback instructions through approved channels and record acknowledgement from each site.
requirements.acceptance: An unacknowledged instruction remains visibly unresolved and escalates to local contacts.
requirements.behaviour: Issue authorised stop or rollback instructions through approved site channels. Track receipt and observed execution per site.
requirements.exception: Unacknowledged sites remain visibly unresolved and escalate to local contacts and backups.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unacknowledged instruction remains visibly unresolved and escalates to local contacts.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Investigation
requirements.statement: Investigations shall preserve artefacts, timestamps, decisions and chain of custody while restricting sensitive details.
requirements.acceptance: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close its own independent investigation.
requirements.behaviour: Preserve evidence with source, digest, collection authority and custody history. Restrict implicated parties' access and editing.
requirements.exception: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close an independent investigation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close its own independent investigation.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Corrective and preventive action
requirements.statement: Actions shall identify root cause, owner, due date, verification method and recurrence prevention.
requirements.acceptance: Closing an action requires verification evidence rather than a completion checkbox alone.
requirements.behaviour: Assign root cause actions with due dates and verification criteria. Closure requires evidence accepted by an eligible verifier.
requirements.exception: A completion checkbox or developer statement alone cannot close required independent remediation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Closing an action requires verification evidence rather than a completion checkbox alone.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Reportability assessment
requirements.statement: Country owners shall determine applicable notifications, recipients and deadlines with legal and clinical input.
requirements.acceptance: The platform records proof of submission or an explicit failure; an internal alert is not treated as statutory reporting.
requirements.behaviour: Assess reporting duties by country and record recipient, deadline and authorised release. Retain transmission and acknowledgement evidence.
requirements.exception: An internal alert is not statutory submission; failed external delivery remains an open escalation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The platform records proof of submission or an explicit failure; an internal alert is not treated as statutory reporting.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Cross study impact
requirements.statement: An incident involving a shared dependency shall identify other potentially affected studies and product versions.
requirements.acceptance: A recalled model component produces an actionable list of impacted evaluations and deployments.
requirements.behaviour: Traverse affected dependencies to identify other versions, studies and deployments, then assign scoped impact reviews.
requirements.exception: Absence of known deployments is qualified by register completeness; do not claim all sites are safe from incomplete inventory.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A recalled model component produces an actionable list of impacted evaluations and deployments.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Resumption decision
requirements.statement: Resumption shall require appropriate independent clinical, security or governance approval and a verified remediation scope.
requirements.acceptance: Commercial pressure or payment status cannot override an active safety hold.
requirements.behaviour: Require appropriate independent clinical, security or governance approval for remediation and resumption. Recheck other holds and prerequisites.
requirements.exception: Payment, commercial urgency or reporter withdrawal cannot clear an unresolved safety hold.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Commercial pressure or payment status cannot override an active safety hold.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: External warning exchange
requirements.statement: Approved safety summaries may be shared with participating networks under legal, confidentiality and accuracy review.
requirements.acceptance: A shared warning excludes unauthorised patient data and clearly states unresolved causality.
requirements.behaviour: Prepare a bounded safety summary with uncertainty, causality status and approved audience. Release only after legal, confidentiality and accuracy review.
requirements.exception: Patient details and restricted attack artefacts remain excluded; draft preparation never sends externally.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A shared warning excludes unauthorised patient data and clearly states unresolved causality.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Learning and trend review
requirements.statement: The service shall review near misses, recurring issues, overdue actions and emerging hazards on a defined cadence.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated low severity incidents can trigger a systemic risk review.
requirements.behaviour: Review near misses, recurrence and overdue actions using declared cadence and definitions. Open systemic risk reviews for patterns.
requirements.exception: Repeated low severity events cannot be hidden by closing individual cases without trend assessment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Repeated low severity incidents can trigger a systemic risk review.
requirements.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Evidence dossier
requirements.statement: Each dossier shall assemble intended use, configuration, protocol, datasets, metrics, limitations, reviews, decisions and relevant external permissions.
requirements.acceptance: A reviewer can trace each headline finding to the underlying approved evidence.
requirements.behaviour: Assemble dossiers from exact approved source versions. The builder flags missing required links and exposes each finding's provenance to authorised reviewers.
requirements.exception: Manual attachments cannot substitute for missing result identities without an explicit verified external evidence record.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reviewer can trace each headline finding to the underlying approved evidence.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Claim level provenance
requirements.statement: Claims shall cite specific studies, populations, versions, dates and limitations rather than only a product level badge.
requirements.acceptance: A new product version does not inherit an unsupported claim from an earlier version.
requirements.behaviour: Link every claim to exact study, population, version, date and limitations; display claim-level support in the report.
requirements.exception: A product's successor cannot inherit a prior claim unless a qualified applicability decision explicitly supports it.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A new product version does not inherit an unsupported claim from an earlier version.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Evidence status
requirements.statement: Reports shall distinguish not assessed, in progress, insufficient evidence, meets specified criteria, fails specified criteria, superseded and withdrawn.
requirements.acceptance: Insufficient evidence cannot be displayed as a positive outcome or averaged into a pass.
requirements.behaviour: Derive evidence status from signed decisions and current validity, separately from workflow progress and regulatory status.
requirements.exception: Insufficient evidence remains inconclusive and cannot be averaged or renamed into a positive badge.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Insufficient evidence cannot be displayed as a positive outcome or averaged into a pass.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Independent review
requirements.statement: Final reports shall undergo scientific and clinical review appropriate to scope with declared conflicts and signed decisions.
requirements.acceptance: A developer response is retained but cannot replace the independent conclusion.
requirements.behaviour: Assign eligible independent scientific and clinical reviewers, retain developer responses and obtain required signatures on the frozen dossier.
requirements.exception: Conflicted sole approval or missing competent reviewer blocks issue; payer edits cannot replace the conclusion.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer response is retained but cannot replace the independent conclusion.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Report generation
requirements.statement: Reports shall use approved templates with exact run references, analysis versions, units, denominators and uncertainty.
requirements.acceptance: Regenerated reports preserve the same approved findings and identify the generator version.
requirements.behaviour: Generate a draft from approved templates and exact result references, including units, denominators and intervals. Record generator and template versions.
requirements.exception: Regeneration cannot silently change findings; any changed source creates a new draft and review cycle.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Regenerated reports preserve the same approved findings and identify the generator version.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Scope and limitations
requirements.statement: Every issued report shall prominently state tested use, population, setting, product version, exclusions and evidentiary limits.
requirements.acceptance: A report cannot omit a material failed subgroup that was included in the approved analysis plan.
requirements.behaviour: Require tested use, population, setting, configuration, exclusions and limitations in the visible report summary.
requirements.exception: Material failed subgroups or incomplete endpoints cannot be hidden in an optional attachment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A report cannot omit a material failed subgroup that was included in the approved analysis plan.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Publication permissions
requirements.statement: Public, partner and restricted report views shall follow approved publication rights and redaction decisions.
requirements.acceptance: A public report does not reveal protected small cells, patient details or proprietary artefacts.
requirements.behaviour: Preview each audience view and apply rights, redaction and disclosure checks before publication approval.
requirements.exception: Restricted originals remain protected even when a public summary exists; content changes invalidate previous clearance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A public report does not reveal protected small cells, patient details or proprietary artefacts.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Signed release and integrity
requirements.statement: Issued reports shall have persistent identifiers, issue dates, authorised signers and a verifiable integrity record.
requirements.acceptance: Altering a released report creates a new version and invalidates the altered copy's integrity check.
requirements.behaviour: Issue the signed frozen report with persistent identifier, digest and current-status verification route. Store the issued bytes and manifest.
requirements.exception: An altered copy fails integrity verification; no regenerated file can retain the original integrity identity if bytes change.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Altering a released report creates a new version and invalidates the altered copy's integrity check.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Corrections and retractions
requirements.statement: The service shall issue linked corrections, supersession notices and withdrawals with reasons and notification of prior recipients.
requirements.acceptance: Opening a superseded report displays its current status and link to the authoritative successor.
requirements.behaviour: Create corrections, supersession or withdrawal as linked records with reason and approvals. Notify known recipients and show current status when old links open.
requirements.exception: Historical copies remain identifiable; the system cannot promise recall of every downloaded external file.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Opening a superseded report displays its current status and link to the authoritative successor.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Evidence portability
requirements.statement: An exportable dossier shall include structured metadata and human readable evidence with usage restrictions and unresolved gaps.
requirements.acceptance: A receiving institution can identify what may be reused and what needs local validation.
requirements.behaviour: Export a structured dossier with human readable reports, manifests, restrictions and local gaps. Validate the package before authorised delivery.
requirements.exception: Missing reuse rights exclude affected assets and produce an explicit restriction entry.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A receiving institution can identify what may be reused and what needs local validation.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Results completeness
requirements.statement: Final reports shall reconcile all prespecified endpoints, registered analyses, deviations and missing results.
requirements.acceptance: Unreported endpoints block issue or require an explicit approved explanation.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile all planned endpoints, analyses and deviations against the report before signature.
requirements.exception: Unreported endpoints block issue unless an eligible reviewer approves an explicit, prominent explanation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Unreported endpoints block issue or require an explicit approved explanation.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Public evidence catalogue
requirements.statement: The catalogue shall show verified publication status and allow discovery by use, setting, population and evidence maturity.
requirements.acceptance: Catalogue presence is not presented as an endorsement or universal approval.
requirements.behaviour: Publish only approved metadata and report views with exact scope and freshness. Support filters for use, population and evidence maturity.
requirements.exception: Catalogue presence cannot imply regulatory authorisation, procurement preference or universal endorsement.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Catalogue presence is not presented as an endorsement or universal approval.
requirements.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

requirements.title: Requirements checklist
requirements.statement: Country reviewers shall maintain applicable submission checklists linked to authoritative sources and approved interpretations.
requirements.acceptance: Each required item identifies its evidence location or a documented gap.
requirements.behaviour: Instantiate a source linked checklist and locate the exact evidence for each applicable item. Assign owners to gaps.
requirements.exception: A checked box without evidence or an authorised not applicable rationale cannot satisfy readiness.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Each required item identifies its evidence location or a documented gap.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Submission packages
requirements.statement: Authorised users shall assemble jurisdiction specific packages from approved dossier versions.
requirements.acceptance: A package can contain different evidence and forms for two jurisdictions without changing the underlying findings.
requirements.behaviour: Assemble separate packages for each jurisdiction from approved dossier versions and local forms. Freeze a manifest for review.
requirements.exception: Local package differences do not modify the underlying scientific findings or their original scope.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A package can contain different evidence and forms for two jurisdictions without changing the underlying findings.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: External decision verification
requirements.statement: Approvals and decisions shall identify issuing authority, reference, scope, date, conditions and verification evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A developer assertion remains unverified until the designated verification process completes.
requirements.behaviour: Verify claimed external decisions against issuer evidence and exact use, configuration and validity.
requirements.exception: Developer assertions remain unverified until qualified review; unmatched scope does not count as permission.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer assertion remains unverified until the designated verification process completes.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Authority questions
requirements.statement: The system shall manage questions, responses, deadlines and changed documents with a complete submission history.
requirements.acceptance: A response can be linked to the exact question and submitted file version.
requirements.behaviour: Record authority questions with deadlines and bind each response to the exact question and file versions.
requirements.exception: Superseded responses remain in history; preparing a response does not mark it sent.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A response can be linked to the exact question and submitted file version.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Decision separation
requirements.statement: Internal reviews, external authorisations and conditions shall have separate status records and responsible issuers.
requirements.acceptance: Completing an internal checklist cannot mark a product legally authorised.
requirements.behaviour: Display internal eligibility, checklist completeness and external decision as separate fields and records.
requirements.exception: An internal completion event cannot set legally authorised status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Completing an internal checklist cannot mark a product legally authorised.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Change submissions
requirements.statement: The service shall assess whether material changes require notification, additional evidence or renewed permission under the applicable profile.
requirements.acceptance: A changed intended use triggers a regulatory impact task before clinical continuation.
requirements.behaviour: Assess material changes against the active country profile and permission conditions; create notification, evidence or renewal tasks.
requirements.exception: Changed intended use remains blocked for affected clinical activity until required external action is resolved.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A changed intended use triggers a regulatory impact task before clinical continuation.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Permission expiry
requirements.statement: External conditions, renewal dates and withdrawal notices shall affect the activities they govern.
requirements.acceptance: A withdrawn permission blocks affected new activity and initiates impact review.
requirements.behaviour: Track expiry, conditions and withdrawal notices; update only governed activities and create an impact queue.
requirements.exception: Pending renewal does not extend permission; valid historical decisions retain their original dates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A withdrawn permission blocks affected new activity and initiates impact review.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Submission channel control
requirements.statement: Direct authority submission shall occur only through an approved supported channel and authorised human release.
requirements.acceptance: Preparing a package never automatically transmits it to an authority.
requirements.behaviour: Require human release of the previewed immutable package and verified recipient through a supported channel. Track transmitted and acknowledged separately.
requirements.exception: Unsupported channel yields a prepared package for authorised manual submission, with proof subsequently recorded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Preparing a package never automatically transmits it to an authority.
requirements.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

requirements.title: Transfer request
requirements.statement: A receiving institution shall define intended local use, population, sites, workflow and decision using an existing evidence dossier.
requirements.acceptance: The request references a specific product and dossier version.
requirements.behaviour: Create a request against exact origin versions and receiving intended use. Check reuse rights before exposing dossier content.
requirements.exception: A newer product version is not substituted automatically; inaccessible origin material remains excluded.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The request references a specific product and dossier version.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Gap assessment
requirements.statement: Qualified reviewers shall assess population, prevalence, language, equipment, guidelines, workflow, data rights and regulation differences.
requirements.acceptance: The assessment identifies evidence that is reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with reasons.
requirements.behaviour: Review each contextual difference and classify evidence as reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with qualified rationale.
requirements.exception: Missing local information remains a gap, not an assumed match to the origin population.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The assessment identifies evidence that is reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with reasons.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Local validation plan
requirements.statement: The receiving institution shall approve the additional evaluation required to address material gaps.
requirements.acceptance: A foreign positive report cannot bypass an unresolved local safety or applicability requirement.
requirements.behaviour: Approve additional validation needed to resolve material gaps, with local thresholds and owners.
requirements.exception: A foreign positive result cannot bypass unresolved local safety, rights or applicability requirements.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A foreign positive report cannot bypass an unresolved local safety or applicability requirement.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Adaptation tracking
requirements.statement: Changes to language, rules, thresholds, integrations or training shall create a traceable local configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Local modifications remain distinguishable from the original evaluated product.
requirements.behaviour: Create a local configuration for changes to language, rules, thresholds, integration or training and link new evidence.
requirements.exception: Do not relabel the original configuration as locally evaluated when material modifications exist.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Local modifications remain distinguishable from the original evaluated product.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Evidence reliance decisions
requirements.statement: Authorities and buyers shall record their own decisions to rely on external evidence, including scope and conditions.
requirements.acceptance: No automated evidence passport grants mutual recognition between countries.
requirements.behaviour: Record the receiving authority's or buyer's own reliance decision with accepted scope and conditions.
requirements.exception: The platform cannot issue mutual recognition or a global approval through an evidence passport field.
requirements.fs_acceptance: No automated evidence passport grants mutual recognition between countries.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Shared studies
requirements.statement: Multi country protocols shall support a common core with local appendices, approvals and analysis plans.
requirements.acceptance: A pooled result preserves country level findings and cannot conceal a material local failure.
requirements.behaviour: Manage a shared protocol core and separately approved local appendices. Preserve country results and pooling rationale.
requirements.exception: A favourable pooled result cannot conceal a material local failure or absent local permission.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A pooled result preserves country level findings and cannot conceal a material local failure.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Reuse measurement
requirements.statement: The service shall measure avoided duplicate tasks, adaptation cost and elapsed time with a stated counterfactual.
requirements.acceptance: Estimated savings remain labelled estimates and do not double count shared work.
requirements.behaviour: Record reused tasks and avoided work against an explicit counterfactual; distinguish estimated savings from observed elapsed time.
requirements.exception: Shared tasks are counted once and adaptation costs are included in the net saving.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Estimated savings remain labelled estimates and do not double count shared work.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Country withdrawal
requirements.statement: A country or institution may leave the network while retaining rights and obligations under its agreements.
requirements.acceptance: Withdrawal blocks new sharing without erasing lawful historical evidence or incident responsibilities.
requirements.behaviour: End new sharing at the effective withdrawal date and reconcile retained rights, incidents and obligations.
requirements.exception: Withdrawal cannot erase lawful historical evidence or unassigned local safety responsibilities.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Withdrawal blocks new sharing without erasing lawful historical evidence or incident responsibilities.
requirements.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

requirements.title: Adoption readiness
requirements.statement: The service shall assess evidence, local permissions, financing, infrastructure, staffing, integration, support and maintenance readiness.
requirements.acceptance: A scientifically successful evaluation can remain operationally unready with explicit blockers.
requirements.behaviour: Score readiness dimensions independently and display blockers alongside the scientific decision.
requirements.exception: A favourable evaluation can remain operationally unready; no single success badge combines the two.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A scientifically successful evaluation can remain operationally unready with explicit blockers.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Business case
requirements.statement: Buyers shall receive cost, expected benefit, budget impact, procurement options, uncertainty and implementation dependencies.
requirements.acceptance: The case includes integration and recurring operating costs as well as licence fees.
requirements.behaviour: Build the buyer case from full implementation and recurring costs, expected benefit, uncertainty and budget impact.
requirements.exception: Licence price alone is insufficient; unobserved benefits are labelled estimates with assumptions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The case includes integration and recurring operating costs as well as licence fees.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Procurement support
requirements.statement: The platform shall assemble neutral specifications, evidence references, requirements and evaluation criteria for an institution's purchasing process.
requirements.acceptance: Paid participation cannot silently change procurement ranking or evaluation criteria.
requirements.behaviour: Assemble neutral procurement requirements and evidence with declared criteria and conflicts.
requirements.exception: Paid participation cannot change rankings or requirements without an authorised transparent revision.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Paid participation cannot silently change procurement ranking or evaluation criteria.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Deployment authorisation
requirements.statement: Each deployment shall bind buyer, sites, intended use, approved configuration, permissions, owner and support arrangements.
requirements.acceptance: A sandbox completion status alone cannot authorise production deployment.
requirements.behaviour: Authorise a specific buyer, site, use and configuration after G5 and local permissions pass.
requirements.exception: Sandbox evaluation completion cannot issue production authority or activate unrelated sites.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A sandbox completion status alone cannot authorise production deployment.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Implementation plan
requirements.statement: Plans shall identify milestones, integrations, change management, training, support, budget and accountable owners.
requirements.acceptance: Go live requires evidence that applicable readiness tasks are complete.
requirements.behaviour: Track dependencies and accepted owners for integration, training, support and change management milestones.
requirements.exception: Go live stays blocked while an applicable readiness task or required evidence is incomplete.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Go live requires evidence that applicable readiness tasks are complete.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Acceptance and fallback
requirements.statement: Sites shall approve operational acceptance tests, downtime procedures, rollback and safe standard care fallback.
requirements.acceptance: A failed integration acceptance test blocks the affected go live.
requirements.behaviour: Execute site acceptance and fallback tests, retain results and require local approval.
requirements.exception: Failed integration or untested safe fallback blocks the affected go live; rollback status needs observed confirmation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed integration acceptance test blocks the affected go live.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Training and competency
requirements.statement: Role specific training and competency records shall be linked to access and renewal requirements.
requirements.acceptance: A user can be restricted from a clinical feature after required training expires.
requirements.behaviour: Bind role access to approved training, competence and renewal. Identify users affected by procedure changes.
requirements.exception: Expired required training removes the relevant clinical permission until reassessment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A user can be restricted from a clinical feature after required training expires.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Production boundary
requirements.statement: Evaluation and production environments, credentials, datasets and operational permissions shall remain explicitly separated.
requirements.acceptance: An evaluation credential cannot write to a production patient record.
requirements.behaviour: Keep evaluation and production environments, credentials and data links explicitly typed and separated.
requirements.exception: An evaluation service identity cannot write a live clinical record, even if the user holds a separate production role.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An evaluation credential cannot write to a production patient record.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Contract and budget transition
requirements.statement: Pilot funding, production ownership, recurring budget and support handover shall be recorded before sustained deployment.
requirements.acceptance: A pilot nearing funding expiry shows an accountable continuation or closure decision.
requirements.behaviour: Record pilot end, recurring budget, production owner and support acceptance before sustained deployment.
requirements.exception: Funding expiry creates continuation or safe closure tasks; it cannot silently end required patient follow up.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A pilot nearing funding expiry shows an accountable continuation or closure decision.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Deployment register
requirements.statement: Each site shall report installed version, configuration, operating dates and monitoring responsibilities.
requirements.acceptance: A recall can locate all registered deployments of an affected version.
requirements.behaviour: Maintain site reported installed configuration, operating dates and monitoring responsibility, including confirmation time.
requirements.exception: Unknown or stale installed version is visible and included in recall follow up rather than assumed current.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A recall can locate all registered deployments of an affected version.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Benefits realisation
requirements.statement: The buyer shall compare observed outcomes and total costs with the approved business case on a defined schedule.
requirements.acceptance: An adoption report identifies baseline, attribution limits and incomplete follow up.
requirements.behaviour: Review observed outcomes and total costs against the approved baseline and follow up window.
requirements.exception: Incomplete follow up and attribution limits remain visible; patient reach is not demonstrated health benefit.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An adoption report identifies baseline, attribution limits and incomplete follow up.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Safe termination
requirements.statement: Contracts and plans shall define termination, replacement, data portability and continuity of care obligations.
requirements.acceptance: A vendor exit leaves the institution with a documented transition and retained lawful records.
requirements.behaviour: Execute termination with replacement or fallback, data export, support and clinical responsibility handover.
requirements.exception: A vendor exit cannot mark continuity complete until an accountable local owner accepts remaining duties.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A vendor exit leaves the institution with a documented transition and retained lawful records.
requirements.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

requirements.title: Monitoring plan
requirements.statement: Every monitored deployment shall specify metrics, data sources, cadence, thresholds, owners, missing data handling and escalation.
requirements.acceptance: A deployment cannot be labelled monitored without an active plan and functioning data source.
requirements.behaviour: Activate a plan only with approved definitions, sources, thresholds, missingness and response owners plus a successful feed check.
requirements.exception: A configured plan with a dead source cannot make a deployment actively monitored.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A deployment cannot be labelled monitored without an active plan and functioning data source.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Operational telemetry
requirements.statement: The service shall track availability, latency, failures, abstentions, input quality and usage within permitted data limits.
requirements.acceptance: A missing telemetry feed is reported as unavailable rather than interpreted as zero incidents.
requirements.behaviour: Track operational availability, latency, failures, abstentions and input quality using permitted telemetry and source freshness.
requirements.exception: Missing feed is unavailable, not zero failures or zero usage.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A missing telemetry feed is reported as unavailable rather than interpreted as zero incidents.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Clinical performance follow up
requirements.statement: Where outcome data permit, the service shall assess performance and subgroup outcomes with delayed label handling.
requirements.acceptance: Recent unlabelled cases cannot be counted as successful outcomes.
requirements.behaviour: Separate recent unlabelled cases from mature follow up cohorts and recalculate using the declared outcome window.
requirements.exception: Unobserved outcomes cannot be counted as successful; delayed label updates retain prior report versions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Recent unlabelled cases cannot be counted as successful outcomes.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Drift detection
requirements.statement: Monitoring shall distinguish input, outcome, workflow and performance shifts with documented limitations and review triggers.
requirements.acceptance: A statistical drift signal creates a review rather than an unsupported conclusion of patient harm.
requirements.behaviour: Detect defined input, outcome, workflow or performance shifts and open a qualified review with limitations.
requirements.exception: Statistical drift alone cannot be presented as proven patient harm or an automatic clinical verdict.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A statistical drift signal creates a review rather than an unsupported conclusion of patient harm.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Version change intake
requirements.statement: Developers and sites shall report changes to models, prompts, rules, dependencies, devices and local configurations.
requirements.acceptance: A changed component identifies the associated evidence and monitoring plans for reassessment.
requirements.behaviour: Register every material model, prompt, rule, dependency, device or local configuration change and identify affected evidence and sites.
requirements.exception: Unreported discovered changes remain explicit uncertainty and may restrict current claims.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A changed component identifies the associated evidence and monitoring plans for reassessment.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Change classification
requirements.statement: Qualified owners shall determine whether a change requires regression tests, local revalidation, regulatory action or a new study.
requirements.acceptance: A developer cannot unilaterally declare a material clinical change insignificant.
requirements.behaviour: A qualified owner classifies change impact and records required tests, permissions and study work.
requirements.exception: The developer cannot unilaterally exempt a material clinical change from review.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A developer cannot unilaterally declare a material clinical change insignificant.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Revalidation scheduling
requirements.statement: The service shall schedule periodic and event triggered revalidation and prevent stale findings from appearing current.
requirements.acceptance: An overdue required revalidation produces an explicit restricted or expired evidence status.
requirements.behaviour: Schedule periodic and event triggered revalidation and show due, overdue, restricted and completed states.
requirements.exception: Overdue mandatory review prevents stale evidence being shown as current without an authorised scope decision.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An overdue required revalidation produces an explicit restricted or expired evidence status.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Alert routing
requirements.statement: Alerts shall have severity, owner, acknowledgement, deduplication, escalation and closure evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Unacknowledged urgent alerts reach the backup contact within the configured escalation period.
requirements.behaviour: Assign alerts with deduplication, acknowledgement, escalation and closure evidence. Critical alerts reach a backup if the primary misses the configured interval.
requirements.exception: Acknowledging an alert does not resolve it; duplicates retain occurrence counts and severity history.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Unacknowledged urgent alerts reach the backup contact within the configured escalation period.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Rollback tracking
requirements.statement: Where integrations support rollback, requests shall identify target configuration, authority and site confirmation.
requirements.acceptance: Central issuance does not imply a site completed rollback without positive confirmation.
requirements.behaviour: Request rollback to an approved configuration and track site-specific acknowledgement and execution.
requirements.exception: Central dispatch cannot mark a remote installation rolled back without positive evidence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Central issuance does not imply a site completed rollback without positive confirmation.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Comparative surveillance
requirements.statement: Portfolio views shall compare trends only where definitions, case mix and follow up support meaningful comparison.
requirements.acceptance: A dashboard discloses incomparable denominators and cannot imply a global product ranking.
requirements.behaviour: Compare trends only when metric definition, case mix, denominator and follow up are compatible.
requirements.exception: Incomparable series are separated or clearly qualified and cannot form a universal product ranking.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A dashboard discloses incomparable denominators and cannot imply a global product ranking.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Monitoring handover
requirements.statement: The operator shall transfer or terminate monitoring responsibilities explicitly when contracts end.
requirements.acceptance: No deployment remains represented as actively monitored after its responsible service has stopped.
requirements.behaviour: Transfer or terminate monitoring with accepted owners, source access and effective dates. Update catalogue and deployment claims.
requirements.exception: Ended service cannot remain labelled actively monitored merely because historical data are still displayed.
requirements.fs_acceptance: No deployment remains represented as actively monitored after its responsible service has stopped.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Evidence freshness
requirements.statement: Reports and registry entries shall display latest review, monitored version, unresolved alerts and expiry conditions.
requirements.acceptance: A buyer can identify that installed software differs from the version supporting a published claim.
requirements.behaviour: Show latest evidence review, supporting configuration, installed configuration, monitoring scope and unresolved alerts.
requirements.exception: Version mismatch or expired conditions produce visible limitations on current suitability claims.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A buyer can identify that installed software differs from the version supporting a published claim.
requirements.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

requirements.title: Role specific dashboards
requirements.statement: Users shall see actionable views for developers, sites, reviewers, authorities, funders and operators within their access scopes.
requirements.acceptance: A funder sees approved programme outcomes without receiving patient records by default.
requirements.behaviour: Select the default dashboard from role and current context, then filter all components by effective access.
requirements.exception: Funder visibility is limited to approved programme outcomes and never implies patient record access.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A funder sees approved programme outcomes without receiving patient records by default.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Portfolio funnel
requirements.statement: Reports shall track need, application, feasibility, evaluation, decision, deployment and ongoing monitoring with withdrawal reasons.
requirements.acceptance: A failed scientific evaluation is distinguishable from an unfunded otherwise suitable solution.
requirements.behaviour: Count distinct opportunities through need, application, feasibility, evaluation, decision, deployment and monitoring with explicit outcomes.
requirements.exception: Scientific failure, withdrawal, missing funds and incomplete application remain separate categories.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed scientific evaluation is distinguishable from an unfunded otherwise suitable solution.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Time and bottlenecks
requirements.statement: The platform shall measure elapsed and active time at each stage, including external delays and rework.
requirements.acceptance: Reported turnaround includes a published rule for paused and abandoned studies.
requirements.behaviour: Calculate elapsed and active stage time from the event ledger with stated pause and abandonment treatment.
requirements.exception: Resetting stage labels cannot erase earlier waiting or rework intervals.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Reported turnaround includes a published rule for paused and abandoned studies.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Evidence quality reporting
requirements.statement: Dashboards shall show completeness, independence, representativeness, unresolved findings and evidence age.
requirements.acceptance: A large number of tests cannot substitute for missing independent clinical validation.
requirements.behaviour: Display evidence completeness, independence, subgroup coverage, unresolved findings and age with their denominators.
requirements.exception: Large test counts cannot substitute for missing independent clinical evidence.
