requirements.fs_acceptance: A large number of tests cannot substitute for missing independent clinical validation.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Outcome reporting
requirements.statement: Programmes shall report relevant clinical, operational, equity and economic outcomes with baseline and attribution limits.
requirements.acceptance: Patient reach is not displayed as demonstrated health benefit.
requirements.behaviour: Report defined clinical, workflow, equity and economic outcomes against baseline with follow up maturity and attribution limits.
requirements.exception: Reach or model calls cannot be relabelled health benefit.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Patient reach is not displayed as demonstrated health benefit.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Resource and financial reporting
requirements.statement: Managers shall view budget, committed and actual costs, capacity, receivables and funding runway at authorised granularity.
requirements.acceptance: Study cost reconciles with approved compute, personnel and external service charges.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile authorised programme and study costs to approved usage, personnel and services; show commitments separately from actuals.
requirements.exception: Do not add currencies without a disclosed approved conversion basis or double count commitments already invoiced.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Study cost reconciles with approved compute, personnel and external service charges.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Governed metrics
requirements.statement: Every shared metric shall have definition, owner, source, refresh rate, allowed dimensions and version history.
requirements.acceptance: A changed definition is visible in longitudinal comparisons.
requirements.behaviour: Approve metric definitions and allowed dimensions before shared use. Version changes and show breaks in longitudinal series.
requirements.exception: A changed denominator cannot silently appear as an improvement in the same metric.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A changed definition is visible in longitudinal comparisons.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Privacy preserving reporting
requirements.statement: Aggregate views shall apply suppression, scope and disclosure controls to filters, comparisons and exports.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated small group queries cannot trivially reconstruct a protected individual's result.
requirements.behaviour: Apply scope, small cell and inference controls to charts, filters, comparisons and exports.
requirements.exception: Repeated queries and complementary totals must not reconstruct suppressed individual results.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Repeated small group queries cannot trivially reconstruct a protected individual's result.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Report exports
requirements.statement: Users shall export approved views with timestamp, filters, definitions, data freshness and confidentiality labels.
requirements.acceptance: An exported chart retains qualifications that materially affect its interpretation.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze export filters, definitions, source freshness and limitations with the approved visual or tabular output.
requirements.exception: Recheck rights before download; an exported chart cannot omit a material qualification.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An exported chart retains qualifications that materially affect its interpretation.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Scheduled reporting
requirements.statement: Reports shall be generated and delivered only to authorised recipients with expiry and failure tracking.
requirements.acceptance: A recipient removed before delivery does not receive the scheduled restricted report.
requirements.behaviour: Generate scheduled reports under the owner's approved scope, recheck each recipient at delivery and record failures.
requirements.exception: Removed recipients receive no restricted content; a schedule cannot preserve privileges after its owner leaves.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A recipient removed before delivery does not receive the scheduled restricted report.
requirements.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

requirements.title: Contextual discussions
requirements.statement: Users shall comment on specific requirements, protocol sections, assets and findings with permissions inherited from the object.
requirements.acceptance: A comment mentioning a restricted study does not expose it to an unauthorised tagged user.
requirements.behaviour: Attach discussions to object versions and inherit their permissions. Validate each mention against discovery and discussion rights.
requirements.exception: A tagged user without access receives no confidential title or comment excerpt.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A comment mentioning a restricted study does not expose it to an unauthorised tagged user.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Assignments and reminders
requirements.statement: Tasks shall support owners, due dates, dependencies, escalations and completion evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A task cannot disappear when its assigned user leaves the organisation.
requirements.behaviour: Assign work with owner, due date, dependencies and evidence; route reminders through permitted channels.
requirements.exception: Departure reassigns to the accountable owner; tasks cannot disappear with a deactivated account.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A task cannot disappear when its assigned user leaves the organisation.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Notifications
requirements.statement: Notifications shall use approved channels, minimise sensitive content and link to authenticated records.
requirements.acceptance: Email subject lines and push previews do not include patient identifiers or confidential findings.
requirements.behaviour: Use minimal notification previews and authenticated links; user preferences govern ordinary channels only.
requirements.exception: Patient identifiers, sensitive findings and secrets never appear in email subjects or push previews.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Email subject lines and push previews do not include patient identifiers or confidential findings.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Consequential communications
requirements.statement: Regulatory submissions, public publication and external safety notices shall require an authorised release action.
requirements.acceptance: Drafting a message or report does not send or publish it automatically.
requirements.behaviour: Require authorised release of exact content and recipients for submissions, public publication and external safety notices.
requirements.exception: Drafting, AI generation or task completion never sends consequential communications automatically.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Drafting a message or report does not send or publish it automatically.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Meeting decisions
requirements.statement: Meeting notes shall capture participants, conflicts, decisions, actions and approval of the final record.
requirements.acceptance: A discussion summary cannot silently substitute for a required formal gate decision.
requirements.behaviour: Record meeting participants, conflicts, decisions and actions, then obtain approval of the final minutes.
requirements.exception: Minutes do not substitute for a required structured gate decision or signature.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A discussion summary cannot silently substitute for a required formal gate decision.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Document collaboration
requirements.statement: The system shall support controlled versions, review comments, comparison and concurrent edit conflict handling.
requirements.acceptance: One reviewer's edit cannot overwrite another reviewer's change without resolution.
requirements.behaviour: Support controlled revisions and compare concurrent changes using observed versions. Preserve comments against their original text where possible.
requirements.exception: Conflicting controlled text requires explicit resolution; no silent last write overwrite.
requirements.fs_acceptance: One reviewer's edit cannot overwrite another reviewer's change without resolution.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Translation review
requirements.statement: Translated clinical and legal materials shall retain source version, reviewer and approved language version.
requirements.acceptance: An unreviewed machine translation is marked draft and cannot serve as approved consent material.
requirements.behaviour: Bind translations to source version and qualified language review; show draft machine provenance until approved.
requirements.exception: Source change marks translations for review; unapproved text cannot become consent or authority material.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unreviewed machine translation is marked draft and cannot serve as approved consent material.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Communication audit
requirements.statement: Material notifications shall record intended recipients, delivery status, acknowledgement when required and retries.
requirements.acceptance: A failed delivery is not counted as successful notification.
requirements.behaviour: Track recipient snapshots, attempts, delivery evidence and required acknowledgement. Escalate failed material notifications.
requirements.exception: Sent is not delivered and delivered is not acknowledged; unsupported channel receipts remain unknown.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed delivery is not counted as successful notification.
requirements.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

requirements.title: Knowledge library
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain approved protocols, checklists, methods, case studies and implementation guidance with owners and review dates.
requirements.acceptance: Outdated guidance is labelled and excluded from default new study templates.
requirements.behaviour: Publish approved methods and guidance with owner, scope and review date. Template selection uses only currently eligible versions.
requirements.exception: Overdue or withdrawn guidance remains labelled historical and is excluded from default new study templates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Outdated guidance is labelled and excluded from default new study templates.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Learning from failure
requirements.statement: Programmes shall capture unsuccessful evaluations and implementation failures with approved confidentiality and publication scopes.
requirements.acceptance: A case study can describe failure without exposing a protected developer or participant.
requirements.behaviour: Capture failed evaluations and implementations with evidence and context, then review confidentiality and rights before sharing.
requirements.exception: Anonymisation must be assessed for reidentification; failure learning cannot expose a protected developer or participant.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A case study can describe failure without exposing a protected developer or participant.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Role based onboarding
requirements.statement: Users shall receive required guidance for their role, including data handling, evaluation integrity and escalation.
requirements.acceptance: Completion of mandatory onboarding is checked before restricted access is activated.
requirements.behaviour: Assign role-specific onboarding on membership activation and track required completion.
requirements.exception: Restricted access remains blocked until mandatory data, integrity and escalation training is complete.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Completion of mandatory onboarding is checked before restricted access is activated.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Training records
requirements.statement: Training shall have version, completion, assessment, renewal date and applicable roles.
requirements.acceptance: Changing a material procedure identifies users requiring refresher training.
requirements.behaviour: Record course version, assessed competence and renewal; material procedure changes identify users needing refresher work.
requirements.exception: Prior attendance alone cannot satisfy a new competence requirement or expired assessment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Changing a material procedure identifies users requiring refresher training.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Community exchange
requirements.statement: Members may share approved questions, methods and events with moderation and conflict controls.
requirements.acceptance: A community post cannot reveal sealed test data or private review materials.
requirements.behaviour: Moderate questions, methods and events within approved audiences and declared conflicts.
requirements.exception: Sealed tests and private reviews cannot be shared through community content or attachments.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A community post cannot reveal sealed test data or private review materials.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Method governance
requirements.statement: Proposed new methods shall undergo validation and approval before they enter official templates or evaluation packs.
requirements.acceptance: An experimental metric remains clearly identified until its review is complete.
requirements.behaviour: Validate a method proposal using declared fixtures and qualified review before adding it to an official pack.
requirements.exception: Experimental status remains visible and cannot replace an approved metric without the relevant protocol change.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An experimental metric remains clearly identified until its review is complete.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Network learning reports
requirements.statement: The service may publish aggregated lessons and recurring evidence gaps under disclosure and rights review.
requirements.acceptance: Published lessons distinguish observed findings from hypotheses and cannot imply universal applicability.
requirements.behaviour: Compile aggregate lessons with source provenance and disclosure review; distinguish findings from hypotheses.
requirements.exception: Network experience cannot be presented as universally applicable clinical proof.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Published lessons distinguish observed findings from hypotheses and cannot imply universal applicability.
requirements.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

requirements.title: Assisted drafting
requirements.statement: Users may obtain drafts of protocols, evidence summaries, applications and implementation plans grounded in approved sources.
requirements.acceptance: Drafts are labelled as AI assisted and cannot become signed decisions without human review.
requirements.behaviour: Generate clearly labelled drafts for enabled tasks from approved sources; insert into an editable draft only after user acceptance.
requirements.exception: Generated material cannot become a signed protocol, decision or report without normal review and gates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Drafts are labelled as AI assisted and cannot become signed decisions without human review.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Permission aware retrieval
requirements.statement: AI assistants shall retrieve only information the requesting user may access for the active purpose and study.
requirements.acceptance: A prompt cannot expose another tenant's document, hidden review or sealed benchmark.
requirements.behaviour: Resolve retrieval against the current user's object, purpose and blinding permissions at query and response delivery.
requirements.exception: Prompts cannot access another tenant, hidden reviewer deliberation or sealed benchmark; revoked sources are removed from delivery.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A prompt cannot expose another tenant's document, hidden review or sealed benchmark.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Source attribution
requirements.statement: Material factual claims in generated summaries shall reference accessible evidence and distinguish inference or missing information.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported findings are flagged and are not inserted as verified study results.
requirements.behaviour: Attach accessible source references to material factual claims and distinguish inference or missing evidence.
requirements.exception: Unsupported claims are flagged and cannot be inserted as verified study findings without human source checking.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Unsupported findings are flagged and are not inserted as verified study results.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Consequential action control
requirements.statement: AI assistance shall not autonomously approve studies, grant access, issue clinical findings, publish reports, submit to authorities or spend unapproved funds.
requirements.acceptance: Every consequential action requires the specified authorised human confirmation and gate checks.
requirements.behaviour: Represent consequential actions as nonexecuting proposals. The authorised user opens the ordinary command preview and passes current guards.
requirements.exception: The assistant cannot approve, grant, publish, submit, issue clinical findings or spend outside an existing authorised budget.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Every consequential action requires the specified authorised human confirmation and gate checks.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Provider governance
requirements.statement: Model providers, data transmission, retention, training use and processing regions shall meet approved institutional terms.
requirements.acceptance: Restricted study content is not sent to a provider lacking applicable approval.
requirements.behaviour: Check provider terms, region, retention and training permissions before transmitting any content.
requirements.exception: Unapproved provider or changed terms block the request; ordinary workflow remains available.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Restricted study content is not sent to a provider lacking applicable approval.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Untrusted content handling
requirements.statement: Uploaded documents, retrieved pages and model outputs shall be treated as content rather than authority to change permissions or instructions.
requirements.acceptance: Embedded instructions in a document cannot trigger an export or disable a review gate.
requirements.behaviour: Treat retrieved text, files and model output as untrusted content. Tool requests use declared allowlists and the user's effective permissions.
requirements.exception: Embedded instructions cannot alter authority, export assets or disable review controls.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Embedded instructions in a document cannot trigger an export or disable a review gate.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: User correction
requirements.statement: Users shall edit, reject and report generated content with retained provenance and feedback routing.
requirements.acceptance: Correcting a draft does not erase the fact that AI assistance was used.
requirements.behaviour: Allow edit, reject and report; preserve the original generated version, user revisions and AI provenance within retention rules.
requirements.exception: Correcting text cannot remove provenance or silently change an issued record.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Correcting a draft does not erase the fact that AI assistance was used.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Assistant evaluation
requirements.statement: Platform AI features shall have task specific quality, safety and privacy evaluation before activation and after material changes.
requirements.acceptance: A failed critical safety or permission test prevents release of the feature.
requirements.behaviour: Activate only after task, privacy, access and adversarial tests pass; rerun affected tests after model, prompt, tool or corpus changes.
requirements.exception: A critical failure blocks the feature even if average quality improves.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed critical safety or permission test prevents release of the feature.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Administrative controls
requirements.statement: Institutions shall enable or disable AI features by purpose, data class and user role within mandatory controls.
requirements.acceptance: A disabled feature cannot be invoked through an API or background task.
requirements.behaviour: Enable functions by institution, role, purpose and data class within mandatory operator limits. Preview effect before activation.
requirements.exception: Disabled capability is also denied through APIs, schedules and background tasks.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A disabled feature cannot be invoked through an API or background task.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Fallback and abstention
requirements.statement: The assistant shall indicate uncertainty and permit normal workflow completion when AI is unavailable or unsuitable.
requirements.acceptance: A failed AI service cannot prevent an authorised user from filing a safety incident.
requirements.behaviour: Show uncertainty, insufficient sources or provider failure plainly and keep the manual workflow usable.
requirements.exception: Assistant outage cannot block incident filing, ordinary drafting, review or required evidence access.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed AI service cannot prevent an authorised user from filing a safety incident.
requirements.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

requirements.title: Versioned interfaces
requirements.statement: The platform shall expose documented versioned APIs for approved core objects with consistent authentication, pagination and error handling.
requirements.acceptance: A published integration can identify the API version and supported deprecation period.
requirements.behaviour: Expose documented versioned operations with consistent authentication, object scoping, cursor pagination and structured errors.
requirements.exception: Breaking changes require the BRD notice period or a recorded urgent exception with managed alternatives.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A published integration can identify the API version and supported deprecation period.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Scoped integration access
requirements.statement: Each connector shall have a separate owner, purpose, scopes, credentials, approved destinations and revocation path.
requirements.acceptance: A reporting connector cannot inherit permission to export raw clinical data.
requirements.behaviour: Create a dedicated owned service identity per connector, with purpose, destinations and minimal scopes.
requirements.exception: Reporting integration cannot inherit raw clinical export rights or the administrator's other privileges.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A reporting connector cannot inherit permission to export raw clinical data.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Health record exchange
requirements.statement: Selected clinical integrations shall support the receiving institution's agreed HL7 FHIR version and implementation profile where applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Profile validation and unit or terminology mapping pass agreed conformance examples before activation.
requirements.behaviour: Select the institution's agreed FHIR version and implementation profile and validate representative resources plus terminology and units.
requirements.exception: Unrecognised or invalid clinical meaning is quarantined; generic JSON acceptance is not conformance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Profile validation and unit or terminology mapping pass agreed conformance examples before activation.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Medical imaging exchange
requirements.statement: Imaging integrations shall support the agreed DICOM objects and services with identity, study relationship and deidentification checks.
requirements.acceptance: Transferred images retain clinically necessary metadata while prohibited identifiers are handled as approved.
requirements.behaviour: Declare supported DICOM objects and services and preserve study and series relationships under approved deidentification.
requirements.exception: Missing identity reconciliation or prohibited identifiers block the transfer's accepted status.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Transferred images retain clinically necessary metadata while prohibited identifiers are handled as approved.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Research and health information systems
requirements.statement: The platform shall support approved connections to institutional EDC, laboratory, public health or research systems according to programme need.
requirements.acceptance: Each connected field has an identified authoritative source and reconciliation rule.
requirements.behaviour: Map EDC, laboratory and research fields to authoritative sources and reconciliation rules before activation.
requirements.exception: Conflicting observations do not create a competing master; raise a source resolution case.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Each connected field has an identified authoritative source and reconciliation rule.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Import and export portability
requirements.statement: Authorised data and metadata shall be exchangeable in documented nonproprietary formats with a data dictionary and version information.
requirements.acceptance: A receiving tool can reconstruct object relationships from an approved export.
requirements.behaviour: Export authorised records in documented open formats with schema version, dictionaries and relationship keys.
requirements.exception: Receiver reconstruction tests must pass; inaccessible assets are omitted with a manifest explanation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A receiving tool can reconstruct object relationships from an approved export.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Reliable events
requirements.statement: Webhooks and events shall support verification, idempotency, retry, ordering assumptions and replay controls.
requirements.acceptance: Repeated delivery does not duplicate a clinical decision, invoice or approval.
requirements.behaviour: Verify event authenticity, deduplicate by event identity and process according to stated ordering rules. Record acknowledgements and bounded retries.
requirements.exception: Repeated delivery cannot repeat approval, grant or charge; replay does not create new authority.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Repeated delivery does not duplicate a clinical decision, invoice or approval.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Connector failures
requirements.statement: Integration failures shall be visible, retriable where safe and isolated from unrelated workflows.
requirements.acceptance: An unavailable external system cannot cause silent loss of an acknowledged source record.
requirements.behaviour: Show failed exchanges with safe reason, affected range and retry eligibility. Preserve acknowledged source records until reconciled.
requirements.exception: External outage cannot silently drop accepted inputs or block unrelated study functions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unavailable external system cannot cause silent loss of an acknowledged source record.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Mapping governance
requirements.statement: Mappings for codes, units, time, identifiers and field meaning shall be reviewed and versioned.
requirements.acceptance: An unrecognised clinical code is quarantined or explicitly represented rather than silently replaced.
requirements.behaviour: Review and version mappings for code, unit, time and identifiers; retain original and transformed meaning.
requirements.exception: Unknown codes and incompatible units are quarantined rather than guessed or silently substituted.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An unrecognised clinical code is quarantined or explicitly represented rather than silently replaced.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Identity and finance integrations
requirements.statement: The service shall integrate approved identity directories, ticketing, accounting and signature systems with limited scopes.
requirements.acceptance: An accounting integration receives billing data without gaining clinical evidence access.
requirements.behaviour: Use approved scoped interfaces for identity, finance, signatures and support; declare ownership of each exchanged field.
requirements.exception: Accounting receives financial metadata only; role provisioning cannot trust arbitrary external group names.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An accounting integration receives billing data without gaining clinical evidence access.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Connector lifecycle
requirements.statement: New and changed connectors shall undergo security, data rights and conformance assessment and support controlled disablement.
requirements.acceptance: Disabling a connector stops new transfers and preserves the record of past exchanges.
requirements.behaviour: Activate after rights, security and conformance approval. Disable stops new exchanges while preserving pending outcomes and history.
requirements.exception: Credential revocation and queued work are reconciled; disablement cannot erase past transmissions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Disabling a connector stops new transfers and preserves the record of past exchanges.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: External evidence exchange
requirements.statement: Participating registries and governance networks may exchange approved evidence metadata through agreed schemas and permissions.
requirements.acceptance: An external directory receives only the authorised metadata and current evidence status.
requirements.behaviour: Exchange only approved evidence metadata with named external networks using agreed schema and audience scope.
requirements.exception: Publish current status and corrections without patient detail; partner directory membership implies no new sharing rights.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An external directory receives only the authorised metadata and current evidence status.
requirements.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

requirements.title: Service catalogue
requirements.statement: The service shall define evaluation, data preparation, implementation and monitoring packages with scope, exclusions and pricing basis.
requirements.acceptance: A buyer can identify which activities and deliverables are included before contracting.
requirements.behaviour: Publish service packages with deliverables, exclusions, pricing basis, prerequisites and acceptance rules.
requirements.exception: A quote cannot imply unsupported countries, capabilities or regulatory approval as an included deliverable.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A buyer can identify which activities and deliverables are included before contracting.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Cost estimation
requirements.statement: Study estimates shall include staff, sites, data preparation, compute, oversight, integration and contingency assumptions.
requirements.acceptance: Estimate changes identify the driver and require the applicable budget approval.
requirements.behaviour: Estimate staff, sites, data, compute, oversight, integration and contingency with quantities and assumptions.
requirements.exception: Scope or cost changes create a revised estimate and applicable budget approval, not hidden increments.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Estimate changes identify the driver and require the applicable budget approval.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Quotes and approvals
requirements.statement: Quotes, discounts and change orders shall be versioned with delegated approval limits and customer acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: A change in scope cannot silently increase an institution's financial commitment.
requirements.behaviour: Route quotes and discounts through delegated financial limits and record customer acceptance of the exact version.
requirements.exception: Accepted scope cannot increase commitment without an authorised change order.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A change in scope cannot silently increase an institution's financial commitment.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Budget controls
requirements.statement: The platform shall allocate budgets, commitments, actual costs and funding sources with alerts and spend approval limits.
requirements.acceptance: A study cannot exceed its approved hard spending limit through automatic retries.
requirements.behaviour: Reserve budget for approved work, show committed versus actual and warn at 80 and 100 percent unless stricter rules apply.
requirements.exception: Hard limits block new unauthorised consumption, including retries, while preserving safe termination and evidence.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study cannot exceed its approved hard spending limit through automatic retries.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Usage metering
requirements.statement: Billable consumption shall be attributable to institution, study, service and run with reconciliation and dispute support.
requirements.acceptance: A failed retry is charged only according to the declared billing policy.
requirements.behaviour: Meter usage by institution, study, service and logical run, then reconcile attempts and rate versions.
requirements.exception: Failed retries are billable only under declared terms; duplicates cannot create a second charge.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A failed retry is charged only according to the declared billing policy.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Invoices and payments
requirements.statement: The service shall support invoices, credits, payment status, local currency and applicable tax handling through approved finance processes.
requirements.acceptance: An issued credit links to the original invoice and preserves audit history.
requirements.behaviour: Prepare invoices through approved finance processes with explicit currency and applicable tax configuration. Link credits to originals.
requirements.exception: Posted accounting records are not silently edited locally; correction uses the finance authority's approved process.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An issued credit links to the original invoice and preserves audit history.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Grant and subsidy management
requirements.statement: Awards shall identify eligible recipients, permitted costs, milestones, reporting and remaining funds.
requirements.acceptance: A subsidised evaluation shows the payer without changing the scientific scoring rules.
requirements.behaviour: Allocate awards to eligible recipients, costs, milestones and periods and report remaining funds.
requirements.exception: Subsidy payer visibility cannot change scientific scoring, reviewer assignment or safety gates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A subsidised evaluation shows the payer without changing the scientific scoring rules.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Commercial independence
requirements.statement: Payment, sponsorship and sales relationships shall not override data, ethics, safety or scientific gates.
requirements.acceptance: An overdue invoice cannot delete unfavourable evidence or prevent an urgent safety report.
requirements.behaviour: Apply commercial restrictions only within contracts and display protected scientific and safety actions separately.
requirements.exception: Overdue payment cannot delete findings, block urgent concern intake or bypass safe closure.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An overdue invoice cannot delete unfavourable evidence or prevent an urgent safety report.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Financial disputes
requirements.statement: Billing disputes shall have an owner, evidence, timeline and decision separate from scientific appeals.
requirements.acceptance: A scientific appeal remains available under its own policy despite an unrelated invoice dispute.
requirements.behaviour: Open billing disputes with charge evidence, owner and timeline; retain independent financial decisions.
requirements.exception: Scientific appeals remain available under their own rules and cannot be merged into invoice negotiation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A scientific appeal remains available under its own policy despite an unrelated invoice dispute.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Renewal and exit
requirements.statement: Monitoring and service subscriptions shall have renewal, notice, transition and retained obligation records.
requirements.acceptance: Service expiry triggers a documented handover and removes unsupported active monitoring claims.
requirements.behaviour: Track renewals, notice and service end; obtain accepted monitoring or support handover where required.
requirements.exception: Expired service removes unsupported active monitoring claims without erasing retained evidence or duties.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Service expiry triggers a documented handover and removes unsupported active monitoring claims.
requirements.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

requirements.title: Audit coverage
requirements.statement: The platform shall record authentication, access grants, restricted data reads, changes, executions, approvals, exports, publications and privileged activity.
requirements.acceptance: A sampled sensitive action can be traced to actor, scope, object version, time and outcome.
requirements.behaviour: Capture authentication, restricted reads, grants, edits, runs, decisions, exports, publications and privileged actions with context.
requirements.exception: A sensitive action cannot succeed without its required durable audit record or approved recoverable transaction treatment.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A sampled sensitive action can be traced to actor, scope, object version, time and outcome.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Audit integrity
requirements.statement: Audit records shall be append only or equivalently protected with detectable tampering and restricted administrative access.
requirements.acceptance: An administrator cannot alter an event without detection and a separately retained record.
requirements.behaviour: Protect event history and provide tamper verification with separately retained integrity evidence.
requirements.exception: Administrators cannot edit audit events as ordinary records; suspected tampering opens an incident.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An administrator cannot alter an event without detection and a separately retained record.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Before and after changes
requirements.statement: Material changes shall preserve previous and new values or safe references, reasons and approvals without logging unnecessary secrets.
requirements.acceptance: An investigator can reconstruct a permission change without exposing authentication credentials.
requirements.behaviour: Retain safe before and after values or protected references for material changes with reason and approval.
requirements.exception: Do not log secrets, full prompts or patient records merely to achieve audit detail.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An investigator can reconstruct a permission change without exposing authentication credentials.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Audit access
requirements.statement: Auditors shall receive scoped read only access with confidentiality controls and no routine permission to alter study records.
requirements.acceptance: An auditor cannot approve the report being audited.
requirements.behaviour: Grant auditors time bounded read only inspection scopes and independently authorise exports.
requirements.exception: Audit access cannot modify records or approve the scientific decision under inspection.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An auditor cannot approve the report being audited.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Control evidence library
requirements.statement: The service shall maintain policies, control owners, assessments, test evidence, exceptions and renewal dates.
requirements.acceptance: A requested control can be linked to its latest verification and unresolved findings.
requirements.behaviour: Maintain controls, owners, test evidence, findings, exceptions and review dates; link each control to current verification.
requirements.exception: A policy attachment without test evidence cannot be displayed as an implemented verified control.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A requested control can be linked to its latest verification and unresolved findings.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Compliance mapping
requirements.statement: Qualified owners shall map applicable laws, contracts and standards to controls and evidence with versioned applicability decisions.
requirements.acceptance: The platform cannot advertise compliance solely because a checklist template exists.
requirements.behaviour: Map obligations and standard versions to applicable controls with qualified interpretation and source.
requirements.exception: A checklist template cannot create a compliance or certification claim.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The platform cannot advertise compliance solely because a checklist template exists.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Inspection support
requirements.statement: Authorised inspections shall produce bounded evidence packages with access records, redaction and chain of custody.
requirements.acceptance: The exported inspection package reconciles to the selected source versions.
requirements.behaviour: Freeze inspection scope and export manifest, apply rights and redactions and record recipient custody.
requirements.exception: Exported record counts and versions must reconcile; omitted restricted items are explicitly accounted for.
requirements.fs_acceptance: The exported inspection package reconciles to the selected source versions.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Legal holds
requirements.statement: Authorised legal holds shall prevent affected destruction and record scope, reason, approver, review and release.
requirements.acceptance: A scheduled deletion cannot remove a held record or its required supporting evidence.
requirements.behaviour: Apply bounded holds to records and required dependencies, intercepting scheduled disposal. Record review and authorised release.
requirements.exception: Deleting a parent or changing a retention rule cannot bypass an active hold.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A scheduled deletion cannot remove a held record or its required supporting evidence.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Exceptions and expiry
requirements.statement: Control exceptions shall have compensating measures, risk owner, independent approval, scope and expiry.
requirements.acceptance: An expired exception cannot silently remain active.
requirements.behaviour: Approve exceptions with compensating controls, independent owner and expiry; show affected release gates.
requirements.exception: Expired exceptions cease to authorise activity and cannot silently roll forward.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An expired exception cannot silently remain active.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Periodic assurance review
requirements.statement: The service shall track security assessments, privacy reviews, clinical audits and remediation with accountable owners.
requirements.acceptance: A recurring critical finding triggers escalation to the appropriate governance body.
requirements.behaviour: Schedule assurance reviews and track finding severity, owners and remediation evidence.
requirements.exception: Recurring critical findings escalate even when previous instances were individually marked resolved.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A recurring critical finding triggers escalation to the appropriate governance body.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Certification claims
requirements.statement: Any certification or accreditation claim shall identify issuing body, scope, version, validity and supporting evidence.
requirements.acceptance: An assessment in progress is never displayed as a completed certification.
requirements.behaviour: Verify issuing body, scope, version and validity before permitting certification wording in public or institutional views.
requirements.exception: Assessment in progress remains pending and cannot be advertised as certification.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An assessment in progress is never displayed as a completed certification.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Audit retention
requirements.statement: Audit retention shall follow approved purpose and jurisdiction profiles with privacy controls and verifiable disposal.
requirements.acceptance: Audit logs cannot be retained indefinitely solely because storage is available.
requirements.behaviour: Apply approved audit retention by event class and jurisdiction, preserving active holds and disposal proof.
requirements.exception: Available storage alone cannot justify indefinite retention or remove privacy restrictions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Audit logs cannot be retained indefinitely solely because storage is available.
requirements.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

requirements.title: Operational console
requirements.statement: Operators shall see service health, queues, capacity, failures and dependencies without routine access to restricted study content.
requirements.acceptance: Support can identify a failed job using metadata and approved diagnostics.
requirements.behaviour: Show queue, health and dependency metadata with correlation references. Use approved diagnostics to locate faults.
requirements.exception: Routine operators cannot open patient content, proprietary models or sealed benchmarks through the console.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Support can identify a failed job using metadata and approved diagnostics.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Support access
requirements.statement: Support cases shall use redacted attachments and explicit time limited approvals for any exceptional sensitive access.
requirements.acceptance: A user filing a ticket does not grant blanket access to all institutional data.
requirements.behaviour: Accept redacted support material and request explicit scoped temporary access only when necessary.
requirements.exception: Creating a ticket grants no general tenant visibility; expired support access is revoked automatically.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A user filing a ticket does not grant blanket access to all institutional data.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Incident management
requirements.statement: Operational incidents shall have severity, owner, communications, recovery actions and post incident review.
requirements.acceptance: Major incidents preserve a timeline and tracked corrective actions.
requirements.behaviour: Declare priority, assign owner and runbook, record recovery and issue required communications. Preserve a complete incident chronology.
requirements.exception: Recovery cannot close the post incident actions or clinical safety case automatically.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Major incidents preserve a timeline and tracked corrective actions.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Configuration control
requirements.statement: Production configuration changes shall be reviewed, versioned, tested and reversible where appropriate.
requirements.acceptance: Changing an access rule records who approved it and what affected scopes were assessed.
requirements.behaviour: Review configuration diffs with scope impact, tests and recovery method before activation.
requirements.exception: A privileged configuration edit cannot weaken nonwaivable controls or silently affect other countries.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Changing an access rule records who approved it and what affected scopes were assessed.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Feature activation
requirements.statement: Risky or conditional capabilities shall be activated only for scopes that pass their release and operational gates.
requirements.acceptance: Enabling a user interface feature cannot bypass a missing clinical capability approval.
requirements.behaviour: Activate capabilities only for scopes with required release and operational evidence. Maintain separate UI availability and enforceable activation record.
requirements.exception: Turning on a menu or feature flag cannot bypass clinical, privacy or country gates.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Enabling a user interface feature cannot bypass a missing clinical capability approval.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Service notices
requirements.statement: Maintenance and incident communications shall identify affected services, scope, expected impact and current status.
requirements.acceptance: Users can distinguish a planned outage from failure of their own study.
requirements.behaviour: Publish scoped maintenance and incident notices with expected impact, current state and approved update cadence.
requirements.exception: Avoid confidential study detail; users must distinguish service disruption from an individual study failure.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Users can distinguish a planned outage from failure of their own study.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Capacity and quota management
requirements.statement: Operators shall manage fair allocation, reservations and escalation for competing workloads.
requirements.acceptance: A large commercial customer cannot consume protected capacity assigned to an active safety investigation.
requirements.behaviour: Allocate reservations and quotas fairly using approved priorities and protected incident capacity.
requirements.exception: A large customer's workload cannot consume a reserved active safety investigation allocation.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A large commercial customer cannot consume protected capacity assigned to an active safety investigation.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Backup and restore operations
requirements.statement: Operators shall perform verified backups and controlled restores with residency, access and deletion restrictions preserved.
requirements.acceptance: A restored environment does not reactivate revoked users or deleted data without reconciliation.
requirements.behaviour: Perform restore in isolation, verify integrity and reconcile current grants, revocations, holds and deletion ledger before reopening.
requirements.exception: A snapshot cannot reactivate departed users, disposed data or expired permissions.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A restored environment does not reactivate revoked users or deleted data without reconciliation.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Release management
requirements.statement: Application and evaluation component releases shall include approvals, verification, rollback conditions and affected user communication.
requirements.acceptance: A metric implementation update cannot silently alter previously issued results.
requirements.behaviour: Release only with approved requirements, regression evidence, rollout and recovery plan. Keep metric versions pinned to historical results.
requirements.exception: Updating computation code cannot recalculate issued reports in place.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A metric implementation update cannot silently alter previously issued results.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Support service catalogue
requirements.statement: Institutions shall know support hours, contact methods, escalation routes and responsibility boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: Clinical sites have a local urgent route even when ordinary technical support is unavailable.
requirements.behaviour: Publish support hours, routes, urgency criteria and local clinical responsibilities per institution.
requirements.exception: Ordinary helpdesk closure does not remove the approved out of band urgent route.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Clinical sites have a local urgent route even when ordinary technical support is unavailable.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Supplier continuity
requirements.statement: Critical suppliers shall have assessed dependencies, exit options, incident contacts and change notification requirements.
requirements.acceptance: A supplier outage can be linked to affected studies and recovery options.
requirements.behaviour: Register critical supplier dependencies and tested continuity options; map outages and changes to affected services and studies.
requirements.exception: Supplier substitution requires renewed rights, residency and conformance checks where material.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A supplier outage can be linked to affected studies and recovery options.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Institutional service reviews
requirements.statement: The operator shall provide agreed reviews of performance, unresolved issues, costs and upcoming obligations.
requirements.acceptance: Actions from the review have owners and due dates visible to both parties.
requirements.behaviour: Hold scoped institutional reviews of performance, unresolved issues, costs and future obligations; assign actions visible to both parties.
requirements.exception: Meeting completion does not close outstanding actions without required evidence and owner acceptance.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Actions from the review have owners and due dates visible to both parties.
requirements.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

requirements.title: Retention schedules
requirements.statement: Data classes shall have approved retention triggers, durations, legal bases, holds and disposal methods by jurisdiction and contract.
requirements.acceptance: A newly created asset inherits an explicit retention policy rather than an indefinite default.
requirements.behaviour: Assign an approved retention schedule before creating production assets. Derive expiry from explicit trigger events and display applicable holds.
requirements.exception: Missing policy blocks asset activation; indefinite retention is not an implicit default.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A newly created asset inherits an explicit retention policy rather than an indefinite default.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Study closure
requirements.statement: Closure shall reconcile access, jobs, datasets, reports, incidents, contracts, billing and outstanding obligations.
requirements.acceptance: A study cannot close its safety obligations by changing its administrative status.
requirements.behaviour: Reconcile access, jobs, data, evidence, incidents, contracts and finance at study close. Assign surviving duties to accepting owners.
requirements.exception: Administrative closure cannot end unfulfilled safety obligations or remove unresolved incident records.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A study cannot close its safety obligations by changing its administrative status.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Data disposal
requirements.statement: Expired assets shall be deleted or irreversibly rendered inaccessible according to policy, with copies and derived artefacts assessed.
requirements.acceptance: A disposal record identifies completed actions, retained exceptions and backup expiry treatment.
requirements.behaviour: Review expired assets, copies and derivatives, then execute lawful disposal and retain verification plus exceptions.
requirements.exception: Held records remain protected; partial completion cannot be represented as total deletion.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A disposal record identifies completed actions, retained exceptions and backup expiry treatment.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Backup deletion handling
requirements.statement: Deletion policy shall define backup expiry and prevent restoration from resurrecting deleted or restricted records.
requirements.acceptance: A restore applies the current deletion and revocation ledger before user access resumes.
requirements.behaviour: Record backup expiry and block ordinary access to disposed content. Restore applies the current deletion and restriction ledger before reopening.
requirements.exception: A restored historical snapshot cannot resurrect lawfully deleted records or revoked access.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A restore applies the current deletion and revocation ledger before user access resumes.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Institutional export
requirements.statement: Institutions shall obtain authorised records, metadata, histories and evidence in documented portable formats.
requirements.acceptance: An export includes relationship keys and definitions needed to interpret the files.
requirements.behaviour: Prepare an authorised export with documented open formats, dictionaries, relationship keys, histories and manifests.
requirements.exception: Verify reconstruction and rights before delivery; export creation alone is not successful handover.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An export includes relationship keys and definitions needed to interpret the files.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Rights aware portability
requirements.statement: Exports shall exclude assets the recipient has no right to retain and explain restrictions.
requirements.acceptance: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data merely because both joined a study.
requirements.behaviour: Evaluate retention rights for each exported asset and recipient, recording exclusions and allowed reuse.
requirements.exception: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data through shared study membership.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data merely because both joined a study.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: User and tenant offboarding
requirements.statement: Offboarding shall revoke credentials, transfer accountable ownership and preserve required authorship and audit records.
requirements.acceptance: Deleting a user profile does not destroy the attribution of a clinical signoff.
requirements.behaviour: Revoke user and tenant credentials, transfer ownership and retain necessary signed attribution under approved privacy rules.
requirements.exception: Profile removal cannot erase clinical signoff identity; missing successor remains a visible continuity issue.
requirements.fs_acceptance: Deleting a user profile does not destroy the attribution of a clinical signoff.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Operator succession
requirements.statement: The service shall maintain an agreed plan for operator insolvency, acquisition or cessation including custody and continuity of essential records.
requirements.acceptance: A tabletop exercise identifies who would receive evidence and incident responsibilities.
requirements.behaviour: Maintain a succession plan for insolvency, acquisition or cessation and exercise custody and incident handover assumptions.
requirements.exception: No automatic asset transfer to an unapproved successor; local rights and institutional authority still apply.
requirements.fs_acceptance: A tabletop exercise identifies who would receive evidence and incident responsibilities.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Closure attestation
requirements.statement: Authorised custodians shall issue closure or deletion attestations stating scope and lawful retention exceptions.
requirements.acceptance: An attestation never claims deletion of data still retained under a documented hold.
requirements.behaviour: Issue signed closure or disposal attestations with exact scope, completed steps, held records and backup treatment.
requirements.exception: Never claim deletion of retained or unverified external copies.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An attestation never claims deletion of data still retained under a documented hold.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Residual obligations
requirements.statement: The platform shall track surviving confidentiality, reporting, clinical follow up and financial obligations after access ends.
requirements.acceptance: An expired commercial agreement does not remove a required safety follow up task.
requirements.behaviour: Keep surviving confidentiality, reporting, follow up and financial obligations assigned after ordinary access ends.
requirements.exception: Expired contracts cannot remove required tasks; use restricted successor access or institutional handover to complete them.
requirements.fs_acceptance: An expired commercial agreement does not remove a required safety follow up task.
requirements.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

requirements.title: Security verification baseline
requirements.statement: The application shall meet the applicable OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 Level 2 requirements, with additional high assurance controls selected for privileged and restricted data paths.
requirements.acceptance: An independent assessment records applicability and evidence; no unresolved exploitable critical or high finding remains at launch.
requirements.realisation: AUD records the applicable verification controls, evidence, findings and signoff; OPS prevents launch with an unresolved exploitable critical or high finding.
requirements.verification: Run an independent scoped assessment against the implemented journeys and record retest evidence, including privileged and restricted data paths.

requirements.title: Transport protection
requirements.statement: All protected browser, API, service and data transfer traffic shall use authenticated encryption with TLS 1.2 or higher; TLS 1.3 is preferred where supported.
requirements.acceptance: Scanning finds no accepted plaintext protected endpoint or obsolete protocol; certificate failure blocks connection.
requirements.realisation: Every protected connection validates its peer and fails without exposing content when certificate or negotiated protocol checks fail.
requirements.verification: Exercise browser, connector, node and service transfers with expired certificates, mismatched identities and obsolete protocols.

requirements.title: Stored data protection
requirements.statement: Restricted data, backups and credentials shall be encrypted using approved contemporary cryptography and separately controlled key access.
requirements.acceptance: Storage and backup inspection finds no unencrypted restricted payload or plaintext secret.
requirements.realisation: Asset and backup inventories record protected storage and key custody; ordinary operators cannot retrieve content through storage administration.
requirements.verification: Inspect representative clinical data, model files, credentials and restored backups and test separation between key and storage access.

requirements.title: Authentication coverage
requirements.statement: One hundred percent of privileged users, signers and restricted data users shall use multifactor authentication; privileged access shall use phishing resistant authentication or an approved equivalent institutional control.
requirements.acceptance: Attempts to enter these scopes without the required assurance are denied in all supported clients.
requirements.realisation: IAM records assurance and ACC checks it at protected entry and signature; privileged functions require the stronger approved method.
requirements.verification: Attempt each restricted action through UI, API and service contexts with insufficient factors and verify consistent denial.

requirements.title: Local credential policy
requirements.statement: Local passwords shall permit at least 64 characters, require at least 15, reject known compromised values and avoid arbitrary composition or routine forced rotation without cause.
requirements.acceptance: Password managers and paste work; recovery and change tests invalidate compromised sessions as specified.
requirements.realisation: Local enrolment and reset validate length and compromised values while supporting paste and password managers; do not impose arbitrary periodic resets.
requirements.verification: Test minimum boundary, a 64 character password, compromised value rejection and recovery revocation without logging the submitted secret.

requirements.title: Session expiry
requirements.statement: Default inactivity expiry shall be 15 minutes for privileged sessions and 30 minutes otherwise, with a 12 hour maximum; critical approvals require authentication within the preceding 5 minutes.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary tests confirm expiry and step up checks without losing safely saved drafts.
requirements.realisation: The UI displays safe expiry warnings; the server uses authoritative activity and authentication times and requires step up before critical signoff.
requirements.verification: Test just before, at and after inactivity, absolute and five minute approval boundaries, including a stale browser tab.

requirements.title: Revocation latency
requirements.statement: Online permission and credential revocation shall take effect within 60 seconds across protected APIs, jobs and active sessions.
requirements.acceptance: A distributed revocation test has no successful new protected action after the deadline; offline limits are documented separately.
requirements.realisation: Revocation generates an effective restriction and impact queue; protected actions and controlled deliveries recheck current authority.
requirements.verification: Measure from committed revocation to last possible protected success across sessions, workers, caches, APIs and download paths; all must meet 60 seconds online.

requirements.title: Isolation assurance
requirements.statement: Cross tenant, cross study and privilege escalation test suites shall cover every protected object and execution boundary.
requirements.acceptance: No unauthorised access succeeds in the release suite or independent penetration test.
requirements.realisation: Every protected object inherits institution and study scope; execution profiles isolate files, secrets and residual memory.
requirements.verification: Use two institutions, cross study users and a hostile workload to exercise direct links, search, exports, background jobs and resource reuse.

requirements.title: Secret handling
requirements.statement: Secrets shall not appear in source repositories, client bundles, telemetry, reports or ordinary support logs; production secrets shall rotate at least every 90 days or faster after compromise.
requirements.acceptance: Automated scans and sampled runtime inspection find no exposed active secret; rotation does not broaden access.
requirements.realisation: Secret fields are write only or masked, references replace values in logs, and rotation tasks have owners and expiry.
requirements.verification: Insert synthetic secret markers and inspect bundles, telemetry, reports, tickets and source artefacts; rotate without expanding scope.

requirements.title: Abuse protection
requirements.statement: Authentication, expensive queries and public interfaces shall have tested rate limits and abuse controls that preserve authorised safety reporting.
requirements.acceptance: Load and brute force tests are contained without preventing the approved emergency reporting route.
requirements.realisation: Authentication, search and expensive jobs have configured per principal and institutional limits; urgent reporting has an independently protected route.
requirements.verification: Burst valid and hostile traffic and verify bounded resource use, safe rate limit messages and continued authorised urgent intake.

requirements.title: Vulnerability response
requirements.statement: Confirmed actively exploited or critical exposures shall be contained within 24 hours; high findings within 7 days and medium within 30 days unless formally risk accepted.
requirements.acceptance: The vulnerability register measures discovery to containment and remediation, with overdue escalation.
requirements.realisation: The vulnerability register starts clocks at confirmed classification and records containment separately from final remediation.
requirements.verification: Seed critical, high and medium findings and verify due dates, escalation, risk acceptance authority and evidence of closure.

requirements.title: Independent testing
requirements.statement: An independent penetration test shall occur before production, annually and after material changes to trust boundaries; continuous dependency and code scanning shall cover releases.
requirements.acceptance: Evidence includes remediation and retest of affected controls rather than only the original report.
requirements.realisation: OPS release and annual assurance calendars require independent testing and retest after material trust changes.
requirements.verification: Inspect a release with a boundary change and verify it cannot pass on an old unrelated assessment.

requirements.title: Residency coverage
requirements.statement: One hundred percent of restricted primary data, replicas, backups, logs containing sensitive content and remote support access shall conform to the approved regional policy.
requirements.acceptance: A residency inventory and technical validation show no unapproved processing or copy location.
requirements.realisation: Country and asset policies constrain originals, replicas, logs, backups, execution and support locations; inventories expose unsupported locations.
requirements.verification: Test each data lifecycle path and a forbidden support session against the active regional policy.

requirements.title: Purpose enforcement
requirements.statement: Every restricted data execution and export shall have an active applicable purpose bound grant.
requirements.acceptance: A sampled audit and negative tests find no run or export without the required grant.
requirements.realisation: Every run and export binds the exact purpose grant and rechecks it at execution and delivery.
requirements.verification: Attempt a valid user with wrong purpose, different release, added team member and expired grant; retain denial evidence.

requirements.title: Minimised telemetry
requirements.statement: Production telemetry shall exclude raw patient records, unrestricted prompts, authentication secrets and proprietary model contents by default.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic sensitive markers inserted into test workflows do not appear in general telemetry.
requirements.realisation: Telemetry schemas accept bounded metadata and safe error codes; raw clinical payloads and unrestricted prompts are excluded by default.
