requirements.verification: Place synthetic identifiers in inputs and failures and inspect general logs, traces, alerts and support attachments.

requirements.title: Disclosure control
requirements.statement: All public or shared aggregate releases shall pass approved small cell, linkage and inference risk rules; thresholds shall be set per context.
requirements.acceptance: A disclosure test pack verifies suppression and complementary cell handling for all supported filters and exports.
requirements.realisation: ANA and DAC share disclosure rules across UI, exports, complementary totals and repeated queries.
requirements.verification: Use fixtures with small cells and overlapping filters; confirm suppression cannot be bypassed through subtraction or a second presentation format.

requirements.title: Privacy impact review
requirements.statement: Every new restricted processing purpose, provider or material transfer shall have a completed privacy and rights assessment before activation.
requirements.acceptance: A release cannot enable the affected processing while a mandatory assessment is incomplete.
requirements.realisation: New purpose, provider or material transfer creates a required privacy assessment gate before related connector or capability activation.
requirements.verification: Submit each change with an incomplete assessment and verify processing remains blocked while unaffected scope stays available.

requirements.title: Data rights service
requirements.statement: Requests shall be acknowledged within 2 business days and assigned within 1; completion follows the shorter applicable legal or contractual deadline.
requirements.acceptance: The case register tracks deadlines, identity checks, holds and reasoned outcomes without assuming one global deadline.
requirements.realisation: Rights cases use the institution's business calendar, acknowledgement and assignment clocks plus the shorter applicable completion deadline.
requirements.verification: Test weekend, holiday, reassignment and paused investigation cases without pausing a legal clock unless the approved rule permits it.

requirements.title: Deletion execution
requirements.statement: Approved deletion shall remove active copies within 30 days or a shorter applicable limit; backup expiry and holds shall be disclosed and enforced.
requirements.acceptance: Verification confirms active deletion and prevents restoration from reintroducing disposed records.
requirements.realisation: Disposal cases track active copies, held assets, backups and external notices separately, with the applicable shorter deadline.
requirements.verification: Verify deleted content cannot be retrieved through caches, exports or a restored snapshot; attestation lists lawful exceptions.

requirements.title: Provider data use
requirements.statement: No external model or analytics provider may train on or reuse restricted content without a separately documented lawful authorisation and explicit institutional approval.
requirements.acceptance: Provider configuration and terms are verified before use; an unapproved change stops affected transmission.
requirements.realisation: Provider approvals explicitly record training and reuse permissions and are checked before content transmission.
requirements.verification: Change a provider term or remove institutional permission and confirm the next affected request is blocked.

requirements.title: Core availability
requirements.statement: The production control plane shall target 99.9 percent monthly availability, measured through authenticated critical journeys in supported regions, including planned maintenance impact.
requirements.acceptance: Independent probes and incident records reconcile successful available minutes; third party failures affecting the journey count.
requirements.realisation: Availability covers authenticated login, task, study, evidence and incident journeys by supported region; planned maintenance and user-visible dependencies count.
requirements.verification: Reconcile probe failures and incident intervals over the month without averaging away a failing supported region or journey.

requirements.title: Emergency reporting continuity
requirements.statement: An out of band route shall remain available for urgent incidents and suspension requests when the platform is unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: A quarterly outage exercise reaches an accountable operator and the relevant local site contact.
requirements.realisation: Institutions have an approved out of band urgent route with accountable operator and local site contact, published before activation.
requirements.verification: Quarterly disable the platform route and record successful human contact and transfer of the urgent concern.

requirements.title: Recovery time
requirements.statement: Core identity, access, study metadata, evidence and incident services shall recover within 4 hours after a declared recoverable regional disaster.
requirements.acceptance: A twice yearly recovery exercise meets the target within permitted residency locations.
requirements.realisation: The recovery runbook restores critical identity, grants, metadata, evidence and incidents only in permitted locations.
requirements.verification: Time a declared recoverable regional disaster through validated reopening, including current policy reconciliation, within four hours.

requirements.title: Recovery point
requirements.statement: Recovery point objectives shall be at most 15 minutes for core metadata and final artefacts and 5 minutes for signed decisions, grants and audit events.
requirements.acceptance: A recovery test demonstrates bounded loss and reconciles any missing authoritative actions before reopening access.
requirements.realisation: Recovery evidence distinguishes core metadata and final artefacts from signed decisions, grants and audit with their separate objectives.
requirements.verification: Create timestamped fixtures before failure, recover and measure actual loss; reconcile uncertain approvals before enabling protected actions.

requirements.title: Source data recovery
requirements.statement: Custodied input data shall have a contracted recovery point no greater than 24 hours unless a stricter study requirement applies; reproducible and unique inputs shall be distinguished.
requirements.acceptance: Restored inputs reconcile to the frozen manifest; a missing unique input blocks dependent evidence claims.
requirements.realisation: Source assets identify unique versus reproducible inputs and contracted recovery objectives in the custodian record.
requirements.verification: Restore representative datasets and compare manifests; missing unique evidence blocks dependent claims.

requirements.title: Backup verification
requirements.statement: Backup integrity shall be checked daily and sampled restoration tested monthly, with a full recovery exercise twice yearly.
requirements.acceptance: A completed backup job without successful restore evidence is not reported as proven recoverability.
requirements.realisation: The console separates completed backups, verified integrity, sampled restore and full exercise status.
requirements.verification: Demonstrate daily checks, monthly sample restoration and twice yearly recovery evidence; failed verification remains a blocking finding.

requirements.title: Failure isolation
requirements.statement: Loss of one study workload or connector shall not disable unrelated study control, incident reporting or access enforcement.
requirements.acceptance: Injected workload and dependency failures leave unrelated critical journeys functional.
requirements.realisation: Run and connector failures are scoped to their workloads while protected control and incident functions remain available.
requirements.verification: Inject one workload exhaustion and one connector outage under representative load and exercise unrelated institutions' critical journeys.

requirements.title: Safe degraded operation
requirements.statement: If permissions, policy or provenance cannot be verified, affected sensitive actions shall fail closed while authorised nonsensitive reporting remains available where safe.
requirements.acceptance: Dependency failure cannot cause unrestricted access, silent approval or fabricated successful results.
requirements.realisation: Unavailable permission or provenance dependencies return a safe unavailable state, withholding protected execution and release.
requirements.verification: Simulate partial dependency failures and confirm no cached approval becomes an unrestricted fallback.

requirements.title: Disconnected sites
requirements.statement: Remote nodes shall show last contact and unacknowledged instructions; offline permissions shall have explicit validity and risk limits.
requirements.acceptance: An offline node is never displayed as stopped or updated without evidence; its local owner receives the escalation.
requirements.realisation: Node records show last contact, instruction acknowledgement and approved offline lease; local enforcement is part of node admission.
requirements.verification: Disconnect a node before stop and verify the central state stays unconfirmed, local lease treatment and backup escalation.

requirements.title: Interactive navigation
requirements.statement: At L1, common authenticated pages shall become usable within 3 seconds at the 95th percentile under the standard network profile.
requirements.acceptance: A 60 minute representative load test covers login landing, study list, task queue and record view.
requirements.realisation: Common pages load permitted summary data first and defer large assets without hiding required actions.
requirements.verification: At L1 measure user-perceived usable time for login landing, study list, task queue and detail over at least 60 minutes.

requirements.title: Transactional response
requirements.statement: At L1, ordinary read and write APIs excluding bulk transfer and model execution shall respond within 1 second at p95 and 3 seconds at p99.
requirements.acceptance: Measured server response includes authentication and policy checks; error rate is below 0.5 percent excluding valid client errors.
requirements.realisation: Ordinary synchronous reads and writes include full authentication and policy evaluation; bulk work returns a tracked job.
requirements.verification: Measure server response p95 and p99 plus error rate using the defined workload, including ordinary background processing.

requirements.title: Search response
requirements.statement: Permission filtered metadata search over 2 million indexed records shall return within 2 seconds at p95 at L1.
requirements.acceptance: The test includes complex filters and confirms that faster results do not omit access controls.
requirements.realisation: Search uses permitted metadata and consistent filters, counts and stable pagination.
requirements.verification: Query the two million record L1 catalogue with complex filters under concurrent use, measuring response and checking hidden-result leakage.

requirements.title: Dashboard response
requirements.statement: Standard portfolio dashboards over L1 data shall load within 5 seconds at p95 and show their data freshness.
requirements.acceptance: Heavy custom analyses are asynchronous with progress rather than blocking the application.
requirements.realisation: Dashboards display calculation time and missing sources; expensive custom analyses become asynchronous.
requirements.verification: Measure the approved standard dashboard set at L1, including scoped aggregation and disclosure checks.

requirements.title: Large ingestion
requirements.statement: A valid 1 GB structured import shall complete validation and reconciliation within 10 minutes after transfer under the specified reference schema and allocated capacity.
requirements.acceptance: Results account for every input row; imaging and custom transforms use separately approved budgets.
requirements.realisation: The 1 GB reference import has a declared schema and resource profile; progress distinguishes transfer from validation and reconciliation.
requirements.verification: Start the measured clock after verified transfer and require reconciled output within ten minutes; profile imaging separately.

requirements.title: Queue responsiveness
requirements.statement: Job submission shall acknowledge within 2 seconds at p95; eligible jobs with reserved available capacity shall start within 2 minutes at p95.
requirements.acceptance: Queue metrics distinguish unavailable resources, policy holds and scheduler delay.
requirements.realisation: Submission records an acknowledged logical request quickly, then separates waiting for capacity, policy blocks and scheduler delay.
requirements.verification: Measure acknowledgement and eligible reserved-capacity start separately; do not count blocked or unfunded jobs as scheduler successes.

requirements.title: Large exports
requirements.statement: Approved exports up to 100000 tabular rows shall be prepared within 5 minutes at p95 at L1.
requirements.acceptance: The user sees progress and expiry; authorisation is rechecked before download.
requirements.realisation: Large exports are jobs with progress, scope manifest and expiry, followed by current authorisation at download.
requirements.verification: Prepare 100000 representative rows under L1 within five minutes p95 and revoke a recipient before delivery.

requirements.title: Low bandwidth use
requirements.statement: Core metadata workflows shall become usable within 8 seconds at p95 on the low bandwidth profile, excluding deliberate large asset transfer.
requirements.acceptance: Users can save an application, review a task and report an incident under the constrained profile.
requirements.realisation: Core metadata forms minimise required transfer and preserve saved drafts; large asset viewers are outside the constrained reference journey.
requirements.verification: Use 1 Mbps, 300 ms round trip and one percent packet loss to save an application, review a task and file an incident within eight seconds p95.

requirements.title: Inference budgets
requirements.statement: Each admitted evaluation pack shall declare modality specific runtime, memory, concurrency and timeout budgets rather than inherit a universal inference target.
requirements.acceptance: Out of budget runs terminate or queue according to policy with clear evidence and billing treatment.
requirements.realisation: Each task pack supplies declared runtime, memory, concurrency and timeout limits that RUN validates against the request.
requirements.verification: Exercise an over-budget inference and verify explicit termination or queuing, preserved diagnostics and correct billing treatment.

requirements.title: Capacity expansion
requirements.statement: Before enabling L2 volume, the service shall pass the same critical performance and isolation tests at L2 or contract explicitly revised targets.
requirements.acceptance: Capacity approval is supported by load test evidence and estimated operating cost.
requirements.realisation: L2 activation requires new capacity approval and funded resource profiles, without weakening isolation or policy checks.
requirements.verification: Repeat the relevant critical suites at L2; unresolved target changes require a baseline decision before promising expanded capacity.

requirements.title: Acknowledged transactions
requirements.statement: An acknowledged transaction shall be durable under ordinary process or single component failure and shall not be partially committed.
requirements.acceptance: Failure injection yields either one complete recorded action or an explicit failure, never a partial approval.
requirements.realisation: State, decision, audit and dispatch intent form a durable acknowledged action; retries return the existing outcome.
requirements.verification: Interrupt processing around each commitment boundary and verify either one complete action or an explicit failure, never partial approval.

requirements.title: Artefact integrity
requirements.statement: Every frozen dataset, model configuration and issued report shall have an integrity identifier and immutable version association.
requirements.acceptance: Changing bytes changes the integrity result and cannot preserve the original verified status.
requirements.realisation: Frozen manifests and issued artefacts have immutable version associations and integrity identifiers.
requirements.verification: Alter bytes and metadata in fixtures; original verification must fail and the change must require a new version.

requirements.title: Provenance completeness
requirements.statement: One hundred percent of formal findings shall identify protocol, inputs, configuration, methods, run and reviewer versions.
requirements.acceptance: An automated completeness check blocks formal issue when any required link is missing.
requirements.realisation: The evidence builder checks mandatory links for every formal finding before final signature.
requirements.verification: Remove each provenance link in turn and confirm issue is blocked with the specific missing evidence.

requirements.title: Deterministic reproducibility
requirements.statement: Deterministic evaluations shall reproduce within protocol specified numerical tolerances on the declared environment.
requirements.acceptance: Results outside tolerance are investigated and cannot be released as reproduced.
requirements.realisation: Reproduction compares against protocol tolerances and the declared environment, not a universal numeric tolerance.
requirements.verification: Use reference fixtures inside and outside tolerance and confirm only acceptable reproduction receives verified status.

requirements.title: Stochastic reproducibility
requirements.statement: Stochastic evaluations shall retain seeds where meaningful, repeat count and uncertainty methods and meet prespecified distributional criteria.
requirements.acceptance: A result's reproducibility statement does not promise identical output from a nondeterministic external model.
requirements.realisation: Stochastic reports preserve planned repeats, meaningful seeds, distribution criteria and provider identity limits.
requirements.verification: Rerun the approved plan and assess its prespecified distributional criterion without promising identical remote outputs.

requirements.title: Clock consistency
requirements.statement: Authoritative platform timestamps shall use UTC with a recorded display timezone and maintain clock skew below 1 second for controlled services.
requirements.acceptance: A trace reconstruction preserves event order; unsynchronised external timestamps are explicitly identified.
requirements.realisation: Authoritative events use UTC and controlled service time; external times retain source timezone and confidence.
requirements.verification: Verify less than one second controlled clock skew and correct ordering across timezone, daylight saving and delayed external events.

requirements.title: Numerical semantics
requirements.statement: Missing, zero, not applicable, suppressed, indeterminate and failed values shall remain distinct throughout analysis and export.
requirements.acceptance: Round trip tests preserve each state and do not convert missing clinical values to zero.
requirements.realisation: All numeric views and exports preserve missing, zero, not applicable, suppressed, indeterminate and failed as separate states.
requirements.verification: Round trip one fixture for each state through import, calculation, chart and export and compare exact meaning.

requirements.title: Concurrent edits
requirements.statement: Conflicting edits to controlled records shall be detected and resolved without silent last write loss.
requirements.acceptance: Two simultaneous protocol edits produce an explicit conflict or preserved merge history.
requirements.realisation: Edits use observed versions and controlled conflict resolution; immutable decisions are never automatically merged.
requirements.verification: Save concurrent conflicting edits and verify both changes remain recoverable with explicit resolution.

requirements.title: Accessibility baseline
requirements.statement: Core user journeys shall meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including authentication, forms, data tables and error recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Automated checks plus manual keyboard, screen reader, focus and zoom testing find no unresolved critical barrier.
requirements.realisation: The shared shell, forms, tables, dialogs, authentication and recovery flows implement the required accessibility behaviours.
requirements.verification: Combine automated checks with keyboard, screen reader, focus, zoom and error recovery testing against WCAG 2.2 AA scope.

requirements.title: Task success
requirements.statement: At least 90 percent of representative users shall complete each core role specific journey without facilitator intervention after standard onboarding.
requirements.acceptance: Usability sessions include at least 5 participants per priority role and document failures and remediation.
requirements.realisation: Role journeys expose status, owner and next action and are tested after standard onboarding.
requirements.verification: Recruit at least five representative participants per priority role; report successes and failures per journey and check the 90 percent target.

requirements.title: Navigation and status clarity
requirements.statement: Every active object shall show its status, owner, next required action and applicable blocker in plain language.
requirements.acceptance: Users correctly identify the next action in at least 90 percent of sampled task scenarios.
requirements.realisation: Each active object header shows state, next required action, responsible owner and applicable blocker in plain language.
requirements.verification: Ask representative users to identify the next action in sampled tasks and retain evidence of at least 90 percent correct identification.

requirements.title: Error prevention
requirements.statement: Consequential actions shall explain scope and consequences, require applicable confirmation and preserve recoverable drafts.
requirements.acceptance: Tests prevent accidental publication, deletion and role escalation through one unintended ordinary click.
requirements.realisation: Consequential actions use exact-scope confirmation and recent authentication; drafts are safely saved before step up.
requirements.verification: Test accidental clicks, stale scope, changed recipients and cancel paths; no unintended destructive or release action should commit.

requirements.title: Responsive support
requirements.statement: Core metadata and incident workflows shall work at viewport widths from 360 CSS pixels through desktop sizes without loss of required actions.
requirements.acceptance: Testing at agreed mobile and desktop sizes finds no blocked critical workflow or inaccessible control.
requirements.realisation: Core metadata and incident screens reflow at 360 CSS pixels with accessible alternatives for wide matrices.
requirements.verification: Exercise all required actions at mobile and desktop widths and ensure controls are neither clipped nor hidden.

requirements.title: Browser support
requirements.statement: The platform shall support the current and preceding major versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari at release, including agreed iOS and Android browser combinations.
requirements.acceptance: The release matrix records tested versions and known limitations; specialised viewers declare separate support.
requirements.realisation: The release record declares current and preceding major browser versions and agreed mobile combinations; specialised viewers state limits.
requirements.verification: Run critical journeys on the actual release matrix and document any viewer-specific restrictions before assignment.

requirements.title: Language readiness
requirements.statement: All user facing interface strings shall be externalised with Unicode, locale formatting and expansion support; launch language is English plus approved country needs.
requirements.acceptance: Pseudo localisation does not clip critical controls or corrupt exported clinical terminology.
requirements.realisation: Interface strings, dates and numbers use locale resources while clinical units and codes remain explicit.
requirements.verification: Use Unicode, expansion and right-to-left readiness fixtures as applicable; verify exported terminology and controls are not corrupted or clipped.

requirements.title: Translation integrity
requirements.statement: Clinical, consent and regulatory translations shall require qualified review and a linked source version before official use.
requirements.acceptance: Unapproved translations cannot appear as final participant or authority documents.
requirements.realisation: Translation approval binds source and language version and qualifies the reviewer for intended use.
requirements.verification: Change source consent text and verify affected translations cannot remain official without renewed review.

requirements.title: Assisted accessibility
requirements.statement: Training and support content shall provide accessible alternatives for essential visual or audio information.
requirements.acceptance: A user unable to use the primary media format can complete the same required training outcome.
requirements.realisation: Essential learning media have text, captions or equivalent accessible alternatives linked to the same learning outcome.
requirements.verification: Complete a required course without its primary visual or audio channel and verify equivalent assessment access.

requirements.title: Critical monitoring
requirements.statement: Core availability, errors, queue delay, access failures, backup failures and safety channel health shall have monitored indicators and accountable owners.
requirements.acceptance: A controlled critical failure generates an operational alert within 5 minutes.
requirements.realisation: Service indicators cover journey health, errors, queue delay, access failures, backups and safety channels with assigned owners.
requirements.verification: Inject each critical fault and verify an actionable alert within five minutes, including correct scope and runbook.

requirements.title: Incident acknowledgement
requirements.statement: Priority 1 operational incidents shall receive human acknowledgement within 15 minutes under a staffed 24 hour rota.
requirements.acceptance: Quarterly drills demonstrate contactability and backup escalation; ordinary support hours are separately published.
requirements.realisation: P1 operations alerts use a staffed 24 hour rota with backup escalation and human acknowledgement distinct from delivery.
requirements.verification: Quarterly drills require human acknowledgement within 15 minutes, including off-hours and primary contact failure.

requirements.title: User communications
requirements.statement: Affected institutions shall receive an initial major incident update within 30 minutes of confirmation and at least hourly while impact continues.
requirements.acceptance: The communication log records delivery failures and contains no unauthorised sensitive data.
requirements.realisation: Major incident communications show affected services, impact, status and next update without protected study data.
requirements.verification: Verify initial update within 30 minutes of confirmation and at least hourly thereafter, retaining failures and corrected delivery.

requirements.title: Traceability
requirements.statement: Requests, jobs, decisions and exports shall carry correlation identifiers across supported services and connectors.
requirements.acceptance: An incident investigation can connect the initiating request with all material outcomes.
requirements.realisation: Every command, job, decision and exchange propagates a correlation reference to authorised diagnostics.
requirements.verification: Trace an initiating request through connector, run, export and audit without relying on patient identifiers.

requirements.title: Operational history
requirements.statement: Searchable operational telemetry shall be retained for at least 90 days unless a stricter approved privacy rule applies; audit records follow their own schedule.
requirements.acceptance: Operators can investigate a sampled 60 day old incident without accessing raw patient data.
requirements.realisation: Telemetry retention defaults to at least 90 days subject to stricter approved privacy rules; audit uses separate policies.
requirements.verification: Investigate a synthetic 60 day old incident from permitted metadata and verify no raw clinical content is required.

requirements.title: Runbook coverage
requirements.statement: Every critical alert shall have a tested runbook, owner, escalation route and recovery or safe shutdown action.
requirements.acceptance: A new on call operator can execute sampled runbooks during a supervised readiness exercise.
requirements.realisation: Each critical alert links a current tested runbook, owner, backup, recovery or safe shutdown procedure.
requirements.verification: Have a newly assigned operator execute sampled scenarios in a supervised exercise and record gaps.

requirements.title: Post incident review
requirements.statement: Major operational incidents shall receive a documented review within 5 business days of stabilisation, with actions and owners.
requirements.acceptance: Repeat causes and overdue actions appear in the service governance review.
requirements.realisation: Stabilisation creates a post incident review task due within five business days with causes, actions and owners.
requirements.verification: Verify due date calculation and escalation; repeated causes appear in service review even after incident closure.

requirements.title: Release traceability
requirements.statement: Every production change shall link approved requirements or fixes, verification evidence, release identity and accountable approval.
requirements.acceptance: A sampled release can be traced to its business reason and rollback or recovery plan.
requirements.realisation: Release records link changes to FS, QC or approved defect identifiers, tests, approval and recovery plans.
requirements.verification: Sample every release type and reconstruct why it was authorised and how it can be recovered.

requirements.title: Regression gates
requirements.statement: All applicable P0 acceptance scenarios and affected clinical metric reference tests shall pass before release.
requirements.acceptance: A failing critical permission, safety, provenance or metric test blocks deployment.
requirements.realisation: Activation requires all applicable P0 and affected metric reference tests to pass with retained evidence.
requirements.verification: Introduce a failing permission, safety, provenance or metric fixture and verify the release gate remains blocked.

requirements.title: Rollback readiness
requirements.statement: Ordinary application releases shall support rollback or a tested forward recovery within 30 minutes where data compatibility allows.
requirements.acceptance: A rehearsal restores service without discarding acknowledged records or reviving revoked access.
requirements.realisation: Release plans declare rollback or forward recovery and data compatibility limitations.
requirements.verification: Rehearse recovery within 30 minutes where applicable, preserving acknowledged records and current restrictions.

requirements.title: Migration assurance
requirements.statement: Schema and configuration migrations shall validate record counts, relationships, permissions and representative values before completion.
requirements.acceptance: A failed reconciliation prevents the migrated environment from serving affected production records.
requirements.realisation: Migration produces counts, relationships, permissions, representative values and reconciliation results before reopening.
requirements.verification: Inject a mismatch and verify affected migrated records remain unavailable while the authoritative source is recoverable.

requirements.title: Interface stability
requirements.statement: Published production APIs shall have at least 180 days deprecation notice except urgent security or legal changes with managed alternatives.
requirements.acceptance: A breaking change cannot silently invalidate an agreed institutional connector.
requirements.realisation: Interface lifecycle records expose versions, affected connectors, notice dates and approved urgent exceptions.
requirements.verification: Attempt premature removal and verify the 180 day notice gate or explicit exception with managed migration.

requirements.title: Dependency governance
requirements.statement: Releases shall inventory software dependencies and licences, assess vulnerabilities and record supported lifetimes.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported critical dependencies have a funded replacement or approved time limited exception.
requirements.realisation: Release evidence contains dependency inventory, licence assessment, vulnerabilities and support end dates.
requirements.verification: Verify unsupported critical components have a funded replacement or independently approved bounded exception.

requirements.title: Portability
requirements.statement: Institutional metadata, evidence, audit exports and permitted assets shall be extractable in documented formats without proprietary reader dependence.
requirements.acceptance: A clean environment reconstructs a sampled exported study and verifies its evidence references.
requirements.realisation: Portable exports include readable reports, structured records, dictionaries, histories and relationship identifiers.
requirements.verification: Reconstruct a sampled study in a clean tool environment without proprietary readers and verify evidence references.

requirements.title: Environment flexibility
requirements.statement: Country requirements for hosted, dedicated or institution operated execution shall be supportable through validated deployment profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Each offered profile passes equivalent access, provenance, safety and operational gates before sale.
requirements.realisation: Hosted, dedicated and local node profiles each declare supported functions, residency, operations and acceptance evidence.
requirements.verification: Run equivalent access, provenance and safety checks before a deployment profile can be sold or activated.

requirements.title: No universal clinical score
requirements.statement: Each admitted clinical use shall have approved task specific thresholds, populations, uncertainty requirements and safety criteria.
requirements.acceptance: An undefined threshold or unsupported population blocks a suitability conclusion.
requirements.realisation: PRO requires approved task, population, uncertainty and threshold definitions; EVD checks them before suitability signoff.
requirements.verification: Leave a clinical threshold undefined and verify no global default score or favourable result can bypass the blocker.

requirements.title: Platform assistant safety
requirements.statement: Platform AI features shall have zero observed critical access, unsafe action or fabricated approval failures in the approved release test pack.
requirements.acceptance: The report discloses sample size and residual uncertainty; zero observed failures is not claimed as zero real world risk.
requirements.realisation: Assistant activation retains the approved test pack and severe failure taxonomy; observed critical failures block release.
requirements.verification: Test cross tenant leakage, unsafe action and fabricated approvals; disclose sample size and residual uncertainty even with zero observed critical failures.

requirements.title: Generated factual grounding
requirements.statement: Every material clinical or evaluative claim in a released AI assisted report shall be human verified against the linked approved source.
requirements.acceptance: A random audit of released reports finds no unreviewed material generated claim.
requirements.realisation: Report review tracks each material generated claim, accessible supporting source and human verification decision.
requirements.verification: Sample released assisted reports and require every material claim to have eligible source verification.

requirements.title: Model change regression
requirements.statement: Every material platform model, prompt, tool or retrieval change shall pass task, privacy, permission and adversarial regression gates.
requirements.acceptance: Changes cannot enter production based solely on improved average response quality.
requirements.realisation: Model, prompt, corpus and tool changes create an impact record and require affected quality, privacy and adversarial regressions.
requirements.verification: Attempt release with improved mean quality but a failing critical regression and verify denial.

requirements.title: Human review independence
requirements.statement: Automated scoring shall not be the sole adjudicator of clinical safety, ethics, legal applicability or final evidence approval.
requirements.acceptance: Workflow tests require the appropriate eligible human decision for each protected outcome.
requirements.realisation: Protected decisions require eligible human signers with independence and professional authority; judge scores are supporting evidence.
requirements.verification: Attempt safety, ethics, applicability and final issue using only service or AI actors and verify denial.

requirements.title: AI service continuity
requirements.statement: Core study, incident and review workflows shall remain usable when optional AI services are disabled.
requirements.acceptance: A simulated provider outage leaves manual authorised completion possible without data loss.
requirements.realisation: Optional AI actions are separate from core drafting, task, review and incident functions.
requirements.verification: Disable all AI providers and complete the authorised manual journeys without data loss or blocked incident intake.

requirements.title: Cost attribution
requirements.statement: At least 95 percent of variable infrastructure and external service spend shall be attributable to a programme, study or approved shared cost category.
requirements.acceptance: Monthly financial reconciliation explains the remaining unattributed amount.
requirements.realisation: Usage and external costs carry study, programme or approved shared allocation keys; finance reports residual unattributed spend.
requirements.verification: Reconcile a month of synthetic bills and metering, showing at least 95 percent attribution and explanations for the remainder.

requirements.title: Spending limits
requirements.statement: All billable automated workloads shall have approved limits and warning thresholds at 80 and 100 percent of budget unless a stricter policy applies.
requirements.acceptance: The hard limit prevents further unauthorised spending while preserving evidence and safe termination.
requirements.realisation: Budget reservations and metering drive warnings at 80 and 100 percent or stricter thresholds and enforce hard stops.
requirements.verification: Use concurrent jobs and retries near the ceiling to prove no unauthorised overrun while evidence and safe termination remain possible.

requirements.title: Idle resource control
requirements.statement: Unneeded compute shall be suspended within a configurable period, default 30 minutes, subject to active study requirements.
requirements.acceptance: An idle workspace stops compute charges without deleting retained assets or disrupting a declared long job.
requirements.realisation: Workspace status distinguishes idle from declared active long jobs and suspends unneeded compute after the configured interval.
requirements.verification: Verify the 30 minute default stops compute charges without deleting retained data or interrupting a legitimately active job.

requirements.title: Resource reporting
requirements.statement: Where providers expose credible measurements, the service shall report compute consumption and estimated environmental impact with methods and limitations.
requirements.acceptance: Estimates do not imply measured carbon emissions when only proxy data are available.
requirements.realisation: Resource reports identify measured consumption, provider estimates, method and uncertainty separately.
requirements.verification: Inspect an estimate based on proxy data and confirm it cannot be labelled measured carbon emissions.

requirements.title: Operational ownership
requirements.statement: Every production capability shall have an accountable product owner, operational owner and escalation route before activation.
requirements.acceptance: No feature is released with an unassigned safety or maintenance responsibility.
requirements.realisation: Feature activation records product, operations and relevant safety ownership with current escalation routes.
requirements.verification: Remove an essential owner and verify new activation is blocked while continuity tasks are assigned.

requirements.title: Documentation completeness
requirements.statement: Each released role shall have current task guidance, access instructions, common error recovery and escalation documentation.
requirements.acceptance: Representative users complete the documented core journeys without undocumented internal assistance.
requirements.realisation: Each role has versioned task guidance, access setup, error recovery and escalation documentation linked from the interface.
requirements.verification: Representative users complete core journeys using published guidance without undocumented internal assistance.

requirements.title: Country launch readiness
requirements.statement: Every active country shall have signed applicability, data, clinical, operational and commercial readiness records for its offered scope.
requirements.acceptance: A country cannot be marked active through marketing configuration alone.
requirements.realisation: Country activation requires signed applicability, data, clinical, operational and commercial readiness for offered scope.
requirements.verification: Attempt activation through marketing configuration or a partially approved profile and verify denial.

requirements.title: Service request response
requirements.statement: Ordinary support requests shall be acknowledged within 1 business day and triaged within 2, with local calendar and support hours disclosed.
requirements.acceptance: Reports measure compliance from receipt and distinguish acknowledgement from resolution.
requirements.realisation: Support tickets start acknowledgement and triage clocks from receipt using disclosed local calendars and hours.
requirements.verification: Verify one business day acknowledgement and two business day triage, separately from resolution and urgent incident service.

requirements.title: Continuity responsibilities
requirements.statement: Every care affecting deployment shall have a locally owned continuity plan independent of platform availability.
requirements.acceptance: A tabletop exercise shows safe local action during a platform or network outage.
requirements.realisation: Each care affecting deployment records a locally accepted downtime and continuity plan independent of platform access.
requirements.verification: Simulate platform and network outage and demonstrate safe local clinical action with assigned responsibility.

requirements.title: Exit readiness
requirements.statement: An annual continuity exercise shall test institutional data export, supplier failure and operator handover assumptions.
requirements.acceptance: The exercise records gaps, assigned remedies and lawful retained obligations.
requirements.realisation: Annual continuity exercises cover institutional export, supplier failure and operator succession with retained obligations.
requirements.verification: Record exercise outcomes, named remedies and accepted custody rather than treating an untested plan as proven readiness.

functional.title: Organisation hierarchy
functional.statement: The platform shall represent the operator, countries, legal organisations, departments, sites, programmes and studies with stable identifiers and effective dates.
functional.acceptance: A study can involve three organisations without merging their users, contracts or data permissions.
functional.behaviour: Create distinct operator, legal organisation, country association, department, site, programme and study records. Link them through typed relationships with effective dates; show the hierarchy without copying permissions between nodes.
functional.exception: Reject cycles, duplicate verified legal identities and attempts to reparent a historical study without a reviewed transfer.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study can involve three organisations without merging their users, contracts or data permissions.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Verified organisation onboarding
functional.statement: The service shall verify an organisation's legal identity, authorised representative, institutional email domains and accountable administrator before granting institutional privileges.
functional.acceptance: An unverified applicant can prepare an application but cannot authorise data access or approve studies.
functional.behaviour: Submit freezes identity evidence. A different authorised verifier records verified, returned or rejected with reasons. Activation requires a verified representative, approved administrator and valid organisational terms.
functional.exception: A returned application stays editable; an unverified institution may prepare drafts but cannot approve data or studies.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unverified applicant can prepare an application but cannot authorise data access or approve studies.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Tenant boundaries
functional.statement: The platform shall maintain separate security boundaries for organisations and explicitly authorised shared workspaces; membership in a network shall confer no implicit access.
functional.acceptance: Cross organisation searches, direct links, exports and background jobs all reject ungranted access.
functional.behaviour: Resolve the active organisation before register queries, shared study views and exports. A participation record exposes only explicitly shared objects; display which institution owns each asset.
functional.exception: Use the safe unavailable response for an ungranted direct link and exclude hidden objects from counts and suggestions.
functional.fs_acceptance: Cross organisation searches, direct links, exports and background jobs all reject ungranted access.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Programme configuration
functional.statement: Authorised managers shall configure programme objectives, eligibility, funding, countries, clinical areas, dates, owners and participant limits.
functional.acceptance: Two programmes can apply different eligibility and funding rules to the same product.
functional.behaviour: Save programme settings as versions. Validate dates, funding eligibility, supported country profiles and capacity; preview which open applications a change would affect before publishing the new rules.
functional.exception: Existing submitted applications retain their original rule version until an approved transition decision is recorded.
functional.fs_acceptance: Two programmes can apply different eligibility and funding rules to the same product.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Cross organisation collaboration
functional.statement: An organisation shall join a study through a documented invitation and agreement identifying its role, contributed assets and access expiry.
functional.acceptance: Accepting a study invitation grants only the study permissions specified in the approved agreement.
functional.behaviour: Invite an institutional representative with a study role, contribution, agreement and expiry. Acceptance creates pending participation; approved terms and scoped grants activate it.
functional.exception: Decline or expiry creates no membership; acceptance cannot grant access beyond the approved participation package.
functional.fs_acceptance: Accepting a study invitation grants only the study permissions specified in the approved agreement.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Accountability register
functional.statement: Every active programme, study, dataset and deployment shall have an accountable institutional owner and a named operational contact with a backup.
functional.acceptance: Removing the last accountable owner is blocked until an authorised successor accepts responsibility.
functional.behaviour: Display the primary owner, operational contact and backup for each governed object. Reassignment requires an eligible successor to accept; dependent tasks transfer with an audit trail.
functional.exception: Block departure or closure that would leave an active critical object without an accountable owner.
functional.fs_acceptance: Removing the last accountable owner is blocked until an authorised successor accepts responsibility.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Lifecycle management
functional.statement: Organisations and programmes shall support draft, active, suspended and closed states with controlled effects on invitations, jobs and existing records.
functional.acceptance: Suspension blocks new activity while preserving authorised incident response and required evidence access.
functional.behaviour: Activate, suspend or close through reasoned commands. Suspension stops invitations and new processing in scope, while authorised evidence preservation, incidents and remediation remain available.
functional.exception: Resumption rechecks all prerequisites; closure fails with an itemised list of unassigned surviving obligations.
functional.fs_acceptance: Suspension blocks new activity while preserving authorised incident response and required evidence access.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Delegated network administration
functional.statement: Country and programme administrators shall manage only assigned institutions and configurations within centrally defined policy limits.
functional.acceptance: A country administrator cannot change another country's rules or weaken mandatory operator controls.
functional.behaviour: Delegation specifies managed countries, organisations, role ceilings and expiry. Preview effective powers and record a separate approver before delegated administration becomes active.
functional.exception: Reject rules or assignments outside the delegation or below mandatory operator safeguards.
functional.fs_acceptance: A country administrator cannot change another country's rules or weaken mandatory operator controls.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Institutional ownership changes
functional.statement: The service shall handle mergers, renamed institutions and changes of sponsor through reviewed transfers preserving provenance and contractual restrictions.
functional.acceptance: Historical reports retain the original legal entity and show the effective transfer date.
functional.behaviour: Create a transfer proposal with effective date, successor acceptance and rights review. Update future responsibility only after approval; retain predecessor identity on old reports and contracts.
functional.exception: Disputed assets or nontransferable agreements remain held and appear as unresolved transfer items.
functional.fs_acceptance: Historical reports retain the original legal entity and show the effective transfer date.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Demonstration environment
functional.statement: Demonstration tenants shall use approved synthetic or public demonstration data and visibly identify their nonproduction status.
functional.acceptance: A demo administrator cannot connect a production dataset or issue a production evidence report.
functional.behaviour: Create demonstration organisations with an immutable environment label and approved synthetic or public data catalogue. Show the label on pages and exports; issue only demonstration reports.
functional.exception: Reject production connectors, restricted source uploads and production evidence signatures from the demonstration context.
functional.fs_acceptance: A demo administrator cannot connect a production dataset or issue a production evidence report.
functional.actors: Organisation representative, OP verifier, OA and programme owner. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: User invitations
functional.statement: Invitations shall identify organisation, proposed roles, scope, inviter and expiry; acceptance shall verify the invitee and prevent reuse.
functional.acceptance: An expired or already accepted invitation cannot create another membership.
functional.behaviour: Invite a named person using the shared single use invitation contract. Show pending, accepted, expired and revoked states. Acceptance verifies the identity and creates only the specified membership.
functional.exception: Resend invalidates the prior token; an already accepted or mismatched identity cannot reuse it.
functional.fs_acceptance: An expired or already accepted invitation cannot create another membership.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Authentication
functional.statement: Users shall authenticate through approved enterprise federation or secure local accounts; shared human accounts shall be prohibited.
functional.acceptance: Each accepted write and approval is attributable to one uniquely identified human or service principal.
functional.behaviour: Authenticate through a verified institutional issuer or approved local account. Resolve a unique human principal before writes and show active institution on entry.
functional.exception: Reject shared account registration and untrusted issuer claims; failed login messages must not reveal whether an email exists.
functional.fs_acceptance: Each accepted write and approval is attributable to one uniquely identified human or service principal.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Multifactor authentication
functional.statement: Multifactor authentication shall be mandatory for privileged users and anyone accessing restricted data or approvals; phishing resistant methods shall be available.
functional.acceptance: A restricted dataset remains inaccessible after password only authentication.
functional.behaviour: Before entering restricted scope, inspect current assurance and require an approved additional factor if insufficient. Offer phishing resistant methods for privileged roles.
functional.exception: A remembered browser or email link alone cannot satisfy a stronger factor requirement; failure preserves only safe drafts.
functional.fs_acceptance: A restricted dataset remains inaccessible after password only authentication.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Enterprise federation
functional.statement: The platform shall support institutional single sign on using approved SAML or OpenID Connect profiles with verified organisation mapping.
functional.acceptance: A federated identity cannot claim an organisation or administrator role using an untrusted attribute.
functional.behaviour: Configure federation in draft, verify domain and issuer control, map trusted claims and test a nonprivileged account before activation. Show the effect on existing members.
functional.exception: Do not create administrator powers from arbitrary group names; preserve an approved recovery procedure for issuer outage.
functional.fs_acceptance: A federated identity cannot claim an organisation or administrator role using an untrusted attribute.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Provisioning and deprovisioning
functional.statement: The platform shall support managed directory provisioning, group mapping and deprovisioning, including SCIM where required by an institution.
functional.acceptance: A directory removal revokes mapped memberships within the agreed revocation objective and creates an audit event.
functional.behaviour: Preview directory mappings and reconcile desired against effective memberships. Apply create, update and disable events idempotently; record source identity and event version.
functional.exception: Out of order or conflicting events enter reconciliation; deprovisioning revokes rather than deleting historical authorship.
functional.fs_acceptance: A directory removal revokes mapped memberships within the agreed revocation objective and creates an audit event.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Account recovery
functional.statement: Recovery shall verify identity, invalidate compromised credentials and notify the legitimate user; support staff shall not bypass multifactor controls without a reviewed recovery procedure.
functional.acceptance: A recovery attempt cannot replace a privileged authentication factor through email access alone.
functional.behaviour: Open a recovery case with claimed identity, risk level and independent evidence. Approved recovery replaces specified factors, revokes affected sessions and sends a notice to verified channels.
functional.exception: A support agent cannot complete privileged recovery alone or rely solely on the potentially compromised mailbox.
functional.fs_acceptance: A recovery attempt cannot replace a privileged authentication factor through email access alone.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Session management
functional.statement: Users and security administrators shall view and revoke sessions; inactivity, absolute expiry and step up authentication shall follow the active risk policy.
functional.acceptance: A revoked session fails its next protected action within the specified revocation limit.
functional.behaviour: List sessions by device description, last activity and approximate location where lawful. Revoke one or all sessions and display pending versus effective revocation.
functional.exception: The next protected action fails by the revocation deadline; do not claim immediate deletion of previously downloaded material.
functional.fs_acceptance: A revoked session fails its next protected action within the specified revocation limit.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Membership changes
functional.statement: Joiner, mover and leaver workflows shall remove obsolete privileges, reassign responsibilities and preserve authorship history.
functional.acceptance: A departing reviewer loses active access without losing attribution on signed historical decisions.
functional.behaviour: Run joiner, mover or leaver checklists covering privileges, tasks, ownership and service credentials. A move removes obsolete scopes before new duties begin.
functional.exception: Departure can revoke access immediately while ownership handover remains an open operational task; attribution is retained.
functional.fs_acceptance: A departing reviewer loses active access without losing attribution on signed historical decisions.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Temporary access
functional.statement: Guest memberships and exceptional privileges shall have an owner, purpose, expiry and review; indefinite guest access shall be disallowed.
functional.acceptance: Expired access is denied by both the user interface and the API without manual cleanup.
functional.behaviour: Create temporary access with named sponsor, purpose, bounded scope and expiry. Show expiry in effective permissions and alert the owner before it lapses.
functional.exception: No renewal is automatic; expiry denies access even if a cleanup task has not run.
functional.fs_acceptance: Expired access is denied by both the user interface and the API without manual cleanup.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Service identities
functional.statement: Automations and integrations shall use separately governed service identities with limited scopes, credential rotation and a named owner.
functional.acceptance: A service credential cannot perform a human clinical signoff or inherit its owner's unrelated privileges.
functional.behaviour: Create service principals with least privilege and a credential issue action that reveals the secret only through the approved secure channel. Track rotation and disablement separately from human departure.
functional.exception: Reject human signoff commands and unrelated scopes; missing active owner blocks new credential issuance.
functional.fs_acceptance: A service credential cannot perform a human clinical signoff or inherit its owner's unrelated privileges.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: User preferences
functional.statement: Users shall manage language, timezone, accessibility settings, notification channels and ordinary profile information without changing verified professional credentials.
functional.acceptance: Changing a display name does not alter the verified signer identity on an issued report.
functional.behaviour: Allow personal language, timezone, accessibility and ordinary notification preferences. Preview localisation and preserve exact dates and units.
functional.exception: Verified names and credentials require a verification workflow; preference changes cannot suppress mandatory safety notifications.
functional.fs_acceptance: Changing a display name does not alter the verified signer identity on an issued report.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Professional verification
functional.statement: Clinical investigators, adjudicators and authorised signers shall have role specific credentials, verification evidence, validity periods and restrictions recorded.
functional.acceptance: Expired credentials block new restricted decisions while preserving historical decisions for review.
functional.behaviour: Submit credential evidence for an eligible verifier. Verification records permitted jurisdictions and decisions, expiry and restrictions; qualification is evaluated at assignment and signoff.
functional.exception: Expired or suspended credentials block new decisions and trigger reassignment; old signed records retain the original verification context.
functional.fs_acceptance: Expired credentials block new restricted decisions while preserving historical decisions for review.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Identity reconciliation
functional.statement: Duplicate identities and changed institutional addresses shall be reconciled through verified procedures with an audit trail.
functional.acceptance: Two accounts cannot be merged in a way that removes an existing conflict of interest declaration.
functional.behaviour: Present suspected duplicate identities and their memberships, interests and historical signatures to an authorised reconciliation reviewer. Link verified aliases without rewriting historical actor identifiers.
functional.exception: Merging cannot erase conflicts, sanctions or audit records; ambiguous identity remains separate and restricted pending resolution.
functional.fs_acceptance: Two accounts cannot be merged in a way that removes an existing conflict of interest declaration.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Access recertification
functional.statement: Institutional owners shall periodically review active users, service identities and permissions; overdue high risk access shall follow a defined suspension policy.
functional.acceptance: The review lists actual effective privileges and records retain, reduce or revoke decisions.
functional.behaviour: Generate periodic review campaigns showing effective grants, inherited scopes, last use and accountable owners. Reviewers record retain, reduce or revoke for each item.
functional.exception: Overdue high risk entries follow the approved suspension policy; the campaign cannot close with unanswered required entries.
functional.fs_acceptance: The review lists actual effective privileges and records retain, reduce or revoke decisions.
functional.actors: OA, institutional identity owner, security operator and individual user. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Permission model
functional.statement: The platform shall combine roles with organisation, country, study, dataset, purpose, sensitivity, lifecycle state and time constraints; default access shall be denied.
functional.acceptance: A user with an evaluator role cannot read an unassigned study merely because both share a country.
functional.behaviour: Evaluate the full context in Section 3 for each action. The inspector computes effective access for a chosen object and purpose using the same rules as runtime.
functional.exception: Missing context, unresolved conflicts and unavailable policy verification deny the affected protected action.
functional.fs_acceptance: A user with an evaluator role cannot read an unassigned study merely because both share a country.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Granular actions
functional.statement: Permissions shall distinguish discover, view metadata, view records, edit, execute, approve, export, publish, administer and delete.
functional.acceptance: Permission to view a result does not automatically permit downloading its underlying records.
functional.behaviour: Display independent permission switches with a preview of resulting actions. Granting view does not preselect export, and granting edit does not preselect approve or publish.
functional.exception: Reject permission combinations beyond the grantor's delegation, even if submitted outside the interface.
functional.fs_acceptance: Permission to view a result does not automatically permit downloading its underlying records.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Independent approval
functional.statement: The submitter or commercial beneficiary of an evaluation shall not be its sole final scientific approver; conflicting assignments shall be blocked or independently resolved.
functional.acceptance: A developer attempting to approve its own product's final report receives a recorded denial.
functional.behaviour: At reviewer assignment and final signature, compare verified identity and declared affiliations against the submitter, author and beneficiary. Require eligible independent signers.
functional.exception: A conflicted sole approver is blocked; an independently accepted conflict mitigation must be scoped and visible to final reviewers.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer attempting to approve its own product's final report receives a recorded denial.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Privileged administration
functional.statement: Platform administrators shall not receive routine access to patient data, proprietary models or sealed benchmarks by virtue of administrative status.
functional.acceptance: An administrator can manage an account without opening that account's restricted study files.
functional.behaviour: Separate infrastructure administration from content grants. Operators see identifiers, health and approved diagnostics; a content request opens the normal access workflow.
functional.exception: Administrator flags cannot override restricted file, proprietary model or sealed benchmark policies.
functional.fs_acceptance: An administrator can manage an account without opening that account's restricted study files.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Exceptional access
functional.statement: Emergency administrative access shall require a recorded purpose, narrow scope, time limit and independent oversight; local clinical emergency procedures remain separate.
functional.acceptance: The access session expires automatically and generates a reviewable record of every protected action.
functional.behaviour: Create a narrow exceptional session after the approved emergency process. Display an active access banner, expiry and case reference; record each protected action for independent review.
functional.exception: Expiry ends the elevated session; emergency administration cannot create new clinical authority or waive prohibited processing.
functional.fs_acceptance: The access session expires automatically and generates a reviewable record of every protected action.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Permission inheritance
functional.statement: Inherited grants, group membership and explicit restrictions shall resolve predictably; administrators shall preview effective access before changes.
functional.acceptance: An explicit dataset restriction remains effective when a user receives a broader programme role.
functional.behaviour: Preview direct, group and inherited grants together with explicit restrictions. Show which rule determines each action before a policy change is submitted.
functional.exception: Broader programme access cannot override a dataset restriction; unresolved precedence is a blocking policy conflict.
functional.fs_acceptance: An explicit dataset restriction remains effective when a user receives a broader programme role.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Uniform enforcement
functional.statement: Authorisation shall apply to APIs, search, previews, thumbnails, aggregate reports, exports, notifications, caches and asynchronous tasks.
functional.acceptance: A denied user's search counts and file previews do not disclose hidden objects.
functional.behaviour: Apply authorisation to rows, snippets, counts, suggestions, thumbnails, exports, notifications, assistant retrieval and background processing. Recheck cached content before delivery.
functional.exception: Hide existence where discovery is denied; do not return restricted fragments in diagnostics or search facets.
functional.fs_acceptance: A denied user's search counts and file previews do not disclose hidden objects.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Access request workflow
functional.statement: Users shall request additional access with purpose and duration; authorised data and institutional owners shall decide with reasons.
functional.acceptance: Approval for one purpose cannot be reused for an unrelated study or training activity.
functional.behaviour: Request access with study, purpose, dataset version, team, fields, environment and duration. Route to the owners whose rights are implicated; decisions may approve a subset.
functional.exception: Changing purpose or adding users after approval creates a new request; denied requests retain authorised reasons and appeal path.
functional.fs_acceptance: Approval for one purpose cannot be reused for an unrelated study or training activity.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Dual control
functional.statement: Sensitive exports, grant of powerful roles, evidence publication and deletion under special circumstances shall require the configured independent approvals.
functional.acceptance: One actor cannot satisfy two required approval roles on the same action.
functional.behaviour: Create an approval package with separate slots and an exact payload digest. Each eligible signer approves that version; commitment occurs only when all mandatory slots are satisfied.
functional.exception: One person cannot fill two independent slots; any payload change invalidates pending approvals.
functional.fs_acceptance: One actor cannot satisfy two required approval roles on the same action.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Permission changes during work
functional.statement: Active jobs, downloads and cached authorisations shall respond to revoked grants according to the safety and revocation policy.
functional.acceptance: A queued export is cancelled when its grant expires before delivery.
functional.behaviour: On revocation identify sessions, queued work, active jobs, controlled downloads and output releases. Cancel unstarted tasks and contain active processing under the approved safety procedure.
functional.exception: A short lived link must still meet the 60 second online revocation limit; completed external downloads require recorded follow up.
functional.fs_acceptance: A queued export is cancelled when its grant expires before delivery.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Permission explanations
functional.statement: Authorised administrators shall inspect why access is granted or denied without disclosing restricted content to the requester.
functional.acceptance: A support explanation identifies the missing grant and responsible approver rather than revealing protected data.
functional.behaviour: Show authorised administrators the missing scope, assurance, expiry or condition and its owner. Provide the requester only an approved explanation and request route.
functional.exception: Never reveal hidden asset titles, reviewer identities or policy details that would expose restricted information.
functional.fs_acceptance: A support explanation identifies the missing grant and responsible approver rather than revealing protected data.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Conflict aware assignment
functional.statement: Financial, employment, authorship and organisational conflicts shall affect reviewer selection and the visibility of competing submissions.
functional.acceptance: A reviewer with a declared material conflict is excluded until an independent decision is recorded.
functional.behaviour: Collect conflict declarations before assignment and periodically on material change. Match affiliations against the current study and competing submissions; exclude material conflicts pending independent review.
functional.exception: A changed employer or new ownership interest triggers reassessment without erasing previous reviews or declarations.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reviewer with a declared material conflict is excluded until an independent decision is recorded.
functional.actors: Delegated administrators, data owners, independent approvers and security owners. Accountable role: Security lead.

functional.title: Country profiles
functional.statement: Each participating country shall have a versioned profile of responsible authorities, ethics routes, data restrictions, approved activities and institutional contacts.
functional.acceptance: A study records the exact country profile version used at each gate.
functional.behaviour: Create profiles in draft and version all authorities, permitted activities and local rules. Pin the exact profile version to each gate decision and retain prior versions.
functional.exception: A draft profile cannot make a country operationally active or retrospectively change a signed study decision.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study records the exact country profile version used at each gate.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Applicability assessment
functional.statement: A qualified owner shall assess each study's intended use, device status, research status and applicable legal obligations; automated suggestions shall remain advisory.
functional.acceptance: No study becomes active with an unanswered mandatory applicability item.
functional.behaviour: Generate study applicability questions from intended use and country scope. Qualified owners resolve required answers with evidence or a reasoned not applicable decision.
functional.exception: An AI suggestion is visibly advisory; an unanswered mandatory item blocks only the dependent activity.
functional.fs_acceptance: No study becomes active with an unanswered mandatory applicability item.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Rule provenance
functional.statement: Every mandatory country rule shall record its source, effective date, interpretation owner, review date and evidence of approval.
functional.acceptance: A source change creates a review task rather than silently changing a previously approved study.
functional.behaviour: Require source, interpretation owner, effective date and review date for each mandatory rule. Link changes to a reviewed successor and an impact task.
functional.exception: An unverified source or overdue mandatory interpretation cannot silently remain accepted for newly affected activity.
