functional.fs_acceptance: A source change creates a review task rather than silently changing a previously approved study.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Residency and transfer rules
functional.statement: Profiles shall specify permitted storage, processing, support access, backup regions and cross border transfers for each data class.
functional.acceptance: An otherwise valid workspace request is blocked when its region conflicts with the dataset policy.
functional.behaviour: Match requested storage, compute, backups, support location and transfer path to every contributing asset policy. Display the permitted execution choices.
functional.exception: No compatible location yields a blocking residency conflict; user preference cannot select a forbidden region.
functional.fs_acceptance: An otherwise valid workspace request is blocked when its region conflicts with the dataset policy.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Restriction precedence
functional.statement: The platform shall apply applicable legal restrictions, ethics conditions and contracts together; unresolved conflicts shall block the affected activity.
functional.acceptance: A permissive programme template cannot override a stricter data use agreement.
functional.behaviour: Resolve law, ethics, agreement and institutional restrictions as a combined policy set. Display conflicts with affected scope and qualified resolution owner.
functional.exception: A commercial template cannot override stricter terms; incompatible rules block processing until formally resolved.
functional.fs_acceptance: A permissive programme template cannot override a stricter data use agreement.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Local terminology and language
functional.statement: Country profiles shall support languages, clinical guideline versions, terminology systems, currencies, units and timezone conventions.
functional.acceptance: A measurement is not interpreted in a different unit because a user changes display language.
functional.behaviour: Register terminology, guideline and locale versions. Show units and source language next to clinical values and require approved mappings for conversion.
functional.exception: Changing language alters presentation only; an unknown code or unit is not interpreted by analogy.
functional.fs_acceptance: A measurement is not interpreted in a different unit because a user changes display language.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Rule change impact
functional.statement: Changes to country rules shall identify affected grants, studies, workspaces, reports and deployments and route decisions to accountable owners.
functional.acceptance: Affected owners receive an actionable list with suspend, remediate or retain decisions and reasons.
functional.behaviour: On approved rule change calculate affected grants, workspaces, studies, reports and deployments. Assign an impact decision with due date and permitted transitional treatment.
functional.exception: Unreviewed affected activities remain restricted according to the effective rule; old findings are not silently rewritten.
functional.fs_acceptance: Affected owners receive an actionable list with suspend, remediate or retain decisions and reasons.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Authority boundaries
functional.statement: The platform shall distinguish internal eligibility, ethics approval, research permission, market authorisation and procurement decisions with separate issuers and scopes.
functional.acceptance: An internal successful evaluation cannot populate a market authorisation field.
functional.behaviour: Store internal eligibility, ethics, research, market access and procurement as separate typed records with different issuers and scopes. Present them in separate status fields.
functional.exception: The scientific result action has no ability to populate market authorisation or procurement approval.
functional.fs_acceptance: An internal successful evaluation cannot populate a market authorisation field.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Regulatory collaboration
functional.statement: Participating authorities may review permitted materials through scoped workspaces and record requests without gaining unrelated institutional access.
functional.acceptance: Two authorities reviewing the same solution see only the evidence explicitly shared with each.
functional.behaviour: Invite an authority reviewer into a bounded review package with material scope, purpose and expiry. Record questions and their own decisions without inheriting other authority access.
functional.exception: Requests for additional material follow a new sharing review; one authority cannot inspect another's private deliberations.
functional.fs_acceptance: Two authorities reviewing the same solution see only the evidence explicitly shared with each.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Profile activation
functional.statement: A country profile shall be activated only after local clinical, legal, privacy and operational owners approve the supported scope.
functional.acceptance: Marketing cannot advertise an active clinical sandbox in a country whose profile is still draft.
functional.behaviour: Activate a declared country scope only after local clinical, legal, privacy and operations signoff and capability checks. Publish only the activated scope to programme selection.
functional.exception: Missing signoff keeps the profile draft or restricted; marketing configuration cannot alter operational activation.
functional.fs_acceptance: Marketing cannot advertise an active clinical sandbox in a country whose profile is still draft.
functional.actors: Country owners, legal and privacy reviewers, clinical owners and authorised external reviewers. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Problem statements
functional.statement: Institutions shall register priority problems with affected population, current workflow, baseline, comparator, intended outcome and decision owner.
functional.acceptance: An opportunity cannot advance to funded evaluation without a defined decision and accountable institution.
functional.behaviour: Save a need with the current process, affected population, measurable decision and named owner. Submit for feasibility only when required context is present.
functional.exception: A vague AI topic without an institutional decision remains a draft and cannot become a commissioned evaluation.
functional.fs_acceptance: An opportunity cannot advance to funded evaluation without a defined decision and accountable institution.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Calls for solutions
functional.statement: Managers shall publish versioned calls specifying eligibility, intended use, evidence needed, support offered, timelines and evaluation criteria.
functional.acceptance: Applicants retain the call version under which they submitted.
functional.behaviour: Preview and publish an approved call version. Record open and close instants and the applicant's submitted version; validate late submission against explicit programme policy.
functional.exception: Editing an open call creates a successor and transition notice; existing applicants retain original terms unless formally changed.
functional.fs_acceptance: Applicants retain the call version under which they submitted.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Applicant screening
functional.statement: The service shall screen technical maturity, clinical relevance, affordability, licensing and deployment feasibility against declared criteria.
functional.acceptance: Rejected applicants receive authorised reasons and an available reconsideration route.
functional.behaviour: Apply a screening checklist to maturity, relevance, affordability, licence and deployment constraints. Each criterion has pass, gap or fail with evidence and reviewer.
functional.exception: Reject or return with authorised reasons and reconsideration deadline; confidential reviewer material stays restricted.
functional.fs_acceptance: Rejected applicants receive authorised reasons and an available reconsideration route.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Portfolio prioritisation
functional.statement: Programme owners shall score opportunities using transparent weights for need, readiness, equity, evidence gaps, cost and adoption prospects.
functional.acceptance: A ranking can be reproduced from its inputs and declared weights.
functional.behaviour: Score eligible applications using the frozen rubric. Calculate weighted results only for complete valid inputs and retain individual reviewer scores and tie rules.
functional.exception: Missing criteria cannot be treated as zero without rubric authority; discretionary overrides require reasons and approval.
functional.fs_acceptance: A ranking can be reproduced from its inputs and declared weights.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Budget and buyer identification
functional.statement: Each funded study shall identify its payer, budget owner, purchasing decision, available envelope and funding expiry.
functional.acceptance: A study lacking an adoption buyer is explicitly labelled exploratory and excluded from adoption readiness claims.
functional.behaviour: Bind a funding source, budget owner and purchasing decision to commissioned scope. Display exploratory status when adoption ownership is absent.
functional.exception: Exploratory studies cannot enter adoption readiness metrics as if a buyer had committed.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study lacking an adoption buyer is explicitly labelled exploratory and excluded from adoption readiness claims.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Feasibility review
functional.statement: Intake shall assess data availability, sample feasibility, reference standards, site capacity and integration constraints before commitment.
functional.acceptance: A feasibility decision records unresolved gaps and their cost and schedule consequences.
functional.behaviour: Complete data, sample, reference, staffing and integration feasibility before issuing a study commitment. Convert unresolved gaps into costed owner assigned tasks.
functional.exception: A critical unresolved feasibility gap blocks commission or requires an explicitly narrower approved exploratory scope.
functional.fs_acceptance: A feasibility decision records unresolved gaps and their cost and schedule consequences.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Demand aggregation
functional.statement: Multiple health systems may define a shared evaluation need while retaining local thresholds and purchasing decisions.
functional.acceptance: A shared call produces distinct country decision records rather than one universal approval.
functional.behaviour: Link multiple institutional needs to a shared call while keeping local decision records. Reuse common descriptions but require each institution's own scope acceptance.
functional.exception: A shared call cannot copy clinical thresholds, funding commitments or purchasing approval between countries.
functional.fs_acceptance: A shared call produces distinct country decision records rather than one universal approval.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Pipeline management
functional.statement: Managers shall track application status, owner, next action, age, blockers and reasons for withdrawal or rejection.
functional.acceptance: A pipeline report separates incomplete applications from scientifically unsuccessful evaluations.
functional.behaviour: Track first submission, current stage, accountable owner, next action and delay category. Preserve withdrawals and rejection reasons in funnel history.
functional.exception: A returned application does not reset elapsed age; scientific failure remains distinct from administrative incompleteness.
functional.fs_acceptance: A pipeline report separates incomplete applications from scientifically unsuccessful evaluations.
functional.actors: Institutional problem owner, programme manager, scientific reviewer and buyer. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Site registry
functional.statement: The service shall maintain site identity, service level, location, clinical capabilities, equipment, connectivity, data assets and responsible personnel.
functional.acceptance: A study can filter suitable sites using verified capabilities and current availability.
functional.behaviour: Register capabilities as verified or self declared and record equipment versions and current connectivity. Searches can filter only on permitted metadata.
functional.exception: Self declared capability cannot satisfy a formal study readiness gate until qualification verifies it.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study can filter suitable sites using verified capabilities and current availability.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Qualification and renewal
functional.statement: Sites and specialist partners shall undergo documented due diligence, capability assessment and periodic requalification.
functional.acceptance: An expired qualification blocks new study allocation until reviewed.
functional.behaviour: Run qualification with scoped evidence and renewal date. Approval activates only the verified tasks and resource types; expiry removes the site from new allocations.
functional.exception: An expired qualification triggers impact review for ongoing work rather than pretending prior evidence never existed.
functional.fs_acceptance: An expired qualification blocks new study allocation until reviewed.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Capacity planning
functional.statement: Sites shall publish capacity for data preparation, recruitment, evaluation and oversight with booking and overcommitment controls.
functional.acceptance: Two programme managers cannot unknowingly allocate the same unavailable clinical capacity.
functional.behaviour: Reserve a resource against a dated capacity window using a concurrency checked transaction. Tentative holds have explicit expiry; confirmed reservations reduce available units.
functional.exception: Overlapping requests cannot both consume the last capacity unit; return a conflict with alternative permitted slots.
functional.fs_acceptance: Two programme managers cannot unknowingly allocate the same unavailable clinical capacity.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Local accountability
functional.statement: Every clinical site shall identify its principal investigator or equivalent, data custodian and escalation contacts.
functional.acceptance: A live study cannot open a site without all required local accountable roles.
functional.behaviour: Assign investigator, data custodian and escalation contacts to each site and study relationship. Verify active role and accepted responsibility.
functional.exception: Opening a site fails if any required local owner or urgent backup is missing or expired.
functional.fs_acceptance: A live study cannot open a site without all required local accountable roles.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Partner agreements
functional.statement: Participation terms shall cover responsibilities, data access, compensation, incident reporting, publication and exit.
functional.acceptance: An agreement expiry is visible before a new study or renewal is approved.
functional.behaviour: Bind site participation to signed active terms covering the allocated work. Alert on expiry and surviving obligations in the capacity and study views.
functional.exception: A new allocation cannot rely on an unsigned or expired agreement; renewal does not erase previous obligations.
functional.fs_acceptance: An agreement expiry is visible before a new study or renewal is approved.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Expert matching
functional.statement: Managers shall identify reviewers, statisticians and specialists by verified expertise, language, availability and conflict status.
functional.acceptance: A match explains its eligibility and never reveals a private competing application.
functional.behaviour: Rank eligible experts by required competence, language, availability and declared conflict status using transparent matching criteria.
functional.exception: Do not reveal private assignments or competing applications; conflict disqualification is reviewed through ACC.
functional.fs_acceptance: A match explains its eligibility and never reveals a private competing application.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Site performance
functional.statement: Operational reports shall track timeliness, data quality, protocol adherence and workload without using recruitment volume as the sole quality measure.
functional.acceptance: Performance comparisons disclose case mix and data completeness limitations.
functional.behaviour: Report operational quality with approved definitions and denominators. Show incomplete data and case mix differences beside comparisons.
functional.exception: Recruitment volume alone cannot determine qualification or scientific quality; metric changes are versioned.
functional.fs_acceptance: Performance comparisons disclose case mix and data completeness limitations.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Partner suspension
functional.statement: The service shall suspend compromised or unqualified partners, stop new access and coordinate study continuity.
functional.acceptance: Affected studies receive a documented reassignment or safe closure plan.
functional.behaviour: Suspend a partner with scope, reason and effective time. Block new allocations and grants and produce an affected study continuity queue.
functional.exception: The queue remains open until qualified successors accept work or safe closure is recorded.
functional.fs_acceptance: Affected studies receive a documented reassignment or safe closure plan.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Community participation
functional.statement: Programmes shall record community and patient representatives, consultation outcomes and responses to material concerns.
functional.acceptance: Community feedback has an accountable response and can influence the approved protocol.
functional.behaviour: Record community consultation topics, participants' capacity, concerns and responsible responses. Link accepted changes to protocol amendments.
functional.exception: Confidential feedback is restricted; closing consultation requires a reasoned response to each material concern.
functional.fs_acceptance: Community feedback has an accountable response and can influence the approved protocol.
functional.actors: Site owner, programme manager, investigator, network lead and specialist reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Product identity
functional.statement: Each solution shall record developer, manufacturer where relevant, owner, intended use, users, population, deployment setting and prohibited uses.
functional.acceptance: A solution cannot enter evaluation with an undefined intended population or user.
functional.behaviour: Create a product profile with explicit intended user, population, task, setting and prohibited use. Validate responsible developer and manufacturer where applicable.
functional.exception: Missing intended use prevents submission and cannot be filled by inferred marketing text.
functional.fs_acceptance: A solution cannot enter evaluation with an undefined intended population or user.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Version identity
functional.statement: Each evaluated configuration shall bind model, software, prompts, retrieval corpus, rules, preprocessing, thresholds and material dependencies to immutable version identifiers.
functional.acceptance: Changing a decision threshold creates a new evaluated configuration rather than overwriting the old one.
functional.behaviour: Assemble a configuration from immutable component references and parameters. Freezing records a digest and version; any material component or threshold change creates a successor.
functional.exception: Remote models without stable provider versions carry an explicit identity limitation and cannot claim exact reproducibility.
functional.fs_acceptance: Changing a decision threshold creates a new evaluated configuration rather than overwriting the old one.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Submission package
functional.statement: Developers shall provide technical documentation, prior evidence, known limitations, security information, commercial terms and required runtime resources.
functional.acceptance: Submission validation identifies missing mandatory materials before scientific review begins.
functional.behaviour: Generate the submission checklist from study task, mode and risk. Upload documents through quarantine and show missing, pending scan, accepted or returned items.
functional.exception: Scientific review cannot start while a mandatory item is absent or quarantined.
functional.fs_acceptance: Submission validation identifies missing mandatory materials before scientific review begins.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Claims register
functional.statement: Each performance or clinical claim shall identify supporting evidence, tested setting, date, limitations and whether it is independently verified.
functional.acceptance: A developer supplied claim remains visibly distinct from a sandbox finding.
functional.behaviour: Create claim records with exact scope and evidence links. Display developer supplied and independently verified claims with different labels and provenance.
functional.exception: A positive result for an older configuration cannot automatically verify a new version's claim.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer supplied claim remains visibly distinct from a sandbox finding.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Regulatory status
functional.statement: The registry shall record jurisdiction, authority, reference, scope, version and validity of reported authorisations with verification status.
functional.acceptance: An authorisation for one use and jurisdiction is not displayed as unrestricted global clearance.
functional.behaviour: Record external authorisation details and route verification to the qualified country owner. Show scope, validity and unverified status until evidence is checked.
functional.exception: A document for another indication or country cannot populate the requested scope's verified status.
functional.fs_acceptance: An authorisation for one use and jurisdiction is not displayed as unrestricted global clearance.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Deployment modes
functional.statement: Submissions shall identify hosted API, local software, container, edge device or other supported execution modes and the visibility each permits.
functional.acceptance: A black box API submission identifies reproducibility and inspection limits before acceptance.
functional.behaviour: Declare container, local, edge or hosted API mode and required inspection visibility. Admission binds the approved execution profile and disclosed limits.
functional.exception: Unsupported mode remains in discovery; a black box API cannot be presented as inspected source or weights.
functional.fs_acceptance: A black box API submission identifies reproducibility and inspection limits before acceptance.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Dependency disclosure
functional.statement: Developers shall disclose relevant third party models, services, licences, update policies and patient data transmission.
functional.acceptance: An undeclared external model provider prevents activation of a restricted data evaluation.
functional.behaviour: List all external models, services and licences and the data they receive. Material dependency changes trigger rights, region and version review.
functional.exception: An undeclared or unapproved provider blocks any run that would transmit restricted content.
functional.fs_acceptance: An undeclared external model provider prevents activation of a restricted data evaluation.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Commercial readiness
functional.statement: Solutions shall disclose pricing structure, licensing restrictions, implementation needs, support, maintenance and exit conditions.
functional.acceptance: A procurement reviewer can distinguish evaluation access from production licensing rights.
functional.behaviour: Separate evaluation licence from production licence and capture recurring fees, integration, support and exit. Present the approved terms to procurement users.
functional.exception: Missing production rights or support is a readiness blocker, even when evaluation access is valid.
functional.fs_acceptance: A procurement reviewer can distinguish evaluation access from production licensing rights.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Confidentiality controls
functional.statement: Developers shall classify submission materials and propose sharing scopes subject to contractual and transparency obligations.
functional.acceptance: Publishing a public solution profile does not expose its proprietary model files.
functional.behaviour: Assign classification and proposed audience per artefact; preview public and partner profiles independently. Publication checks all contributing rights.
functional.exception: Making a profile public does not release model binaries, confidential prices or patient evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: Publishing a public solution profile does not expose its proprietary model files.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Withdrawal and recall
functional.statement: Developers and authorised operators shall withdraw submissions or flag recalls without deleting existing findings, safety history or obligations.
functional.acceptance: A withdrawn version is unavailable for new studies while its historical evidence remains traceable.
functional.behaviour: Withdraw a submission or recall a configuration with reason and affected versions. Block new studies and identify active runs, reports and deployments for action.
functional.exception: Preserve negative findings, safety history and contractual duties; withdrawal cannot delete them.
functional.fs_acceptance: A withdrawn version is unavailable for new studies while its historical evidence remains traceable.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Comparable profiles
functional.statement: The public and restricted catalogues shall use consistent metadata and filters for use case, evidence status, population and operating requirements.
functional.acceptance: Search results do not rank unlike clinical tasks by a single undifferentiated accuracy score.
functional.behaviour: Use a common profile schema and filters for intended use, population, setting and evidence status. Show comparisons only within declared compatible task and method scope.
functional.exception: Do not sort unrelated products by a single accuracy field or imply endorsement from catalogue presence.
functional.fs_acceptance: Search results do not rank unlike clinical tasks by a single undifferentiated accuracy score.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Ownership disputes
functional.statement: The service shall record ownership challenges, restrict disputed assets and preserve evidence while a responsible institution resolves the dispute.
functional.acceptance: A disputed uploader cannot transfer or delete the challenged asset during a hold.
functional.behaviour: Open an ownership dispute with claimant, evidence, affected assets and responsible institution. Apply a hold to transfer and deletion while preserving controlled review access.
functional.exception: The challenged uploader cannot resolve its own dispute or erase evidence during the hold.
functional.fs_acceptance: A disputed uploader cannot transfer or delete the challenged asset during a hold.
functional.actors: Developer, intake reviewer, scientific reviewer and permitted buyer. Accountable role: Product owner.

functional.title: Agreement register
functional.statement: The platform shall track participation, confidentiality, data use, processing, evaluation, licensing and site agreements with parties, versions and signatures.
functional.acceptance: A study gate evaluates the active signed agreement rather than an unsigned draft.
functional.behaviour: Register versions and parties, then collect verified signatures against the exact file digest. Only effective signed versions satisfy study gates.
functional.exception: Replacing a file creates a successor and resets its signature status; unsigned drafts cannot satisfy effectiveness.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study gate evaluates the active signed agreement rather than an unsigned draft.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Rights by activity
functional.statement: Agreements shall separately identify rights to inspect, execute, modify, fine tune, train, retain, publish and transfer assets.
functional.acceptance: Permission to run inference does not authorise training or model weight redistribution.
functional.behaviour: Capture separate rights for each activity and asset class. Preview whether a proposed run, adaptation, export or publication is permitted.
functional.exception: Inference permission cannot satisfy training or redistribution checks; ambiguous rights block that activity.
functional.fs_acceptance: Permission to run inference does not authorise training or model weight redistribution.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Evidence ownership
functional.statement: Contracts shall specify ownership, use rights, publication rights and confidentiality for raw data, derived data, models, results and reports.
functional.acceptance: A report export checks the rights of all contributing assets.
functional.behaviour: Record ownership and licensed use of raw data, derived assets, models, results and reports. Resolve contributing rights when assembling an export.
functional.exception: Restricted publication terms withhold affected content until redaction or an additional right is approved.
functional.fs_acceptance: A report export checks the rights of all contributing assets.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Term and expiry
functional.statement: Effective dates, renewal, termination, surviving obligations and legal holds shall drive alerts and activity restrictions.
functional.acceptance: An expired data licence blocks new runs even if a study remains administratively open.
functional.behaviour: Calculate effective, expiring, expired and terminated states from signed dates. Create renewal tasks and enforce the exact effective boundary.
functional.exception: Renewal discussions do not extend rights; surviving confidentiality, retention and safety duties remain active.
functional.fs_acceptance: An expired data licence blocks new runs even if a study remains administratively open.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Subprocessors and providers
functional.statement: The service shall register approved processors, subprocessors, external model providers and their permitted regions and retention terms.
functional.acceptance: A new provider cannot receive study data before its approval becomes effective.
functional.behaviour: Approve providers for specific services, purposes, regions and data classes. Connectors and assistants reference the effective approval version.
functional.exception: Changed provider or training terms suspend affected transmission until assessed; vendor registration alone is insufficient.
functional.fs_acceptance: A new provider cannot receive study data before its approval becomes effective.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Funding restrictions
functional.statement: Sponsors shall attach eligible costs, reporting rules, geographic limits, milestones and spending periods to awards.
functional.acceptance: A charge outside the award period is flagged before invoicing or drawdown.
functional.behaviour: Bind awards to eligible costs, geography, period and milestones. Validate commitments and charges before allocation.
functional.exception: Out of scope costs enter a finance exception queue and cannot silently consume the award.
functional.fs_acceptance: A charge outside the award period is flagged before invoicing or drawdown.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Independence terms
functional.statement: Evaluation agreements shall define reviewer independence, treatment of negative results, developer response rights and final editorial authority.
functional.acceptance: A payer cannot remove an unfavourable finding from the signed scientific record.
functional.behaviour: Record editorial authority, negative result treatment, developer response period and appeal route as required evaluation terms.
functional.exception: A payer cannot acquire unilateral power to replace or remove signed scientific findings.
functional.fs_acceptance: A payer cannot remove an unfavourable finding from the signed scientific record.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Contract exceptions
functional.statement: Proposed exceptions shall have an owner, rationale, approval, scope and expiry and shall not waive nonwaivable controls.
functional.acceptance: A commercial discount does not modify clinical safety or data protection requirements.
functional.behaviour: Request exceptions with affected clause, compensating measures, owner, expiry and independent decision; preview the affected activities.
functional.exception: Reject nonwaivable law, clinical or data exceptions; a discount changes price only.
functional.fs_acceptance: A commercial discount does not modify clinical safety or data protection requirements.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Signature integration
functional.statement: The platform shall accept authenticated signatures or verified external signed documents with signer identity and document integrity.
functional.acceptance: Replacing an agreement file invalidates its prior signature association.
functional.behaviour: Accept an approved signature response or verify an external signed file. Bind signers, document bytes, time and verification evidence.
functional.exception: Invalid integrity or unknown signer capacity leaves the agreement pending; retries cannot duplicate signatures.
functional.fs_acceptance: Replacing an agreement file invalidates its prior signature association.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Liability allocation
functional.statement: The service shall record responsibilities for care, product performance, study conduct, data handling, insurance where required and incident response.
functional.acceptance: Activation is blocked where a required responsibility or coverage obligation is unresolved.
functional.behaviour: Require accepted responsibility for care, study, product, data and incidents; verify required insurance scope and period.
functional.exception: Unassigned responsibility or expired required coverage blocks the dependent activation gate.
functional.fs_acceptance: Activation is blocked where a required responsibility or coverage obligation is unresolved.
functional.actors: Contract owner, institutional signers, privacy owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Legal and commercial lead.

functional.title: Configurable gates
functional.statement: Workflows shall define mandatory evidence, responsible roles, dependencies and permitted transitions by study type and country.
functional.acceptance: Users cannot skip an applicable ethics or data gate by changing a display status.
functional.behaviour: Instantiate gates from study type and effective country profiles. Show required evidence and use the Section 5 transition guards.
functional.exception: Changing a display status or template cannot skip mandatory gates.
functional.fs_acceptance: Users cannot skip an applicable ethics or data gate by changing a display status.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Task orchestration
functional.statement: The platform shall assign tasks, deadlines, dependencies, reminders and escalation paths with clear ownership.
functional.acceptance: A blocked task shows the dependency and accountable party rather than an unexplained delay.
functional.behaviour: Create dependent tasks with owners, due dates and escalation. Mark actionable only when prerequisites are satisfied.
functional.exception: Departure routes the task to accountable owner and backup; it never completes the task automatically.
functional.fs_acceptance: A blocked task shows the dependency and accountable party rather than an unexplained delay.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Decision records
functional.statement: Each gate decision shall record decision, scope, evidence versions, conditions, reasons, signer and timestamp.
functional.acceptance: A report can reconstruct precisely which documents supported the decision.
functional.behaviour: Present the exact evidence snapshot and scope. Commit decision, conditions and audit together after eligible signature.
functional.exception: Stale evidence or expired competence returns a blocker; no partial approval is recorded.
functional.fs_acceptance: A report can reconstruct precisely which documents supported the decision.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Parallel review
functional.statement: Independent reviewers shall work concurrently where appropriate with controlled visibility and conflict checks.
functional.acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see another review before its permitted unblinding point.
functional.behaviour: Assign independent parallel review lanes with configured blinding. Lock each review before permitted comparison.
functional.exception: Comments, exports and notifications preserve blinding; early disclosure becomes a deviation.
functional.fs_acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see another review before its permitted unblinding point.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Conditional decisions
functional.statement: Approvals with conditions shall record measurable obligations, responsible owners and expiry or recheck triggers.
functional.acceptance: An unmet prerequisite condition prevents the dependent activity from starting.
functional.behaviour: Classify every condition as execution prerequisite or permitted follow up, with measurable completion and owner.
functional.exception: Unmet prerequisites block dependent action; vague conditions require clarification before decision acceptance.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unmet prerequisite condition prevents the dependent activity from starting.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Rework and resubmission
functional.statement: Applicants shall answer queries and resubmit versioned materials without destroying earlier reviews.
functional.acceptance: Reviewers can compare the changed material and distinguish new evidence from unchanged claims.
functional.behaviour: Return itemised queries and accept a versioned resubmission with comparison. Preserve original review and first submission time.
functional.exception: Reviewers acknowledge changed material; unchanged evidence is reused only within continuing validity.
functional.fs_acceptance: Reviewers can compare the changed material and distinguish new evidence from unchanged claims.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Appeals
functional.statement: Applicants shall have an auditable appeal route with grounds, deadlines and an independent reviewer or panel.
functional.acceptance: The original decision maker cannot be the sole adjudicator of the appeal.
functional.behaviour: Accept appeal grounds within the programme window and assign an independent panel. Retain the appealed decision and its evidence.
functional.exception: Original sole decision maker cannot adjudicate; an appeal does not automatically lift a safety hold.
functional.fs_acceptance: The original decision maker cannot be the sole adjudicator of the appeal.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Suspension and resumption
functional.statement: Authorised safety or governance owners shall suspend affected work; resumption requires recorded remediation and approval.
functional.acceptance: A commercial manager cannot resume a clinical suspension independently.
functional.behaviour: Suspend affected activity, retain prior phase and permit authorised remediation. Resumption rechecks every active hold and gate.
functional.exception: Commercial users cannot clear clinical or security holds; each hold requires its own authorised resolution.
functional.fs_acceptance: A commercial manager cannot resume a clinical suspension independently.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Amendments
functional.statement: Material changes to intended use, protocol, data, model, sites or oversight shall trigger impact assessment and appropriate reapproval.
functional.acceptance: An added site cannot recruit under another site's approval unless explicitly covered.
functional.behaviour: Submit material changes as amendments and calculate affected sites, permissions, runs and claims. Route impact decisions separately.
functional.exception: New sites, uses or configurations remain inactive until relevant amendment and local prerequisites pass.
functional.fs_acceptance: An added site cannot recruit under another site's approval unless explicitly covered.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Service clocks
functional.statement: Review timers shall separate active work, applicant delay, external authority delay and agreed pauses.
functional.acceptance: Turnaround reporting cannot improve by silently resetting an application's start date.
functional.behaviour: Record stage events and reasoned pause intervals. Show wall clock elapsed and active time using normalised nonoverlapping intervals.
functional.exception: Rework cannot reset age and overlapping pauses cannot be deducted twice.
functional.fs_acceptance: Turnaround reporting cannot improve by silently resetting an application's start date.
functional.actors: Programme manager, assigned reviewers, decision owners and independent appeals panel. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Ethics applicability
functional.statement: Every study shall record whether ethics review is required and the qualified determination supporting approval, exemption or another lawful route.
functional.acceptance: An evaluator cannot self declare exemption without the required institutional authority.
functional.behaviour: Require a qualified applicability determination with evidence supporting approval, exemption or another lawful route.
functional.exception: An evaluator cannot self select exemption without the required institutional authority.
functional.fs_acceptance: An evaluator cannot self declare exemption without the required institutional authority.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Approval records
functional.statement: Ethics permissions shall capture issuing body, protocol version, sites, population, conditions, dates and approved materials.
functional.acceptance: A study cannot use an approval that covers a different protocol or excluded population.
functional.behaviour: Match permission to protocol, sites, population, activities and materials. Show scope, conditions and expiry beside the study gate.
functional.exception: A different protocol or excluded population creates a blocker, not assumed equivalence.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study cannot use an approval that covers a different protocol or excluded population.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Consent and notices
functional.statement: Prospective studies shall maintain approved participant information, consent or authorised waiver basis, language versions and collection evidence.
functional.acceptance: A participant's record identifies the exact consent materials and basis that apply.
functional.behaviour: Store approved materials by language and source version; bind exact consent or waiver evidence to each governed participant activity.
functional.exception: Draft translations or missing collection evidence cannot satisfy enrolment.
functional.fs_acceptance: A participant's record identifies the exact consent materials and basis that apply.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Vulnerable populations
functional.statement: Protocols involving children or other vulnerable groups shall specify applicable safeguards, assent or representative processes and exclusions.
functional.acceptance: Recruitment blocks when the required authorised consent pathway is missing.
functional.behaviour: Apply the approved vulnerable population pathway and validate representative authority, assent and exclusions.
functional.exception: Missing required safeguards block recruitment and route to the qualified local owner.
functional.fs_acceptance: Recruitment blocks when the required authorised consent pathway is missing.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Secondary use
functional.statement: Retrospective use shall document permitted purposes, lawful basis and ethics conditions independently of assumptions about deidentification.
functional.acceptance: A deidentified dataset is rejected for a purpose excluded by its data use agreement.
functional.behaviour: Assess retrospective use against lawful basis, purposes, ethics and data terms; bind to dataset and protocol.
functional.exception: Deidentification does not authorise an excluded secondary purpose.
functional.fs_acceptance: A deidentified dataset is rejected for a purpose excluded by its data use agreement.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Participant withdrawal
functional.statement: Withdrawal requests shall stop relevant future participation and trigger an assessment of permitted retention and analysis obligations.
functional.acceptance: The participant and study owner receive an outcome showing what ceased and what must remain.
functional.behaviour: Verify withdrawal, stop governed future participation and review retention, analyses and follow up. Record the participant response.
functional.exception: Do not promise deletion of lawfully retained records; distinguish what ceased and what remains.
functional.fs_acceptance: The participant and study owner receive an outcome showing what ceased and what must remain.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Clinical oversight
functional.statement: Studies influencing care shall specify qualified supervision, escalation, standard care fallback and responsibilities at each site.
functional.acceptance: The study cannot start until a local accountable clinician accepts the oversight plan.
functional.behaviour: Require local clinical acceptance of supervision, escalation and standard care fallback. Display current urgent contacts at each site.
functional.exception: No qualified owner or fallback means care affecting functionality cannot start.
functional.fs_acceptance: The study cannot start until a local accountable clinician accepts the oversight plan.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Ethics renewal
functional.statement: Expiry and amendment conditions shall trigger alerts and prevent unauthorised continued activity.
functional.acceptance: New affected activity stops at expiry unless a valid extension is recorded.
functional.behaviour: Generate renewal and amendment tasks and stop governed new activity at expiry unless a verified extension is effective.
functional.exception: Submitted renewal is not approval; existing participants require a local continuity decision.
functional.fs_acceptance: New affected activity stops at expiry unless a valid extension is recorded.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Participant communication
functional.statement: The service shall support approved communication of study information, material changes and results through site appropriate channels.
functional.acceptance: Messages are checked for language, confidentiality and approved content before release.
functional.behaviour: Prepare approved language content, validate recipients and obtain release authority before dispatch. Track delivery and acknowledgement where needed.
functional.exception: Failed delivery remains open; shared device previews contain no sensitive details.
functional.fs_acceptance: Messages are checked for language, confidentiality and approved content before release.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Ethical complaints
functional.statement: Participants and staff shall have accessible routes to raise concerns, including confidential handling and protection against retaliation.
functional.acceptance: A complaint receives an independent owner and cannot be deleted by the subject of the complaint.
functional.behaviour: Accept confidential concerns independently of developer permissions and assign a handler outside the implicated chain.
functional.exception: The complaint subject cannot delete the case, reveal protected reporter details or close its independent review.
functional.fs_acceptance: A complaint receives an independent owner and cannot be deleted by the subject of the complaint.
functional.actors: Qualified ethics owner, local investigator, communication owner and independent complaints handler. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Dataset catalogue
functional.statement: Each dataset shall describe custodian, modality, provenance, population, time period, geography, quality, permitted uses, sensitivity and access conditions.
functional.acceptance: A catalogue entry can be discoverable without exposing records or sensitive sample counts.
functional.behaviour: Publish metadata separately from records. Custodians choose discoverable fields and restrict sensitive population counts or locations.
functional.exception: Discovery never grants sample, thumbnail or underlying record access.
functional.fs_acceptance: A catalogue entry can be discoverable without exposing records or sensitive sample counts.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Data access applications
functional.statement: Applicants shall specify purpose, protocol, users, environment, duration, outputs and training intent for each access request.
functional.acceptance: The custodian can approve a restricted subset or deny with reasons.
functional.behaviour: Request purpose, protocol, team, version, region, period and outputs. Reviewers approve exact subsets and conditions.
functional.exception: Added users, fields or training intent require revised approval; returned requests retain questions.
functional.fs_acceptance: The custodian can approve a restricted subset or deny with reasons.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Purpose bound grants
functional.statement: Data permissions shall bind approved users, study, purpose, dataset version, region and duration and be enforced on execution and export.
functional.acceptance: A valid grant for evaluation cannot be used by a training job.
functional.behaviour: Issue a grant after all required decisions; enforce approved view and period on queries, runs, exports and provider calls.
functional.exception: Evaluation rights fail training requests; successor datasets are not automatically included.
functional.fs_acceptance: A valid grant for evaluation cannot be used by a training job.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Consent and legal basis metadata
functional.statement: Datasets shall retain applicable consent categories, lawful basis, use restrictions and evidence references at suitable granularity.
functional.acceptance: A mixed dataset can exclude records that are not authorised for the requested purpose.
functional.behaviour: Apply consent and basis restrictions at record or cohort level where needed. Include only eligible records and retain safe exclusion counts.
functional.exception: Mixed rights cannot collapse into one permissive dataset flag; uncertain records remain excluded.
functional.fs_acceptance: A mixed dataset can exclude records that are not authorised for the requested purpose.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Data minimisation
functional.statement: Study owners shall justify required fields, granularity and retention; approved views shall expose only the necessary information.
functional.acceptance: An evaluator using age bands cannot request dates of birth without a new approved need.
functional.behaviour: Review necessary fields and precision against the protocol, then publish the approved view.
functional.exception: Extra identifiers or granularity require documented need and reapproval.
functional.fs_acceptance: An evaluator using age bands cannot request dates of birth without a new approved need.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Data residence
functional.statement: The catalogue shall record where original, working, derived, cached and backup data may reside and whether remote access is allowed.
functional.acceptance: A cross border support session is evaluated under the same applicable restrictions as processing.
functional.behaviour: Validate every planned copy, backup and remote support location against the asset inventory and policy.
functional.exception: Cross border support is a governed access event, not a routine administrative exemption.
functional.fs_acceptance: A cross border support session is evaluated under the same applicable restrictions as processing.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Pseudonymisation
functional.statement: Direct identifiers and linkage keys shall be separated and restricted; pseudonymised data shall remain governed as sensitive personal data where applicable.
functional.acceptance: Evaluation users cannot recover identities using the linkage key store.
functional.behaviour: Expose study pseudonyms to evaluators and restrict linkage and reidentification to separately authorised local roles.
functional.exception: Pseudonymised data remain sensitive; operators cannot use linkage stores through administrative status.
functional.fs_acceptance: Evaluation users cannot recover identities using the linkage key store.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Revocation and downstream impact
functional.statement: A revoked grant shall identify active workspaces, copies, jobs, exports and derived outputs requiring action.
functional.acceptance: New access stops promptly and each affected asset receives an accountable remediation decision.
functional.behaviour: Revoke with reason, identify active work, controlled copies and outputs, then assign containment and remediation.
functional.exception: New online access stops within 60 seconds; external copies require tracked contractual follow up.
functional.fs_acceptance: New access stops promptly and each affected asset receives an accountable remediation decision.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Controlled exports
functional.statement: Outputs shall be assessed for personal information, small cells, memorisation and contractual restrictions before authorised release.
functional.acceptance: A result containing disallowed patient rows is withheld even when its aggregate score is releasable.
functional.behaviour: Check rights, personal information, small cells and inference risks on the exact export manifest, then collect required human approvals.
functional.exception: Patient rows remain withheld even when aggregate scores are releasable; changes invalidate release approval.
functional.fs_acceptance: A result containing disallowed patient rows is withheld even when its aggregate score is releasable.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Federated access
functional.statement: A dataset may remain with its custodian while approved evaluation work and reviewed outputs move under local rules.
functional.acceptance: A local custodian can refuse a run or an output release independently of central scheduling.
functional.behaviour: Send an approved run to a custodian node; local acceptance and outgoing result review remain separate decisions.
functional.exception: Central scheduling cannot override refusal; missing acknowledgement never implies execution.
functional.fs_acceptance: A local custodian can refuse a run or an output release independently of central scheduling.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Benchmark secrecy
functional.statement: Sealed evaluation sets shall have limited custodians, query budgets and rules preventing disclosure or repeated optimisation against hidden labels.
functional.acceptance: A developer cannot download sealed labels or bypass its submission limit with a duplicate identity.
functional.behaviour: Enforce hidden labels and attempt budgets across verified related identities. Record attempts and disclose only approved feedback.
functional.exception: Duplicate accounts cannot reset quota; reset requires independent authority.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer cannot download sealed labels or bypass its submission limit with a duplicate identity.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Data rights requests
functional.statement: The service shall route access, correction, objection and deletion requests to the responsible controller with deadlines and evidence of disposition.
functional.acceptance: A request is not automatically fulfilled in a way that destroys a lawful clinical record or legal hold.
functional.behaviour: Verify the rights requester, controller, scope and deadline; trace affected assets and issue a reasoned outcome.
functional.exception: Assess holds and clinical duties before deletion; do not fulfil requests by arbitrary record removal.
functional.fs_acceptance: A request is not automatically fulfilled in a way that destroys a lawful clinical record or legal hold.
functional.actors: Data custodian, study applicant, privacy reviewer and disclosure reviewer. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Import methods
functional.statement: Approved users shall import supported files or connect authorised source systems with declared source, schema, owner and expected volume.
functional.acceptance: An import without an authorised source and active access grant cannot enter a study workspace.
functional.behaviour: Register source, rights, manifest and mapping before transfer. Accept only admitted formats and approved source systems.
functional.exception: Unknown source, unsupported type or absent purpose keeps the batch unaccepted.
functional.fs_acceptance: An import without an authorised source and active access grant cannot enter a study workspace.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Quarantine and scanning
functional.statement: Incoming files, archives, models and attachments shall be quarantined and checked for malware, unsupported content and unsafe structures.
functional.acceptance: A failed scan prevents previews, execution and downstream indexing.
functional.behaviour: Quarantine before preview, extraction, indexing or execution. Record detected type, malware and unsafe structure results.
functional.exception: Failed or unavailable scan blocks downstream use; extensions cannot override content detection.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed scan prevents previews, execution and downstream indexing.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Schema and semantic validation
functional.statement: Imports shall validate field types, required values, units, codes, time ordering and modality specific constraints.
functional.acceptance: A plausible numeric value with an incompatible unit is flagged rather than silently accepted.
functional.behaviour: Validate types, required values, units, codes and chronology against the approved schema. Expose field reasons to permitted reviewers.
functional.exception: Do not coerce semantically incompatible clinical values into acceptance.
functional.fs_acceptance: A plausible numeric value with an incompatible unit is flagged rather than silently accepted.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Identity and deduplication
functional.statement: Imports shall detect duplicates, repeated participants and linkage ambiguity without exposing unnecessary identifiers.
functional.acceptance: Repeated encounters remain distinguishable from accidental duplicate records.
functional.behaviour: Detect duplicates and overlap through approved linkage, then distinguish repeated encounters using reviewed disposition.
functional.exception: Ambiguous identity remains unresolved; messages cannot expose hidden identifiers.
functional.fs_acceptance: Repeated encounters remain distinguishable from accidental duplicate records.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Import reconciliation
functional.statement: The platform shall reconcile source, accepted, rejected and quarantined counts with record level reasons visible to authorised users.
functional.acceptance: An import cannot report complete while unaccounted records remain.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile source count as accepted plus rejected plus quarantined. Release a summary with every exclusion and reason.
functional.exception: Unaccounted inputs block completion; partial acceptance needs explicit approval carried into analysis.
functional.fs_acceptance: An import cannot report complete while unaccounted records remain.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Resumable transfer
functional.statement: Large uploads shall support interrupted transfer recovery, integrity verification and duplicate safe retries.
functional.acceptance: A resumed upload produces one verified asset with the expected checksum.
functional.behaviour: Resume verified chunks under the same upload identity and check final size and digest.
functional.exception: Conflicting payloads fail integrity; retries cannot produce duplicate released assets or charges.
functional.fs_acceptance: A resumed upload produces one verified asset with the expected checksum.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Provenance lineage
functional.statement: Transformations shall retain source version, applied rules, actor, timestamp and destination versions without overwriting source evidence.
functional.acceptance: A reported metric can be traced back through every material transformation.
functional.behaviour: Persist lineage for every material transform with versions, parameters, mapping and execution identity.
functional.exception: Missing source or transform references block use in formal findings.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reported metric can be traced back through every material transformation.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Data correction
functional.statement: Custodians shall correct data through controlled versions and issue impact notifications to affected analyses.
functional.acceptance: Correcting a label creates a new dataset version and marks dependent reports for assessment.
functional.behaviour: Correct through a successor with original, replacement, reason and evidence; notify affected analyses and reports.
functional.exception: Never overwrite an issued dataset; scientific owners decide correction or withdrawal impact.
functional.fs_acceptance: Correcting a label creates a new dataset version and marks dependent reports for assessment.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Deidentification review
functional.statement: Relevant modalities shall undergo identifier detection and human review as required, including metadata, free text and burned in image identifiers.
functional.acceptance: Removing structured identifiers alone does not mark an imaging dataset safe to release.
functional.behaviour: Detect identifiers across structured metadata, text and pixels; require specified human residual risk review.
functional.exception: Removing identifier columns alone does not clear imaging or narrative data for release.
functional.fs_acceptance: Removing structured identifiers alone does not mark an imaging dataset safe to release.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Scheduled ingestion
functional.statement: Approved connectors shall support incremental ingestion, freshness monitoring, schema change detection and safe replay.
functional.acceptance: An incompatible source change pauses affected processing and identifies the responsible integration owner.
functional.behaviour: Ingest incrementally with approved source cursor, freshness checks and schema fingerprint before checkpoint advancement.
functional.exception: Incompatible changes pause processing; replay uses source keys and versions to prevent duplicates.
functional.fs_acceptance: An incompatible source change pauses affected processing and identifies the responsible integration owner.
functional.actors: Data engineer, custodian, mapping reviewer and integration owner. Accountable role: Data engineering lead.

functional.title: Reference standard definition
functional.statement: Each evaluation shall document its reference standard, rationale, timing, limitations and adjudication method.
functional.acceptance: A protocol cannot label an unverified model prediction as clinical ground truth.
functional.behaviour: Approve the clinical reference before annotation and evaluation; record timing and limitations for analysis.
functional.exception: Available model predictions cannot be declared clinical ground truth by default.
functional.fs_acceptance: A protocol cannot label an unverified model prediction as clinical ground truth.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Annotation work allocation
functional.statement: Managers shall allocate annotation tasks by verified expertise, permitted data access and blinding rules.
functional.acceptance: An annotator cannot open an unassigned task or access a disallowed patient identifier.
functional.behaviour: Allocate to qualified users with valid grants and blinding. Reserve work while permitting planned independent labels.
functional.exception: Assignment does not grant access; expired competence or purpose blocks opening cases.
functional.fs_acceptance: An annotator cannot open an unassigned task or access a disallowed patient identifier.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Annotation guidelines
functional.statement: Instructions, label definitions and examples shall be versioned and approved before use.
functional.acceptance: Every label records the applicable guideline version and annotator identity.
functional.behaviour: Bind each label to an approved guideline. Changes create successors and identify tasks needing review.
functional.exception: In progress tasks cannot silently switch definitions; annotators acknowledge the new version.
functional.fs_acceptance: Every label records the applicable guideline version and annotator identity.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Independent labelling
functional.statement: Studies shall support multiple independent labels and adjudication by an eligible reviewer when their protocol requires it.
functional.acceptance: Initial independent labels remain recoverable after adjudication.
functional.behaviour: Collect independent labels without revealing peers, then route disagreement to an eligible adjudicator.
functional.exception: Preserve originals and disagreement; conflicts or insufficient competence require reassignment.
functional.fs_acceptance: Initial independent labels remain recoverable after adjudication.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Agreement and quality checks
functional.statement: The system shall calculate appropriate interrater agreement and sample quality checks, with methods and denominators disclosed.
functional.acceptance: A quality report distinguishes consensus, disagreement and missing labels.
functional.behaviour: Calculate approved agreement and sampled quality with denominators, missingness and method version.
functional.exception: Post adjudication consensus cannot be reported as original interrater agreement.
functional.fs_acceptance: A quality report distinguishes consensus, disagreement and missing labels.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Uncertain and unavailable labels
functional.statement: Reference data shall represent uncertainty, indeterminate findings and unavailable follow up without forcing a binary label.
functional.acceptance: An indeterminate outcome is handled according to the prespecified analysis plan.
functional.behaviour: Offer explicit uncertain, indeterminate and unavailable outcomes with reasons; carry them into analysis.
functional.exception: Do not force binary labels or convert missing follow up into clinical negatives.
functional.fs_acceptance: An indeterminate outcome is handled according to the prespecified analysis plan.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Blinding controls
functional.statement: Label assignment shall restrict access to model outputs or other information that could bias the reference standard.
functional.acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see the evaluated model's prediction through exports or task history.
functional.behaviour: Filter views, history, exports and links under blinding; record authorised unblinding.
functional.exception: Accidental output exposure creates a deviation and affected label review.
functional.fs_acceptance: A blinded reviewer cannot see the evaluated model's prediction through exports or task history.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Dataset partitions
functional.statement: Data owners shall control development, tuning, validation and final test partitions using patient, site and time boundaries as applicable.
functional.acceptance: Patient overlap across partitions is detected before an evaluation is accepted.
functional.behaviour: Assign partitions using patient, site and time rules; retain leakage checks before freezing.
functional.exception: Known overlap blocks independent test claims unless explicitly justified by the approved design.
functional.fs_acceptance: Patient overlap across partitions is detected before an evaluation is accepted.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Curation release
functional.statement: A dataset release shall require quality review, rights verification and a frozen manifest of included records and labels.
functional.acceptance: A released dataset cannot change its membership without a new version.
