functional.behaviour: Freeze records and labels after rights and quality approval and generate immutable manifest identity.
functional.exception: Membership or label changes create a successor; drafts cannot be formal test inputs.
functional.fs_acceptance: A released dataset cannot change its membership without a new version.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Specialist annotation integrations
functional.statement: The platform shall integrate approved annotation tools while preserving task identity, access rules and provenance.
functional.acceptance: Imported annotations reconcile to the original task and retain reviewer attribution.
functional.behaviour: Export scoped tasks to approved tools and reconcile returned labels to task, guideline and reviewer.
functional.exception: Unknown tasks, changed definitions or missing attribution enter reconciliation rather than automatic acceptance.
functional.fs_acceptance: Imported annotations reconcile to the original task and retain reviewer attribution.
functional.actors: Curation manager, annotator, adjudicator and custodian. Accountable role: Clinical data lead.

functional.title: Workspace request
functional.statement: Workspace provisioning shall require approved study, configuration, data grants, execution region, access list and resource budget.
functional.acceptance: Provisioning fails when any required grant or prerequisite is expired.
functional.behaviour: Provision after checking study gates, configuration, grants, region, access and funded resources. Expiry is bounded by controlling permissions.
functional.exception: Missing prerequisites return blockers; partially provisioned workspaces remain inaccessible.
functional.fs_acceptance: Provisioning fails when any required grant or prerequisite is expired.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Execution isolation
functional.statement: Submitted models, containers and scripts shall run in isolated environments with approved privileges, storage, network access and controlled cleanup before resource reuse.
functional.acceptance: A workload cannot read another study's files, secrets or residual CPU or GPU memory.
functional.behaviour: Use validated isolation profiles and verified cleanup of storage and residual CPU or GPU memory before reuse. Retain profile and cleanup evidence.
functional.exception: Failed isolation or cleanup quarantines resources before another study can use them.
functional.fs_acceptance: A workload cannot read another study's files, secrets or residual CPU or GPU memory.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Network controls
functional.statement: Outbound access shall be denied unless explicitly required and authorised; allowed destinations and transmitted data shall be logged appropriately.
functional.acceptance: A model attempting an undeclared external API call is blocked and flagged.
functional.behaviour: Match each outbound destination to approved egress; record permitted categories and safe blocked connection diagnostics.
functional.exception: Undeclared connections are denied and flagged without copying unrestricted payloads into logs.
functional.fs_acceptance: A model attempting an undeclared external API call is blocked and flagged.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Resource quotas
functional.statement: The platform shall enforce compute, storage, concurrency, runtime and spend limits at study and institutional levels.
functional.acceptance: A runaway job stops at its approved limit and cannot exhaust another study's allocation.
functional.behaviour: Reserve resources and budget before start, meter consumption and enforce limits while preserving other studies' allocations.
functional.exception: Retries cannot bypass remaining budget; safety investigation reserves remain protected.
functional.fs_acceptance: A runaway job stops at its approved limit and cannot exhaust another study's allocation.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Reproducible run manifest
functional.statement: Every run shall bind input versions, model configuration, environment, dependencies, seeds where applicable, parameters and execution identity.
functional.acceptance: An authorised reviewer can reconstruct the exact configuration used for a reported result.
functional.behaviour: Freeze the run manifest before dispatch and record actual environment identities at start.
functional.exception: Missing or unpinned components create explicit reproducibility limits and block execution where the protocol requires stable identity.
functional.fs_acceptance: An authorised reviewer can reconstruct the exact configuration used for a reported result.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Execution lifecycle
functional.statement: Users shall submit, queue, start, inspect, cancel and retry authorised runs with explicit states and failure reasons.
functional.acceptance: A failed job cannot be represented as a completed successful evaluation.
functional.behaviour: Use requested, validating, queued, running, cancelling, succeeded, failed, cancelled and blocked states with observed times.
functional.exception: Execution success is distinct from scientific success; failure cannot be cleared by editing status.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed job cannot be represented as a completed successful evaluation.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Idempotent retries
functional.statement: Retries shall preserve lineage and avoid duplicate evidence, charges or downstream actions.
functional.acceptance: A network retry creates no second charge or duplicate final result for the same logical request.
functional.behaviour: Retry with a linked attempt after checking current permission and budget; duplicate network submissions return the existing request.
functional.exception: Changed payload under the same key conflicts; evidence and charges follow the declared attempt policy.
functional.fs_acceptance: A network retry creates no second charge or duplicate final result for the same logical request.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: External API evaluation
functional.statement: Remote model endpoints shall be permitted only under approved data terms and recorded version guarantees or limitations.
functional.acceptance: An unpinned provider change marks comparability uncertain and triggers review.
functional.behaviour: Check endpoint terms, region, fields and version guarantees; record request identities and provider configuration.
functional.exception: Provider change triggers comparability review; unapproved transmission is blocked.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unpinned provider change marks comparability uncertain and triggers review.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Output handling
functional.statement: Run outputs shall remain restricted until validated and reviewed under the applicable output release policy.
functional.acceptance: Logs containing patient data cannot be automatically attached to a public support ticket.
functional.behaviour: Keep outputs and logs restricted until integrity, schema and disclosure checks pass on the exact manifest.
functional.exception: Sensitive diagnostics cannot automatically enter ordinary support tickets or public reports.
functional.fs_acceptance: Logs containing patient data cannot be automatically attached to a public support ticket.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Expiry and shutdown
functional.statement: Workspace access and new processing shall stop on grant expiry, suspension or study closure; retained assets follow policy.
functional.acceptance: A scheduled job cannot restart a closed workspace using an old credential.
functional.behaviour: At expiry, suspension or closure block new processing, cancel queued work and safely contain active jobs.
functional.exception: Saved schedules and old credentials cannot restart an expired workspace.
functional.fs_acceptance: A scheduled job cannot restart a closed workspace using an old credential.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Remote execution nodes
functional.statement: Approved local institutions may operate execution nodes with policy enforcement, attestation evidence and connectivity status.
functional.acceptance: A disconnected node cannot be assumed to have received a stop instruction.
functional.behaviour: Dispatch scoped instructions to qualified local nodes and track acceptance, execution and observed completion; display contact age and lease.
functional.exception: Disconnected status stays unconfirmed; local policy stops new work after approved offline lease expiry.
functional.fs_acceptance: A disconnected node cannot be assumed to have received a stop instruction.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Emergency termination
functional.statement: Authorised operators shall terminate unsafe sandbox execution and preserve necessary diagnostic evidence.
functional.acceptance: Termination prevents new affected execution and records the scope, requester and observed completion status.
functional.behaviour: Allow immediate authorised termination, preserve bounded diagnostics and distinguish requested from observed stop.
functional.exception: A central command does not prove local shutdown; missing acknowledgement escalates.
functional.fs_acceptance: Termination prevents new affected execution and records the scope, requester and observed completion status.
functional.actors: Evaluator, execution operator, custodian and safety or security owner. Accountable role: Engineering lead.

functional.title: Protocol templates
functional.statement: Protocols shall specify intended use, setting, population, comparators, endpoints, data, risks, methods, oversight and decision rules.
functional.acceptance: A protocol with an undefined primary endpoint cannot be frozen for formal evaluation.
functional.behaviour: Populate protocol sections from an approved task template, then require explicit intended use, setting, population, endpoints, comparator and oversight.
functional.exception: Missing primary endpoint or decision rule blocks freeze; copied text remains draft until reviewed for local relevance.
functional.fs_acceptance: A protocol with an undefined primary endpoint cannot be frozen for formal evaluation.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Study type
functional.statement: The platform shall distinguish technical benchmarking, retrospective validation, simulation, silent prospective evaluation and interventional studies.
functional.acceptance: Study type determines required gates and allowable exposure of outputs to clinical users.
functional.behaviour: Select study type before gate generation. Changing type recalculates ethics, site, participant and output exposure requirements.
functional.exception: Silent prospective type cannot enable clinician worklist outputs; change to intervention requires a reviewed amendment.
functional.fs_acceptance: Study type determines required gates and allowable exposure of outputs to clinical users.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Sample justification
functional.statement: An accountable statistician or qualified reviewer shall approve sample size or precision rationale, prevalence assumptions and subgroup feasibility.
functional.acceptance: An underpowered subgroup is labelled inconclusive rather than represented as proven safe.
functional.behaviour: Capture the sample rationale, assumptions and qualified statistical approval. Preview subgroup counts against the required precision or adequacy criteria.
functional.exception: Insufficient subgroups remain inconclusive and cannot inherit overall performance as proof of safety.
functional.fs_acceptance: An underpowered subgroup is labelled inconclusive rather than represented as proven safe.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Prespecified thresholds
functional.statement: Clinical and technical thresholds shall be defined by intended use, comparator and risk before final testing.
functional.acceptance: Threshold changes after results are viewed create a protocol amendment and disclosed exploratory analysis.
functional.behaviour: Approve thresholds before final results are unblinded. Store comparison operators, units, populations and confidence rules as machine interpretable values.
functional.exception: Changing a threshold after viewing results creates an amendment and exploratory analysis label.
functional.fs_acceptance: Threshold changes after results are viewed create a protocol amendment and disclosed exploratory analysis.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Analysis plan
functional.statement: The plan shall define missing data, exclusions, repeated measures, multiplicity, uncertainty estimates and handling of failed predictions.
functional.acceptance: An evaluator cannot silently remove model failures from the primary denominator.
functional.behaviour: Specify denominator, exclusions, failures, repeated measures and missingness before running primary analysis. Register each planned analysis identity.
functional.exception: Unplanned filtering cannot silently alter a primary denominator; deviations require explicit disclosure and review.
functional.fs_acceptance: An evaluator cannot silently remove model failures from the primary denominator.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Comparator definition
functional.statement: Each comparative claim shall identify the comparator version, standard care workflow and comparable dataset or study design.
functional.acceptance: A comparison using different populations must disclose the limitation and cannot imply a controlled head to head result.
functional.behaviour: Bind comparator version and standard care workflow to the study, including data and timing differences.
functional.exception: Different populations require a qualified limitation; they cannot be presented as a controlled head to head comparison.
functional.fs_acceptance: A comparison using different populations must disclose the limitation and cannot imply a controlled head to head result.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Subgroup plan
functional.statement: Protocols shall prespecify relevant demographic, clinical, site, device, language and intersectional analyses with lawful data collection.
functional.acceptance: A missing protected attribute is shown as unassessed rather than interpreted as absence of bias.
functional.behaviour: Define subgroup attributes, lawful collection basis, intersections and adequacy rules. Show not collected separately from not assessed.
functional.exception: Missing protected attributes do not imply no bias; sparse groups follow disclosure and uncertainty rules.
functional.fs_acceptance: A missing protected attribute is shown as unassessed rather than interpreted as absence of bias.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Freeze and amendment
functional.statement: Protocol and analysis versions shall be frozen before formal evaluation, with approved amendments and access to prior versions.
functional.acceptance: Final results link to the frozen plan and identify all departures from it.
functional.behaviour: Freeze a complete reviewed plan, generating immutable identity and signatures. Formal runs reference that version; amendments preserve the original and impact decision.
functional.exception: New material cannot modify a frozen plan in place or conceal departures from prespecification.
functional.fs_acceptance: Final results link to the frozen plan and identify all departures from it.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Stopping rules
functional.statement: Clinical studies and high risk tests shall define pause, stop, escalation and resumption criteria with accountable decision makers.
functional.acceptance: A trigger crossing creates the configured hold and requires the designated independent decision.
functional.behaviour: Define stopping triggers and responsible authorities. A qualifying observation opens the specified hold and urgent task with supporting evidence.
functional.exception: Only the relevant independent authority may resume; acknowledgement alone does not clear the trigger.
functional.fs_acceptance: A trigger crossing creates the configured hold and requires the designated independent decision.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Protocol reuse
functional.statement: Approved templates may be reused across sites or countries while identifying required local adaptation.
functional.acceptance: Reusing a template does not copy another country's ethics approval or clinical thresholds automatically.
functional.behaviour: Clone an approved template as a new draft and display required local adaptations. Preserve template provenance without copying approvals.
functional.exception: Country permissions and clinical thresholds must be explicitly reviewed for the receiving scope.
functional.fs_acceptance: Reusing a template does not copy another country's ethics approval or clinical thresholds automatically.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Risk proportional review
functional.statement: Review depth shall reflect intended use, harm potential, autonomy, evidence maturity and deployment context.
functional.acceptance: A high risk clinical use cannot enter through a low risk administrative template.
functional.behaviour: Apply the approved risk rubric to intended use, autonomy, harm and maturity. Set review depth and required competence accordingly.
functional.exception: A high risk clinical use cannot select an administrative low risk route to avoid safeguards.
functional.fs_acceptance: A high risk clinical use cannot enter through a low risk administrative template.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Study registration
functional.statement: The service shall record applicable external study registration, identifier and timing and reconcile material changes.
functional.acceptance: A claimed registered study includes a verifiable registration reference and matching scope.
functional.behaviour: Record registry identity, registration time, protocol match and public reference when applicable. Track amendments against the external record.
functional.exception: Unverifiable or mismatched registration remains unverified and cannot support a registered study claim.
functional.fs_acceptance: A claimed registered study includes a verifiable registration reference and matching scope.
functional.actors: Evaluation lead, statistician, clinical owner and independent protocol reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Task appropriate metrics
functional.statement: The platform shall support registered metric definitions suited to classification, regression, segmentation, detection, forecasting or other admitted tasks.
functional.acceptance: Every reported metric identifies its definition, implementation version and denominator.
functional.behaviour: Select metrics only from the admitted task pack. Each result binds the formula, implementation version, denominator and validated fixture evidence.
functional.exception: Unsupported metrics remain experimental and cannot become official endpoints through a user entered name.
functional.fs_acceptance: Every reported metric identifies its definition, implementation version and denominator.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Diagnostic performance
functional.statement: Diagnostic evaluations shall support sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, confusion matrices and threshold analysis where applicable.
functional.acceptance: Predictive values state the observed or assumed prevalence and are not transferred without qualification.
functional.behaviour: Calculate confusion matrices and diagnostic measures using approved reference labels and failure handling. Display observed or assumed prevalence with predictive values.
functional.exception: Undefined denominators display not estimable; zero divisions cannot become zero performance or a pass.
functional.fs_acceptance: Predictive values state the observed or assumed prevalence and are not transferred without qualification.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Uncertainty estimates
functional.statement: Reports shall include appropriate confidence or uncertainty intervals and clustering adjustments when required by the study design.
functional.acceptance: Repeated observations from one patient are not treated as independent without justification.
functional.behaviour: Apply the protocol's interval and clustering method. Retain participant or site resampling unit and method parameters with results.
functional.exception: Repeated observations cannot be treated as independent without approved justification; failed intervals remain explicit.
functional.fs_acceptance: Repeated observations from one patient are not treated as independent without justification.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Calibration and utility
functional.statement: Risk score evaluations shall assess calibration and decision consequences where relevant, alongside discrimination.
functional.acceptance: A high discrimination score alone cannot satisfy a protocol requiring calibration or clinical utility.
functional.behaviour: For risk scores show calibration measures and decision consequences alongside discrimination when required by protocol.
functional.exception: High AUROC alone cannot satisfy a calibration or clinical utility criterion.
functional.fs_acceptance: A high discrimination score alone cannot satisfy a protocol requiring calibration or clinical utility.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Missing and rejected inputs
functional.statement: Tests shall measure missing fields, poor quality inputs, abstentions, unsupported cases and failed outputs under explicit scoring rules.
functional.acceptance: All attempted cases reconcile across scored, abstained, rejected and failed categories.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile every attempted case into mutually exclusive execution categories and separately identify reference availability. Carry the prespecified scoring rule into denominators.
functional.exception: Do not drop abstentions, rejected inputs or model failures to improve reported accuracy.
functional.fs_acceptance: All attempted cases reconcile across scored, abstained, rejected and failed categories.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: External validation
functional.statement: Evaluation records shall identify independence from development data and report site, temporal and population differences.
functional.acceptance: A developer's tuning set cannot be labelled an independent external test set.
functional.behaviour: Record development independence and site, time and population shifts using dataset provenance and overlap checks.
functional.exception: Known tuning data cannot be labelled independent external validation; unresolved overlap blocks that claim.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer's tuning set cannot be labelled an independent external test set.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Robustness testing
functional.statement: Relevant tests shall examine input variation, noise, device differences, distribution shift and operational constraints.
functional.acceptance: Reports distinguish tested conditions from unsupported assumptions about robustness.
functional.behaviour: Run the approved robustness scenarios against exact perturbation or condition definitions. Present baseline and changed-condition results with scope.
functional.exception: Untested devices, languages or shifts remain unassessed; simulated robustness is not prospective clinical evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: Reports distinguish tested conditions from unsupported assumptions about robustness.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Subgroup results
functional.statement: The system shall report prespecified subgroup performance, uncertainty, sample sufficiency and clinically relevant gaps.
functional.acceptance: A suppressed small cell remains marked as suppressed rather than displayed as zero.
functional.behaviour: Calculate prespecified subgroup outputs and adequacy, then apply disclosure rules to display and export.
functional.exception: Suppressed cells stay marked suppressed and cannot be recovered through complementary totals or repeated filters.
functional.fs_acceptance: A suppressed small cell remains marked as suppressed rather than displayed as zero.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Baseline comparison
functional.statement: Evaluations shall compare against the approved baseline using consistent inclusion and analysis rules.
functional.acceptance: A benefit claim identifies both absolute and relative differences where relevant.
functional.behaviour: Compare to the frozen baseline using identical inclusion rules where required. Show absolute and relative changes with uncertainty and comparator provenance.
functional.exception: Incompatible populations or follow up display limitations and block unsupported comparative claims.
functional.fs_acceptance: A benefit claim identifies both absolute and relative differences where relevant.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Independent reproduction
functional.statement: An independent reviewer shall be able to verify reported outputs from retained manifests, data access and approved metric code.
functional.acceptance: A reproduced result outside the declared tolerance triggers an investigation before report issue.
functional.behaviour: Assign an independent reproducer to the retained manifest and approved metric code. Compare results against protocol tolerances and retain evidence.
functional.exception: Out of tolerance results create an investigation and prevent a reproduced status until resolved.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reproduced result outside the declared tolerance triggers an investigation before report issue.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Custom metric governance
functional.statement: Qualified teams may register task specific metrics with documentation, validation and version controls.
functional.acceptance: A custom metric cannot replace a primary endpoint without an approved protocol change.
functional.behaviour: Register a custom metric with formula, intended task, fixtures, limits and qualified validation before activation.
functional.exception: Replacing a primary endpoint requires a protocol amendment; registration alone does not change the study plan.
functional.fs_acceptance: A custom metric cannot replace a primary endpoint without an approved protocol change.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Evidence interpretation
functional.statement: Automated score calculation shall remain separate from the authorised interpretation of clinical significance and suitability.
functional.acceptance: A benchmark score cannot automatically issue a clinical suitability decision.
functional.behaviour: Keep computed score status separate from clinical interpretation. Eligible reviewers record suitability only for the stated use and population.
functional.exception: Automated threshold checks cannot issue an independent clinical suitability decision.
functional.fs_acceptance: A benchmark score cannot automatically issue a clinical suitability decision.
functional.actors: Evaluator, statistician and independent scientific reviewer. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Generative configuration identity
functional.statement: Evaluation shall bind base model version, prompts, tools, retrieval corpus, decoding settings, guardrails and context limits.
functional.acceptance: A prompt or retrieval update invalidates claims of an unchanged evaluated configuration.
functional.behaviour: Freeze the complete generative configuration and provider identity before tests. Retain prompts, tools, corpus and decoding parameters under appropriate rights.
functional.exception: Any material change creates a new configuration and cannot inherit unchanged evaluation status.
functional.fs_acceptance: A prompt or retrieval update invalidates claims of an unchanged evaluated configuration.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Clinical answer assessment
functional.statement: Tests shall assess factuality, harmful omissions, inappropriate reassurance, unsafe recommendations, uncertainty and escalation using qualified clinical review.
functional.acceptance: A fluent but clinically unsafe answer is treated as a safety failure under the approved rubric.
functional.behaviour: Assign qualified clinicians to rubric based response review. Score omissions, unsafe advice, reassurance, uncertainty and escalation separately from fluency.
functional.exception: Severe safety failures remain individually visible and cannot be averaged away by stylistic quality.
functional.fs_acceptance: A fluent but clinically unsafe answer is treated as a safety failure under the approved rubric.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Grounding and citations
functional.statement: Tests shall assess whether retrieved sources support generated claims and whether guideline jurisdiction and currency are appropriate.
functional.acceptance: A plausible fabricated citation is counted as an error rather than credited for formatting.
functional.behaviour: Link each material claim to retrieved evidence and assess support, authenticity, jurisdiction and date. Review citations in their original context.
functional.exception: A plausible but fabricated reference is an error; inaccessible support remains unverified.
functional.fs_acceptance: A plausible fabricated citation is counted as an error rather than credited for formatting.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Interaction testing
functional.statement: Evaluation shall cover multi turn conversations, contradictory inputs, changing context, long records and follow up questions.
functional.acceptance: Performance reporting identifies failures that appear only across multiple turns.
functional.behaviour: Execute ordered multi turn scenarios with contradictions, context changes and follow up. Preserve conversation-level outcomes and the failure turn.
functional.exception: Do not report isolated turn success as full task success when later context exposes a failure.
functional.fs_acceptance: Performance reporting identifies failures that appear only across multiple turns.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Language and population coverage
functional.statement: Tests shall include approved languages, dialects, health literacy levels and locally relevant presentations with competent reviewers.
functional.acceptance: English performance cannot substitute for evidence in another advertised clinical language.
functional.behaviour: Build language and population strata with competent reviewers and scenario provenance. Report coverage and unsupported advertised languages.
functional.exception: English results cannot substitute for local language evidence; unavailable qualified review blocks the claim.
functional.fs_acceptance: English performance cannot substitute for evidence in another advertised clinical language.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Adversarial safety
functional.statement: Authorised testing shall assess prompt injection, malicious documents, tool misuse, leakage and unsafe instruction following in isolated environments.
functional.acceptance: Successful bypasses are recorded with impact and remediation evidence without releasing sensitive attack artefacts publicly.
functional.behaviour: Run authorised adversarial tests in isolated accounts and data. Record attack identity, successful action, impact and remediation retest.
functional.exception: Attack content cannot escape into production tools or public artefacts; real data exposure opens an incident.
functional.fs_acceptance: Successful bypasses are recorded with impact and remediation evidence without releasing sensitive attack artefacts publicly.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Agent permissions
functional.statement: Agents shall operate within explicit action scopes, simulation boundaries and approval requirements for consequential actions.
functional.acceptance: A test agent cannot issue a real prescription, contact a patient or modify a live record without the separately authorised workflow.
functional.behaviour: Declare agent tool permissions and use simulation endpoints for consequential actions. Capture requested, denied, approved and executed tool actions.
functional.exception: No real prescribing, patient contact or clinical record write without the separately authorised clinical workflow.
functional.fs_acceptance: A test agent cannot issue a real prescription, contact a patient or modify a live record without the separately authorised workflow.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Judge validation
functional.statement: Automated evaluators shall have documented agreement with qualified human reviewers, known limitations and drift checks.
functional.acceptance: An unvalidated model judge cannot be the sole basis for a final clinical safety decision.
functional.behaviour: Compare model judge scores to qualified human review on a documented sample and assess disagreement by severity.
functional.exception: An unvalidated judge cannot be sole safety adjudicator; material judge changes require revalidation.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unvalidated model judge cannot be the sole basis for a final clinical safety decision.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Stochastic variation
functional.statement: Tests shall use prespecified repeat runs and report variability, rare severe failures and uncertainty where outputs are stochastic.
functional.acceptance: Reporting one favourable run while excluding unsuccessful repetitions is prevented or explicitly disclosed.
functional.behaviour: Run the prespecified repetitions and include all attempts, failures and variability. Record seeds only where meaningful and explain provider nondeterminism.
functional.exception: Selecting a favourable run cannot replace the full planned denominator; rare severe failures remain visible.
functional.fs_acceptance: Reporting one favourable run while excluding unsuccessful repetitions is prevented or explicitly disclosed.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Privacy and memorisation
functional.statement: Evaluations shall assess inappropriate disclosure, cross session leakage and relevant memorisation risk with controlled test data.
functional.acceptance: A model that exposes another participant's information triggers the incident and hold workflow.
functional.behaviour: Test cross session disclosure and memorisation with approved controlled fixtures. Restrict raw sensitive findings and record risk assessment.
functional.exception: Disclosure of another participant's data initiates containment and incident handling immediately.
functional.fs_acceptance: A model that exposes another participant's information triggers the incident and hold workflow.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Cost and latency tradeoffs
functional.statement: Reports shall measure task completion, latency, resource consumption and human correction burden with the tested configuration.
functional.acceptance: A low per token price cannot be reported as total workflow cost.
functional.behaviour: Measure complete task cost, latency and human correction burden for the tested configuration. Include retries and failed attempts under declared accounting.
functional.exception: Per token price alone cannot be labelled workflow cost or labour saving.
functional.fs_acceptance: A low per token price cannot be reported as total workflow cost.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Synthetic evaluation limits
functional.statement: Synthetic cases and simulated patients shall be labelled, reviewed and separated from evidence based on real clinical outcomes.
functional.acceptance: Passing synthetic scenarios cannot automatically satisfy a requirement for prospective clinical evidence.
functional.behaviour: Label synthetic cases and simulated patients at scenario and report level. Require qualified review of realism and limitations.
functional.exception: Passing synthetic tests cannot satisfy a protocol that requires real prospective outcome evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: Passing synthetic scenarios cannot automatically satisfy a requirement for prospective clinical evidence.
functional.actors: Clinical reviewers, AI evaluators, adversarial testers and qualified language reviewers. Accountable role: AI evaluation lead.

functional.title: Tabular prediction
functional.statement: Admitted structured data tasks shall support feature dictionaries, units, timestamps, missingness and leakage checks.
functional.acceptance: Post outcome variables are identified before a prediction evaluation is accepted.
functional.behaviour: Validate structured features against meaning, unit, availability time and missingness. Flag post outcome information before model execution.
functional.exception: Unresolved temporal leakage blocks predictive evaluation acceptance.
functional.fs_acceptance: Post outcome variables are identified before a prediction evaluation is accepted.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Imaging evaluation
functional.statement: Admitted imaging tasks shall support study series relationships, device metadata, relevant annotations and image quality assessment.
functional.acceptance: Results retain linkage to the correct examination and evaluated image series.
functional.behaviour: Preserve examination, study and series relationships and required device metadata. Validate annotation coordinates and image quality in the approved viewer.
functional.exception: Wrong series or orientation mapping blocks scoring; deidentification must preserve necessary clinical meaning.
functional.fs_acceptance: Results retain linkage to the correct examination and evaluated image series.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Clinical text
functional.statement: Text evaluations shall preserve document context, redaction status, chronology and applicable language while restricting identifiers.
functional.acceptance: A summary evaluation can identify clinically material omissions from the authorised source record.
functional.behaviour: Retain document chronology, source context, language and redaction status for text evaluation. Link material omissions back to permitted source passages.
functional.exception: An isolated excerpt cannot represent a complete record unless the task explicitly defines that scope.
functional.fs_acceptance: A summary evaluation can identify clinically material omissions from the authorised source record.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Speech and audio
functional.statement: Speech evaluations shall assess clinically relevant transcription and comprehension errors, speaker variation and recording conditions.
functional.acceptance: Medical term errors and consequential negation errors remain distinguishable from ordinary word errors.
functional.behaviour: Capture recording conditions and assess clinical transcription and comprehension errors separately from ordinary word errors.
functional.exception: Negation, dosage and medical term errors retain their clinical severity instead of being hidden in aggregate word error rate.
functional.fs_acceptance: Medical term errors and consequential negation errors remain distinguishable from ordinary word errors.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Signals and devices
functional.statement: Time series and connected device tasks shall support sampling frequency, device versions, missing intervals and alignment requirements.
functional.acceptance: Misaligned sensor timestamps cannot be silently compared to clinical event labels.
functional.behaviour: Validate sampling frequency, device version, clock alignment and missing intervals before comparing signals to outcomes.
functional.exception: Misalignment or unapproved resampling blocks dependent evaluation; transformation provenance is retained.
functional.fs_acceptance: Misaligned sensor timestamps cannot be silently compared to clinical event labels.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Multimodal systems
functional.statement: Combined input solutions shall be evaluated for modality contribution, missing modalities and inconsistent inputs.
functional.acceptance: A solution's advertised fallback behaviour is tested when one required modality is absent.
functional.behaviour: Test required, optional and missing modalities plus contradictory inputs according to the declared fallback contract.
functional.exception: An advertised fallback cannot be accepted without testing the absent modality scenario.
functional.fs_acceptance: A solution's advertised fallback behaviour is tested when one required modality is absent.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Administrative and public health AI
functional.statement: Nonclinical workflow tools shall be assessed against their own operational and equity outcomes with documented clinical spillover risks.
functional.acceptance: A scheduling model is not assigned diagnostic metrics solely because it operates in a hospital.
functional.behaviour: Select operational and equity endpoints for administrative or public health tasks and document potential clinical spillovers.
functional.exception: Hospital location alone does not make diagnostic metrics appropriate for scheduling or allocation tools.
functional.fs_acceptance: A scheduling model is not assigned diagnostic metrics solely because it operates in a hospital.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Capability admission
functional.statement: Each supported modality and study type shall have a validated evaluation pack, responsible experts and required controls before admission.
functional.acceptance: Unsupported tasks remain in discovery status and cannot receive a formal validated result.
functional.behaviour: Activate a task pack only after fixtures, method validation, qualified owners and required controls pass within declared scope.
functional.exception: Unsupported tasks stay in discovery and cannot issue formal validated findings.
functional.fs_acceptance: Unsupported tasks remain in discovery status and cannot receive a formal validated result.
functional.actors: Modality lead, clinical expert, data engineer and evaluation pack owner. Accountable role: Clinical product lead.

functional.title: Workflow definition
functional.statement: Evaluations shall describe user roles, work steps, handoffs, decision authority and standard care fallback.
functional.acceptance: A model result cannot be interpreted without its intended position in the clinical workflow.
functional.behaviour: Map intended work steps, handoffs and decision authority with the standard care comparator and fallback. Bind the model output to a specific step.
functional.exception: A model score cannot be interpreted as workflow benefit without its intended use context.
functional.fs_acceptance: A model result cannot be interpreted without its intended position in the clinical workflow.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Usability studies
functional.statement: Teams shall assess task completion, errors, training needs and cognitive workload with representative users in relevant settings.
functional.acceptance: A usability report identifies participant roles and includes observed failures as well as satisfaction.
functional.behaviour: Run approved task scenarios with representative roles, recording completion, observed errors, training needs and workload.
functional.exception: Reports include failures and sample limits; satisfaction alone cannot establish usable clinical performance.
functional.fs_acceptance: A usability report identifies participant roles and includes observed failures as well as satisfaction.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Human AI interaction
functional.statement: Tests shall assess overreliance, underreliance, overrides, alert fatigue and the quality of human review.
functional.acceptance: An apparent time saving is qualified when required verification work is omitted.
functional.behaviour: Capture reliance, overrides, verification time and alert exposure using the approved observation method.
functional.exception: Apparent time savings exclude no required review work; omitted verification is recorded as a safety or protocol issue.
functional.fs_acceptance: An apparent time saving is qualified when required verification work is omitted.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Accessibility and inclusion
functional.statement: Studies shall examine barriers related to disability, literacy, language, connectivity and shared devices for the intended users.
functional.acceptance: A deployment plan includes mitigations for material exclusion risks identified during evaluation.
functional.behaviour: Assess barriers across disability, literacy, language, connectivity and device sharing. Assign mitigations and verify them in the intended context.
functional.exception: Unresolved material exclusion risk remains a deployment blocker or explicit scope restriction.
functional.fs_acceptance: A deployment plan includes mitigations for material exclusion risks identified during evaluation.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Clinical workflow outcomes
functional.statement: Prospective evaluations shall capture referral completion, follow up, treatment delays and other relevant workflow outcomes.
functional.acceptance: A high detection rate alone cannot establish benefit when the protocol requires completed referral.
functional.behaviour: Track downstream referrals, follow up and delays with correct eligible denominators and outcome windows.
functional.exception: Detection alone cannot satisfy an endpoint that requires completed referral or treatment.
functional.fs_acceptance: A high detection rate alone cannot establish benefit when the protocol requires completed referral.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Training effectiveness
functional.statement: Implementation teams shall record training participation, assessed competence, refresher needs and role specific permissions.
functional.acceptance: An untrained user cannot be enabled for a function requiring verified competence.
functional.behaviour: Record training, assessment, competence and renewal against the user role and procedure version.
functional.exception: Expired or failed required competence removes access to the affected clinical function until renewed.
functional.fs_acceptance: An untrained user cannot be enabled for a function requiring verified competence.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Equity interpretation
functional.statement: Equity assessments shall consider access, error distribution and downstream burden as well as aggregate performance.
functional.acceptance: The report identifies who may lose access or bear additional costs under the proposed workflow.
functional.behaviour: Interpret equity across access, errors and downstream burden, with qualified consideration of missing groups and costs.
functional.exception: Aggregate model performance cannot erase an identified exclusion or disproportionate burden.
functional.fs_acceptance: The report identifies who may lose access or bear additional costs under the proposed workflow.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Patient and staff feedback
functional.statement: Feedback shall be collected through approved confidential channels and linked to issues and corrective actions.
functional.acceptance: Negative feedback remains visible to reviewers even when a site or developer disputes it.
functional.behaviour: Accept staff and patient feedback through approved confidential routes and link concerns to issue ownership.
functional.exception: Disputed negative feedback remains available to independent reviewers; implicated parties cannot delete it.
functional.fs_acceptance: Negative feedback remains visible to reviewers even when a site or developer disputes it.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Economic measurement
functional.statement: Studies shall capture staff time, integration, equipment, training, recurring fees and downstream resource costs.
functional.acceptance: A cost effectiveness calculation states perspective, currency, price year, assumptions and uncertainty.
functional.behaviour: Capture staff, integration, equipment, training, recurring and downstream costs under explicit perspective and price year.
functional.exception: Missing assumptions or incompatible currencies block a definitive cost effectiveness claim; uncertainty remains visible.
functional.fs_acceptance: A cost effectiveness calculation states perspective, currency, price year, assumptions and uncertainty.
functional.actors: Human factors evaluator, representative users, clinical owner and economic analyst. Accountable role: Clinical implementation lead.

functional.title: Site activation
functional.statement: Each site shall pass a readiness gate covering approvals, contracts, trained staff, systems, emergency procedures and resources.
functional.acceptance: No recruitment or care affecting evaluation can begin at an inactive site.
functional.behaviour: Activate each site only after verified permissions, terms, competent staff, integration and emergency readiness for exact protocol and configuration.
functional.exception: Inactive sites cannot enrol or expose care affecting outputs; another site's approval cannot substitute.
functional.fs_acceptance: No recruitment or care affecting evaluation can begin at an inactive site.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Eligibility and enrolment
functional.statement: Authorised site staff shall apply approved inclusion and exclusion criteria, document eligibility and prevent duplicate enrolment where relevant.
functional.acceptance: An ineligible enrolment creates a deviation and cannot be silently corrected out of the record.
functional.behaviour: Apply approved eligibility rules, record source evidence and check authorised duplicate enrolment constraints before enrolment.
functional.exception: An ineligible enrolment is retained as a deviation; it cannot be silently edited out of history.
functional.fs_acceptance: An ineligible enrolment creates a deviation and cannot be silently corrected out of the record.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Participant identifiers
functional.statement: Studies shall use site controlled identifiers and restrict reidentification and cross site linkage to approved roles.
functional.acceptance: Central evaluators receive only the participant information authorised by their study role.
functional.behaviour: Assign site controlled study keys and restrict linkage to authorised local roles. Central users see only approved participant fields.
functional.exception: Cross site matching requires explicit authority and cannot expose identities through duplicate warnings.
functional.fs_acceptance: Central evaluators receive only the participant information authorised by their study role.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Case report forms
functional.statement: The platform or approved integration shall support versioned forms, validation, queries, source references and correction history.
functional.acceptance: A corrected clinical observation retains its original value, reason, actor and timestamp.
functional.behaviour: Use approved form versions with semantic validation and queries. Corrections retain original value, reason, actor and time.
functional.exception: Source discrepancies remain queries until resolved; version upgrades cannot reinterpret historic answers silently.
functional.fs_acceptance: A corrected clinical observation retains its original value, reason, actor and timestamp.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Allocation and blinding
functional.statement: Studies requiring randomisation or allocation concealment shall use validated procedures and controlled unblinding.
functional.acceptance: Only authorised staff can unblind, with reason and downstream impact recorded.
functional.behaviour: Use the validated allocation procedure and restrict concealed assignments. Unblinding requires an eligible actor, reason and impact record.
functional.exception: Emergency local care follows its approved route; unblinding is never an ordinary unrestricted reveal button.
functional.fs_acceptance: Only authorised staff can unblind, with reason and downstream impact recorded.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Silent prospective mode
functional.statement: Outputs from silent evaluation shall remain unavailable for treatment decisions and clearly separated from active care interfaces.
functional.acceptance: A silent mode prediction cannot appear in a clinician's production worklist.
functional.behaviour: Route silent predictions only to authorised evaluation storage and blinded review workflows; exclude them from clinical production worklists.
functional.exception: Accidental exposure creates a deviation and safety assessment, with containment of the leaking channel.
functional.fs_acceptance: A silent mode prediction cannot appear in a clinician's production worklist.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Interventional controls
functional.statement: Studies influencing care shall enforce authorised users, approved version, operating limits and oversight specified in the protocol.
functional.acceptance: A changed clinical configuration requires the defined amendment process before use.
functional.behaviour: Permit care affecting outputs only for authorised users, approved version and operating limits with active oversight.
functional.exception: Changed configuration or expired permission blocks further use under the affected protocol and activates fallback.
functional.fs_acceptance: A changed clinical configuration requires the defined amendment process before use.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Deviations and queries
functional.statement: Sites shall record protocol deviations, missing observations and data queries with resolution ownership and impact review.
functional.acceptance: A deviation affecting participant safety triggers escalation independently of ordinary data cleaning.
functional.behaviour: Open deviations and data queries with severity, owner and due date; preserve correction history and scientific impact.
functional.exception: Safety relevant deviations escalate immediately and do not wait in ordinary data cleaning queues.
functional.fs_acceptance: A deviation affecting participant safety triggers escalation independently of ordinary data cleaning.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Monitoring and verification
functional.statement: Monitors shall review consent, eligibility, source evidence and study conduct within approved access boundaries.
functional.acceptance: Monitoring findings have accountable corrective actions and verifiable closure evidence.
functional.behaviour: Give monitors bounded access to consent, eligibility and source evidence. Record findings, corrective actions and independent verification.
functional.exception: Monitoring access does not permit changing original clinical observations or closing its own unresolved findings without authority.
functional.fs_acceptance: Monitoring findings have accountable corrective actions and verifiable closure evidence.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Safety reporting
functional.statement: Sites shall report adverse events, near misses and serious concerns with timely local escalation and applicable reporting routes.
functional.acceptance: A report initiates safety review without waiting for causality to be proven.
functional.behaviour: Accept adverse events, near misses and serious concerns with minimal initial information and local escalation.
functional.exception: Causality need not be proven before reporting; incomplete fields cannot block an urgent safety case.
functional.fs_acceptance: A report initiates safety review without waiting for causality to be proven.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Study closeout
functional.statement: Closeout shall reconcile participants, unresolved queries, safety events, assets, financial obligations and retention requirements.
functional.acceptance: A study cannot be marked fully closed while mandatory follow up obligations remain unassigned.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile participants, queries, safety, assets and duties before closeout. Assign any lawful continuing obligation to an accepting owner.
functional.exception: Unassigned required follow up blocks fully closed status even after recruitment ends.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study cannot be marked fully closed while mandatory follow up obligations remain unassigned.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: External study systems
functional.statement: Existing validated electronic data capture and trial systems may remain the source of record with controlled integration.
functional.acceptance: An imported record retains source identity and does not create an inconsistent competing master record.
functional.behaviour: Import from approved EDC or trial systems with source identifiers, versions and reconciliation. Mark external authoritative fields read only locally.
functional.exception: Conflicting masters create a reconciliation case; imported data cannot silently replace the authoritative source.
functional.fs_acceptance: An imported record retains source identity and does not create an inconsistent competing master record.
functional.actors: Site investigator, authorised study staff, monitor and local clinical owner. Accountable role: Clinical operations lead.

functional.title: Safety case
functional.statement: Each admitted use shall maintain hazards, foreseeable misuse, mitigations, residual risks, evidence and accountable acceptance.
functional.acceptance: No clinical use proceeds with an unaccepted material residual risk.
functional.behaviour: Maintain hazards and residual risks linked to each admitted intended use and mitigation evidence. Require the accountable qualified acceptance before activity.
functional.exception: Unaccepted material risk blocks affected activation; lower estimated likelihood cannot hide severe unresolved consequences.
functional.fs_acceptance: No clinical use proceeds with an unaccepted material residual risk.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Incident intake
functional.statement: The service shall accept reports from authorised staff, institutions and appropriate external channels with confidentiality controls.
functional.acceptance: A reporter can raise a concern without needing permission from the implicated developer.
functional.behaviour: Accept concerns from approved staff and external channels without developer permission. Preserve confidential reporter details and minimal initial facts.
functional.exception: Anonymous or incomplete reports enter triage where supported; attachments remain quarantined without delaying intake.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reporter can raise a concern without needing permission from the implicated developer.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Severity and triage
functional.statement: Qualified owners shall triage impact, affected population, urgency and scope while allowing uncertain initial information.
functional.acceptance: An incomplete but potentially serious report enters urgent review rather than being rejected by form validation.
functional.behaviour: Assign qualified triage, record uncertainty and choose urgency based on potential harm. Route potentially serious reports immediately.
functional.exception: Missing causality or participant details cannot postpone urgent review; reclassification retains original assessment.
functional.fs_acceptance: An incomplete but potentially serious report enters urgent review rather than being rejected by form validation.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Containment
functional.statement: Authorised owners shall suspend affected datasets, versions, jobs or sites and communicate local containment responsibilities.
functional.acceptance: A targeted suspension prevents affected new activity without concealing historical evidence.
functional.behaviour: Apply targeted holds to versions, datasets, runs or sites and notify responsible local owners. Preserve evidence and permitted remediation.
functional.exception: Containment does not delete historical findings or imply that remote sites already stopped.
functional.fs_acceptance: A targeted suspension prevents affected new activity without concealing historical evidence.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Deployment stop coordination
functional.statement: For deployed tools, the platform shall issue stop or rollback instructions through approved channels and record acknowledgement from each site.
functional.acceptance: An unacknowledged instruction remains visibly unresolved and escalates to local contacts.
functional.behaviour: Issue authorised stop or rollback instructions through approved site channels. Track receipt and observed execution per site.
functional.exception: Unacknowledged sites remain visibly unresolved and escalate to local contacts and backups.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unacknowledged instruction remains visibly unresolved and escalates to local contacts.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Investigation
functional.statement: Investigations shall preserve artefacts, timestamps, decisions and chain of custody while restricting sensitive details.
functional.acceptance: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close its own independent investigation.
functional.behaviour: Preserve evidence with source, digest, collection authority and custody history. Restrict implicated parties' access and editing.
functional.exception: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close an independent investigation.
functional.fs_acceptance: An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close its own independent investigation.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Corrective and preventive action
functional.statement: Actions shall identify root cause, owner, due date, verification method and recurrence prevention.
functional.acceptance: Closing an action requires verification evidence rather than a completion checkbox alone.
functional.behaviour: Assign root cause actions with due dates and verification criteria. Closure requires evidence accepted by an eligible verifier.
functional.exception: A completion checkbox or developer statement alone cannot close required independent remediation.
functional.fs_acceptance: Closing an action requires verification evidence rather than a completion checkbox alone.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Reportability assessment
functional.statement: Country owners shall determine applicable notifications, recipients and deadlines with legal and clinical input.
functional.acceptance: The platform records proof of submission or an explicit failure; an internal alert is not treated as statutory reporting.
functional.behaviour: Assess reporting duties by country and record recipient, deadline and authorised release. Retain transmission and acknowledgement evidence.
functional.exception: An internal alert is not statutory submission; failed external delivery remains an open escalation.
functional.fs_acceptance: The platform records proof of submission or an explicit failure; an internal alert is not treated as statutory reporting.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Cross study impact
functional.statement: An incident involving a shared dependency shall identify other potentially affected studies and product versions.
functional.acceptance: A recalled model component produces an actionable list of impacted evaluations and deployments.
functional.behaviour: Traverse affected dependencies to identify other versions, studies and deployments, then assign scoped impact reviews.
functional.exception: Absence of known deployments is qualified by register completeness; do not claim all sites are safe from incomplete inventory.
functional.fs_acceptance: A recalled model component produces an actionable list of impacted evaluations and deployments.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Resumption decision
functional.statement: Resumption shall require appropriate independent clinical, security or governance approval and a verified remediation scope.
functional.acceptance: Commercial pressure or payment status cannot override an active safety hold.
functional.behaviour: Require appropriate independent clinical, security or governance approval for remediation and resumption. Recheck other holds and prerequisites.
functional.exception: Payment, commercial urgency or reporter withdrawal cannot clear an unresolved safety hold.
functional.fs_acceptance: Commercial pressure or payment status cannot override an active safety hold.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: External warning exchange
functional.statement: Approved safety summaries may be shared with participating networks under legal, confidentiality and accuracy review.
functional.acceptance: A shared warning excludes unauthorised patient data and clearly states unresolved causality.
functional.behaviour: Prepare a bounded safety summary with uncertainty, causality status and approved audience. Release only after legal, confidentiality and accuracy review.
functional.exception: Patient details and restricted attack artefacts remain excluded; draft preparation never sends externally.
functional.fs_acceptance: A shared warning excludes unauthorised patient data and clearly states unresolved causality.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Learning and trend review
functional.statement: The service shall review near misses, recurring issues, overdue actions and emerging hazards on a defined cadence.
functional.acceptance: Repeated low severity incidents can trigger a systemic risk review.
functional.behaviour: Review near misses, recurrence and overdue actions using declared cadence and definitions. Open systemic risk reviews for patterns.
functional.exception: Repeated low severity events cannot be hidden by closing individual cases without trend assessment.
functional.fs_acceptance: Repeated low severity incidents can trigger a systemic risk review.
functional.actors: Reporter, clinical safety lead, security owner, investigator and local site authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Evidence dossier
functional.statement: Each dossier shall assemble intended use, configuration, protocol, datasets, metrics, limitations, reviews, decisions and relevant external permissions.
functional.acceptance: A reviewer can trace each headline finding to the underlying approved evidence.
functional.behaviour: Assemble dossiers from exact approved source versions. The builder flags missing required links and exposes each finding's provenance to authorised reviewers.
functional.exception: Manual attachments cannot substitute for missing result identities without an explicit verified external evidence record.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reviewer can trace each headline finding to the underlying approved evidence.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Claim level provenance
functional.statement: Claims shall cite specific studies, populations, versions, dates and limitations rather than only a product level badge.
functional.acceptance: A new product version does not inherit an unsupported claim from an earlier version.
functional.behaviour: Link every claim to exact study, population, version, date and limitations; display claim-level support in the report.
functional.exception: A product's successor cannot inherit a prior claim unless a qualified applicability decision explicitly supports it.
functional.fs_acceptance: A new product version does not inherit an unsupported claim from an earlier version.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Evidence status
functional.statement: Reports shall distinguish not assessed, in progress, insufficient evidence, meets specified criteria, fails specified criteria, superseded and withdrawn.
functional.acceptance: Insufficient evidence cannot be displayed as a positive outcome or averaged into a pass.
functional.behaviour: Derive evidence status from signed decisions and current validity, separately from workflow progress and regulatory status.
functional.exception: Insufficient evidence remains inconclusive and cannot be averaged or renamed into a positive badge.
functional.fs_acceptance: Insufficient evidence cannot be displayed as a positive outcome or averaged into a pass.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Independent review
functional.statement: Final reports shall undergo scientific and clinical review appropriate to scope with declared conflicts and signed decisions.
functional.acceptance: A developer response is retained but cannot replace the independent conclusion.
functional.behaviour: Assign eligible independent scientific and clinical reviewers, retain developer responses and obtain required signatures on the frozen dossier.
functional.exception: Conflicted sole approval or missing competent reviewer blocks issue; payer edits cannot replace the conclusion.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer response is retained but cannot replace the independent conclusion.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Report generation
functional.statement: Reports shall use approved templates with exact run references, analysis versions, units, denominators and uncertainty.
functional.acceptance: Regenerated reports preserve the same approved findings and identify the generator version.
functional.behaviour: Generate a draft from approved templates and exact result references, including units, denominators and intervals. Record generator and template versions.
functional.exception: Regeneration cannot silently change findings; any changed source creates a new draft and review cycle.
functional.fs_acceptance: Regenerated reports preserve the same approved findings and identify the generator version.
