functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Scope and limitations
functional.statement: Every issued report shall prominently state tested use, population, setting, product version, exclusions and evidentiary limits.
functional.acceptance: A report cannot omit a material failed subgroup that was included in the approved analysis plan.
functional.behaviour: Require tested use, population, setting, configuration, exclusions and limitations in the visible report summary.
functional.exception: Material failed subgroups or incomplete endpoints cannot be hidden in an optional attachment.
functional.fs_acceptance: A report cannot omit a material failed subgroup that was included in the approved analysis plan.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Publication permissions
functional.statement: Public, partner and restricted report views shall follow approved publication rights and redaction decisions.
functional.acceptance: A public report does not reveal protected small cells, patient details or proprietary artefacts.
functional.behaviour: Preview each audience view and apply rights, redaction and disclosure checks before publication approval.
functional.exception: Restricted originals remain protected even when a public summary exists; content changes invalidate previous clearance.
functional.fs_acceptance: A public report does not reveal protected small cells, patient details or proprietary artefacts.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Signed release and integrity
functional.statement: Issued reports shall have persistent identifiers, issue dates, authorised signers and a verifiable integrity record.
functional.acceptance: Altering a released report creates a new version and invalidates the altered copy's integrity check.
functional.behaviour: Issue the signed frozen report with persistent identifier, digest and current-status verification route. Store the issued bytes and manifest.
functional.exception: An altered copy fails integrity verification; no regenerated file can retain the original integrity identity if bytes change.
functional.fs_acceptance: Altering a released report creates a new version and invalidates the altered copy's integrity check.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Corrections and retractions
functional.statement: The service shall issue linked corrections, supersession notices and withdrawals with reasons and notification of prior recipients.
functional.acceptance: Opening a superseded report displays its current status and link to the authoritative successor.
functional.behaviour: Create corrections, supersession or withdrawal as linked records with reason and approvals. Notify known recipients and show current status when old links open.
functional.exception: Historical copies remain identifiable; the system cannot promise recall of every downloaded external file.
functional.fs_acceptance: Opening a superseded report displays its current status and link to the authoritative successor.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Evidence portability
functional.statement: An exportable dossier shall include structured metadata and human readable evidence with usage restrictions and unresolved gaps.
functional.acceptance: A receiving institution can identify what may be reused and what needs local validation.
functional.behaviour: Export a structured dossier with human readable reports, manifests, restrictions and local gaps. Validate the package before authorised delivery.
functional.exception: Missing reuse rights exclude affected assets and produce an explicit restriction entry.
functional.fs_acceptance: A receiving institution can identify what may be reused and what needs local validation.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Results completeness
functional.statement: Final reports shall reconcile all prespecified endpoints, registered analyses, deviations and missing results.
functional.acceptance: Unreported endpoints block issue or require an explicit approved explanation.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile all planned endpoints, analyses and deviations against the report before signature.
functional.exception: Unreported endpoints block issue unless an eligible reviewer approves an explicit, prominent explanation.
functional.fs_acceptance: Unreported endpoints block issue or require an explicit approved explanation.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Public evidence catalogue
functional.statement: The catalogue shall show verified publication status and allow discovery by use, setting, population and evidence maturity.
functional.acceptance: Catalogue presence is not presented as an endorsement or universal approval.
functional.behaviour: Publish only approved metadata and report views with exact scope and freshness. Support filters for use, population and evidence maturity.
functional.exception: Catalogue presence cannot imply regulatory authorisation, procurement preference or universal endorsement.
functional.fs_acceptance: Catalogue presence is not presented as an endorsement or universal approval.
functional.actors: Evidence author, independent scientific signers, rights owner and publication owner. Accountable role: Evaluation director.

functional.title: Requirements checklist
functional.statement: Country reviewers shall maintain applicable submission checklists linked to authoritative sources and approved interpretations.
functional.acceptance: Each required item identifies its evidence location or a documented gap.
functional.behaviour: Instantiate a source linked checklist and locate the exact evidence for each applicable item. Assign owners to gaps.
functional.exception: A checked box without evidence or an authorised not applicable rationale cannot satisfy readiness.
functional.fs_acceptance: Each required item identifies its evidence location or a documented gap.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Submission packages
functional.statement: Authorised users shall assemble jurisdiction specific packages from approved dossier versions.
functional.acceptance: A package can contain different evidence and forms for two jurisdictions without changing the underlying findings.
functional.behaviour: Assemble separate packages for each jurisdiction from approved dossier versions and local forms. Freeze a manifest for review.
functional.exception: Local package differences do not modify the underlying scientific findings or their original scope.
functional.fs_acceptance: A package can contain different evidence and forms for two jurisdictions without changing the underlying findings.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: External decision verification
functional.statement: Approvals and decisions shall identify issuing authority, reference, scope, date, conditions and verification evidence.
functional.acceptance: A developer assertion remains unverified until the designated verification process completes.
functional.behaviour: Verify claimed external decisions against issuer evidence and exact use, configuration and validity.
functional.exception: Developer assertions remain unverified until qualified review; unmatched scope does not count as permission.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer assertion remains unverified until the designated verification process completes.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Authority questions
functional.statement: The system shall manage questions, responses, deadlines and changed documents with a complete submission history.
functional.acceptance: A response can be linked to the exact question and submitted file version.
functional.behaviour: Record authority questions with deadlines and bind each response to the exact question and file versions.
functional.exception: Superseded responses remain in history; preparing a response does not mark it sent.
functional.fs_acceptance: A response can be linked to the exact question and submitted file version.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Decision separation
functional.statement: Internal reviews, external authorisations and conditions shall have separate status records and responsible issuers.
functional.acceptance: Completing an internal checklist cannot mark a product legally authorised.
functional.behaviour: Display internal eligibility, checklist completeness and external decision as separate fields and records.
functional.exception: An internal completion event cannot set legally authorised status.
functional.fs_acceptance: Completing an internal checklist cannot mark a product legally authorised.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Change submissions
functional.statement: The service shall assess whether material changes require notification, additional evidence or renewed permission under the applicable profile.
functional.acceptance: A changed intended use triggers a regulatory impact task before clinical continuation.
functional.behaviour: Assess material changes against the active country profile and permission conditions; create notification, evidence or renewal tasks.
functional.exception: Changed intended use remains blocked for affected clinical activity until required external action is resolved.
functional.fs_acceptance: A changed intended use triggers a regulatory impact task before clinical continuation.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Permission expiry
functional.statement: External conditions, renewal dates and withdrawal notices shall affect the activities they govern.
functional.acceptance: A withdrawn permission blocks affected new activity and initiates impact review.
functional.behaviour: Track expiry, conditions and withdrawal notices; update only governed activities and create an impact queue.
functional.exception: Pending renewal does not extend permission; valid historical decisions retain their original dates.
functional.fs_acceptance: A withdrawn permission blocks affected new activity and initiates impact review.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Submission channel control
functional.statement: Direct authority submission shall occur only through an approved supported channel and authorised human release.
functional.acceptance: Preparing a package never automatically transmits it to an authority.
functional.behaviour: Require human release of the previewed immutable package and verified recipient through a supported channel. Track transmitted and acknowledged separately.
functional.exception: Unsupported channel yields a prepared package for authorised manual submission, with proof subsequently recorded.
functional.fs_acceptance: Preparing a package never automatically transmits it to an authority.
functional.actors: Country reviewer, submission preparer and authorised institutional representative. Accountable role: Regulatory lead.

functional.title: Transfer request
functional.statement: A receiving institution shall define intended local use, population, sites, workflow and decision using an existing evidence dossier.
functional.acceptance: The request references a specific product and dossier version.
functional.behaviour: Create a request against exact origin versions and receiving intended use. Check reuse rights before exposing dossier content.
functional.exception: A newer product version is not substituted automatically; inaccessible origin material remains excluded.
functional.fs_acceptance: The request references a specific product and dossier version.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Gap assessment
functional.statement: Qualified reviewers shall assess population, prevalence, language, equipment, guidelines, workflow, data rights and regulation differences.
functional.acceptance: The assessment identifies evidence that is reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with reasons.
functional.behaviour: Review each contextual difference and classify evidence as reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with qualified rationale.
functional.exception: Missing local information remains a gap, not an assumed match to the origin population.
functional.fs_acceptance: The assessment identifies evidence that is reusable, uncertain or inapplicable with reasons.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Local validation plan
functional.statement: The receiving institution shall approve the additional evaluation required to address material gaps.
functional.acceptance: A foreign positive report cannot bypass an unresolved local safety or applicability requirement.
functional.behaviour: Approve additional validation needed to resolve material gaps, with local thresholds and owners.
functional.exception: A foreign positive result cannot bypass unresolved local safety, rights or applicability requirements.
functional.fs_acceptance: A foreign positive report cannot bypass an unresolved local safety or applicability requirement.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Adaptation tracking
functional.statement: Changes to language, rules, thresholds, integrations or training shall create a traceable local configuration.
functional.acceptance: Local modifications remain distinguishable from the original evaluated product.
functional.behaviour: Create a local configuration for changes to language, rules, thresholds, integration or training and link new evidence.
functional.exception: Do not relabel the original configuration as locally evaluated when material modifications exist.
functional.fs_acceptance: Local modifications remain distinguishable from the original evaluated product.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Evidence reliance decisions
functional.statement: Authorities and buyers shall record their own decisions to rely on external evidence, including scope and conditions.
functional.acceptance: No automated evidence passport grants mutual recognition between countries.
functional.behaviour: Record the receiving authority's or buyer's own reliance decision with accepted scope and conditions.
functional.exception: The platform cannot issue mutual recognition or a global approval through an evidence passport field.
functional.fs_acceptance: No automated evidence passport grants mutual recognition between countries.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Shared studies
functional.statement: Multi country protocols shall support a common core with local appendices, approvals and analysis plans.
functional.acceptance: A pooled result preserves country level findings and cannot conceal a material local failure.
functional.behaviour: Manage a shared protocol core and separately approved local appendices. Preserve country results and pooling rationale.
functional.exception: A favourable pooled result cannot conceal a material local failure or absent local permission.
functional.fs_acceptance: A pooled result preserves country level findings and cannot conceal a material local failure.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Reuse measurement
functional.statement: The service shall measure avoided duplicate tasks, adaptation cost and elapsed time with a stated counterfactual.
functional.acceptance: Estimated savings remain labelled estimates and do not double count shared work.
functional.behaviour: Record reused tasks and avoided work against an explicit counterfactual; distinguish estimated savings from observed elapsed time.
functional.exception: Shared tasks are counted once and adaptation costs are included in the net saving.
functional.fs_acceptance: Estimated savings remain labelled estimates and do not double count shared work.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Country withdrawal
functional.statement: A country or institution may leave the network while retaining rights and obligations under its agreements.
functional.acceptance: Withdrawal blocks new sharing without erasing lawful historical evidence or incident responsibilities.
functional.behaviour: End new sharing at the effective withdrawal date and reconcile retained rights, incidents and obligations.
functional.exception: Withdrawal cannot erase lawful historical evidence or unassigned local safety responsibilities.
functional.fs_acceptance: Withdrawal blocks new sharing without erasing lawful historical evidence or incident responsibilities.
functional.actors: Receiving institution, country owner, scientific reviewer and implementation owner. Accountable role: Country lead.

functional.title: Adoption readiness
functional.statement: The service shall assess evidence, local permissions, financing, infrastructure, staffing, integration, support and maintenance readiness.
functional.acceptance: A scientifically successful evaluation can remain operationally unready with explicit blockers.
functional.behaviour: Score readiness dimensions independently and display blockers alongside the scientific decision.
functional.exception: A favourable evaluation can remain operationally unready; no single success badge combines the two.
functional.fs_acceptance: A scientifically successful evaluation can remain operationally unready with explicit blockers.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Business case
functional.statement: Buyers shall receive cost, expected benefit, budget impact, procurement options, uncertainty and implementation dependencies.
functional.acceptance: The case includes integration and recurring operating costs as well as licence fees.
functional.behaviour: Build the buyer case from full implementation and recurring costs, expected benefit, uncertainty and budget impact.
functional.exception: Licence price alone is insufficient; unobserved benefits are labelled estimates with assumptions.
functional.fs_acceptance: The case includes integration and recurring operating costs as well as licence fees.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Procurement support
functional.statement: The platform shall assemble neutral specifications, evidence references, requirements and evaluation criteria for an institution's purchasing process.
functional.acceptance: Paid participation cannot silently change procurement ranking or evaluation criteria.
functional.behaviour: Assemble neutral procurement requirements and evidence with declared criteria and conflicts.
functional.exception: Paid participation cannot change rankings or requirements without an authorised transparent revision.
functional.fs_acceptance: Paid participation cannot silently change procurement ranking or evaluation criteria.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Deployment authorisation
functional.statement: Each deployment shall bind buyer, sites, intended use, approved configuration, permissions, owner and support arrangements.
functional.acceptance: A sandbox completion status alone cannot authorise production deployment.
functional.behaviour: Authorise a specific buyer, site, use and configuration after G5 and local permissions pass.
functional.exception: Sandbox evaluation completion cannot issue production authority or activate unrelated sites.
functional.fs_acceptance: A sandbox completion status alone cannot authorise production deployment.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Implementation plan
functional.statement: Plans shall identify milestones, integrations, change management, training, support, budget and accountable owners.
functional.acceptance: Go live requires evidence that applicable readiness tasks are complete.
functional.behaviour: Track dependencies and accepted owners for integration, training, support and change management milestones.
functional.exception: Go live stays blocked while an applicable readiness task or required evidence is incomplete.
functional.fs_acceptance: Go live requires evidence that applicable readiness tasks are complete.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Acceptance and fallback
functional.statement: Sites shall approve operational acceptance tests, downtime procedures, rollback and safe standard care fallback.
functional.acceptance: A failed integration acceptance test blocks the affected go live.
functional.behaviour: Execute site acceptance and fallback tests, retain results and require local approval.
functional.exception: Failed integration or untested safe fallback blocks the affected go live; rollback status needs observed confirmation.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed integration acceptance test blocks the affected go live.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Training and competency
functional.statement: Role specific training and competency records shall be linked to access and renewal requirements.
functional.acceptance: A user can be restricted from a clinical feature after required training expires.
functional.behaviour: Bind role access to approved training, competence and renewal. Identify users affected by procedure changes.
functional.exception: Expired required training removes the relevant clinical permission until reassessment.
functional.fs_acceptance: A user can be restricted from a clinical feature after required training expires.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Production boundary
functional.statement: Evaluation and production environments, credentials, datasets and operational permissions shall remain explicitly separated.
functional.acceptance: An evaluation credential cannot write to a production patient record.
functional.behaviour: Keep evaluation and production environments, credentials and data links explicitly typed and separated.
functional.exception: An evaluation service identity cannot write a live clinical record, even if the user holds a separate production role.
functional.fs_acceptance: An evaluation credential cannot write to a production patient record.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Contract and budget transition
functional.statement: Pilot funding, production ownership, recurring budget and support handover shall be recorded before sustained deployment.
functional.acceptance: A pilot nearing funding expiry shows an accountable continuation or closure decision.
functional.behaviour: Record pilot end, recurring budget, production owner and support acceptance before sustained deployment.
functional.exception: Funding expiry creates continuation or safe closure tasks; it cannot silently end required patient follow up.
functional.fs_acceptance: A pilot nearing funding expiry shows an accountable continuation or closure decision.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Deployment register
functional.statement: Each site shall report installed version, configuration, operating dates and monitoring responsibilities.
functional.acceptance: A recall can locate all registered deployments of an affected version.
functional.behaviour: Maintain site reported installed configuration, operating dates and monitoring responsibility, including confirmation time.
functional.exception: Unknown or stale installed version is visible and included in recall follow up rather than assumed current.
functional.fs_acceptance: A recall can locate all registered deployments of an affected version.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Benefits realisation
functional.statement: The buyer shall compare observed outcomes and total costs with the approved business case on a defined schedule.
functional.acceptance: An adoption report identifies baseline, attribution limits and incomplete follow up.
functional.behaviour: Review observed outcomes and total costs against the approved baseline and follow up window.
functional.exception: Incomplete follow up and attribution limits remain visible; patient reach is not demonstrated health benefit.
functional.fs_acceptance: An adoption report identifies baseline, attribution limits and incomplete follow up.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Safe termination
functional.statement: Contracts and plans shall define termination, replacement, data portability and continuity of care obligations.
functional.acceptance: A vendor exit leaves the institution with a documented transition and retained lawful records.
functional.behaviour: Execute termination with replacement or fallback, data export, support and clinical responsibility handover.
functional.exception: A vendor exit cannot mark continuity complete until an accountable local owner accepts remaining duties.
functional.fs_acceptance: A vendor exit leaves the institution with a documented transition and retained lawful records.
functional.actors: Buyer, implementation lead, local clinical owner and site administrator. Accountable role: Implementation lead.

functional.title: Monitoring plan
functional.statement: Every monitored deployment shall specify metrics, data sources, cadence, thresholds, owners, missing data handling and escalation.
functional.acceptance: A deployment cannot be labelled monitored without an active plan and functioning data source.
functional.behaviour: Activate a plan only with approved definitions, sources, thresholds, missingness and response owners plus a successful feed check.
functional.exception: A configured plan with a dead source cannot make a deployment actively monitored.
functional.fs_acceptance: A deployment cannot be labelled monitored without an active plan and functioning data source.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Operational telemetry
functional.statement: The service shall track availability, latency, failures, abstentions, input quality and usage within permitted data limits.
functional.acceptance: A missing telemetry feed is reported as unavailable rather than interpreted as zero incidents.
functional.behaviour: Track operational availability, latency, failures, abstentions and input quality using permitted telemetry and source freshness.
functional.exception: Missing feed is unavailable, not zero failures or zero usage.
functional.fs_acceptance: A missing telemetry feed is reported as unavailable rather than interpreted as zero incidents.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Clinical performance follow up
functional.statement: Where outcome data permit, the service shall assess performance and subgroup outcomes with delayed label handling.
functional.acceptance: Recent unlabelled cases cannot be counted as successful outcomes.
functional.behaviour: Separate recent unlabelled cases from mature follow up cohorts and recalculate using the declared outcome window.
functional.exception: Unobserved outcomes cannot be counted as successful; delayed label updates retain prior report versions.
functional.fs_acceptance: Recent unlabelled cases cannot be counted as successful outcomes.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Drift detection
functional.statement: Monitoring shall distinguish input, outcome, workflow and performance shifts with documented limitations and review triggers.
functional.acceptance: A statistical drift signal creates a review rather than an unsupported conclusion of patient harm.
functional.behaviour: Detect defined input, outcome, workflow or performance shifts and open a qualified review with limitations.
functional.exception: Statistical drift alone cannot be presented as proven patient harm or an automatic clinical verdict.
functional.fs_acceptance: A statistical drift signal creates a review rather than an unsupported conclusion of patient harm.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Version change intake
functional.statement: Developers and sites shall report changes to models, prompts, rules, dependencies, devices and local configurations.
functional.acceptance: A changed component identifies the associated evidence and monitoring plans for reassessment.
functional.behaviour: Register every material model, prompt, rule, dependency, device or local configuration change and identify affected evidence and sites.
functional.exception: Unreported discovered changes remain explicit uncertainty and may restrict current claims.
functional.fs_acceptance: A changed component identifies the associated evidence and monitoring plans for reassessment.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Change classification
functional.statement: Qualified owners shall determine whether a change requires regression tests, local revalidation, regulatory action or a new study.
functional.acceptance: A developer cannot unilaterally declare a material clinical change insignificant.
functional.behaviour: A qualified owner classifies change impact and records required tests, permissions and study work.
functional.exception: The developer cannot unilaterally exempt a material clinical change from review.
functional.fs_acceptance: A developer cannot unilaterally declare a material clinical change insignificant.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Revalidation scheduling
functional.statement: The service shall schedule periodic and event triggered revalidation and prevent stale findings from appearing current.
functional.acceptance: An overdue required revalidation produces an explicit restricted or expired evidence status.
functional.behaviour: Schedule periodic and event triggered revalidation and show due, overdue, restricted and completed states.
functional.exception: Overdue mandatory review prevents stale evidence being shown as current without an authorised scope decision.
functional.fs_acceptance: An overdue required revalidation produces an explicit restricted or expired evidence status.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Alert routing
functional.statement: Alerts shall have severity, owner, acknowledgement, deduplication, escalation and closure evidence.
functional.acceptance: Unacknowledged urgent alerts reach the backup contact within the configured escalation period.
functional.behaviour: Assign alerts with deduplication, acknowledgement, escalation and closure evidence. Critical alerts reach a backup if the primary misses the configured interval.
functional.exception: Acknowledging an alert does not resolve it; duplicates retain occurrence counts and severity history.
functional.fs_acceptance: Unacknowledged urgent alerts reach the backup contact within the configured escalation period.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Rollback tracking
functional.statement: Where integrations support rollback, requests shall identify target configuration, authority and site confirmation.
functional.acceptance: Central issuance does not imply a site completed rollback without positive confirmation.
functional.behaviour: Request rollback to an approved configuration and track site-specific acknowledgement and execution.
functional.exception: Central dispatch cannot mark a remote installation rolled back without positive evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: Central issuance does not imply a site completed rollback without positive confirmation.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Comparative surveillance
functional.statement: Portfolio views shall compare trends only where definitions, case mix and follow up support meaningful comparison.
functional.acceptance: A dashboard discloses incomparable denominators and cannot imply a global product ranking.
functional.behaviour: Compare trends only when metric definition, case mix, denominator and follow up are compatible.
functional.exception: Incomparable series are separated or clearly qualified and cannot form a universal product ranking.
functional.fs_acceptance: A dashboard discloses incomparable denominators and cannot imply a global product ranking.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Monitoring handover
functional.statement: The operator shall transfer or terminate monitoring responsibilities explicitly when contracts end.
functional.acceptance: No deployment remains represented as actively monitored after its responsible service has stopped.
functional.behaviour: Transfer or terminate monitoring with accepted owners, source access and effective dates. Update catalogue and deployment claims.
functional.exception: Ended service cannot remain labelled actively monitored merely because historical data are still displayed.
functional.fs_acceptance: No deployment remains represented as actively monitored after its responsible service has stopped.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Evidence freshness
functional.statement: Reports and registry entries shall display latest review, monitored version, unresolved alerts and expiry conditions.
functional.acceptance: A buyer can identify that installed software differs from the version supporting a published claim.
functional.behaviour: Show latest evidence review, supporting configuration, installed configuration, monitoring scope and unresolved alerts.
functional.exception: Version mismatch or expired conditions produce visible limitations on current suitability claims.
functional.fs_acceptance: A buyer can identify that installed software differs from the version supporting a published claim.
functional.actors: Monitoring owner, site owner, evaluator and safety authority. Accountable role: Clinical safety lead.

functional.title: Role specific dashboards
functional.statement: Users shall see actionable views for developers, sites, reviewers, authorities, funders and operators within their access scopes.
functional.acceptance: A funder sees approved programme outcomes without receiving patient records by default.
functional.behaviour: Select the default dashboard from role and current context, then filter all components by effective access.
functional.exception: Funder visibility is limited to approved programme outcomes and never implies patient record access.
functional.fs_acceptance: A funder sees approved programme outcomes without receiving patient records by default.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Portfolio funnel
functional.statement: Reports shall track need, application, feasibility, evaluation, decision, deployment and ongoing monitoring with withdrawal reasons.
functional.acceptance: A failed scientific evaluation is distinguishable from an unfunded otherwise suitable solution.
functional.behaviour: Count distinct opportunities through need, application, feasibility, evaluation, decision, deployment and monitoring with explicit outcomes.
functional.exception: Scientific failure, withdrawal, missing funds and incomplete application remain separate categories.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed scientific evaluation is distinguishable from an unfunded otherwise suitable solution.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Time and bottlenecks
functional.statement: The platform shall measure elapsed and active time at each stage, including external delays and rework.
functional.acceptance: Reported turnaround includes a published rule for paused and abandoned studies.
functional.behaviour: Calculate elapsed and active stage time from the event ledger with stated pause and abandonment treatment.
functional.exception: Resetting stage labels cannot erase earlier waiting or rework intervals.
functional.fs_acceptance: Reported turnaround includes a published rule for paused and abandoned studies.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Evidence quality reporting
functional.statement: Dashboards shall show completeness, independence, representativeness, unresolved findings and evidence age.
functional.acceptance: A large number of tests cannot substitute for missing independent clinical validation.
functional.behaviour: Display evidence completeness, independence, subgroup coverage, unresolved findings and age with their denominators.
functional.exception: Large test counts cannot substitute for missing independent clinical evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: A large number of tests cannot substitute for missing independent clinical validation.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Outcome reporting
functional.statement: Programmes shall report relevant clinical, operational, equity and economic outcomes with baseline and attribution limits.
functional.acceptance: Patient reach is not displayed as demonstrated health benefit.
functional.behaviour: Report defined clinical, workflow, equity and economic outcomes against baseline with follow up maturity and attribution limits.
functional.exception: Reach or model calls cannot be relabelled health benefit.
functional.fs_acceptance: Patient reach is not displayed as demonstrated health benefit.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Resource and financial reporting
functional.statement: Managers shall view budget, committed and actual costs, capacity, receivables and funding runway at authorised granularity.
functional.acceptance: Study cost reconciles with approved compute, personnel and external service charges.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile authorised programme and study costs to approved usage, personnel and services; show commitments separately from actuals.
functional.exception: Do not add currencies without a disclosed approved conversion basis or double count commitments already invoiced.
functional.fs_acceptance: Study cost reconciles with approved compute, personnel and external service charges.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Governed metrics
functional.statement: Every shared metric shall have definition, owner, source, refresh rate, allowed dimensions and version history.
functional.acceptance: A changed definition is visible in longitudinal comparisons.
functional.behaviour: Approve metric definitions and allowed dimensions before shared use. Version changes and show breaks in longitudinal series.
functional.exception: A changed denominator cannot silently appear as an improvement in the same metric.
functional.fs_acceptance: A changed definition is visible in longitudinal comparisons.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Privacy preserving reporting
functional.statement: Aggregate views shall apply suppression, scope and disclosure controls to filters, comparisons and exports.
functional.acceptance: Repeated small group queries cannot trivially reconstruct a protected individual's result.
functional.behaviour: Apply scope, small cell and inference controls to charts, filters, comparisons and exports.
functional.exception: Repeated queries and complementary totals must not reconstruct suppressed individual results.
functional.fs_acceptance: Repeated small group queries cannot trivially reconstruct a protected individual's result.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Report exports
functional.statement: Users shall export approved views with timestamp, filters, definitions, data freshness and confidentiality labels.
functional.acceptance: An exported chart retains qualifications that materially affect its interpretation.
functional.behaviour: Freeze export filters, definitions, source freshness and limitations with the approved visual or tabular output.
functional.exception: Recheck rights before download; an exported chart cannot omit a material qualification.
functional.fs_acceptance: An exported chart retains qualifications that materially affect its interpretation.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Scheduled reporting
functional.statement: Reports shall be generated and delivered only to authorised recipients with expiry and failure tracking.
functional.acceptance: A recipient removed before delivery does not receive the scheduled restricted report.
functional.behaviour: Generate scheduled reports under the owner's approved scope, recheck each recipient at delivery and record failures.
functional.exception: Removed recipients receive no restricted content; a schedule cannot preserve privileges after its owner leaves.
functional.fs_acceptance: A recipient removed before delivery does not receive the scheduled restricted report.
functional.actors: Authorised role users, programme owner, metric owner and finance owner. Accountable role: Analytics lead.

functional.title: Contextual discussions
functional.statement: Users shall comment on specific requirements, protocol sections, assets and findings with permissions inherited from the object.
functional.acceptance: A comment mentioning a restricted study does not expose it to an unauthorised tagged user.
functional.behaviour: Attach discussions to object versions and inherit their permissions. Validate each mention against discovery and discussion rights.
functional.exception: A tagged user without access receives no confidential title or comment excerpt.
functional.fs_acceptance: A comment mentioning a restricted study does not expose it to an unauthorised tagged user.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Assignments and reminders
functional.statement: Tasks shall support owners, due dates, dependencies, escalations and completion evidence.
functional.acceptance: A task cannot disappear when its assigned user leaves the organisation.
functional.behaviour: Assign work with owner, due date, dependencies and evidence; route reminders through permitted channels.
functional.exception: Departure reassigns to the accountable owner; tasks cannot disappear with a deactivated account.
functional.fs_acceptance: A task cannot disappear when its assigned user leaves the organisation.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Notifications
functional.statement: Notifications shall use approved channels, minimise sensitive content and link to authenticated records.
functional.acceptance: Email subject lines and push previews do not include patient identifiers or confidential findings.
functional.behaviour: Use minimal notification previews and authenticated links; user preferences govern ordinary channels only.
functional.exception: Patient identifiers, sensitive findings and secrets never appear in email subjects or push previews.
functional.fs_acceptance: Email subject lines and push previews do not include patient identifiers or confidential findings.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Consequential communications
functional.statement: Regulatory submissions, public publication and external safety notices shall require an authorised release action.
functional.acceptance: Drafting a message or report does not send or publish it automatically.
functional.behaviour: Require authorised release of exact content and recipients for submissions, public publication and external safety notices.
functional.exception: Drafting, AI generation or task completion never sends consequential communications automatically.
functional.fs_acceptance: Drafting a message or report does not send or publish it automatically.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Meeting decisions
functional.statement: Meeting notes shall capture participants, conflicts, decisions, actions and approval of the final record.
functional.acceptance: A discussion summary cannot silently substitute for a required formal gate decision.
functional.behaviour: Record meeting participants, conflicts, decisions and actions, then obtain approval of the final minutes.
functional.exception: Minutes do not substitute for a required structured gate decision or signature.
functional.fs_acceptance: A discussion summary cannot silently substitute for a required formal gate decision.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Document collaboration
functional.statement: The system shall support controlled versions, review comments, comparison and concurrent edit conflict handling.
functional.acceptance: One reviewer's edit cannot overwrite another reviewer's change without resolution.
functional.behaviour: Support controlled revisions and compare concurrent changes using observed versions. Preserve comments against their original text where possible.
functional.exception: Conflicting controlled text requires explicit resolution; no silent last write overwrite.
functional.fs_acceptance: One reviewer's edit cannot overwrite another reviewer's change without resolution.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Translation review
functional.statement: Translated clinical and legal materials shall retain source version, reviewer and approved language version.
functional.acceptance: An unreviewed machine translation is marked draft and cannot serve as approved consent material.
functional.behaviour: Bind translations to source version and qualified language review; show draft machine provenance until approved.
functional.exception: Source change marks translations for review; unapproved text cannot become consent or authority material.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unreviewed machine translation is marked draft and cannot serve as approved consent material.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Communication audit
functional.statement: Material notifications shall record intended recipients, delivery status, acknowledgement when required and retries.
functional.acceptance: A failed delivery is not counted as successful notification.
functional.behaviour: Track recipient snapshots, attempts, delivery evidence and required acknowledgement. Escalate failed material notifications.
functional.exception: Sent is not delivered and delivered is not acknowledged; unsupported channel receipts remain unknown.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed delivery is not counted as successful notification.
functional.actors: Permitted object participants, task owners, communication approvers and translators. Accountable role: Programme director.

functional.title: Knowledge library
functional.statement: The platform shall maintain approved protocols, checklists, methods, case studies and implementation guidance with owners and review dates.
functional.acceptance: Outdated guidance is labelled and excluded from default new study templates.
functional.behaviour: Publish approved methods and guidance with owner, scope and review date. Template selection uses only currently eligible versions.
functional.exception: Overdue or withdrawn guidance remains labelled historical and is excluded from default new study templates.
functional.fs_acceptance: Outdated guidance is labelled and excluded from default new study templates.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Learning from failure
functional.statement: Programmes shall capture unsuccessful evaluations and implementation failures with approved confidentiality and publication scopes.
functional.acceptance: A case study can describe failure without exposing a protected developer or participant.
functional.behaviour: Capture failed evaluations and implementations with evidence and context, then review confidentiality and rights before sharing.
functional.exception: Anonymisation must be assessed for reidentification; failure learning cannot expose a protected developer or participant.
functional.fs_acceptance: A case study can describe failure without exposing a protected developer or participant.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Role based onboarding
functional.statement: Users shall receive required guidance for their role, including data handling, evaluation integrity and escalation.
functional.acceptance: Completion of mandatory onboarding is checked before restricted access is activated.
functional.behaviour: Assign role-specific onboarding on membership activation and track required completion.
functional.exception: Restricted access remains blocked until mandatory data, integrity and escalation training is complete.
functional.fs_acceptance: Completion of mandatory onboarding is checked before restricted access is activated.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Training records
functional.statement: Training shall have version, completion, assessment, renewal date and applicable roles.
functional.acceptance: Changing a material procedure identifies users requiring refresher training.
functional.behaviour: Record course version, assessed competence and renewal; material procedure changes identify users needing refresher work.
functional.exception: Prior attendance alone cannot satisfy a new competence requirement or expired assessment.
functional.fs_acceptance: Changing a material procedure identifies users requiring refresher training.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Community exchange
functional.statement: Members may share approved questions, methods and events with moderation and conflict controls.
functional.acceptance: A community post cannot reveal sealed test data or private review materials.
functional.behaviour: Moderate questions, methods and events within approved audiences and declared conflicts.
functional.exception: Sealed tests and private reviews cannot be shared through community content or attachments.
functional.fs_acceptance: A community post cannot reveal sealed test data or private review materials.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Method governance
functional.statement: Proposed new methods shall undergo validation and approval before they enter official templates or evaluation packs.
functional.acceptance: An experimental metric remains clearly identified until its review is complete.
functional.behaviour: Validate a method proposal using declared fixtures and qualified review before adding it to an official pack.
functional.exception: Experimental status remains visible and cannot replace an approved metric without the relevant protocol change.
functional.fs_acceptance: An experimental metric remains clearly identified until its review is complete.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Network learning reports
functional.statement: The service may publish aggregated lessons and recurring evidence gaps under disclosure and rights review.
functional.acceptance: Published lessons distinguish observed findings from hypotheses and cannot imply universal applicability.
functional.behaviour: Compile aggregate lessons with source provenance and disclosure review; distinguish findings from hypotheses.
functional.exception: Network experience cannot be presented as universally applicable clinical proof.
functional.fs_acceptance: Published lessons distinguish observed findings from hypotheses and cannot imply universal applicability.
functional.actors: Knowledge owner, training assessor, moderator and method reviewer. Accountable role: Network lead.

functional.title: Assisted drafting
functional.statement: Users may obtain drafts of protocols, evidence summaries, applications and implementation plans grounded in approved sources.
functional.acceptance: Drafts are labelled as AI assisted and cannot become signed decisions without human review.
functional.behaviour: Generate clearly labelled drafts for enabled tasks from approved sources; insert into an editable draft only after user acceptance.
functional.exception: Generated material cannot become a signed protocol, decision or report without normal review and gates.
functional.fs_acceptance: Drafts are labelled as AI assisted and cannot become signed decisions without human review.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Permission aware retrieval
functional.statement: AI assistants shall retrieve only information the requesting user may access for the active purpose and study.
functional.acceptance: A prompt cannot expose another tenant's document, hidden review or sealed benchmark.
functional.behaviour: Resolve retrieval against the current user's object, purpose and blinding permissions at query and response delivery.
functional.exception: Prompts cannot access another tenant, hidden reviewer deliberation or sealed benchmark; revoked sources are removed from delivery.
functional.fs_acceptance: A prompt cannot expose another tenant's document, hidden review or sealed benchmark.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Source attribution
functional.statement: Material factual claims in generated summaries shall reference accessible evidence and distinguish inference or missing information.
functional.acceptance: Unsupported findings are flagged and are not inserted as verified study results.
functional.behaviour: Attach accessible source references to material factual claims and distinguish inference or missing evidence.
functional.exception: Unsupported claims are flagged and cannot be inserted as verified study findings without human source checking.
functional.fs_acceptance: Unsupported findings are flagged and are not inserted as verified study results.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Consequential action control
functional.statement: AI assistance shall not autonomously approve studies, grant access, issue clinical findings, publish reports, submit to authorities or spend unapproved funds.
functional.acceptance: Every consequential action requires the specified authorised human confirmation and gate checks.
functional.behaviour: Represent consequential actions as nonexecuting proposals. The authorised user opens the ordinary command preview and passes current guards.
functional.exception: The assistant cannot approve, grant, publish, submit, issue clinical findings or spend outside an existing authorised budget.
functional.fs_acceptance: Every consequential action requires the specified authorised human confirmation and gate checks.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Provider governance
functional.statement: Model providers, data transmission, retention, training use and processing regions shall meet approved institutional terms.
functional.acceptance: Restricted study content is not sent to a provider lacking applicable approval.
functional.behaviour: Check provider terms, region, retention and training permissions before transmitting any content.
functional.exception: Unapproved provider or changed terms block the request; ordinary workflow remains available.
functional.fs_acceptance: Restricted study content is not sent to a provider lacking applicable approval.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Untrusted content handling
functional.statement: Uploaded documents, retrieved pages and model outputs shall be treated as content rather than authority to change permissions or instructions.
functional.acceptance: Embedded instructions in a document cannot trigger an export or disable a review gate.
functional.behaviour: Treat retrieved text, files and model output as untrusted content. Tool requests use declared allowlists and the user's effective permissions.
functional.exception: Embedded instructions cannot alter authority, export assets or disable review controls.
functional.fs_acceptance: Embedded instructions in a document cannot trigger an export or disable a review gate.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: User correction
functional.statement: Users shall edit, reject and report generated content with retained provenance and feedback routing.
functional.acceptance: Correcting a draft does not erase the fact that AI assistance was used.
functional.behaviour: Allow edit, reject and report; preserve the original generated version, user revisions and AI provenance within retention rules.
functional.exception: Correcting text cannot remove provenance or silently change an issued record.
functional.fs_acceptance: Correcting a draft does not erase the fact that AI assistance was used.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Assistant evaluation
functional.statement: Platform AI features shall have task specific quality, safety and privacy evaluation before activation and after material changes.
functional.acceptance: A failed critical safety or permission test prevents release of the feature.
functional.behaviour: Activate only after task, privacy, access and adversarial tests pass; rerun affected tests after model, prompt, tool or corpus changes.
functional.exception: A critical failure blocks the feature even if average quality improves.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed critical safety or permission test prevents release of the feature.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Administrative controls
functional.statement: Institutions shall enable or disable AI features by purpose, data class and user role within mandatory controls.
functional.acceptance: A disabled feature cannot be invoked through an API or background task.
functional.behaviour: Enable functions by institution, role, purpose and data class within mandatory operator limits. Preview effect before activation.
functional.exception: Disabled capability is also denied through APIs, schedules and background tasks.
functional.fs_acceptance: A disabled feature cannot be invoked through an API or background task.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Fallback and abstention
functional.statement: The assistant shall indicate uncertainty and permit normal workflow completion when AI is unavailable or unsuitable.
functional.acceptance: A failed AI service cannot prevent an authorised user from filing a safety incident.
functional.behaviour: Show uncertainty, insufficient sources or provider failure plainly and keep the manual workflow usable.
functional.exception: Assistant outage cannot block incident filing, ordinary drafting, review or required evidence access.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed AI service cannot prevent an authorised user from filing a safety incident.
functional.actors: Authorised user, institutional AI administrator and qualified content reviewer. Accountable role: AI product lead.

functional.title: Versioned interfaces
functional.statement: The platform shall expose documented versioned APIs for approved core objects with consistent authentication, pagination and error handling.
functional.acceptance: A published integration can identify the API version and supported deprecation period.
functional.behaviour: Expose documented versioned operations with consistent authentication, object scoping, cursor pagination and structured errors.
functional.exception: Breaking changes require the BRD notice period or a recorded urgent exception with managed alternatives.
functional.fs_acceptance: A published integration can identify the API version and supported deprecation period.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Scoped integration access
functional.statement: Each connector shall have a separate owner, purpose, scopes, credentials, approved destinations and revocation path.
functional.acceptance: A reporting connector cannot inherit permission to export raw clinical data.
functional.behaviour: Create a dedicated owned service identity per connector, with purpose, destinations and minimal scopes.
functional.exception: Reporting integration cannot inherit raw clinical export rights or the administrator's other privileges.
functional.fs_acceptance: A reporting connector cannot inherit permission to export raw clinical data.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Health record exchange
functional.statement: Selected clinical integrations shall support the receiving institution's agreed HL7 FHIR version and implementation profile where applicable.
functional.acceptance: Profile validation and unit or terminology mapping pass agreed conformance examples before activation.
functional.behaviour: Select the institution's agreed FHIR version and implementation profile and validate representative resources plus terminology and units.
functional.exception: Unrecognised or invalid clinical meaning is quarantined; generic JSON acceptance is not conformance.
functional.fs_acceptance: Profile validation and unit or terminology mapping pass agreed conformance examples before activation.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Medical imaging exchange
functional.statement: Imaging integrations shall support the agreed DICOM objects and services with identity, study relationship and deidentification checks.
functional.acceptance: Transferred images retain clinically necessary metadata while prohibited identifiers are handled as approved.
functional.behaviour: Declare supported DICOM objects and services and preserve study and series relationships under approved deidentification.
functional.exception: Missing identity reconciliation or prohibited identifiers block the transfer's accepted status.
functional.fs_acceptance: Transferred images retain clinically necessary metadata while prohibited identifiers are handled as approved.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Research and health information systems
functional.statement: The platform shall support approved connections to institutional EDC, laboratory, public health or research systems according to programme need.
functional.acceptance: Each connected field has an identified authoritative source and reconciliation rule.
functional.behaviour: Map EDC, laboratory and research fields to authoritative sources and reconciliation rules before activation.
functional.exception: Conflicting observations do not create a competing master; raise a source resolution case.
functional.fs_acceptance: Each connected field has an identified authoritative source and reconciliation rule.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Import and export portability
functional.statement: Authorised data and metadata shall be exchangeable in documented nonproprietary formats with a data dictionary and version information.
functional.acceptance: A receiving tool can reconstruct object relationships from an approved export.
functional.behaviour: Export authorised records in documented open formats with schema version, dictionaries and relationship keys.
functional.exception: Receiver reconstruction tests must pass; inaccessible assets are omitted with a manifest explanation.
functional.fs_acceptance: A receiving tool can reconstruct object relationships from an approved export.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Reliable events
functional.statement: Webhooks and events shall support verification, idempotency, retry, ordering assumptions and replay controls.
functional.acceptance: Repeated delivery does not duplicate a clinical decision, invoice or approval.
functional.behaviour: Verify event authenticity, deduplicate by event identity and process according to stated ordering rules. Record acknowledgements and bounded retries.
functional.exception: Repeated delivery cannot repeat approval, grant or charge; replay does not create new authority.
functional.fs_acceptance: Repeated delivery does not duplicate a clinical decision, invoice or approval.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Connector failures
functional.statement: Integration failures shall be visible, retriable where safe and isolated from unrelated workflows.
functional.acceptance: An unavailable external system cannot cause silent loss of an acknowledged source record.
functional.behaviour: Show failed exchanges with safe reason, affected range and retry eligibility. Preserve acknowledged source records until reconciled.
functional.exception: External outage cannot silently drop accepted inputs or block unrelated study functions.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unavailable external system cannot cause silent loss of an acknowledged source record.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Mapping governance
functional.statement: Mappings for codes, units, time, identifiers and field meaning shall be reviewed and versioned.
functional.acceptance: An unrecognised clinical code is quarantined or explicitly represented rather than silently replaced.
functional.behaviour: Review and version mappings for code, unit, time and identifiers; retain original and transformed meaning.
functional.exception: Unknown codes and incompatible units are quarantined rather than guessed or silently substituted.
functional.fs_acceptance: An unrecognised clinical code is quarantined or explicitly represented rather than silently replaced.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Identity and finance integrations
functional.statement: The service shall integrate approved identity directories, ticketing, accounting and signature systems with limited scopes.
functional.acceptance: An accounting integration receives billing data without gaining clinical evidence access.
functional.behaviour: Use approved scoped interfaces for identity, finance, signatures and support; declare ownership of each exchanged field.
functional.exception: Accounting receives financial metadata only; role provisioning cannot trust arbitrary external group names.
functional.fs_acceptance: An accounting integration receives billing data without gaining clinical evidence access.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Connector lifecycle
functional.statement: New and changed connectors shall undergo security, data rights and conformance assessment and support controlled disablement.
functional.acceptance: Disabling a connector stops new transfers and preserves the record of past exchanges.
functional.behaviour: Activate after rights, security and conformance approval. Disable stops new exchanges while preserving pending outcomes and history.
functional.exception: Credential revocation and queued work are reconciled; disablement cannot erase past transmissions.
functional.fs_acceptance: Disabling a connector stops new transfers and preserves the record of past exchanges.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: External evidence exchange
functional.statement: Participating registries and governance networks may exchange approved evidence metadata through agreed schemas and permissions.
functional.acceptance: An external directory receives only the authorised metadata and current evidence status.
functional.behaviour: Exchange only approved evidence metadata with named external networks using agreed schema and audience scope.
functional.exception: Publish current status and corrections without patient detail; partner directory membership implies no new sharing rights.
functional.fs_acceptance: An external directory receives only the authorised metadata and current evidence status.
functional.actors: Integration owner, data custodian, security reviewer and external system owner. Accountable role: Integration lead.

functional.title: Service catalogue
functional.statement: The service shall define evaluation, data preparation, implementation and monitoring packages with scope, exclusions and pricing basis.
functional.acceptance: A buyer can identify which activities and deliverables are included before contracting.
functional.behaviour: Publish service packages with deliverables, exclusions, pricing basis, prerequisites and acceptance rules.
functional.exception: A quote cannot imply unsupported countries, capabilities or regulatory approval as an included deliverable.
functional.fs_acceptance: A buyer can identify which activities and deliverables are included before contracting.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Cost estimation
functional.statement: Study estimates shall include staff, sites, data preparation, compute, oversight, integration and contingency assumptions.
functional.acceptance: Estimate changes identify the driver and require the applicable budget approval.
functional.behaviour: Estimate staff, sites, data, compute, oversight, integration and contingency with quantities and assumptions.
functional.exception: Scope or cost changes create a revised estimate and applicable budget approval, not hidden increments.
functional.fs_acceptance: Estimate changes identify the driver and require the applicable budget approval.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Quotes and approvals
functional.statement: Quotes, discounts and change orders shall be versioned with delegated approval limits and customer acceptance.
functional.acceptance: A change in scope cannot silently increase an institution's financial commitment.
functional.behaviour: Route quotes and discounts through delegated financial limits and record customer acceptance of the exact version.
functional.exception: Accepted scope cannot increase commitment without an authorised change order.
functional.fs_acceptance: A change in scope cannot silently increase an institution's financial commitment.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Budget controls
functional.statement: The platform shall allocate budgets, commitments, actual costs and funding sources with alerts and spend approval limits.
functional.acceptance: A study cannot exceed its approved hard spending limit through automatic retries.
functional.behaviour: Reserve budget for approved work, show committed versus actual and warn at 80 and 100 percent unless stricter rules apply.
functional.exception: Hard limits block new unauthorised consumption, including retries, while preserving safe termination and evidence.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study cannot exceed its approved hard spending limit through automatic retries.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Usage metering
functional.statement: Billable consumption shall be attributable to institution, study, service and run with reconciliation and dispute support.
functional.acceptance: A failed retry is charged only according to the declared billing policy.
functional.behaviour: Meter usage by institution, study, service and logical run, then reconcile attempts and rate versions.
functional.exception: Failed retries are billable only under declared terms; duplicates cannot create a second charge.
functional.fs_acceptance: A failed retry is charged only according to the declared billing policy.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Invoices and payments
functional.statement: The service shall support invoices, credits, payment status, local currency and applicable tax handling through approved finance processes.
functional.acceptance: An issued credit links to the original invoice and preserves audit history.
functional.behaviour: Prepare invoices through approved finance processes with explicit currency and applicable tax configuration. Link credits to originals.
functional.exception: Posted accounting records are not silently edited locally; correction uses the finance authority's approved process.
functional.fs_acceptance: An issued credit links to the original invoice and preserves audit history.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Grant and subsidy management
functional.statement: Awards shall identify eligible recipients, permitted costs, milestones, reporting and remaining funds.
functional.acceptance: A subsidised evaluation shows the payer without changing the scientific scoring rules.
functional.behaviour: Allocate awards to eligible recipients, costs, milestones and periods and report remaining funds.
