functional.exception: Subsidy payer visibility cannot change scientific scoring, reviewer assignment or safety gates.
functional.fs_acceptance: A subsidised evaluation shows the payer without changing the scientific scoring rules.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Commercial independence
functional.statement: Payment, sponsorship and sales relationships shall not override data, ethics, safety or scientific gates.
functional.acceptance: An overdue invoice cannot delete unfavourable evidence or prevent an urgent safety report.
functional.behaviour: Apply commercial restrictions only within contracts and display protected scientific and safety actions separately.
functional.exception: Overdue payment cannot delete findings, block urgent concern intake or bypass safe closure.
functional.fs_acceptance: An overdue invoice cannot delete unfavourable evidence or prevent an urgent safety report.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Financial disputes
functional.statement: Billing disputes shall have an owner, evidence, timeline and decision separate from scientific appeals.
functional.acceptance: A scientific appeal remains available under its own policy despite an unrelated invoice dispute.
functional.behaviour: Open billing disputes with charge evidence, owner and timeline; retain independent financial decisions.
functional.exception: Scientific appeals remain available under their own rules and cannot be merged into invoice negotiation.
functional.fs_acceptance: A scientific appeal remains available under its own policy despite an unrelated invoice dispute.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Renewal and exit
functional.statement: Monitoring and service subscriptions shall have renewal, notice, transition and retained obligation records.
functional.acceptance: Service expiry triggers a documented handover and removes unsupported active monitoring claims.
functional.behaviour: Track renewals, notice and service end; obtain accepted monitoring or support handover where required.
functional.exception: Expired service removes unsupported active monitoring claims without erasing retained evidence or duties.
functional.fs_acceptance: Service expiry triggers a documented handover and removes unsupported active monitoring claims.
functional.actors: Commercial owner, finance approver, budget owner and customer representative. Accountable role: Commercial lead.

functional.title: Audit coverage
functional.statement: The platform shall record authentication, access grants, restricted data reads, changes, executions, approvals, exports, publications and privileged activity.
functional.acceptance: A sampled sensitive action can be traced to actor, scope, object version, time and outcome.
functional.behaviour: Capture authentication, restricted reads, grants, edits, runs, decisions, exports, publications and privileged actions with context.
functional.exception: A sensitive action cannot succeed without its required durable audit record or approved recoverable transaction treatment.
functional.fs_acceptance: A sampled sensitive action can be traced to actor, scope, object version, time and outcome.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Audit integrity
functional.statement: Audit records shall be append only or equivalently protected with detectable tampering and restricted administrative access.
functional.acceptance: An administrator cannot alter an event without detection and a separately retained record.
functional.behaviour: Protect event history and provide tamper verification with separately retained integrity evidence.
functional.exception: Administrators cannot edit audit events as ordinary records; suspected tampering opens an incident.
functional.fs_acceptance: An administrator cannot alter an event without detection and a separately retained record.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Before and after changes
functional.statement: Material changes shall preserve previous and new values or safe references, reasons and approvals without logging unnecessary secrets.
functional.acceptance: An investigator can reconstruct a permission change without exposing authentication credentials.
functional.behaviour: Retain safe before and after values or protected references for material changes with reason and approval.
functional.exception: Do not log secrets, full prompts or patient records merely to achieve audit detail.
functional.fs_acceptance: An investigator can reconstruct a permission change without exposing authentication credentials.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Audit access
functional.statement: Auditors shall receive scoped read only access with confidentiality controls and no routine permission to alter study records.
functional.acceptance: An auditor cannot approve the report being audited.
functional.behaviour: Grant auditors time bounded read only inspection scopes and independently authorise exports.
functional.exception: Audit access cannot modify records or approve the scientific decision under inspection.
functional.fs_acceptance: An auditor cannot approve the report being audited.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Control evidence library
functional.statement: The service shall maintain policies, control owners, assessments, test evidence, exceptions and renewal dates.
functional.acceptance: A requested control can be linked to its latest verification and unresolved findings.
functional.behaviour: Maintain controls, owners, test evidence, findings, exceptions and review dates; link each control to current verification.
functional.exception: A policy attachment without test evidence cannot be displayed as an implemented verified control.
functional.fs_acceptance: A requested control can be linked to its latest verification and unresolved findings.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Compliance mapping
functional.statement: Qualified owners shall map applicable laws, contracts and standards to controls and evidence with versioned applicability decisions.
functional.acceptance: The platform cannot advertise compliance solely because a checklist template exists.
functional.behaviour: Map obligations and standard versions to applicable controls with qualified interpretation and source.
functional.exception: A checklist template cannot create a compliance or certification claim.
functional.fs_acceptance: The platform cannot advertise compliance solely because a checklist template exists.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Inspection support
functional.statement: Authorised inspections shall produce bounded evidence packages with access records, redaction and chain of custody.
functional.acceptance: The exported inspection package reconciles to the selected source versions.
functional.behaviour: Freeze inspection scope and export manifest, apply rights and redactions and record recipient custody.
functional.exception: Exported record counts and versions must reconcile; omitted restricted items are explicitly accounted for.
functional.fs_acceptance: The exported inspection package reconciles to the selected source versions.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Legal holds
functional.statement: Authorised legal holds shall prevent affected destruction and record scope, reason, approver, review and release.
functional.acceptance: A scheduled deletion cannot remove a held record or its required supporting evidence.
functional.behaviour: Apply bounded holds to records and required dependencies, intercepting scheduled disposal. Record review and authorised release.
functional.exception: Deleting a parent or changing a retention rule cannot bypass an active hold.
functional.fs_acceptance: A scheduled deletion cannot remove a held record or its required supporting evidence.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Exceptions and expiry
functional.statement: Control exceptions shall have compensating measures, risk owner, independent approval, scope and expiry.
functional.acceptance: An expired exception cannot silently remain active.
functional.behaviour: Approve exceptions with compensating controls, independent owner and expiry; show affected release gates.
functional.exception: Expired exceptions cease to authorise activity and cannot silently roll forward.
functional.fs_acceptance: An expired exception cannot silently remain active.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Periodic assurance review
functional.statement: The service shall track security assessments, privacy reviews, clinical audits and remediation with accountable owners.
functional.acceptance: A recurring critical finding triggers escalation to the appropriate governance body.
functional.behaviour: Schedule assurance reviews and track finding severity, owners and remediation evidence.
functional.exception: Recurring critical findings escalate even when previous instances were individually marked resolved.
functional.fs_acceptance: A recurring critical finding triggers escalation to the appropriate governance body.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Certification claims
functional.statement: Any certification or accreditation claim shall identify issuing body, scope, version, validity and supporting evidence.
functional.acceptance: An assessment in progress is never displayed as a completed certification.
functional.behaviour: Verify issuing body, scope, version and validity before permitting certification wording in public or institutional views.
functional.exception: Assessment in progress remains pending and cannot be advertised as certification.
functional.fs_acceptance: An assessment in progress is never displayed as a completed certification.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Audit retention
functional.statement: Audit retention shall follow approved purpose and jurisdiction profiles with privacy controls and verifiable disposal.
functional.acceptance: Audit logs cannot be retained indefinitely solely because storage is available.
functional.behaviour: Apply approved audit retention by event class and jurisdiction, preserving active holds and disposal proof.
functional.exception: Available storage alone cannot justify indefinite retention or remove privacy restrictions.
functional.fs_acceptance: Audit logs cannot be retained indefinitely solely because storage is available.
functional.actors: Independent auditor, control owner, legal owner and assurance lead. Accountable role: Assurance lead.

functional.title: Operational console
functional.statement: Operators shall see service health, queues, capacity, failures and dependencies without routine access to restricted study content.
functional.acceptance: Support can identify a failed job using metadata and approved diagnostics.
functional.behaviour: Show queue, health and dependency metadata with correlation references. Use approved diagnostics to locate faults.
functional.exception: Routine operators cannot open patient content, proprietary models or sealed benchmarks through the console.
functional.fs_acceptance: Support can identify a failed job using metadata and approved diagnostics.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Support access
functional.statement: Support cases shall use redacted attachments and explicit time limited approvals for any exceptional sensitive access.
functional.acceptance: A user filing a ticket does not grant blanket access to all institutional data.
functional.behaviour: Accept redacted support material and request explicit scoped temporary access only when necessary.
functional.exception: Creating a ticket grants no general tenant visibility; expired support access is revoked automatically.
functional.fs_acceptance: A user filing a ticket does not grant blanket access to all institutional data.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Incident management
functional.statement: Operational incidents shall have severity, owner, communications, recovery actions and post incident review.
functional.acceptance: Major incidents preserve a timeline and tracked corrective actions.
functional.behaviour: Declare priority, assign owner and runbook, record recovery and issue required communications. Preserve a complete incident chronology.
functional.exception: Recovery cannot close the post incident actions or clinical safety case automatically.
functional.fs_acceptance: Major incidents preserve a timeline and tracked corrective actions.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Configuration control
functional.statement: Production configuration changes shall be reviewed, versioned, tested and reversible where appropriate.
functional.acceptance: Changing an access rule records who approved it and what affected scopes were assessed.
functional.behaviour: Review configuration diffs with scope impact, tests and recovery method before activation.
functional.exception: A privileged configuration edit cannot weaken nonwaivable controls or silently affect other countries.
functional.fs_acceptance: Changing an access rule records who approved it and what affected scopes were assessed.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Feature activation
functional.statement: Risky or conditional capabilities shall be activated only for scopes that pass their release and operational gates.
functional.acceptance: Enabling a user interface feature cannot bypass a missing clinical capability approval.
functional.behaviour: Activate capabilities only for scopes with required release and operational evidence. Maintain separate UI availability and enforceable activation record.
functional.exception: Turning on a menu or feature flag cannot bypass clinical, privacy or country gates.
functional.fs_acceptance: Enabling a user interface feature cannot bypass a missing clinical capability approval.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Service notices
functional.statement: Maintenance and incident communications shall identify affected services, scope, expected impact and current status.
functional.acceptance: Users can distinguish a planned outage from failure of their own study.
functional.behaviour: Publish scoped maintenance and incident notices with expected impact, current state and approved update cadence.
functional.exception: Avoid confidential study detail; users must distinguish service disruption from an individual study failure.
functional.fs_acceptance: Users can distinguish a planned outage from failure of their own study.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Capacity and quota management
functional.statement: Operators shall manage fair allocation, reservations and escalation for competing workloads.
functional.acceptance: A large commercial customer cannot consume protected capacity assigned to an active safety investigation.
functional.behaviour: Allocate reservations and quotas fairly using approved priorities and protected incident capacity.
functional.exception: A large customer's workload cannot consume a reserved active safety investigation allocation.
functional.fs_acceptance: A large commercial customer cannot consume protected capacity assigned to an active safety investigation.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Backup and restore operations
functional.statement: Operators shall perform verified backups and controlled restores with residency, access and deletion restrictions preserved.
functional.acceptance: A restored environment does not reactivate revoked users or deleted data without reconciliation.
functional.behaviour: Perform restore in isolation, verify integrity and reconcile current grants, revocations, holds and deletion ledger before reopening.
functional.exception: A snapshot cannot reactivate departed users, disposed data or expired permissions.
functional.fs_acceptance: A restored environment does not reactivate revoked users or deleted data without reconciliation.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Release management
functional.statement: Application and evaluation component releases shall include approvals, verification, rollback conditions and affected user communication.
functional.acceptance: A metric implementation update cannot silently alter previously issued results.
functional.behaviour: Release only with approved requirements, regression evidence, rollout and recovery plan. Keep metric versions pinned to historical results.
functional.exception: Updating computation code cannot recalculate issued reports in place.
functional.fs_acceptance: A metric implementation update cannot silently alter previously issued results.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Support service catalogue
functional.statement: Institutions shall know support hours, contact methods, escalation routes and responsibility boundaries.
functional.acceptance: Clinical sites have a local urgent route even when ordinary technical support is unavailable.
functional.behaviour: Publish support hours, routes, urgency criteria and local clinical responsibilities per institution.
functional.exception: Ordinary helpdesk closure does not remove the approved out of band urgent route.
functional.fs_acceptance: Clinical sites have a local urgent route even when ordinary technical support is unavailable.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Supplier continuity
functional.statement: Critical suppliers shall have assessed dependencies, exit options, incident contacts and change notification requirements.
functional.acceptance: A supplier outage can be linked to affected studies and recovery options.
functional.behaviour: Register critical supplier dependencies and tested continuity options; map outages and changes to affected services and studies.
functional.exception: Supplier substitution requires renewed rights, residency and conformance checks where material.
functional.fs_acceptance: A supplier outage can be linked to affected studies and recovery options.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Institutional service reviews
functional.statement: The operator shall provide agreed reviews of performance, unresolved issues, costs and upcoming obligations.
functional.acceptance: Actions from the review have owners and due dates visible to both parties.
functional.behaviour: Hold scoped institutional reviews of performance, unresolved issues, costs and future obligations; assign actions visible to both parties.
functional.exception: Meeting completion does not close outstanding actions without required evidence and owner acceptance.
functional.fs_acceptance: Actions from the review have owners and due dates visible to both parties.
functional.actors: Operations lead, support agent, security owner and release manager. Accountable role: Operations lead.

functional.title: Retention schedules
functional.statement: Data classes shall have approved retention triggers, durations, legal bases, holds and disposal methods by jurisdiction and contract.
functional.acceptance: A newly created asset inherits an explicit retention policy rather than an indefinite default.
functional.behaviour: Assign an approved retention schedule before creating production assets. Derive expiry from explicit trigger events and display applicable holds.
functional.exception: Missing policy blocks asset activation; indefinite retention is not an implicit default.
functional.fs_acceptance: A newly created asset inherits an explicit retention policy rather than an indefinite default.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Study closure
functional.statement: Closure shall reconcile access, jobs, datasets, reports, incidents, contracts, billing and outstanding obligations.
functional.acceptance: A study cannot close its safety obligations by changing its administrative status.
functional.behaviour: Reconcile access, jobs, data, evidence, incidents, contracts and finance at study close. Assign surviving duties to accepting owners.
functional.exception: Administrative closure cannot end unfulfilled safety obligations or remove unresolved incident records.
functional.fs_acceptance: A study cannot close its safety obligations by changing its administrative status.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Data disposal
functional.statement: Expired assets shall be deleted or irreversibly rendered inaccessible according to policy, with copies and derived artefacts assessed.
functional.acceptance: A disposal record identifies completed actions, retained exceptions and backup expiry treatment.
functional.behaviour: Review expired assets, copies and derivatives, then execute lawful disposal and retain verification plus exceptions.
functional.exception: Held records remain protected; partial completion cannot be represented as total deletion.
functional.fs_acceptance: A disposal record identifies completed actions, retained exceptions and backup expiry treatment.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Backup deletion handling
functional.statement: Deletion policy shall define backup expiry and prevent restoration from resurrecting deleted or restricted records.
functional.acceptance: A restore applies the current deletion and revocation ledger before user access resumes.
functional.behaviour: Record backup expiry and block ordinary access to disposed content. Restore applies the current deletion and restriction ledger before reopening.
functional.exception: A restored historical snapshot cannot resurrect lawfully deleted records or revoked access.
functional.fs_acceptance: A restore applies the current deletion and revocation ledger before user access resumes.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Institutional export
functional.statement: Institutions shall obtain authorised records, metadata, histories and evidence in documented portable formats.
functional.acceptance: An export includes relationship keys and definitions needed to interpret the files.
functional.behaviour: Prepare an authorised export with documented open formats, dictionaries, relationship keys, histories and manifests.
functional.exception: Verify reconstruction and rights before delivery; export creation alone is not successful handover.
functional.fs_acceptance: An export includes relationship keys and definitions needed to interpret the files.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Rights aware portability
functional.statement: Exports shall exclude assets the recipient has no right to retain and explain restrictions.
functional.acceptance: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data merely because both joined a study.
functional.behaviour: Evaluate retention rights for each exported asset and recipient, recording exclusions and allowed reuse.
functional.exception: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data through shared study membership.
functional.fs_acceptance: A departing partner cannot take another institution's raw data merely because both joined a study.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: User and tenant offboarding
functional.statement: Offboarding shall revoke credentials, transfer accountable ownership and preserve required authorship and audit records.
functional.acceptance: Deleting a user profile does not destroy the attribution of a clinical signoff.
functional.behaviour: Revoke user and tenant credentials, transfer ownership and retain necessary signed attribution under approved privacy rules.
functional.exception: Profile removal cannot erase clinical signoff identity; missing successor remains a visible continuity issue.
functional.fs_acceptance: Deleting a user profile does not destroy the attribution of a clinical signoff.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Operator succession
functional.statement: The service shall maintain an agreed plan for operator insolvency, acquisition or cessation including custody and continuity of essential records.
functional.acceptance: A tabletop exercise identifies who would receive evidence and incident responsibilities.
functional.behaviour: Maintain a succession plan for insolvency, acquisition or cessation and exercise custody and incident handover assumptions.
functional.exception: No automatic asset transfer to an unapproved successor; local rights and institutional authority still apply.
functional.fs_acceptance: A tabletop exercise identifies who would receive evidence and incident responsibilities.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Closure attestation
functional.statement: Authorised custodians shall issue closure or deletion attestations stating scope and lawful retention exceptions.
functional.acceptance: An attestation never claims deletion of data still retained under a documented hold.
functional.behaviour: Issue signed closure or disposal attestations with exact scope, completed steps, held records and backup treatment.
functional.exception: Never claim deletion of retained or unverified external copies.
functional.fs_acceptance: An attestation never claims deletion of data still retained under a documented hold.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

functional.title: Residual obligations
functional.statement: The platform shall track surviving confidentiality, reporting, clinical follow up and financial obligations after access ends.
functional.acceptance: An expired commercial agreement does not remove a required safety follow up task.
functional.behaviour: Keep surviving confidentiality, reporting, follow up and financial obligations assigned after ordinary access ends.
functional.exception: Expired contracts cannot remove required tasks; use restricted successor access or institutional handover to complete them.
functional.fs_acceptance: An expired commercial agreement does not remove a required safety follow up task.
functional.actors: Data custodian, legal owner, institutional administrator and continuity owner. Accountable role: Data governance lead.

quality.title: Security verification baseline
quality.statement: The application shall meet the applicable OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 Level 2 requirements, with additional high assurance controls selected for privileged and restricted data paths.
quality.acceptance: An independent assessment records applicability and evidence; no unresolved exploitable critical or high finding remains at launch.
quality.realisation: AUD records the applicable verification controls, evidence, findings and signoff; OPS prevents launch with an unresolved exploitable critical or high finding.
quality.verification: Run an independent scoped assessment against the implemented journeys and record retest evidence, including privileged and restricted data paths.

quality.title: Transport protection
quality.statement: All protected browser, API, service and data transfer traffic shall use authenticated encryption with TLS 1.2 or higher; TLS 1.3 is preferred where supported.
quality.acceptance: Scanning finds no accepted plaintext protected endpoint or obsolete protocol; certificate failure blocks connection.
quality.realisation: Every protected connection validates its peer and fails without exposing content when certificate or negotiated protocol checks fail.
quality.verification: Exercise browser, connector, node and service transfers with expired certificates, mismatched identities and obsolete protocols.

quality.title: Stored data protection
quality.statement: Restricted data, backups and credentials shall be encrypted using approved contemporary cryptography and separately controlled key access.
quality.acceptance: Storage and backup inspection finds no unencrypted restricted payload or plaintext secret.
quality.realisation: Asset and backup inventories record protected storage and key custody; ordinary operators cannot retrieve content through storage administration.
quality.verification: Inspect representative clinical data, model files, credentials and restored backups and test separation between key and storage access.

quality.title: Authentication coverage
quality.statement: One hundred percent of privileged users, signers and restricted data users shall use multifactor authentication; privileged access shall use phishing resistant authentication or an approved equivalent institutional control.
quality.acceptance: Attempts to enter these scopes without the required assurance are denied in all supported clients.
quality.realisation: IAM records assurance and ACC checks it at protected entry and signature; privileged functions require the stronger approved method.
quality.verification: Attempt each restricted action through UI, API and service contexts with insufficient factors and verify consistent denial.

quality.title: Local credential policy
quality.statement: Local passwords shall permit at least 64 characters, require at least 15, reject known compromised values and avoid arbitrary composition or routine forced rotation without cause.
quality.acceptance: Password managers and paste work; recovery and change tests invalidate compromised sessions as specified.
quality.realisation: Local enrolment and reset validate length and compromised values while supporting paste and password managers; do not impose arbitrary periodic resets.
quality.verification: Test minimum boundary, a 64 character password, compromised value rejection and recovery revocation without logging the submitted secret.

quality.title: Session expiry
quality.statement: Default inactivity expiry shall be 15 minutes for privileged sessions and 30 minutes otherwise, with a 12 hour maximum; critical approvals require authentication within the preceding 5 minutes.
quality.acceptance: Boundary tests confirm expiry and step up checks without losing safely saved drafts.
quality.realisation: The UI displays safe expiry warnings; the server uses authoritative activity and authentication times and requires step up before critical signoff.
quality.verification: Test just before, at and after inactivity, absolute and five minute approval boundaries, including a stale browser tab.

quality.title: Revocation latency
quality.statement: Online permission and credential revocation shall take effect within 60 seconds across protected APIs, jobs and active sessions.
quality.acceptance: A distributed revocation test has no successful new protected action after the deadline; offline limits are documented separately.
quality.realisation: Revocation generates an effective restriction and impact queue; protected actions and controlled deliveries recheck current authority.
quality.verification: Measure from committed revocation to last possible protected success across sessions, workers, caches, APIs and download paths; all must meet 60 seconds online.

quality.title: Isolation assurance
quality.statement: Cross tenant, cross study and privilege escalation test suites shall cover every protected object and execution boundary.
quality.acceptance: No unauthorised access succeeds in the release suite or independent penetration test.
quality.realisation: Every protected object inherits institution and study scope; execution profiles isolate files, secrets and residual memory.
quality.verification: Use two institutions, cross study users and a hostile workload to exercise direct links, search, exports, background jobs and resource reuse.

quality.title: Secret handling
quality.statement: Secrets shall not appear in source repositories, client bundles, telemetry, reports or ordinary support logs; production secrets shall rotate at least every 90 days or faster after compromise.
quality.acceptance: Automated scans and sampled runtime inspection find no exposed active secret; rotation does not broaden access.
quality.realisation: Secret fields are write only or masked, references replace values in logs, and rotation tasks have owners and expiry.
quality.verification: Insert synthetic secret markers and inspect bundles, telemetry, reports, tickets and source artefacts; rotate without expanding scope.

quality.title: Abuse protection
quality.statement: Authentication, expensive queries and public interfaces shall have tested rate limits and abuse controls that preserve authorised safety reporting.
quality.acceptance: Load and brute force tests are contained without preventing the approved emergency reporting route.
quality.realisation: Authentication, search and expensive jobs have configured per principal and institutional limits; urgent reporting has an independently protected route.
quality.verification: Burst valid and hostile traffic and verify bounded resource use, safe rate limit messages and continued authorised urgent intake.

quality.title: Vulnerability response
quality.statement: Confirmed actively exploited or critical exposures shall be contained within 24 hours; high findings within 7 days and medium within 30 days unless formally risk accepted.
quality.acceptance: The vulnerability register measures discovery to containment and remediation, with overdue escalation.
quality.realisation: The vulnerability register starts clocks at confirmed classification and records containment separately from final remediation.
quality.verification: Seed critical, high and medium findings and verify due dates, escalation, risk acceptance authority and evidence of closure.

quality.title: Independent testing
quality.statement: An independent penetration test shall occur before production, annually and after material changes to trust boundaries; continuous dependency and code scanning shall cover releases.
quality.acceptance: Evidence includes remediation and retest of affected controls rather than only the original report.
quality.realisation: OPS release and annual assurance calendars require independent testing and retest after material trust changes.
quality.verification: Inspect a release with a boundary change and verify it cannot pass on an old unrelated assessment.

quality.title: Residency coverage
quality.statement: One hundred percent of restricted primary data, replicas, backups, logs containing sensitive content and remote support access shall conform to the approved regional policy.
quality.acceptance: A residency inventory and technical validation show no unapproved processing or copy location.
quality.realisation: Country and asset policies constrain originals, replicas, logs, backups, execution and support locations; inventories expose unsupported locations.
quality.verification: Test each data lifecycle path and a forbidden support session against the active regional policy.

quality.title: Purpose enforcement
quality.statement: Every restricted data execution and export shall have an active applicable purpose bound grant.
quality.acceptance: A sampled audit and negative tests find no run or export without the required grant.
quality.realisation: Every run and export binds the exact purpose grant and rechecks it at execution and delivery.
quality.verification: Attempt a valid user with wrong purpose, different release, added team member and expired grant; retain denial evidence.

quality.title: Minimised telemetry
quality.statement: Production telemetry shall exclude raw patient records, unrestricted prompts, authentication secrets and proprietary model contents by default.
quality.acceptance: Synthetic sensitive markers inserted into test workflows do not appear in general telemetry.
quality.realisation: Telemetry schemas accept bounded metadata and safe error codes; raw clinical payloads and unrestricted prompts are excluded by default.
quality.verification: Place synthetic identifiers in inputs and failures and inspect general logs, traces, alerts and support attachments.

quality.title: Disclosure control
quality.statement: All public or shared aggregate releases shall pass approved small cell, linkage and inference risk rules; thresholds shall be set per context.
quality.acceptance: A disclosure test pack verifies suppression and complementary cell handling for all supported filters and exports.
quality.realisation: ANA and DAC share disclosure rules across UI, exports, complementary totals and repeated queries.
quality.verification: Use fixtures with small cells and overlapping filters; confirm suppression cannot be bypassed through subtraction or a second presentation format.

quality.title: Privacy impact review
quality.statement: Every new restricted processing purpose, provider or material transfer shall have a completed privacy and rights assessment before activation.
quality.acceptance: A release cannot enable the affected processing while a mandatory assessment is incomplete.
quality.realisation: New purpose, provider or material transfer creates a required privacy assessment gate before related connector or capability activation.
quality.verification: Submit each change with an incomplete assessment and verify processing remains blocked while unaffected scope stays available.

quality.title: Data rights service
quality.statement: Requests shall be acknowledged within 2 business days and assigned within 1; completion follows the shorter applicable legal or contractual deadline.
quality.acceptance: The case register tracks deadlines, identity checks, holds and reasoned outcomes without assuming one global deadline.
quality.realisation: Rights cases use the institution's business calendar, acknowledgement and assignment clocks plus the shorter applicable completion deadline.
quality.verification: Test weekend, holiday, reassignment and paused investigation cases without pausing a legal clock unless the approved rule permits it.

quality.title: Deletion execution
quality.statement: Approved deletion shall remove active copies within 30 days or a shorter applicable limit; backup expiry and holds shall be disclosed and enforced.
quality.acceptance: Verification confirms active deletion and prevents restoration from reintroducing disposed records.
quality.realisation: Disposal cases track active copies, held assets, backups and external notices separately, with the applicable shorter deadline.
quality.verification: Verify deleted content cannot be retrieved through caches, exports or a restored snapshot; attestation lists lawful exceptions.

quality.title: Provider data use
quality.statement: No external model or analytics provider may train on or reuse restricted content without a separately documented lawful authorisation and explicit institutional approval.
quality.acceptance: Provider configuration and terms are verified before use; an unapproved change stops affected transmission.
quality.realisation: Provider approvals explicitly record training and reuse permissions and are checked before content transmission.
quality.verification: Change a provider term or remove institutional permission and confirm the next affected request is blocked.

quality.title: Core availability
quality.statement: The production control plane shall target 99.9 percent monthly availability, measured through authenticated critical journeys in supported regions, including planned maintenance impact.
quality.acceptance: Independent probes and incident records reconcile successful available minutes; third party failures affecting the journey count.
quality.realisation: Availability covers authenticated login, task, study, evidence and incident journeys by supported region; planned maintenance and user-visible dependencies count.
quality.verification: Reconcile probe failures and incident intervals over the month without averaging away a failing supported region or journey.

quality.title: Emergency reporting continuity
quality.statement: An out of band route shall remain available for urgent incidents and suspension requests when the platform is unavailable.
quality.acceptance: A quarterly outage exercise reaches an accountable operator and the relevant local site contact.
quality.realisation: Institutions have an approved out of band urgent route with accountable operator and local site contact, published before activation.
quality.verification: Quarterly disable the platform route and record successful human contact and transfer of the urgent concern.

quality.title: Recovery time
quality.statement: Core identity, access, study metadata, evidence and incident services shall recover within 4 hours after a declared recoverable regional disaster.
quality.acceptance: A twice yearly recovery exercise meets the target within permitted residency locations.
quality.realisation: The recovery runbook restores critical identity, grants, metadata, evidence and incidents only in permitted locations.
quality.verification: Time a declared recoverable regional disaster through validated reopening, including current policy reconciliation, within four hours.

quality.title: Recovery point
quality.statement: Recovery point objectives shall be at most 15 minutes for core metadata and final artefacts and 5 minutes for signed decisions, grants and audit events.
quality.acceptance: A recovery test demonstrates bounded loss and reconciles any missing authoritative actions before reopening access.
quality.realisation: Recovery evidence distinguishes core metadata and final artefacts from signed decisions, grants and audit with their separate objectives.
quality.verification: Create timestamped fixtures before failure, recover and measure actual loss; reconcile uncertain approvals before enabling protected actions.

quality.title: Source data recovery
quality.statement: Custodied input data shall have a contracted recovery point no greater than 24 hours unless a stricter study requirement applies; reproducible and unique inputs shall be distinguished.
quality.acceptance: Restored inputs reconcile to the frozen manifest; a missing unique input blocks dependent evidence claims.
quality.realisation: Source assets identify unique versus reproducible inputs and contracted recovery objectives in the custodian record.
quality.verification: Restore representative datasets and compare manifests; missing unique evidence blocks dependent claims.

quality.title: Backup verification
quality.statement: Backup integrity shall be checked daily and sampled restoration tested monthly, with a full recovery exercise twice yearly.
quality.acceptance: A completed backup job without successful restore evidence is not reported as proven recoverability.
quality.realisation: The console separates completed backups, verified integrity, sampled restore and full exercise status.
quality.verification: Demonstrate daily checks, monthly sample restoration and twice yearly recovery evidence; failed verification remains a blocking finding.

quality.title: Failure isolation
quality.statement: Loss of one study workload or connector shall not disable unrelated study control, incident reporting or access enforcement.
quality.acceptance: Injected workload and dependency failures leave unrelated critical journeys functional.
quality.realisation: Run and connector failures are scoped to their workloads while protected control and incident functions remain available.
quality.verification: Inject one workload exhaustion and one connector outage under representative load and exercise unrelated institutions' critical journeys.

quality.title: Safe degraded operation
quality.statement: If permissions, policy or provenance cannot be verified, affected sensitive actions shall fail closed while authorised nonsensitive reporting remains available where safe.
quality.acceptance: Dependency failure cannot cause unrestricted access, silent approval or fabricated successful results.
quality.realisation: Unavailable permission or provenance dependencies return a safe unavailable state, withholding protected execution and release.
quality.verification: Simulate partial dependency failures and confirm no cached approval becomes an unrestricted fallback.

quality.title: Disconnected sites
quality.statement: Remote nodes shall show last contact and unacknowledged instructions; offline permissions shall have explicit validity and risk limits.
quality.acceptance: An offline node is never displayed as stopped or updated without evidence; its local owner receives the escalation.
quality.realisation: Node records show last contact, instruction acknowledgement and approved offline lease; local enforcement is part of node admission.
quality.verification: Disconnect a node before stop and verify the central state stays unconfirmed, local lease treatment and backup escalation.

quality.title: Interactive navigation
quality.statement: At L1, common authenticated pages shall become usable within 3 seconds at the 95th percentile under the standard network profile.
quality.acceptance: A 60 minute representative load test covers login landing, study list, task queue and record view.
quality.realisation: Common pages load permitted summary data first and defer large assets without hiding required actions.
quality.verification: At L1 measure user-perceived usable time for login landing, study list, task queue and detail over at least 60 minutes.

quality.title: Transactional response
quality.statement: At L1, ordinary read and write APIs excluding bulk transfer and model execution shall respond within 1 second at p95 and 3 seconds at p99.
quality.acceptance: Measured server response includes authentication and policy checks; error rate is below 0.5 percent excluding valid client errors.
quality.realisation: Ordinary synchronous reads and writes include full authentication and policy evaluation; bulk work returns a tracked job.
quality.verification: Measure server response p95 and p99 plus error rate using the defined workload, including ordinary background processing.

quality.title: Search response
quality.statement: Permission filtered metadata search over 2 million indexed records shall return within 2 seconds at p95 at L1.
quality.acceptance: The test includes complex filters and confirms that faster results do not omit access controls.
quality.realisation: Search uses permitted metadata and consistent filters, counts and stable pagination.
quality.verification: Query the two million record L1 catalogue with complex filters under concurrent use, measuring response and checking hidden-result leakage.

quality.title: Dashboard response
quality.statement: Standard portfolio dashboards over L1 data shall load within 5 seconds at p95 and show their data freshness.
quality.acceptance: Heavy custom analyses are asynchronous with progress rather than blocking the application.
quality.realisation: Dashboards display calculation time and missing sources; expensive custom analyses become asynchronous.
quality.verification: Measure the approved standard dashboard set at L1, including scoped aggregation and disclosure checks.

quality.title: Large ingestion
quality.statement: A valid 1 GB structured import shall complete validation and reconciliation within 10 minutes after transfer under the specified reference schema and allocated capacity.
quality.acceptance: Results account for every input row; imaging and custom transforms use separately approved budgets.
quality.realisation: The 1 GB reference import has a declared schema and resource profile; progress distinguishes transfer from validation and reconciliation.
quality.verification: Start the measured clock after verified transfer and require reconciled output within ten minutes; profile imaging separately.

quality.title: Queue responsiveness
quality.statement: Job submission shall acknowledge within 2 seconds at p95; eligible jobs with reserved available capacity shall start within 2 minutes at p95.
quality.acceptance: Queue metrics distinguish unavailable resources, policy holds and scheduler delay.
quality.realisation: Submission records an acknowledged logical request quickly, then separates waiting for capacity, policy blocks and scheduler delay.
quality.verification: Measure acknowledgement and eligible reserved-capacity start separately; do not count blocked or unfunded jobs as scheduler successes.

quality.title: Large exports
quality.statement: Approved exports up to 100000 tabular rows shall be prepared within 5 minutes at p95 at L1.
quality.acceptance: The user sees progress and expiry; authorisation is rechecked before download.
quality.realisation: Large exports are jobs with progress, scope manifest and expiry, followed by current authorisation at download.
quality.verification: Prepare 100000 representative rows under L1 within five minutes p95 and revoke a recipient before delivery.

quality.title: Low bandwidth use
quality.statement: Core metadata workflows shall become usable within 8 seconds at p95 on the low bandwidth profile, excluding deliberate large asset transfer.
quality.acceptance: Users can save an application, review a task and report an incident under the constrained profile.
quality.realisation: Core metadata forms minimise required transfer and preserve saved drafts; large asset viewers are outside the constrained reference journey.
quality.verification: Use 1 Mbps, 300 ms round trip and one percent packet loss to save an application, review a task and file an incident within eight seconds p95.

quality.title: Inference budgets
quality.statement: Each admitted evaluation pack shall declare modality specific runtime, memory, concurrency and timeout budgets rather than inherit a universal inference target.
quality.acceptance: Out of budget runs terminate or queue according to policy with clear evidence and billing treatment.
quality.realisation: Each task pack supplies declared runtime, memory, concurrency and timeout limits that RUN validates against the request.
quality.verification: Exercise an over-budget inference and verify explicit termination or queuing, preserved diagnostics and correct billing treatment.

quality.title: Capacity expansion
quality.statement: Before enabling L2 volume, the service shall pass the same critical performance and isolation tests at L2 or contract explicitly revised targets.
quality.acceptance: Capacity approval is supported by load test evidence and estimated operating cost.
quality.realisation: L2 activation requires new capacity approval and funded resource profiles, without weakening isolation or policy checks.
quality.verification: Repeat the relevant critical suites at L2; unresolved target changes require a baseline decision before promising expanded capacity.

quality.title: Acknowledged transactions
quality.statement: An acknowledged transaction shall be durable under ordinary process or single component failure and shall not be partially committed.
quality.acceptance: Failure injection yields either one complete recorded action or an explicit failure, never a partial approval.
quality.realisation: State, decision, audit and dispatch intent form a durable acknowledged action; retries return the existing outcome.
quality.verification: Interrupt processing around each commitment boundary and verify either one complete action or an explicit failure, never partial approval.

quality.title: Artefact integrity
quality.statement: Every frozen dataset, model configuration and issued report shall have an integrity identifier and immutable version association.
quality.acceptance: Changing bytes changes the integrity result and cannot preserve the original verified status.
quality.realisation: Frozen manifests and issued artefacts have immutable version associations and integrity identifiers.
quality.verification: Alter bytes and metadata in fixtures; original verification must fail and the change must require a new version.

quality.title: Provenance completeness
quality.statement: One hundred percent of formal findings shall identify protocol, inputs, configuration, methods, run and reviewer versions.
quality.acceptance: An automated completeness check blocks formal issue when any required link is missing.
quality.realisation: The evidence builder checks mandatory links for every formal finding before final signature.
quality.verification: Remove each provenance link in turn and confirm issue is blocked with the specific missing evidence.

quality.title: Deterministic reproducibility
quality.statement: Deterministic evaluations shall reproduce within protocol specified numerical tolerances on the declared environment.
quality.acceptance: Results outside tolerance are investigated and cannot be released as reproduced.
quality.realisation: Reproduction compares against protocol tolerances and the declared environment, not a universal numeric tolerance.
quality.verification: Use reference fixtures inside and outside tolerance and confirm only acceptable reproduction receives verified status.

quality.title: Stochastic reproducibility
quality.statement: Stochastic evaluations shall retain seeds where meaningful, repeat count and uncertainty methods and meet prespecified distributional criteria.
quality.acceptance: A result's reproducibility statement does not promise identical output from a nondeterministic external model.
quality.realisation: Stochastic reports preserve planned repeats, meaningful seeds, distribution criteria and provider identity limits.
quality.verification: Rerun the approved plan and assess its prespecified distributional criterion without promising identical remote outputs.

quality.title: Clock consistency
quality.statement: Authoritative platform timestamps shall use UTC with a recorded display timezone and maintain clock skew below 1 second for controlled services.
quality.acceptance: A trace reconstruction preserves event order; unsynchronised external timestamps are explicitly identified.
quality.realisation: Authoritative events use UTC and controlled service time; external times retain source timezone and confidence.
quality.verification: Verify less than one second controlled clock skew and correct ordering across timezone, daylight saving and delayed external events.

quality.title: Numerical semantics
quality.statement: Missing, zero, not applicable, suppressed, indeterminate and failed values shall remain distinct throughout analysis and export.
quality.acceptance: Round trip tests preserve each state and do not convert missing clinical values to zero.
quality.realisation: All numeric views and exports preserve missing, zero, not applicable, suppressed, indeterminate and failed as separate states.
quality.verification: Round trip one fixture for each state through import, calculation, chart and export and compare exact meaning.

quality.title: Concurrent edits
quality.statement: Conflicting edits to controlled records shall be detected and resolved without silent last write loss.
quality.acceptance: Two simultaneous protocol edits produce an explicit conflict or preserved merge history.
quality.realisation: Edits use observed versions and controlled conflict resolution; immutable decisions are never automatically merged.
quality.verification: Save concurrent conflicting edits and verify both changes remain recoverable with explicit resolution.

quality.title: Accessibility baseline
quality.statement: Core user journeys shall meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including authentication, forms, data tables and error recovery.
quality.acceptance: Automated checks plus manual keyboard, screen reader, focus and zoom testing find no unresolved critical barrier.
quality.realisation: The shared shell, forms, tables, dialogs, authentication and recovery flows implement the required accessibility behaviours.
quality.verification: Combine automated checks with keyboard, screen reader, focus, zoom and error recovery testing against WCAG 2.2 AA scope.

quality.title: Task success
quality.statement: At least 90 percent of representative users shall complete each core role specific journey without facilitator intervention after standard onboarding.
quality.acceptance: Usability sessions include at least 5 participants per priority role and document failures and remediation.
quality.realisation: Role journeys expose status, owner and next action and are tested after standard onboarding.
quality.verification: Recruit at least five representative participants per priority role; report successes and failures per journey and check the 90 percent target.

quality.title: Navigation and status clarity
quality.statement: Every active object shall show its status, owner, next required action and applicable blocker in plain language.
quality.acceptance: Users correctly identify the next action in at least 90 percent of sampled task scenarios.
quality.realisation: Each active object header shows state, next required action, responsible owner and applicable blocker in plain language.
quality.verification: Ask representative users to identify the next action in sampled tasks and retain evidence of at least 90 percent correct identification.

quality.title: Error prevention
quality.statement: Consequential actions shall explain scope and consequences, require applicable confirmation and preserve recoverable drafts.
quality.acceptance: Tests prevent accidental publication, deletion and role escalation through one unintended ordinary click.
quality.realisation: Consequential actions use exact-scope confirmation and recent authentication; drafts are safely saved before step up.
quality.verification: Test accidental clicks, stale scope, changed recipients and cancel paths; no unintended destructive or release action should commit.

quality.title: Responsive support
quality.statement: Core metadata and incident workflows shall work at viewport widths from 360 CSS pixels through desktop sizes without loss of required actions.
quality.acceptance: Testing at agreed mobile and desktop sizes finds no blocked critical workflow or inaccessible control.
quality.realisation: Core metadata and incident screens reflow at 360 CSS pixels with accessible alternatives for wide matrices.
quality.verification: Exercise all required actions at mobile and desktop widths and ensure controls are neither clipped nor hidden.

quality.title: Browser support
quality.statement: The platform shall support the current and preceding major versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari at release, including agreed iOS and Android browser combinations.
quality.acceptance: The release matrix records tested versions and known limitations; specialised viewers declare separate support.
quality.realisation: The release record declares current and preceding major browser versions and agreed mobile combinations; specialised viewers state limits.
quality.verification: Run critical journeys on the actual release matrix and document any viewer-specific restrictions before assignment.

quality.title: Language readiness
quality.statement: All user facing interface strings shall be externalised with Unicode, locale formatting and expansion support; launch language is English plus approved country needs.
quality.acceptance: Pseudo localisation does not clip critical controls or corrupt exported clinical terminology.
quality.realisation: Interface strings, dates and numbers use locale resources while clinical units and codes remain explicit.
quality.verification: Use Unicode, expansion and right-to-left readiness fixtures as applicable; verify exported terminology and controls are not corrupted or clipped.

quality.title: Translation integrity
quality.statement: Clinical, consent and regulatory translations shall require qualified review and a linked source version before official use.
quality.acceptance: Unapproved translations cannot appear as final participant or authority documents.
quality.realisation: Translation approval binds source and language version and qualifies the reviewer for intended use.
quality.verification: Change source consent text and verify affected translations cannot remain official without renewed review.

quality.title: Assisted accessibility
quality.statement: Training and support content shall provide accessible alternatives for essential visual or audio information.
quality.acceptance: A user unable to use the primary media format can complete the same required training outcome.
quality.realisation: Essential learning media have text, captions or equivalent accessible alternatives linked to the same learning outcome.
quality.verification: Complete a required course without its primary visual or audio channel and verify equivalent assessment access.

quality.title: Critical monitoring
quality.statement: Core availability, errors, queue delay, access failures, backup failures and safety channel health shall have monitored indicators and accountable owners.
quality.acceptance: A controlled critical failure generates an operational alert within 5 minutes.
quality.realisation: Service indicators cover journey health, errors, queue delay, access failures, backups and safety channels with assigned owners.
quality.verification: Inject each critical fault and verify an actionable alert within five minutes, including correct scope and runbook.

quality.title: Incident acknowledgement
quality.statement: Priority 1 operational incidents shall receive human acknowledgement within 15 minutes under a staffed 24 hour rota.
quality.acceptance: Quarterly drills demonstrate contactability and backup escalation; ordinary support hours are separately published.
quality.realisation: P1 operations alerts use a staffed 24 hour rota with backup escalation and human acknowledgement distinct from delivery.
quality.verification: Quarterly drills require human acknowledgement within 15 minutes, including off-hours and primary contact failure.

quality.title: User communications
quality.statement: Affected institutions shall receive an initial major incident update within 30 minutes of confirmation and at least hourly while impact continues.
quality.acceptance: The communication log records delivery failures and contains no unauthorised sensitive data.
quality.realisation: Major incident communications show affected services, impact, status and next update without protected study data.
quality.verification: Verify initial update within 30 minutes of confirmation and at least hourly thereafter, retaining failures and corrected delivery.

quality.title: Traceability
quality.statement: Requests, jobs, decisions and exports shall carry correlation identifiers across supported services and connectors.
quality.acceptance: An incident investigation can connect the initiating request with all material outcomes.
quality.realisation: Every command, job, decision and exchange propagates a correlation reference to authorised diagnostics.
quality.verification: Trace an initiating request through connector, run, export and audit without relying on patient identifiers.

quality.title: Operational history
quality.statement: Searchable operational telemetry shall be retained for at least 90 days unless a stricter approved privacy rule applies; audit records follow their own schedule.
quality.acceptance: Operators can investigate a sampled 60 day old incident without accessing raw patient data.
quality.realisation: Telemetry retention defaults to at least 90 days subject to stricter approved privacy rules; audit uses separate policies.
quality.verification: Investigate a synthetic 60 day old incident from permitted metadata and verify no raw clinical content is required.

quality.title: Runbook coverage
quality.statement: Every critical alert shall have a tested runbook, owner, escalation route and recovery or safe shutdown action.
quality.acceptance: A new on call operator can execute sampled runbooks during a supervised readiness exercise.
quality.realisation: Each critical alert links a current tested runbook, owner, backup, recovery or safe shutdown procedure.
quality.verification: Have a newly assigned operator execute sampled scenarios in a supervised exercise and record gaps.

quality.title: Post incident review
quality.statement: Major operational incidents shall receive a documented review within 5 business days of stabilisation, with actions and owners.
quality.acceptance: Repeat causes and overdue actions appear in the service governance review.
quality.realisation: Stabilisation creates a post incident review task due within five business days with causes, actions and owners.
quality.verification: Verify due date calculation and escalation; repeated causes appear in service review even after incident closure.

quality.title: Release traceability
quality.statement: Every production change shall link approved requirements or fixes, verification evidence, release identity and accountable approval.
quality.acceptance: A sampled release can be traced to its business reason and rollback or recovery plan.
quality.realisation: Release records link changes to FS, QC or approved defect identifiers, tests, approval and recovery plans.
quality.verification: Sample every release type and reconstruct why it was authorised and how it can be recovered.

quality.title: Regression gates
quality.statement: All applicable P0 acceptance scenarios and affected clinical metric reference tests shall pass before release.
quality.acceptance: A failing critical permission, safety, provenance or metric test blocks deployment.
quality.realisation: Activation requires all applicable P0 and affected metric reference tests to pass with retained evidence.
quality.verification: Introduce a failing permission, safety, provenance or metric fixture and verify the release gate remains blocked.

quality.title: Rollback readiness
quality.statement: Ordinary application releases shall support rollback or a tested forward recovery within 30 minutes where data compatibility allows.
quality.acceptance: A rehearsal restores service without discarding acknowledged records or reviving revoked access.
quality.realisation: Release plans declare rollback or forward recovery and data compatibility limitations.
quality.verification: Rehearse recovery within 30 minutes where applicable, preserving acknowledged records and current restrictions.

quality.title: Migration assurance
quality.statement: Schema and configuration migrations shall validate record counts, relationships, permissions and representative values before completion.
quality.acceptance: A failed reconciliation prevents the migrated environment from serving affected production records.
quality.realisation: Migration produces counts, relationships, permissions, representative values and reconciliation results before reopening.
quality.verification: Inject a mismatch and verify affected migrated records remain unavailable while the authoritative source is recoverable.

quality.title: Interface stability
quality.statement: Published production APIs shall have at least 180 days deprecation notice except urgent security or legal changes with managed alternatives.
quality.acceptance: A breaking change cannot silently invalidate an agreed institutional connector.
quality.realisation: Interface lifecycle records expose versions, affected connectors, notice dates and approved urgent exceptions.
quality.verification: Attempt premature removal and verify the 180 day notice gate or explicit exception with managed migration.

quality.title: Dependency governance
quality.statement: Releases shall inventory software dependencies and licences, assess vulnerabilities and record supported lifetimes.
quality.acceptance: Unsupported critical dependencies have a funded replacement or approved time limited exception.
quality.realisation: Release evidence contains dependency inventory, licence assessment, vulnerabilities and support end dates.
quality.verification: Verify unsupported critical components have a funded replacement or independently approved bounded exception.

quality.title: Portability
quality.statement: Institutional metadata, evidence, audit exports and permitted assets shall be extractable in documented formats without proprietary reader dependence.
quality.acceptance: A clean environment reconstructs a sampled exported study and verifies its evidence references.
quality.realisation: Portable exports include readable reports, structured records, dictionaries, histories and relationship identifiers.
quality.verification: Reconstruct a sampled study in a clean tool environment without proprietary readers and verify evidence references.

quality.title: Environment flexibility
quality.statement: Country requirements for hosted, dedicated or institution operated execution shall be supportable through validated deployment profiles.
quality.acceptance: Each offered profile passes equivalent access, provenance, safety and operational gates before sale.
quality.realisation: Hosted, dedicated and local node profiles each declare supported functions, residency, operations and acceptance evidence.
quality.verification: Run equivalent access, provenance and safety checks before a deployment profile can be sold or activated.

quality.title: No universal clinical score
quality.statement: Each admitted clinical use shall have approved task specific thresholds, populations, uncertainty requirements and safety criteria.
quality.acceptance: An undefined threshold or unsupported population blocks a suitability conclusion.
quality.realisation: PRO requires approved task, population, uncertainty and threshold definitions; EVD checks them before suitability signoff.
quality.verification: Leave a clinical threshold undefined and verify no global default score or favourable result can bypass the blocker.

quality.title: Platform assistant safety
quality.statement: Platform AI features shall have zero observed critical access, unsafe action or fabricated approval failures in the approved release test pack.
quality.acceptance: The report discloses sample size and residual uncertainty; zero observed failures is not claimed as zero real world risk.
quality.realisation: Assistant activation retains the approved test pack and severe failure taxonomy; observed critical failures block release.
quality.verification: Test cross tenant leakage, unsafe action and fabricated approvals; disclose sample size and residual uncertainty even with zero observed critical failures.

quality.title: Generated factual grounding
quality.statement: Every material clinical or evaluative claim in a released AI assisted report shall be human verified against the linked approved source.
quality.acceptance: A random audit of released reports finds no unreviewed material generated claim.
quality.realisation: Report review tracks each material generated claim, accessible supporting source and human verification decision.
quality.verification: Sample released assisted reports and require every material claim to have eligible source verification.

quality.title: Model change regression
quality.statement: Every material platform model, prompt, tool or retrieval change shall pass task, privacy, permission and adversarial regression gates.
quality.acceptance: Changes cannot enter production based solely on improved average response quality.
quality.realisation: Model, prompt, corpus and tool changes create an impact record and require affected quality, privacy and adversarial regressions.
quality.verification: Attempt release with improved mean quality but a failing critical regression and verify denial.

quality.title: Human review independence
quality.statement: Automated scoring shall not be the sole adjudicator of clinical safety, ethics, legal applicability or final evidence approval.
quality.acceptance: Workflow tests require the appropriate eligible human decision for each protected outcome.
quality.realisation: Protected decisions require eligible human signers with independence and professional authority; judge scores are supporting evidence.
quality.verification: Attempt safety, ethics, applicability and final issue using only service or AI actors and verify denial.

quality.title: AI service continuity
quality.statement: Core study, incident and review workflows shall remain usable when optional AI services are disabled.
quality.acceptance: A simulated provider outage leaves manual authorised completion possible without data loss.
quality.realisation: Optional AI actions are separate from core drafting, task, review and incident functions.
quality.verification: Disable all AI providers and complete the authorised manual journeys without data loss or blocked incident intake.

quality.title: Cost attribution
quality.statement: At least 95 percent of variable infrastructure and external service spend shall be attributable to a programme, study or approved shared cost category.
quality.acceptance: Monthly financial reconciliation explains the remaining unattributed amount.
quality.realisation: Usage and external costs carry study, programme or approved shared allocation keys; finance reports residual unattributed spend.
quality.verification: Reconcile a month of synthetic bills and metering, showing at least 95 percent attribution and explanations for the remainder.

quality.title: Spending limits
quality.statement: All billable automated workloads shall have approved limits and warning thresholds at 80 and 100 percent of budget unless a stricter policy applies.
quality.acceptance: The hard limit prevents further unauthorised spending while preserving evidence and safe termination.
quality.realisation: Budget reservations and metering drive warnings at 80 and 100 percent or stricter thresholds and enforce hard stops.
quality.verification: Use concurrent jobs and retries near the ceiling to prove no unauthorised overrun while evidence and safe termination remain possible.

quality.title: Idle resource control
quality.statement: Unneeded compute shall be suspended within a configurable period, default 30 minutes, subject to active study requirements.
quality.acceptance: An idle workspace stops compute charges without deleting retained assets or disrupting a declared long job.
quality.realisation: Workspace status distinguishes idle from declared active long jobs and suspends unneeded compute after the configured interval.
quality.verification: Verify the 30 minute default stops compute charges without deleting retained data or interrupting a legitimately active job.

quality.title: Resource reporting
quality.statement: Where providers expose credible measurements, the service shall report compute consumption and estimated environmental impact with methods and limitations.
quality.acceptance: Estimates do not imply measured carbon emissions when only proxy data are available.
quality.realisation: Resource reports identify measured consumption, provider estimates, method and uncertainty separately.
quality.verification: Inspect an estimate based on proxy data and confirm it cannot be labelled measured carbon emissions.

quality.title: Operational ownership
quality.statement: Every production capability shall have an accountable product owner, operational owner and escalation route before activation.
quality.acceptance: No feature is released with an unassigned safety or maintenance responsibility.
quality.realisation: Feature activation records product, operations and relevant safety ownership with current escalation routes.
quality.verification: Remove an essential owner and verify new activation is blocked while continuity tasks are assigned.

quality.title: Documentation completeness
quality.statement: Each released role shall have current task guidance, access instructions, common error recovery and escalation documentation.
quality.acceptance: Representative users complete the documented core journeys without undocumented internal assistance.
quality.realisation: Each role has versioned task guidance, access setup, error recovery and escalation documentation linked from the interface.
quality.verification: Representative users complete core journeys using published guidance without undocumented internal assistance.

quality.title: Country launch readiness
quality.statement: Every active country shall have signed applicability, data, clinical, operational and commercial readiness records for its offered scope.
quality.acceptance: A country cannot be marked active through marketing configuration alone.
quality.realisation: Country activation requires signed applicability, data, clinical, operational and commercial readiness for offered scope.
quality.verification: Attempt activation through marketing configuration or a partially approved profile and verify denial.

quality.title: Service request response
quality.statement: Ordinary support requests shall be acknowledged within 1 business day and triaged within 2, with local calendar and support hours disclosed.
quality.acceptance: Reports measure compliance from receipt and distinguish acknowledgement from resolution.
