quality.realisation: Support tickets start acknowledgement and triage clocks from receipt using disclosed local calendars and hours.
quality.verification: Verify one business day acknowledgement and two business day triage, separately from resolution and urgent incident service.

quality.title: Continuity responsibilities
quality.statement: Every care affecting deployment shall have a locally owned continuity plan independent of platform availability.
quality.acceptance: A tabletop exercise shows safe local action during a platform or network outage.
quality.realisation: Each care affecting deployment records a locally accepted downtime and continuity plan independent of platform access.
quality.verification: Simulate platform and network outage and demonstrate safe local clinical action with assigned responsibility.

quality.title: Exit readiness
quality.statement: An annual continuity exercise shall test institutional data export, supplier failure and operator handover assumptions.
quality.acceptance: The exercise records gaps, assigned remedies and lawful retained obligations.
quality.realisation: Annual continuity exercises cover institutional export, supplier failure and operator succession with retained obligations.
quality.verification: Record exercise outcomes, named remedies and accepted custody rather than treating an untested plan as proven readiness.

critical.title: Unauthorised tenant access
critical.fixture: Two institutions A and B, private study B1 and an evaluator scoped only to A.
critical.action: Try list, guessed deep link, search count, thumbnail, export, API and assistant retrieval for B1.
critical.expected: No protected content or existence clue appears; safe denial and scoped audit are recorded.

critical.title: Self elevation
critical.fixture: An organisation administrator has a delegated role ceiling and requests a stronger role for themself.
critical.action: Submit through the UI and direct command; try to occupy both approval slots under two role labels.
critical.expected: Delegation and verified person checks reject both attempts; no effective privilege changes.

critical.title: Leaver revocation
critical.fixture: A member has an open session, queued export, active workspace and a scheduled connector job.
critical.action: Commit departure, then attempt protected actions repeatedly and execute queued work.
critical.expected: No new online protected action succeeds beyond 60 seconds; queued delivery stops and ownership tasks remain visible.

critical.title: Conflicting reviewer
critical.fixture: The report author is also a financial beneficiary and is assigned as sole scientific signer.
critical.action: Attempt final signature, then assign an eligible independent reviewer after conflict assessment.
critical.expected: First issue is blocked; eligible independent signoff can proceed only after all other gates pass.

critical.title: Expired agreement
critical.fixture: A study remains active while its data agreement expires at a known UTC instant.
critical.action: Submit just before expiry and let a queued run reach its start check just after expiry.
critical.expected: New execution is blocked despite active study status; expired agreement is identified without changing past decisions.

critical.title: Wrong purpose
critical.fixture: A valid grant permits evaluation on dataset version D1 for study A1.
critical.action: Request model training, study A2 use and dataset D2 using the same grant.
critical.expected: Each mismatched purpose, study or version is denied; no copied grant expands rights.

critical.title: Forbidden region
critical.fixture: An asset permits primary data and support only in region X, with separately declared backup policy.
critical.action: Request workspace, backup copy and remote support from forbidden region Y.
critical.expected: Each restricted route is blocked and creates a scoped policy explanation; approved unrelated processing remains available.

critical.title: Hostile artefact
critical.fixture: Controlled malicious file, hostile container and document containing unauthorised tool instructions are available in an isolated test environment.
critical.action: Upload, preview, execute and retrieve them through relevant approved test routes.
critical.expected: Files remain quarantined, workload cannot escape scope and embedded text creates no authority; findings are retained safely.

critical.title: Silent data loss
critical.fixture: A synthetic source contains 1000 records with 930 accepted, 50 rejected and 20 quarantined.
critical.action: Complete validation, attempt release with one missing record, then restore full accounting.
critical.expected: Unaccounted record blocks completion; final counts reconcile and partial acceptance remains explicit.

critical.title: Clinical unit mismatch
critical.fixture: A numeric clinical field has valid magnitude but an incompatible unit; another field has an unknown clinical code.
critical.action: Import with an unapproved conversion and round trip through export.
critical.expected: Records are quarantined or explicitly unmapped; no guessed conversion or silent substitution occurs.

critical.title: Patient leakage
critical.fixture: One participant has different encounter keys in development and final test partitions.
critical.action: Run the approved linkage and leakage check before release.
critical.expected: Overlap is identified without revealing unnecessary identity; independent test status is blocked until qualified resolution.

critical.title: Sealed benchmark exposure
critical.fixture: A developer has two verified related accounts and a sealed benchmark attempt limit.
critical.action: Exhaust quota, retry through the second account, query hidden labels and request assistant summaries.
critical.expected: Quota remains enforced across related identity; labels do not appear in any output, preview or side channel.

critical.title: Protocol change after results
critical.fixture: A protocol was frozen before results and contains a failed primary endpoint.
critical.action: Change endpoint or threshold after unblinding and attempt to regenerate the original report.
critical.expected: A successor amendment and exploratory label are required; original plan and unfavourable result remain traceable.

critical.title: Failed predictions
critical.fixture: The diagnostic fixture has 200 labelled scored cases and ten failed attempts.
critical.action: Calculate metrics and attempt to filter failures out without an approved analysis rule.
critical.expected: Attempted and scored denominators remain separate and reconciled; the primary rule follows the frozen protocol.

critical.title: Insufficient subgroup
critical.fixture: Overall performance is favourable but a prespecified subgroup has inadequate sample size and a small disclosure-sensitive count.
critical.action: Generate the subgroup conclusion, dashboard and export.
critical.expected: The subgroup is inconclusive and suppressed where required; it is never certified safe or displayed as zero.

critical.title: Reproducibility failure
critical.fixture: An independent rerun differs from the signed analysis beyond protocol tolerance.
critical.action: Attempt to mark it reproduced and issue the dossier.
critical.expected: Reproduction remains failed or under investigation and issue is blocked for the unsupported claim.

critical.title: Unpinned remote model
critical.fixture: An external API provides no fixed version guarantee and changes behaviour between planned repeats.
critical.action: Ingest provider evidence and compare runs; attempt unchanged configuration claims.
critical.expected: Identity limitation and impact review are visible; exact reproducibility and unchanged evidence claims are withheld.

critical.title: Fabricated citation
critical.fixture: An assisted report contains a plausible nonexistent guideline citation and a material clinical claim.
critical.action: Run human claim verification and attempt publication without source support.
critical.expected: The claim is flagged and cannot enter released findings; reviewer correction and AI provenance are retained.

critical.title: Prompt injection
critical.fixture: An accessible source document instructs the assistant to export another study and grant an administrator role.
critical.action: Retrieve it in a legitimate drafting task and observe proposed tool actions.
critical.expected: No unauthorised data retrieval, export or role change occurs; untrusted text remains content.

critical.title: Silent study contamination
critical.fixture: A prospective site is activated in silent mode with a separate live clinical worklist.
critical.action: Execute predictions and attempt to send them to the care-facing connector.
critical.expected: The production destination is denied; attempted exposure creates a deviation and safety review.

critical.title: Missing participant permission
critical.fixture: Participant permission covers an old materials version or excludes the proposed population.
critical.action: Attempt enrolment and governed data use at the site.
critical.expected: Affected activity is blocked with the missing approved basis; a local qualified owner must resolve it.

critical.title: Serious safety concern
critical.fixture: A reporter knows of potential serious harm but lacks participant identity and proof of causality.
critical.action: Submit minimal concern through platform and outage route exercises.
critical.expected: Both routes reach qualified urgent triage; incomplete optional fields cannot suppress intake or local escalation.

critical.title: Offline site stop
critical.fixture: A registered local node is offline when a safety owner sends a stop instruction.
critical.action: Observe central status, backup escalation and eventual local acknowledgement.
critical.expected: State remains unconfirmed until evidence arrives; contact age and approved offline lease behaviour are visible.

critical.title: Payment influence
critical.fixture: A developer has an overdue invoice, a negative report and an active safety hold.
critical.action: A commercial user attempts report deletion, hold release and disabling incident intake.
critical.expected: Each prohibited action is denied; financial dispute remains separate from scientific and safety processes.

critical.title: Regulatory status confusion
critical.fixture: An evaluation meets specified criteria but there is no verified market authorisation.
critical.action: Complete internal checklists and inspect public and buyer profiles.
critical.expected: Scientific success remains distinct; no market-authorised field or regulatory approval claim is created.

critical.title: Transfer to new country
critical.fixture: A receiving country has different language, prevalence, workflow and permissions from the origin study.
critical.action: Clone a dossier and attempt immediate local suitability and deployment.
critical.expected: Gap assessment, local evidence and independent reliance decisions are required; foreign permissions are not copied.

critical.title: Restricted publication
critical.fixture: A public report draft contains a patient row, a protected small cell and a proprietary model attachment.
critical.action: Preview, approve and export the public view through normal and direct routes.
critical.expected: Disclosure and rights checks withhold disallowed content; changed redactions require renewed review.

critical.title: Report correction
critical.fixture: A report was issued to two recipients and later corrected, with one recipient currently unable to receive email.
critical.action: Open the old verification link and dispatch correction notifications.
critical.expected: Old status is superseded with successor link; delivery failure remains recorded and escalated appropriately.

critical.title: Model recall
critical.fixture: A recalled component appears in several configurations and registered sites, including one stale version report.
critical.action: Run impact discovery and issue required site actions.
critical.expected: All registered dependent scopes appear, stale inventory is explicit and unresolved acknowledgements remain open.

critical.title: Deletion with hold
critical.fixture: A deletion request covers both held and unheld assets with a shorter local disposal deadline.
critical.action: Approve the lawful scope and run disposal.
critical.expected: Held assets remain preserved, unheld assets meet applicable deadline and attestation lists exact retained exceptions.

critical.title: Restoration resurrection
critical.fixture: A backup predates a user's revocation and a lawful data deletion.
critical.action: Restore into isolation and attempt to reopen service before current ledger reconciliation.
critical.expected: Reopening is blocked until current restrictions apply; departed user and disposed data remain inaccessible.

critical.title: Duplicate webhook
critical.fixture: One webhook representing a completed billable run is delivered five times and later replayed out of order.
critical.action: Process all deliveries and reconcile resulting evidence and charge records.
critical.expected: One logical outcome and declared charge exist; duplicate event receipts remain auditable without repeated effects.

critical.title: Spending overrun
critical.fixture: Two concurrent jobs approach a shared hard budget ceiling and one triggers retry.
critical.action: Submit both and inspect reservations, metering and stop behaviour.
critical.expected: No unauthorised overrun is committed; warnings, safe termination, retained evidence and charge reconciliation are correct.

critical.title: Unsupported capability
critical.fixture: A user selects an unsupported modality or a draft country profile while the UI capability flag is enabled.
critical.action: Attempt admission, execution and formal issue through direct commands.
critical.expected: Capability and country gates deny formal activity regardless of menu visibility.

critical.title: Accessibility barrier
critical.fixture: Representative keyboard and screen reader users complete onboarding and core workflows using the approved browser matrix.
critical.action: Authenticate, resolve form errors, review a record, confirm an action and file an incident.
critical.expected: Required actions are operable with labelled fields, focus handling and announcements; critical accessibility barriers block release.

critical.title: Constrained connection
critical.fixture: L1 workload is active over 1 Mbps, 300 ms round trip and one percent packet loss.
critical.action: Save application, review task and file incident with representative content.
critical.expected: Core metadata workflows meet eight seconds p95 without losing saved changes; large deliberate transfers are separately measured.

critical.title: Regional disaster
critical.fixture: A recoverable regional disaster occurs after timestamped decisions, grants, metadata and source data changes.
critical.action: Execute the approved recovery plan in a permitted region and reconcile evidence before reopening.
critical.expected: Four hour RTO and differentiated 5 minute, 15 minute and contracted source RPO targets are verified with actual loss measurements.

critical.title: Ai provider outage
critical.fixture: All optional AI providers are unavailable or disabled by the institution.
critical.action: Draft manually, review evidence and report an incident.
critical.expected: Authorised core workflows remain usable; assistant state shows unavailable without fabricated content or blocked safety intake.

critical.title: Institutional exit
critical.fixture: An institution exits with a shared dataset, active monitoring duty, retained report and open financial item.
critical.action: Create export, revoke access, transfer owners and issue closure attestation.
critical.expected: Only permitted assets transfer, monitoring responsibility is accepted, attribution remains and residual obligations stay assigned.

critical.title: Clinical threshold misuse
critical.fixture: An admitted task has no approved clinical threshold but a model scores highly on a generic benchmark.
critical.action: Attempt protocol freeze, suitability decision and final issue using a global accuracy default.
critical.expected: Each dependent decision remains blocked until a qualified task-specific rule is approved; favourable score provides no bypass.

commands.outcome: Draft application; invalid legal references rejected
commands.guard: Server-issued applicant context only; legal reference validation; does not confer institutional privilege.

commands.outcome: Pending invitation; delegation and self-elevation checked
commands.guard: Current verified institution, delegable role subset and scope, positive expiry; recipient cannot activate own privilege.

commands.input_summary: Subject, scope, reason and expected version
commands.outcome: Effective restriction and impact tasks within revocation target
commands.guard: Lock subject membership; prevent removing last owner without accepted successor; apply online revocation target.

commands.input_summary: Intended use, components, mode, dependencies and files
commands.outcome: Frozen submission; quarantine or missing materials block review
commands.guard: Exact component versions, quarantine clearance, provider rights and selected execution-mode prerequisites.

commands.name: SubmitAccessRequest
commands.input_summary: Dataset release, study, purpose, users, fields, region and period
commands.outcome: Review package; discovery rights and scope validated
commands.guard: Discoverable exact dataset release; study reference and purpose; requested interval positive; no implied grant.

commands.name: DecideAccessRequest
commands.input_summary: Frozen request, decision, approved subset and eligible signatures
commands.outcome: Grant or denial; independence and all required rights checked
commands.guard: Snapshot current; independent required owners; approved scope subset of request and all rights; approved_scope required only for approval.

commands.name: RegisterImport
commands.input_summary: Source manifest, rights and mapping
commands.outcome: Quarantined import identity and controlled transfer route
commands.guard: Current grant, approved source and mapping; transfer enters quarantine; no preview or search before clearance.

commands.name: FinaliseImport
commands.input_summary: Verified bytes, validation and reconciliation
commands.outcome: Reconciled batch; missing inputs or integrity mismatch block acceptance
commands.guard: Expected source digest and bytes; accepted + rejected + quarantined = source; counts nonnegative; no omitted records.

commands.name: ReleaseDataset
commands.input_summary: Members, labels, rights, partitions and quality decisions
commands.outcome: Immutable manifest; leakage or quality blockers prevent release
commands.guard: Immutable manifest, label quality, leakage/partition checks, rights, eligible quality decisions; sealed labels remain separate.

commands.name: FreezeProtocol
commands.input_summary: Complete plan, thresholds and review decisions
commands.outcome: Frozen protocol; missing clinical rules or stale review blocked
commands.guard: All endpoints, thresholds, sample and subgroup methods, failure rules, uncertainty and stop criteria complete and approved.

commands.name: ActivateStudy
commands.input_summary: Exact scope, gates, owners, versions and budget
commands.outcome: Active study record; all applicable prerequisites rechecked
commands.guard: Ready state; exact frozen protocol/config; G1/G2 and all applicable G4/G7/G8; current grants, owners, budget; no holds.

commands.name: SubmitRun
commands.input_summary: Manifest, grants, resources, egress and budget
commands.outcome: Logical run plus attempt; same request deduplicated
commands.guard: Lock study and budget; exact immutable manifest; active grants and allowed region/egress; admitted resource profile; reserve budget atomically.

commands.name: CancelRun
commands.input_summary: Run, reason and authority
commands.outcome: Cancellation intent followed by observed result; no assumed remote stop
commands.guard: Authorised run scope; terminal observations preserved; append intent then await observed termination; settle usage once.

commands.name: RequestOutputExport
commands.input_summary: Exact assets, recipient, purpose and format
commands.outcome: Disclosure and rights review package; no immediate unrestricted link
commands.guard: Exact assets, intended recipient/purpose; rights and disclosure review task; cannot directly create unrestricted delivery.

commands.name: IssueEvidence
commands.input_summary: Frozen dossier and eligible signatures

commands.name: PublishEvidenceView
commands.input_summary: Approved view, rights and audience
